'go brjod/—gling gi snying po1 gangs kyi ra ba/ chu bo kun gyi 'go bo/ ri mtho sagatsang / myi mdzangs shes dpa' ru skye/ rta mgyogs su 'phel ba'i gnas/zhes kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di lo ngo stong phrag gong nas rang cag bod kyi mesapos bsngags pa'i gdu gyur/ de lta bu'i bod mi rigs kyi tshe srog dang rig gnas kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i tsho gyi skye khams sam phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di dang phyogs gang thad nas mthun spyor dang / der srung skyong dgosatshi lta spyod ni bod mi'i 'du shes khrod du ྾gna' bo nas gas dar yod/de lta bu mi rgya klung rgya bsdams nas ri brag gang byung gis dang shig bdang /nags shing rang dag pa'i gas pa/ ༅ par mi dgas gcan gzan lags pa'i srog de bas mi 'phrog pa sogs kyi srol rgyun bzang po des rang ༅ bod mir 'tsho rten sbyin pa'i skye khams la gces skyong thub pa'i phan 'brasarlabs che thon tsho la mi rigs gzhan gyi skye bo mang pos yodang bsngagasabarjod zhu mus yis deng gi yo sngon thon sa rig lag yodang deng rabs can kyi dpal 'byor bar gyi chu gter ji bzhin 'phel rgyas shugasarṣa phyin te tsho rigs la zad mas ga pa'i dngos po'i longs spyod tsho dang sbyin bas tsho mod1 'on te bde bar 'a༅ba'i dngos po'i longasaspyod sbyin pa dang dus ma gas nas ba kyi ྾sa can 'tsho sdod byed ༅phyi — 1 —

bo kyi sbom ga zin sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga bsnod kyi 'jig rten nas skye khams khor yug 'dir mi'i rigs kyis 'dod dang mi 'dod kyi bzos pa'i gnod 'tshe chen po phog stong byung khams do skomanyamapar gyur pa dang skye khams khor yug je sdug je zhan du song nas/ mi'i rigasadang skye khams khor yug dbar mthun sbyor med pa/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyasadang skye khams khor yug srung skyong dbar gyi 'gal ba de rno ngar je cher 'gro bzhin yod la/ skye khams gnas bab zhan pas mi'i rigs la sdug spyong gtong ba sogs kyi ngan 'bras thon dang 'thon bzhin yod/ des na mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho rten sbyin pa'i skye khams la srung skyong byed rgyu ni skye bo kun gyi bzlog med kyi 'os 'gan yin pas gal te mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho gnas skye khamasalag ces spras dang srung skyong ma byas tshe/ mtha' mar mtho gangs ri dang pho ris 'thungs ba1 'og nags tshal dang spang ljongs kyis 'gebs pa/ sagazhir dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu klung babs pa dang g.yumatsho mdzes bkramasapa lta bu'i yum khyad par can bod khams 'di 'bas bcud nyams te ri klung kun du chu spyon sha 'od rgyas pa/ sbang ljongs bye ma'i thang du 'gyur ba/ bye 'tshung kyis nam mkha' bsgrib pa/ rang byung srog chags kyi rigs stong nga sogs kyi dusang na shar rgyu nyag cig yin/ de phyir skye bo kun gyis rnam pa kun du skye khams khor ༅srung skyong byed rgyu'i 'du shes nan 'dzin dang don de'i ga las rang bzhin la ngos 'dzin yo dag skye khams khor yug srung skyong gi don de rang gi snga phyi bar gsum gyi bya spyod dngos nang mtshon par byed rgyu ni gas 'gangs che bar mthong / da lam bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi sbu zhabs zla ba tshe rang dang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal rnams gnyis kyis bod kyi — 2 —

sa bcad dang bo/ 'dzam gling thog gi khor yug gnas tshulaXdang khoraXyug spung spyob kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/mi'i rigs kyi bya spyod dang yang na rang byung gi rgyu rkyen las khor yug la shugs rkyen 'gro ba dang / khor yug gi 'gyur ldog des mi'i rigs kyi thon skyed dang 'asngo bar 'gog rkyen bzo ba ma zad tha na bgegs dang gnod 'tshe bzo ba der khor yug gnad don zer/ khor yug gnad don kyi 'byung rkyen gtso bo ni/ mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho bdang thon skyed bya spyod dang gcig de bzhin rang byung gnod 'tshe bcas gnyis yin/ de yang rang byung gi rgyu rkyen gtso bo da chu log dang / than skyon1 rlung nag sa g.yo/ mtsho rlabasasogs 'jig rten chags pa nas bzung yod pa'i rang byung gi snang tshur bag la godagos shing / de dag ni rang byung khams kyi grub cha dang phyi sgod kyi 'jig rten la bdag pa'i rnam 'argyur dang gshis ka lta bu yin ba las 'dir brjod pa'i khor yug gnad don dngos de ma yin/mi'i rigs kyi bya spyod las rang byung khor yug la gtor bshig dang khor yug lord skyon ( bo༅)btang ba gnyis ni skabs 'di'i brjod bya gtso bo de yin/ de yang khor yug gtor bshig las byung ba'i gnad don ni — 1 —

bo kyi srol dpa sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga banags 'dzad pa las sa rdo rud pa dang / phyugs gas thal bas tswa thang gi 'khos nyams pa/ sa sbol bas yul lung bye thang du 'gyur ba/ khrel med du rngon pas srog chags kyi rigs mang po rtsa stong 'gro ba bcas gtor bshig btang tshe re zhig slar gsodaka' ba'am rtsa ba nas slar gso'i thub pa'i rigs dang / khor yug rdzad skyon ni gtso bo bzo las dang zhing las de bzhin grong khyer 'tsho ba las thon pa'i btsog snyigs rnams rang byung khor yug chen po'i nang 'phangs pa las khor yug gi rang bzhin gtsang ma der btsog snyigasakyi lhad skyon byung bar go dgos/ khor yug rdzad skyon de la yang rigs che ba gnyis te/ dngos rdzas las byung ba'i rdzad skyon dang / dngos rdzas kyi rang bzhin las byung ba'i rdzad skyon yin/ dngos rdzas las byung ba'i rdzad skyon la dbye na rlung rṣa dang / chu/ rten byed sa gzhi/ skyed dngos bcas kyi rdzad skyon dang / dngos rdzas kyi rang bzhin la dbye na/ sgra ngan dang / tsha gdugaglog khab len kyi rtsibs 'phro(za)bcas kyi rdzad skyon yin/khor yug gnad don ni mi'i rigs kyi 'phel rgyas la 'byar ba'i nyen zon cong brda lta bu zhig yin stabs dus dang skal bkun du khrel med kyisatshad las 'das pa'i bya spyod spel skabs lha gu rgyud dam gcig lagacig 'brel gyi lan 'char thon gyi yod/'on kyang dus dang skal pa so sor rnam ba re dang kun spyod re yod pasaskabs so so'i khor yug gnad don kyi rnam pa dang ngo bo yang ka'adra ba losayod/ deng rabs kyi mkhas pa tshos rang byung khor yug gi gnad don de dusamatshams gsum du dbye yod pa las/ dang po/ 'gro nga mi'i rigs byung nga — 2 —

'dzam gling tho ra yu sa la nga ra yu nga ba kyi la sa mar bsanas bzo las gsar brje'i ngar dang / gnyis pa/ bzo las gsar brje nas1984lor lho sne'i gling gi dku dbyang rim par bug rdol ba'i bar/gsum pa/ 1984nas da bar gyi deng rabs khor yug gnad don bcas yin/dang bo/ gdod ma'i kor yug gnad don/skal pa lo thog gam ches snga ba'i dus na da rnams kyang srog chagasagazhan dang la med du 'tsho gnas byed pa srog chags kyi gnas bab dang /denas rim bzhin rtsal dang shes pa skyes te stangs bde'i lag cha dang me la sogs pa'i nus pa'i 'byung khungs bod spyod thub pa las rang byung khamasa'adul ba'i nus stobs 'phel ba nas bzung mi'i rigs kyi bya spyod las khor yug la thog ma'i gnod 'tshe btang yod/ des na ches snga mo'i dus kyi srog la tsamang po rtsa stongs su song ba de mi rnams kyis tsho 'dzin med pa'i rngon rgyag byas pa'i tha 'bras yin par gal / 'on kyang skabs de'i ka' bor nyung la 'tsho sdod sa gnas kyang rgya chen po med pas rang byung khor yug khyon yongs la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen byung med/de nas mi 'bor 'phar ba dang zas kyi dgos ma khoskong ra 'debasalas kyi gon ma rgya cher la ba dang / ri skyes srog chags mi nyung bzhig g.yung du phab nas sgo phyugs rten pa dper na/ rang re'i mes po rnamasakyis 'brong sogs ri skyes srog la yod nyung bas ngo khri gcig tsam kyi gong nal yung du phab ste zhing 'brog las gnyer du spyod blta bu yin/ gzhan —3—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bayang lo khri gcig gong la 'dzam gling ka' bor gas lnga lhag tsam las med pa nas lo ngo 2000gong gi dung phyur gcig lhag tsam du 'phar yod/zhing las thon 'bab kyi ched du speng sbol ba dang shing nags gcod sreg dus stabs khor yug spyi dang bye brag tu skyes dngos khor yug lagator bshig chen po btang yod/ de'i skabs su rgya gar dang yodang gling du zhing las 'phel rgyas byung ba'i dpal yon mang po lugs dang ma mthun pa'i zhing las spos phyogs las nyams rgud byung stabs/ skabs de'i dpyod ldan pa mang pos zhing las thon skyed kyi byed thabs la ngo rgol dang zur za byas yod la tha na sa khul nyung shas su shing 'dzugs las don yang spel yod/ spyi lo'i gong gi lo590tsam gyi g.yas g.yon la gi ru'i dpyod ldan pa zo lon zhes pas zhing lasakyis nags tshal lagator bshig byung ba dang / sa zhing gi spus ka zhan du song ba mthong skabs skyu ru shing dang rgun 'brum sogs 'debs rgyur skul ma btang ba dang skabs de'i rgyal pos kyang skyu ru shing 'debs mkhan khag gcig la bya dga' sprad yod/ gzhan yang spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga'i nang dbyin ji sogs yod ba kyi sa khul khag tu rdo sol 'bor chen bed spyad pas mkha' rlung nang sol thal kyi rdzad skyon byung nas rdo sol bed spyod byed rgyur chod 'dzin mabyed ka med byung /rgya nag gi yul du yang / zhing las kyis khor yug la shugs rkyen byung ba ma zad/ thog ma kre'o nub ma'i skabs su shing bcad mi chog pa dang / ri skyes srog chags bsad mi chog pa/ chu 'gor bdag gces byed dgos pa — 4 —

'dzam gling tho ra yu sa zang nga ra yu nga ba kyi lo sa ma ra ba sabacas rtsa khrims thog bkod yod ④pa dang / de nas thang dang sung gi skabasartsa yang ri klung gi nags dang / ri skyes srog chags rnams rgyal khab kyi do dayobyed pa'i 'gan khri'i nang bcug pa ma zad/ rgyal sa'i nye 'khor du shing gcod dang srog gcod byas mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs byas yod/bod la cha mtshon na/ thog mar bod kyi gangs ri/ g.yang ri/ rdza ri/nags tshal/ sgangs ljongs sogs kyi steng na/ ri dwags sha ba/ dgo ba/'brong / gtsod/ stag dom/ gzig spre'u sogs dang de bzhin 'dab chags sna tshogs kyi khengs nas yod pa dang / de nas 'gro nga mi'i rigs byung nas lo thog srid pa'i bod zhes pa'i chos lugs shig dar ba dang / chosalugs 'di ni gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i thog dar ba zhig yin stabs/ 'byung ba lnga'i lhal mar de sems can bsad nas mas pa phul ba'i srol zhig dar ba dang / skabs de'i bod mis kyang 'brog las kyi zhor la ri dwags rngon nas 'tsho ba rol gyi yod par grags/ de nas ston pa gshen rang kyis po thog srid pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog g.yung drung sems dpa'i bon gyi chos lugs gsar du gtod de gdul bya bod mi rnams yang dag lam du dkrisaba'i chen du bon sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / sgo bzhi mdzod lnga/ theg pa rim dgu sogs bon gyi 'khor lo rgyas par bskor/ khyad par jeg pa riyodagu'i phywa gshen gyi theg pa'i nang du mi 'tshe nga'am srog gcod spangs ba'i ra du zan dpar gyi srol gtod pa dang spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa nas bzung nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bod du dar spel shugs chen byung ste/ semasacan la 'tshe ba spangs nas dge spyong la 'bad rgyu de'ang skabs de'i khrims— 5 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga b.lugs nang du bkod yod/de bzhin bod la bur thor rjes rngon rgyag gi las la bkag 'gog byed la / gtsang pa sde srid bstan skyong dbang po'i zhal lce bcu drug dang tā ba'i bla ma sku 'phreng lnga pa'i zhal lce bcu gsum sogs kyi nang du sems can gang byung du bsad mi chog pa'i bca' khrims mu mthud de gtan 'bebasamadzad pa dang de bzhin phag gru gi tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod kyi chab srid la dbang sgyur mdzad pa'i dus bod mi yon gas tsha la bdag skyongs kyi nus pa ka'adangs bar dgongs nas〈bka' yig yid bzhin nor bu'i bang mdzod〉ces bya ba'i nang du bod yongs la lo rer lcang ma 'bum phrag gnyis re la snyegs dgos pa dang / de dag la blta srung byed mkhan lcang khrims pa bskos pa lcang gcod byed skabs rtsa ba nas bkog da chog pa sogs rang byung khor yug la bdag skyong kyi nus pa thon pa'i bca' khrims mang dag cig gtan phabs mdzad yod/de ltar bod kyi chos lugs lta ba dang bca' khrims sogs kyi mthu lasabod mi'i dge sdeg gi blo rig je gal du phyin pa dang / sems rgyud dang kun spyod rje bzang du phyin nas gang byung du srog la yol gnod 'tshe dbyed pa dang / gang byung du khor yug la gnod 'tshe mi byed pa'i bar bas shes rig ldan pa'i goms gshis khyad du 'phags pa zhig rang rgyud la ma skul rang bzhin du 'jags thub pa byung yod/—6—

'dzam gling tho ra yu sa tshal nga ra yu ngab kyi lo la mar bsaganyis pa/ nye rabs kyi khor yug gnad don dang khor yug grung skyob kyi las don/dus rabs bco brgyad pa nasabazung nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab mang po'i nang tshan rig lag rtsal gong 'phel byung ba des bzo las thon skyed dar rgyas btang ba dang / mi'i 'tsho bar yang 'gyur ldog la po byung yod/ 'on kyang bzo las thon skyed de dag gtso bo nus pa'i 'byung khungs rdo la dang rdo snum la brten dgos bdang bzo las thon rdzas ma rgyu rnams gtso bo gter khasogs rang byung thon khungs las grub pa ma zad/ thon skyed dang 'dzad spyod kyi brgyud rim nang khor yug la rdzad skyon la po bzo gi yod/ dper na/spyi lo 1952lo'i zla ba lnga pa nas bdun pa'i ring dbyin ji'i rgyal sa kun ston du rdo la dang rdo snum gyi du bas mkha' rlung la dug dang rdzas 'gyur kyi lhad byung ste skomang por glo la sogs kyi nad gzhi phog pa ma zad/ de'i skangasasami khri gcig lhag tsam shi ba sogs bzo las ngod skyon las byung ba'i don rkyen dag a ri dang / 'jar pan/ dbyen ji sogs bzo las 'phel rgyas byung ba'i rgyal khab mang por thon pa dang / don rkyen dang rdzad skyon gi gnod 'tshe rim bzhin tshangs che 'gro ba des mi rnams kyis bzo las las byung ba'i khophan dang gnod 'al bskyar du mno bas yogatong rgyur sgul lcags thebs pa ma zad/ nub phyogs kyi dpyod ldan ba mang pos bzo las spyi tshogs nang gi —7—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bathon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i bya spyod mang por ngo rgol dang changs gcig rang byung khams la srung skyob byed rgyur re 'bod byas yod/dus rabs gong ma'i lor bas lnga bcu tsam nas bzung gsar 'god pa dang / tshan rig pa/ de bzhin mi sna grags can mang pos sbas gsang med par khor yug gnas tshu ther 'don byed 'go tshugs pa dang / da sna dang ma rtsa sgrig 'dzugs kyis khor yug gnad don la zhib la ga dang khor yug srung skyob byed pa'i las don de rgyal spyi'i thog ༅ 'go tshugs yod/ dper na/ rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa la ba96 dang rgyal spyi'i srog chagasajebs rtsa ba༅yo1969'dzam gling khor yug mnyam 'brel ba0ba ) sogasathebs rtsa mang po btsugs pa dang / spyi lo 1960lor stongs su nye ba'am rtsa la ri skyes srog ༅sa dang skyes dngos nyo tshong skor kyi rgyal spyi'i spyi chingasa'ajog rgyur gros 'go bton yod/ de nas lo rabs bdun hru'i nang 'dzam gling gi khor yug gnad don de bas tshangs cher song ba dang / chabs gcig khor yug srung skyong kyi las don dang khor yug gnod 'al ngo rgol byed pa'i khrom skor ga ri dang yodang gling du sgrig la shegs byas yod/ dper na/ spyi lo 970lo'i zla ba 4pa'i tshes22nyin a ri'i rgyal yongs su nan 'dzam gling sadakyil nyin mo mi mi zhes pa'i khrom skor nang slob grwa che chung bsdoms2500tsam dang / rgyal tshogs kyi la sa medang / bzo pa/ slob ma bsdoms mi grangasabye ba gsum tsam zhugs te/ khor yug la srung skyob byed dgos pa'i skor gyi gtam bshad dang 'bod sgra bsgrags pa ma zad lag tu par ris dang yig la sna la sa khyer nas ba'i ga skyon gyi gnod 'tshe ther 'don byas yod/ khroyo—8—

'dzam gling tho ra yu sa zung nga ra yu nga ba kyi lo sa ma ra ba saskor de ni khor yug srung skyob byed sgo'i nang gzhi rgya dang shugs rkyen che shos de yin pa ma zad/ mnyam 'brel rgyal gas kyi khor yug gas chen tshogasargyur sgul ma thebs pa dang / lo re'i zla ba 4pa'i tshes22de ‘‘'dzam gling sadakyil nyin mor gtan 'khel byas1spyi lo 1972lo'i zla ba 6par gi thog khor mo zhes par mnyam 'brel rgyalatshogs kyi khor yug gsam skong gas byas par rgyal khab 113dang rgyalaspyi'i sgrig tshogs khag gi sku tshab 1300tsam gas 'dur zhugs pa dang /tshogs 'du'i thog khor yug srung skyong kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang dngosayod gnad don la gros mol dang khor yug gnad don la ga gtad byed thabasaskor bzhib 'jug byas yod/ gas 'du de'i thog ‘‘sa gzhi ri mo gcig las med zhes pa'i 'bod ga bton nas rgyal khab dang dngo res rang byung khor yug dang rang byung thon khungs la srung skyob dang gron ༅ byas nasamirabs rjes mar bde skyid bskrun rgyur skul lcags byas yod/ gas 'du 'di ni mnyam 'brel rgyal tshog sgyu ma kyi lo rgyus thog gi khor yug skor gyi tshogs chen zangs dang po de yin la tshogs po der dran gsodang khor yug srung skyob laskul ma yong ra mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs nas lo re'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes5de‘‘'dzam gling khor yug nyi mor 3gtan 'a྾byas/ gas chen 'di'i thog‘‘logazhi ri mo gcig las med mi(྾17 ྾6 za'i11rwa)〈mtho—4/ sgyu〉zhes pa dang ‘‘mi'i rigs kyi khor yug bsgrags gtam 1(྾01sku1'i11༷sa tsoza⑪'ib༅bam110྾6༅1)〈ma༅mas bza〉gnyis tshogs 'du'i grub 'bras gtso lo rnam pa'i thog nas bton yod/— 9 —

bo kyi srol la la nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bgasum ba/ deng rabs mi kyi khor yugs srung skyob las don/spyi lo 1972lor khor yug tshogs 'du tshogs pa nas bzung khor yug srung skyob kyi las don la de bas do snang byas stabs sa khul nges can zhig tu grub 'bras yag po thon thub pa byung yod/ 'on kyang srung skyob las don gī gzhi rgya chung la 'gro gron gyi ma rtsa nyung bas 'dzam gling khyon yongs kyi khor yug gnad don tshangs cher 'gro ba der rtsa ba'i thog nas legs bcos dang bkag 'gog byed thub pa byung med/ spyi lo 1984lor dbyin ji'i tshan rig pasalhosne'i dku dbyang rim pa rdol ba shes pa des bskyar du rgyal spyi'i srung skyob lasadon la tsha 'ded byung zhing / skabs de'i khor yug gnad don gtso bo ni 'dzam gling drod la 'phar ba dang / dku dbyang la gnod 'tshe byung bsaskyur char bab pa bcas yin la khor yug gnad don de dag gis1992lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs nas yang bskyar khor yug gnad don gtso bor byasapa'i tshogs chen tshogs rgyur skul lcags thebs yod/ la sa chen de'i thog rgyal khab mang po'i gtso 'dzin dang rgyal spyi'i sgrig la gas khag gi mkhas pa 'bor chen zhugs pa dang / tshogs 'du'i thog 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i mkha' rlung rdzad skyon dang / nags tsha / skyur char/ tshwa med chu/ ri skyes srog la sa/ skye dngos/ gnam gshis sogs la grosabasdur dang dbye zhib byas pa ma zad/ de dag la kha gtad lcog rgyu'i rgyal spyi'i thabs jus sna tshogs gtan 'khel byas te 'dzam gling yongs kyis khor yug — 10 —

'dzam gling tho ra yu sa tshal nga ra yu nga ba kyi lo sa ma ra ba sagand don la 'gog bcos byed rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag yod1gas 'du'i thog‘‘khor yug dang 'phel rgyas bsgrags gtam (྾01'i1'i110༅01ba110sa 6༅1 'is6ba0ma0109yo6༅1)(ba༅bza〉dang ‘‘dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros rim (khu6ba6'i21)〈21 tsho phrejiyong〉zhes pa'i yig char gros 'cham byung ba dang / gzhan yang ‘‘gnam gshis 'gyur ldog gi sgrom gzhi'i spyi ྾sa 〈gas༅ tshoḥ༅yi phre3〉(la50ba1྾0yo01smo ①sa56ba11༷ba 0ba 611ba'i10 65mas lha6)dang ‘‘skyes dngosasna mang rang bzhin gyi spyi ྾sa 〈150 21cha1ma'u1bya117 11tso67)〉〈༅oṃzos g.yi༅〉gnyis la ming rtags bkod yod/lhag par du ‘‘dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros rim la 'dzam gling rgyalakhab dang srid gzhung mang pos rgyab skyor dang lag bstar byas yod pa/dper na/ rgyal khab brgya lhag tsam gyis gros rimadon a yong ra ra mngags yon lhan khang btsugs pa dang sa gnas srid gzhung 1600lhag tsam gyis rang rang sa khul kyi dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros rims gtan 'khel byas yod/‘‘dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros rim gyi snying don ni khor yug gnad don de 'dzam gling rgyal khab yongs dang mi rigs tshang mar 'phrad pa'i dka' ngal zhig yin stabs rgyal khab tshang ma mnyam 'brel byas te dka' ngalade dag yo bsad byed rgyu dang / khor yug la srung skyob dang thon khungs la gron chung yong rṣa rgyal khab rsha mas rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi thabs jusadang / 'char gzhi/ srid jus bzo rgyu ma zad nges par du don a yong ba — 11 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babyed rgyu de red/rang rgyal srid gzhung gis gros rim der gang mgyogs shogs 'degasadang / rgyab skyor/ lag bstar bcas yong ra krung dbyang gi thad ka'i 'go khrid 'og ra du mi sna sgrigs logs byas te krung go'i dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros rim bzos pa der rgyal srid spyi khyang khang gi rgyun las lnga yon sasathengs16pa'i thog gros 'cham byung ba dang / de ni 'dzam gling thog gi rgyalakhab rim pa'i gros rim ang dang po de red/le'u 'di'i mchan 'grel/④(sa༅0 〉mas ༅ma ༅za༅ tshogs ༅kar tho zam1)0 zo ༅za༅༷

sa bcad gnyis pa/ deng rabs khor yug gnadadon dang de dag gi gnod 'che/dang bo/ 'dzam gling gnam gshis kyi 'gyur kyi ldogagacig 'dzam gling gnam gshis dro rus 'gro ba/sa gzhi ril mol sa pa'i brgyud rim nang 'dzam gling gi gnam gshis la 'gyur ldog 'dra min sna tshog sgyu ma byung yod pa dang / dngo khri gcig tsam gyi sngon nas bzung gnam gshis la rtsa ba'i 'gyur ldog chen po byung med pa tshan rig pas shes rtogs byung ba ltar yin/ de yang gnam gshis brtan po dgos par cha rkyen gtso bo gcig yod de/ logazhi ril mor 'phro ba'i nyi ma'i tsha nus de dang la go la dang rlung chen bang rim las 'thul ba'i tsha nusaganyis do snyoms dgos/ 'on kyang bzo las dang zhing las gtso bor byasapa'i mi'i bya spyod las rlung chen bang rim nang chu rlung dang dbyang gnyis thun 'gyur (ba)de bzhin dku dbyang sogs drod rlung gi lhad la po byung ba nas bzung gnam gshis yang rim bzhin tsha drod che ru phyin yod/ lhag par du dbyang gnyis bā na 'gyur gyi rdzad skyon dang gnam gshis kyi 'gyur bar 'brel ba chen po yod/ nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi bzo las gsar brjes bzo las dang dpal 'byor la rnam pa gsar pa zhig bskrun pa dang dus mtshu sa— 13 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga brlung chen bang rim la gtor bshig gtong 'go yang brtsams pa yin/ skabasade'i bzo las thon skyed nang rdo sol dang rdo snum gnyis 'bar rdzas gtso bo yin pa dang 1 'bar rdzas de rigs las byung ba'i dbyang gnyis ston 'gyur tshang ma thad kar rlung chen bang rim nang slebs kyi yod/ tshan rig pas zhing 'jug byas par ltar na/ nye ba'i lo brgya'i nang 'dzam gleng gi drod ba 0 3༷dun ga 6༷6bar phar yod la/ rgya mas mtho tshad li rngid 10—25bar 'phar yod/①gnyis/ gnam gshis 'gyur lhog las byung ba'i gnod 'che/④ gnam gshis kyi drod tshad phar skabs sa khul nges can zhig tu char rgyun che ru 'gro ba dang / yang sa gnas mang por than skyon sogs kyi rang byung gnod 'tshe gsar pa yong rgyu dang /④ 'dzam gling ming bor gyi gsum zur gcig mtsho rgyud du gnas yod pa ma zad sa khul de dag gi dpal 'byor dang grong khyer gyi 'dzugs bskrun yag po yod pa red/ 'on kyang drod tshad 'phar skabs skam thog dang sne gnyis kyi gangs dang 'khyags rom rnams bzhu nas rgya mtshor bab pas rgya mtsho'i mtho tshad lo ltar 'phar gyi yod/ tshod rtsis byas par gzhigs na spyi lo 2100tsam la rgya mtsho'i mtho tshad li thid 50tsam 'phar gyi yod pas mtsho rgyud sa khul du mtsho kha lud pa'i gnod 'tshe yong nges yin/ ④ drod sa 'phar skabs rims nad kyi gnod 'tshe rgya cher 'gro rgyu dang nad gzhi'i nyen kha yang che ru 'gro nges yin/— 14 —

nga zag bas zad (thu nga 'byed① rang re'i ljongs la mtshon na gcig nas poms rdom rnams bzhu nas sa khul mang por skam skyon yong rgyu dang / gnyis nas dbyar dus yo zhod rgyas nas chu skyon thon pa/ gsum nas gangs ljongs su gangs mthong rgyu med pa chags srid/gsum/ gnam gshis 'gyur lhog la tshod 'dzin byed rgyu'i thabs jus/drod rlung las 'dzin dang gnam gshis 'gyur ldog gi gnod 'tsher bkag 'gog byed ched/ spyi lo1992lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi khor yug dang 'phel rgyas gas chen thog〈gnam gshis 'gyur ldog gi spyi chingasasgrom gzhir〉mos mthun byung ba dang / de nas1997lor ljar pan du gnam gshis 'gyur ldog skor gas chen gas te drod rlung gi rdzad skyon las 'dzin byed rgyu dang / 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i rgyal khab kyi drod rlung 'bud sa la gtan 'khel grangs ga bzos pa red/ drod rlung 'bud ba las 'dzin dang drod rlung de dag sim len byed rgyu ni mig snga'i las don gtso bo de yin/ de yang drod rlung 'bud ba lar 'dzin byed rgyu gtso bo ni 'bar rdzas do sol dang rdo snum la tshod 'dzin dang drod rlung sim len byed thabasagatso bo ni shing tshogs nags gas byed rgyu dang 'bar rdzas las thon pa'i dbyang gnyis zan 'gyur rnams dbye 'byed bsdu len byas nas sa 'og du sbasargyu de yin/— 15 —

la la la srog la sa nga nga sa la ba pa nga ba/gnyis pa/ dku dbyang rims par gtor kyi bshig byung ba/gcig dku dbyang rim par ji ltar byas nas gtor bshig byung tshul/rlung chen bang rim nang dku dbyang ha cang nyung nyung yin/ 'on kyang der nus pa chen po yod/ dku dbyang gis skyes dngos la gnod 'tshe yod pa'i nyi ma'i sprug phyi'i thig rnams sim len byed thub/ gal srid gnod 'tshe yod pa'i sprug phyi'i thig rnams thad kar skyes dngos dang grol phog na 'tsho gnas la dka' ngal chen po bzo gi yod pa red/nye rabs kyi bzo las thon skyed dang rdzas 'gyur dngos rigs lasathon pa'i rlung yan dang dngos rdzas kyis dku dbyang dang de'i nus par nyamasargud chen po byung yod/ dper na/ rlangs 'khor dang / khyem spyod glog chas/rdzas 'gyur thon rdzas bcas kyi dgos mkho skong cad lor bas nyi shu'i nang hphu li ang (༅ka1za)zhes pa'i rdzas 'gyur dngos rdzas gsar du bzos rjes rlung chen ngang rim nang hphu len ang gi lhad can po byung yod/ hphu len ang dang dku dbyang gnyis 'dres skabs dku dbyang gi ngo bo 'gyur pa ma zad nus pa shor bas dku dbyang gi 'bor la du 'gro gi yod pa red/gnyis/ dku dbyang ka nus pa nyams ba las byung ba'i gnod 'che/zhib 'jug byas par gzhigs na/ gal srid dku dbyang gi 'bor brgya cha 1chags na/ sa steng du sprug phyi'i thig brgya cha 2'phar ba dang /— 16 —

dang rngodang ba ba zad /thu snang sgyuradaganod 'tshe yod pa'i sprug phyi'i thig 'phar tshe gsham gsal gnod 'tshe yong rgyu yin/④ lpags nad 'bras skran dang ling sgrib/ rims nad kyi na tsha mang po thon rgyu dang rims 'gog nus pa nyams pa/④ skyes dngos kyi skye tshar dang thon 'bab zhan du 'gro ba/④ bod la yang nyi 'od kyi tsha dub de bas che ru 'gro ba ma zad skyes dngosadang mi'i 'tsho bar dka' ngal bzo nges yin/gsum/ dku dbyang la spung skyob byed thabs/mnyam 'brel rgyal tshog rje pa kyi skul slong 'og spyi lo 1985nas bzung rgyal spyi'i gas 'du thengs mang gas nas dku dbyang laganod 'tshe yod pa'i rdzas 'gyur la rdza 'dzin dang bed spyod byas mig pa'i gtan 'as byasayod/gsum pa/ skyes dngos 'dra min rdamaXgrangs nyams rgud du 'gro ba/gcig skyes dngos 'dra min rdam grangs kyi rin thang /skyes dngos 'dra min rnam grangs(༅oṃ༅gas)zhes pa ni sa khul nges can du yod pa'i rgyud 'dzin gzhi rgyu (༅za)dang / skyes dngos kyi rigs1 skye khams bcas sna 'dzoms pa'i ma lag spyi lo go dgos/ skyesadangos 'dra min rnam grangs kyi rin thang rgya che bas re re bzhin brjod thabs— 17 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bamed/ 'on kyang nga chos stabs bde'i thog nas dbye na gtso bo thad ka dang gzhan rgyud kyi rin thang gnyis ldan yod pa re'u mig ltar/spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang mi'i 'tsho ba ni skyes dngos dang srog gas de bzhin rang byung thon khungs la brten dgos pa dper na/ zasarigs kyi ngos nas bshad na/ 'dzam gling thog gi skyes dngos rigs khri 8tsayozas su rung ba dang / skyes dngos las thon pa'i zas rigs kyis zas kyi brgya cha 90tsam zin gyi yod/ gzhan yang sgo phyugs dang ri skyes srog chags kyis za bca'i rigs phun sum gas su btang ba ma zad 'tsho bcud gtso bor 'gyur yod pa dang / sman dang sman rdzas kyi ngos nas bshad na deng rabs kyi rdzasa'agyur sman rdzas mthon gong sman rigs tshang ma skyes dngos dang srog chags— 18 —

nga zad bas zad sdig nga sgyur byed1las grub pa dang deng skabs yang skyes dngos dang srog chags rnams sman gyi rgyu cha ga bo bo yin pa ma zad/ sman bcos kyi nus pa mngon gsal dod po yod/bzo las thon skyed kyi ngos nas bshad na/ bzo las thon skyed kyi rgyu cha gtso boni shing cha dang 'thug sogs skyes dngos la brten dgos kyi yod/gnyis/ skyes dngos 'dra min rdam grangs nyams grud du 'groXba'i rgyud rkyen/dus yun ring po'i lo rgyus nang skyes dngos dang srog gas kyi rigasa'adra min sna gas rang rang la 'a྾sa pa'i 'tsho sdod cha rkyen 'og 'tsho gnasadang 'phel rgyas thub pa byung yod/ 'on kyang nye ba'i lo brgya ༅ nang 'dzam gling ka' bor rgya cher 'phar ba dang / khor yug la dzad skyon de bzhin gnayogashes 'gyur ldog sogs kyi rgyu rkyen dang gnod 'tshes skyes dngos dang srog chags mang po rtsa stong du song ba dang / de bas mang ba zhig rtsa stong 'gro nyen yod pa'i long ba'i gnas tshugazhig gas yod/rtsa stong song ba dang 'gro nyen yod pa'i skyes dngos dang srog chags rigs/④④ (kṣa7ba༅ma〉— 19 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bskyes dngos 'dra min rnam grangs nyams rgud 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo khag gsham gsag/④ nags྾ dang rtsi shing la gcod bsregs kyi gtor bshig btang bas skyes dngos dang srog ༅sa mang po'i 'tsho sdod cha rkyen med par bzos pa dang /④ sa zhing gsar sbol dang ra rgal gyi phyugs gsos kyis sa thang lanyams nyes byung ba/④ skyes dngos dang ri dwags bag med kyi rngon pa dang gnod 'tshe btang ba/④ bzo las dang grong khyer 'phel rgyas kyis skye khams la rdzad skyon dang gnod 'tshe btang ba/— 20 —

nga rabs ra yu ma nga 'tshe/④phyi rol las 'ong ba'i skyes dngos dang srog chags kyis sngar yod skye khams la gtor bshig btang ba/① ྾ min kyi a skor spro 'cham gyi skye khams la gnod 'tshe btang ba/④chu dang sa zhing / mkha' rlung la rdzad skyon gyi lhad byung nas shing nags dang srog chags la gnod 'tshe btang ba/④ gnam gshis 'gyur ldog gis skye khams la nyams rgyad byung ba sogasayin/gsum/ skyes dngos 'dra min rdam grangs la spung skyob byed thabs skor/lo rabs70nas bzung rgyal spyi'i thog skyes dngos 'dra min rnam grangs la srung skyob byed za kyi spyi ྾sa mang po gtan 'pha byas yod pa dang / spyi lo1992lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi khor yug dang 'phel rgyasagasam thog‘‘skyes dngos 'dra min rnam grangs kyi spyi ྾sa la grosa'acham byung ba ma zad gsad de'i thog66'dzam gling skyes dngos 'dra min rnam grangs la srung skyob byed rgyu'i thabs jus gsal bsgrags byas yod/skyes dngos 'dra min rnam grangs srung skyong byed rgyu'i thabs shes gtso bo ni rang byung srung skyob gsags rgyu de red/ lor bas70nas bzung rang byung srung skyob khul gyi grangs 'bor dang rgya khyon nyin re bzhin 'phar ba dang / spyi lo1990lor rang byung srung skyob ga gyis 'dzam gling skams brgya cha 5yan zin yod/— 21 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babazhi pa/ sa zhing thang nod duX'agyur ba/gcig sa zhing thang nod du 'gyur ba'i spyi'i gnas bab/sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba zhes pa ni shin tu skam pa dang skam shas che ba yang na rlan sa rnams mi'i bya spyod dang gnam gshis kyis rkyen bsas zhing de dag gi dpal 'byor thon skyed kyi nus pa nyams pa'am yang na rtsa ba nasashor ba la zer/ sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba la rigs bzhi ste/ ① lhag pas khyer ba'am bsnan pa/ ① chus khyer nas sa rgod chags pa/ ④ dngosapo'i chos nyid dang rdzas 'gyur shugs rkyen las sa zhing sra po chags pa dang skam nas nus pa shor ba/ ④ bzo las dang gter 'don gyis thad kar gtor bshig btang ba dang rdzad skyon byung ba bcas yin/sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba de 'dzam gleng khor yug dang dpal 'byor kyi gnas tshul tshabs che shos shig yin/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi tshod rtsis byas pa lagazhigs na/ 'dzam gling gi sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba de spyi lo 1984lo'i spyi ching dung phyur 34 75nas spyi lo 1991lo'i spyi ྾ dung phyur 35 92du 'phar yod pa des 'dzam gling skam lo bzhi zur gcig zin gyi yod pa dang / lo ltar spyi ching khri 600tsam thang rgod du 'gyur bzhin yod lda④ bod kyi sa khul 'di yang sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba'i sa gnas gtso bo gcig yin/ dper na/ spyi lo 2000lor tshad rtsis byas par gzhigs na — 22 —

bsgyu dang kyib zad /thu snang sgyur zudaljongs yongs kyi sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba'i rgya khyon spyi ྾ gas gnyisayan zin yod/gnyis/ sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen dang gnod 'che/sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba de la mi dang rang byung gnyis kyi rgyu rkyen yod pa de rang byung gyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni rlung dang / yo pa/ than skyon sogs gnam gshis kyi cha rkyen las byung ba'i sa zhing skam pa dang khyer ba de bzhin skyes dngos nyams rgyud song ba lta bu dang / mi'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni phyugs gas thal ba dang / nags tshal gcod sreg byed pa/ spang dang na ga sbol ba bcas la go dgos/'brel yod sgrig tshogs dang ba zhib pas rtogs zhib byas par gzhigs na 'dzam gling thog sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo che shos ni phyugs gas thal drag pa dang / spang dang rtsi shing lagator bshig btang ba/ ྾ min gyi zhing las bcas yin/ bod kyi byang thang dang /mnga' ris/ gzhi rtse bcas kyi sams da thang mang che ba spus ka zhan khar slar gso'i nus pa chung pa'i thog nye rabs kyi 'brog las 'phel rgyas dang /gter 'don/ grong khyer logs bskrun sogs kyi shugs rkyen mas tswa thang nyams rgud chen po byung yod/sa zhing thang rgod du gyur ba'i shugs rkyen dang gnod 'tshe ga bo bo ni sazhing gi thon skyed nus pa dang 'khos ka nyams nas zhing 'brog las kyi thon ba bsags pa dang / sa khul mang po'i mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba zhan du 'gro ba — 23 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba/dang / tha na dbul phongs su 'gyur ba de yin/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi tshod rtsis byas par gzhigs na lo re sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur bas dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun a sgor dung phyur 200tsam zin gyi yod/gsum/ sa zhing thangaXrgod du 'gyur bar 'gog bcos byed thabs/spyi lo 1977nas bzung mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur bar 'gog bcos byed pa'i las ka'i 'char gzhi bzos pa dang /spyi lo1996lor‘6gling chen a lha ri kha gtso bor byas pa'i rgyal khab khag tu than skyon dang thang rgod 'gog bcos byed pa'i spyi ྾sa gtan 'khol byas par rang rgyal yang spyi lo1996lor de'i nang zhugs pa red/sa zhing thang rgod du 'gyur ngar 'gog bcos byed thabs gtso bo ni/① dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang thon khungs srung skyobazung 'brel gyi srid jus bzo rgyu dang / ④ gzhing bed spyod kyi sgrig gzhi dang 'char gzhi gsar pa bzo rgyu/ ④ ba thon khungs la bkol spyod lugs mthun yong nga byed rgyu/④phyugs gso thal ba dang tshul min gyi gsar sbol la bkag 'gog byed rgyu bcas yin/

nga zad bas zad (thu nga 'byedalnga pa/ nags tshal gtor bshigagacig 'dzam gling nags tshal gyi gnas bab dang nyams rgyad 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen/nags tshal ni skam thog skye khams kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig yin pa ma zad/'byung ba do snyom par byed pa dang / sa chu 'dzin pa/ chu log 'gog pa sogs kyi dmigs bsal nus pa yod/ 'on kyang nags tshal gyi rgya khyon de lore bzhin ༅sa 'gro ba dang lhag par du 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khang nang nags tshal la gtor bshig gnod 'tshe de bas che ba yod/ spyi lo 1980nas1990ring nags྾ rgya pho spyi chings khri 9950rtsa stong phyin yod/nags྾ gyi rgya khyon chung du 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo khag lnga ste/ ④bzo las thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho skong ra du nags྾ rgya rṣa po bcad pa dang / ④ka' bor 'phar bas na gas bcad nas zhing las༅ ba/ ① 'dzam gling mi 'bor gyi brgya cha 50tsam gyi 'tsho ba'i 'bar rdzas shing la rten dgos pa/ ① nags bcad nas 'brog las༅ ba/ ④ mkha' rlung rdzad skyon gyis nags྾ gyi thon bang dang spus ga nyams pa bcas yin/gnyas/ nags tshal nyams pa'i gnod 'che/gong du brjod pa ltar nags tshal ni skamathog skye khams kyi grub cha gtso — 25 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babo zhig yin pas nags྾ gyi rgya khyon chung du 'gro ba des 'dzam gleng gi gnam gshis dang / skyes dngos gzhan gyi 'tsho gnas/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba de bzhin sa zhing gi chu 'dzin nus pa bcas la gnod 'tshe chen po yod/dper na/ sa khul mang por nags྾ stong nas chu skyon thon pa dang sa zhing mang po chus khyer nga/ nags khul du yod pa'i skyes dngos dang srog chagasamang po rtsa stong du 'gro gi yod pa red/gsum/ nags tshal spung skyob skor gyi rgyal spyi'i bya thabs/lor bas80nas bzung mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogan ma kyis na gas tshal srung skyob byed ra snga rjes tshogs bsgrags dang spyi chings sna gas gtan 'khel byas yod/ spyi lo 1992lor‘‘nags྾ skor gyi rtsa don ga྾ bsgragasarngobaton pa dang / de rjes‘‘rgyal spyi'i tsha khul shing za gros mthun dang /‘‘'jigs nye'i ri skyes skyes dngos dang srog gas kyi rgyal spyi'i spyi ྾sa gtan 'khel byas te nags྾dang rtsa za skyes dngos la srung skyob byed rgyu de rgyal khab tshang ma'i 'os 'gan du gtan 'khel byas yod/drug pa/ chu'i rdzad rgyon dang chuXdakon pa'i dka' ngal/rigacig chu'i rdzad spyon/ba 'khor bskyod de ni skyes dngos 'tsho gnas dang 'phel rgyas kyi srog rtsa yin/ ba 'khor bskyod kyi rgyud rim nang chu rnams rlangs 'gyur — 26 —

zang ba pa'i ba'i ga bad sdig zang rten zudagyis bar snang rlung khams chen po'i nang 'gro ba dang / chu rlung rnams༅ khams nang sil 'bru chags rjes rim bzhin sa thog du lhungs nas char ba'ang ba kyi yod pa red/ ༅ 'khor bskyod kyi rgyud rim des rab byung khamasakyi chu la nus pa gsar pa bskyar skyes yong gi yod pa dang / nus pa de lasasathog gi tshe srog la skyes stobs kyi go skabs sprod gyi yod/ 'on kyang mi'i bya spyod las rang byung gi ba 'khor bskyod der 'gyur ldog 'gro bzhin yod pa ste/ra rtsis byas pa la gzhigs na spyir rgyugs ma bzhi cha gcig tsam mi'i 'tsho ba dang thon skyed thad bed spyod byed kyi yod pa des sa thog dang sa 'og gi ma 'bang rgyun dang de'i 'brel bar gnod 'tshe chen po yong gi tsho/ da yod 'dzam gling thog gi ba 'byung khungs tshang mar rdzad skyon gyi lhad slebs yod/de yang jod skyon gtso bo gnyis yin te/ gcig rtsi shing dang nags tshal kyi gtor bshig las yum lung mang por char chu dang gtsang pos sa rdo thad kar khyer bas chu nang sa dang bye ma'i lhad shugs che ru 'gro ba/ gnyis/ mi'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba spyod phyogs las byung ba'i gad snyegs kyi rdzad skyon de yin/rgya mtsho ni 'dzam gleng yongs kyi ba yong khungs gtso bo de yin la desas gzhi ril mo'i rgya khyon gyi brgya cha 71 8tsam zin gyi yod/ skam sa'i thog gi chu dang rlung chen bang rim nang gi ba mtha' ma'i gro sa yang rgya mtsho de yin larlung rṣa dang skams 'o thog gi gad snyegs kyi 'gro sa yang de rang red/ rgya mas zad skyon gi yong khungs gtso bo dag tsang po'i nang du skyur nga'i gad snyegs dang thad kar mtsho thog rtsa spos kyi ba'i bya spyod dper na snum 'don pa de — 27 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babazhin mtsho thog 'grem 'grul/ snum gru rdol ba sogs yin/ tshod rtsis byasapar gzhigs na ④lo ltar snum gru rdol ba dang yang na mtsho thog rdo snum 'don pa las snum kung hreng dung phyur 2tsam rgya mtsho'i nang chu dang 'dres kyi yod/spyi lo 1989lor a mi ri ka'i snum gru chen po zhig mtsho'i nang gi brag rdor rdab nas khyon bsdoms snum ston khri 12000tsam rgya mtsho'i nang chu dang 'dres pa dang de rjes lo lnga'i nang 'dzam gleng gi mtsho gzig gsum cha gcig tsam nyung du song yod/ de ni rgya mtsho la dug btab/ ri bo la rtse btang zhes pa'i gtam dpe dang mtshungs/chu ni srog gi 'byung khungs yin la mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed ni chu dang kha bral thabs med/ 'on kyang mi'i rigs kyis rang byung khamasalagator bshig shugs chen btang ba'i rkyen gyis da cha spyod nus kyi ba 'byung khungs dang ba spus kar nyams rgyad shugs chen byung yod/nga chos shes gsal ltar rgya mtsho dang tshwa mtsho'i chu rnams thad kar bed spyod byed mi nyan pa dang tshwa med spyod du rung ba'i chus skam thog dang rgya mtsho'i ba brgya cha 3las zin gyi med pa ma zad de'i nang nas gsum zur gnyis tsamalho sne'i gleng dang rgu run lan du yod pa'i gags nom yin/ don dngosathogang tshos dngos sa spyod du rung pa'i chus chu yongs kyi brgya cha 0 003tsamalas zin kyi med/ma gzhi rang byung gi ba 'khor bskyod la brten nas spyod du rung pa'i tshwa med chu la ga sgon yong gi yod rung da cha nga chos bod spyod byed pa'i ba 'bor tshad de rang byung 'khor bskyod kyi kha sgon byung ba'i 'bor yo las— 28 —

nga zag bas zad /thu nga (1byedabasab dang rdzad skyon gyis tshu med ba 'bor ra je nyung du btang yod latshwa med spyod bya'i ba 'byung khungs thad dka' ngal chen po 'phrad bzhin yod/nye ba'i lo300nang 'dzam gling gi ka' bor ldab bcu tsam 'phar ba dang / mi'i 'tsho ba yang ldab mang pos gra rgyas su song yod pas po dgosamakho yang de ltar gyi che ru song yod/ bzo las thon skyed dang / zhing lasathon skyed/ grong khyer 'dzad spyod bcas la chu 'gro shin du che la bod spyad zin pa'i chu snyigs de dag chu gzhan dang 'dres rjes dzad skyon gyi rgya khyod de bas rgya cher 'gro gi yod bded1tshwa med chu dkon pa'i gnad don de ni 'dzam gling yongs kyi dka' ngal zhig tu gyur yod/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis tshod rtsis byas par gzhigs na ①yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab kyi zhing pa bzhi zur gsuyodang grong khyer ka' bor gyi lnga zur gcig la lo 'khor ma'i nang yong chu gtsang ma 'thung rgyu med pa dang / de bas 'dzam gling thog gi ka' bor dung phyur 17tsam la ldang nges kyi chu bed spyod byed rgyu med pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad yod/gnyis/ gtsang po dang rgya mtsho'i rdzad skyon la 'gog bcos byed pa'i thabs/gtsang po dang rgya mtsho'i rdzad skyon la bkag 'gog yong chen chu rgyug ༅ sa khul gyi rgyal khang dang rgyal spyi'i 'char gzhi dang spyi ྾sa mang pogatan 'khel byas yod/ de yang gling chen khag gi gtsang po mang che ba rgyal— 29 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bakhab mang po brgyud nas rgya mtshor bab kyi yod stabs gtsang po'i rdzad skyon gyi 'gog bcos thad rgyug yul rgyal khab tshang mas 'gan khri khyer dgos pa zhig yin/ dper na/ dus rabs19tsam nas yodang gling gi rgyal khab mang posagatsang po che khag la srung skyob dang gcig 'gyur gyi do dam yong rṣa chu thog 'grim 'grul dang / chu'i bed spyod/ rdzad skyon gyi 'gog bcos/ rgyug khulaskye khams kyi srung skyob bcas la dmigs pa'i spyi chings gtan 'khel byas yod/rgya mas rdzad skyon la 'gog bcos byed rgyu de ni de bas rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i las don zhig yin stabs spyi lo 1954lor thog mar‘‘mtsho thog rdo snum gyi gnod 'tshe bkag 'gog byed rgyu'i rgyal spyi'i spyi chings gtan 'khel byu sa pa dang / de rjes 'grim 'grul dang 'dzugs bskrun las bzosapa'i gnod 'tshe dang nya rigs 'dzin rnyab sogs kyi skor la do dam gyi ra don dang rtsa khrims bzos ste 'dzam gleng yongs kyis rgya mtsho dang rgya mtsho'i thon khungs la bdag skyong yong ra las don mang po spel yod/gsum/ mtsho bod sa mtho'i chu dang 'khrags rom/mtsho bod sa mtho de 'dzam gling sa cha gzhan dang mi 'dra bar chu dang ba 'byung khungs phun sum tshogs po yod pa ni rgya che ba'i 'khyags nom dang /phyogs bzhir 'bab pa'i gtsang po/ skar gas lta bu'i mtsho dang mtsho bcas gsal po mngon thub/'khrag rom/— 30 —

nga rabs ra sdig nga 'tshematsho bod sa mtho'i gag rom rnams gtso bo ri dang sa mtho sar chags yod la 'khrug rom gi rgya khyon spyi dngos snyoms gru bzhi ma 49162yod pa des rgyal yongs pog rom gyi brgya cha 80yan zin shadang / gshes ri rgyud 'khyag rom gyi brgya cha 40tsam zin gyi yod/'khrug rom de dag gsham g.yo gyi ri rgyud dang sa mtho'i thog gnasayod bste/④ri bo ho ma la ya'i ri rgyud/④ gnyan chen thang lha'i ri rgyud/④ ldang la'i ri rgyud/① gangs ti si'i ri rgyud/ ④ gnu ri bo'i ri rgyud/④ khal gnu ri bo'i ri rgyud/④ byang thang gi mtho sgang /④ tang len ri bo'i ri rgyud/(ni'i༅ma)④'phred rgyug ri rgyud bcas la yod/(ga)gag nom de dag gis mtho sgang gi rgyug chu dang mtsho rnams rgyun sring 'phel rgyas thub par dge sa chen po yod/ 'khyags nom de dag gisagacig nas sa 'og gi rlan gsher la ldeng nges kyi ga sgon gsab thub pa dang /gnyis nas sa thog gi rgyug chu dang mtsho rnams la 'dzad mtha' med pa'i chu rgyun 'don sprod byed thub/ der brten gags nom de dag ni nga tsho bod — 31 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bdang mtsho bod mtho sgang gi chu'i bang mdzod lta bu yin/phyogs bzhir 'bab pa'i gtsang po khagabod dang mtsho bod mtho sgang ni 'dzam gling thog sab ba mtho shos dang e she ya'i gtsang chu mang che ba'i 'byung khungs yin/ mtsho bod sa mtho lasabab pa'i gtsang chu rnams rgyug yul sa gnas dang bab yul rgya mtshor gzhigasanas dbye na khag gsum te/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i chu rgyud dang / rgya gar rgya mtsho'i chu rgyud/ bod kyi nang bab chu bo khag bcas yin/ ④nang 'bab chu bo ni skam sa'i thog rgyug pa las rgya mtsho'i nang mee'abab pa'i chu bor go dgos/ skam thog gtsang po'i rgyug yul gyi rgya khyon la spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma 98245tsam yodadichu bo de dag gi khrod nas lo 'khor mar bzhur rgyun mi chad pa'i gtsang po chu rtsa bzang ba 'ga' shas yod pa phud phal che ba nam dus la gzhigs nasa'aphel grib 'gro ba'i chu bo sha stag yin/ bod kyi byang rgyud du nang 'ang ba chu bo che shos kyi gras su ser gleng mtshor 'bab pa'i rtsa skya gtsang po dang / sngo mtshor 'bab pa'i gas 'brug gtsang po/ g.yo jig tshwa khar 'bab pa'i skya rub gtsang po/ stag rtse mtshor 'bab pa'i 'bog tshang gtsang po/ bkra ri gnamamatshor 'bab pa'i mtsho la gtsang po/ ngang la ring mtshor 'bab pa'i wamogatsang po sogs yod/ de khrod ldang la'i lho phyogs thamado rdzong khongs nasargyug pa'i rtsa skya gtsang po'i chu rgyun ring shos yin pas de'i ring tshad la spyi lebazhi brgya bcu med dgu yod/ bod lo phyogs kyi nang 'bab chu bo che shos ni — 32 —

nga zad bas zad (thu nga rngon byedayar 'brog g.yumatshor 'bab pa'i kha yong skya chu zhes ba ring rṣa sgyulebadun cu don gsum yod pa de yin/ de'i 'og rtsa bod kyi lho nuba'i po gyimapham g.yums 'bas cing / ring sa spyi le bdun cu don gcig yod pa'i brag gtsang po zhes pa de redashi④ zhi bde rgya mtshor 'bang pa'i gtsang po khag mtsho bod mtho sgang lasabang ste mtha' ma zhi bde rgya mtshor sgril mkhan gtsang po khag ni 'bri chu dang /rgyal nong rgyal mo rngul chu1 mchu/ rdza chu sogs yin/ gtsang chu de dag mdo dbus mtho sgang gi shar phyogs su rgyug pa dang rgyug yum kyi rgya khyon bsdoms spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi yo638477tsam yod/④ rgya gar rgya mas nang 'bab pa'i gtsang po rnams bod kyi lho ngosasuyod pa dang de'i nang nas gtso bo che shos ni yar klung gtsang po yin/ yar klung gtsang por bod kyi gtsang po mang po zhig 'gril gyi yod bdaper na/mdogazhung gtsang po dang / myang chu/ skyid chu/ nyang chu sogs lho rgyud kyi gtsang po mang dag zhig yod/gzhan yang seng ge kha'ang ba dang glang chen kha' bab/ ga'u bu gtsang bu/ rgya mo rngul chu sogs rgya gar rgya mtshor 'bab kyi yod/mtsho dang mche'u khagabod yongs dang lhag par du byang thang la mtsho dang mtsho nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu mang po yod pa 'dzam gleng gling phran gzhan gyis 'gran thabasabral ba zhig red/ bod kyi byang thang khon ra mtsho dang mtshe'u brgya phrag mang po — 33 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bayod pa dang rgya khyon la spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma 21400tsam zin gyi yod/de'i nang nas snyan grags dang rgya khyon che ba dwangs ra g.yumatsho (zhang zhung sgo mo bar la'i gnas yul gyi lteb)dang / gnam mtsho phyug mo(bod kyi mtsho chen ang dang po/) skya ring mtsho mo dgu mthud/ mu tig skyang 'gram mtsho/'brong mtsho/ zi ling bsdu mtsho/ a mdo'i mtsho nag g.yag rgan mtsho/rag spyod mtsho/ mtsho mo ngang la ring mo/ brag ri gnam mtsho/ aru mtsho/smad ma mtsho/ lu ma byang stong mtsho/ yar 'brog g.yumatsho/ ma pham g.yumatsho/ skyems mtsho/ phag mtsho/ mtsho sngo rengs/ be ru dug mtsho/ stong ri mtsho nag mtsho khri shor rgyal mo sogs yod de bod dang mtsho bod mtho sgang gi sa cha gams gtsang 'dir chu dang ba 'byung khungs shin tu phun sum tshogs po yod pa de ni rgyal yongs dang tha na 'dzam gling sa cha gzhan dag tu rtsa ba nasamathong rgyu med pa'i phul byung gi rang byung thon khungs shig red/ chu dang ba 'byung khungs de dag la da bar jod skyon gyi dri ma dang lhad shugs chen po phog med la/ gang la thon na yul red/ chu khar thon na ja red zer ba'i gtam dpe ltar yul lung gang du song yang rdzad skyon gyi lhad la skrag snang mi dgosapar chu gang rung nasang bkol nyan pa'i skal pa bzang po zhig yod/ nga tshosad lta nas 'tsho ba dang thon skyed kyi rgyud rim nang yid zab dang do snang chen pos da yod kyi ba rgyun dang ba 'byung khungs la srung skyong byas te ba 'byung khungs dang o she ya'i chu 'go rnams pad skyon gyi gnar gcod las thar thabs byed dgos/— 34 —

pas zag kyi babs zad (thu nga 'i byedabadun pa/ char pa skyur po/gcig char pa skyur po'i gnod 'che/da cha 'dzam gling sa cha mang por‘‘char pa skyur po 'bang kyi yod pa dang des mi dang skyes dngos tshang ma'i bde thang gi gnod 'tshe bzo gi yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gas red/ 'o na gang 'dra byas nas char pa skyur po chags pa yin zhes na/ de yang rlangs 'khor sogs 'phrul chas kyi du ba dang / bzo grwa dang glog khang gis bsregs pa'i rdo sol gyi du ba/ de bzhin zhing nang du rgyab pa'i rdzas lud kyi rgyu cha khag gcig bar nang du rlung 'gyur byas pa bcasadug ldan gyi rdzas de dag nyi ma'i 'od dang / rlung / thal brdul bcas kyi nus pa la brten nas rim bzhin mu zi'i skyur dang ze za skyur la 'gyur nga dang / skyur de dag bar snang du slebs rjes char pa dang lhan du sa thog tu 'bab kyi yod bas char pa skyur po zer ba byung ba red/char pa skyur pos mi'i bde thang la gnod 'tshe chen po yod pa dper na/mid pa la na zug gtong bdang / mig pa na ba/ glo slong nga rnams mngon gsal dod pa'i dpe tshon tsam yin/ de bas tshab che ba zhig ni char pa skyur mos sngar yod rang byung gi ba 'khor skyod kyi ngo bo dang nus par 'gyur ldog btang ste skamasa'i thog gi chu'i skyar gsodang ga snon la bar chad bzo ba ma zad skam thog gi dzing dang 1 mtshe'u/ gtsang po bcas la char pa skyur po'i rdzad skyon gyis skam ba'i tshe srog mang por dka' ngal bzo gi yod pa red/— 35 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bgazhan yang char pa skyur pos nags tsha dang zhing las thon skyed la'ang shugs rkyen chen po yod pa dang / des skyes dngos la thad ka'i gnod 'tshe dang gzhan brgyud gnod 'tshe khag gnyis yong gi yod pa ste/ char pa skyur po skyes dngos kyi rlung mig nang la gte skyes dngos kyi 'byen rngub lo al 'gog rkyen byed pa de thad ka'i gnod 'tshe dang / char pa skyur posasal bcud nyams par byas nas rim bzhin skyes dngos 'tsho rten gyi sa shugasazhan par 'gyur ba'am sa shugs med par bzos nas skyes dngos skye 'al skoyong ba byed pa de gzhan brgyud kyi gnod 'tshe yin/ da ngar char pa skyur po de yodang dang / a mi ri ka/ a lha ri ka de bzhin o she ya'i rdzad skyon dang sko'abor che sa'i grong khyer khag la bab pa ma gtogs sa cha gzhan du bab pa'i lo rgyus med/gnyis/ char pa skyur po tshod 'jin byed thabs/char pa skyur po'i 'byung khungs ni 'tsho nga dang bzo las thon skyed lasabyung ba'i mkha' rlung jod skyon yin stabs/ gtso bo bzo las thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i 'bar rdzas dang 'dzad spyod kyi rnam pa dang 'brel ba chen po yod/da yod kyi rdo la dang rdo snum gtso bor byas pa'i 'bar rdzas kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog gtong rgyu dang 'bar rdzas de dag las byung ba'i ze tshwa rnams mkha' rlung du mi shor ba'i la 'dzin byed rgyu de ni las don ang dang po de yin/yod ba kyi rgyal khab khag dang a ri de bzhin mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs bcasanas ze tshwa gtso bor byas pa'i dngos rdzas la la 'dzin byed rgyu'i spyi chings—36—

la la la la cad mthu la rngona'imang po gtan 'al byas yod/brgyad pa/ mig 'bor dang rang byung khor yugad lta 'dzam gling yongs la sngar byung myong med pa'i gnas tshu gsar pa zhig thug yod pa de ni rang byung khor yug dang / skyes dngos ma laga'agro ba'i rigs/ skyes dngos bcas kyi 'tsho gnas cha rkyen nyin re bzhin nyams rgud du 'gro ba dang / de bzhin rang byung thon khungs mang po zad pa'am zad nyer thugs yod pa de red/ 'o na gnas༅ de rigs thon dgos don gang yin zhe na/ de ni nga rang tsho 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i kun spyod 'ba' zhig lor ga las yod/mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba ni skyes dngos dang / srog chags/ de bzhin sa 'og dang sa steng gi rang byung thon khungs la brten dgos pa dang / spyi tshogs rim bzhin 'phel rgyas song ba las mi'i 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho yang rgya cher 'gro ba ma zad 'tsho ba dang / thon skyed las byung ba'i snyigs no sna la sathon pa de dag gis sngar yod 'byung ba snyoms pa'i skyes khams der shugs rkyen dang gtor bshig chen po byung yod/ spyir nga chos 'tsho ba dang thon skyed kyi snyegs ro dang de'i rdzad skyon zhes brjod skabs mi mang che bas rgyun du mthong rgyu yod pa'i gad snyigs dang / snod shub/ de bzhin mi'i bya spyod dang gong gal gad snyegs kyis ba'i ga ba bzos pa'i chu dang khor yug la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang thon skyed las byung ba'i btsog snyigs ni de las rgya che — 37 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bal gnod 'tshe de bas che ba yod/ 'dir thon skyed ni gtso bo bzo las thon skyed dang zhing las thon skyed la go dgos/ mi'i 'tsho ba dang bya spyod kyi 'dzad spyod des sa gzhi ril mo'i skyes khams nus par shugs rkyen chen po gtong gi yod pa dang lhag par du mi 'bor 'phar skabs 'dzad spyod kyi dgos mkho'i 'bor la kyang che ru 'gro gi yod/ der brten mi'i rigs kyi 'dzad spyod de ni khor yug gnod 'al 'byung khungs gtso bo de red/spyi lo'i dus dngas18pa nas bzung tshan rig 'phel rgyas dang bzo las gsar brje'i dngang gis 'dzam gling khyon yongs kyi mi'i 'tsho ba dang thon skyed la sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas byung ba dang dus mtshungs mi'i rigasarang nyid la yang grangs 'bor kyi 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ dper na/la rtsis byas par gzhigs na spyi lo'i dus rangs 'go tshugs skabs 'dzam gleng gi mi 'bor dung phyur 3las med pa dang / de nas spyi lo 1820tsam la dung phyur 10tsam la slebs pa dang / spyi lo 1987lor dung phyur 50zin pa nasad bar lo bcu lhag tsam ring la dung phyur 60zin yod/ deng skabs ha lam nyin lnga'i nang 'dzam gleng gi ka' bor khri tsho 100re 'phar gyi yod/ grong khyer nang 'tsho sdod byed mkhan mi 'bor gyi brgya cha yang rim bzhin 'phar gyi yod/spyi lo 1950lo tsam la grong khyer gyi ka' bor de mi 'bor yongs kyi brgya cha 29tsam las zin kyi med pa dang da lta brgya cha 50zin yod/nga chos mi 'bor gyi 'phar la la la 'dzin ma byas na 'dzam gleng gi mi 'bor ldab 'gyur 'phar rgyu nyag gcig dang / ka' bor 'phar ba dang — 38 —

nga rabs ra /thu nga 'tshedus mtshungs mi re'i 'dzad spyod kyi 'bor yang rim bzhin 'phar rgyu1 lhag par du deng dbas spyi tshogs nang bag med kyi 'dzad spyod byed mkhan de bsargya chen po yod/ deng rabs mi'i 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho ha cang rgya che la rnamathayang mang dag zhig yod la/ dper na/ zas rigs 'dra min grangs kyi meelang ba de dag shubs dang snod mang pos btum pa dang 1 pyon chas kyi rigasarnam pa stong phrag mang po rgyu cha 'dra min las grub pa/ khang pa'i phyi nang dang /spro skyed/ las shor byed sgo'i mkho chas/ dbyar kha grang rlung dang dgun kha drod rlung / 'phrul chas yogs bskrun dang bed spyod byed pa'i 'gro song sogs sne mang gyi 'dzad spyod de dag rang 'byung gi thon khungs la brten nasabazo dgos la de dag bzo ba'i brgyud rim nang thon skyed las byung ba'i snyegasanodang dug ldan rdzas sgyur tshang ma rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe shin tu che ba'i rgyu cha 'ba' zhig gas 'gro gi yod/ der brten rang byung khor yug gi gnod 'tsho 'byung rkyen gtso bo de 'dzam gling ka' bor dang 'tsho nga'i 'dzad spyod rgya ba 'phar ba de rang yin/le'u 'di'i mchan 'grel④(mchos mas rtsegs〉923①(mas mchos〉④〈ga༅༅mas mas༅༅tsamachos mas4ba 〉9105④(6yo6'u1༅0mi6'u7 yo'u6bsa'u gas 31mas61 ba1 0'i7kyi1ba27ཿla ༅11ma11༷ba 6yo)④(mas bza ma lo(sgo7ba7tshom༅sgo〉)④(tshe༅mas mas sgom༅༅du〉①(dung bkar tshig mdzod/〉21408④(tshe༅mas mchos ma za༅1pe〉

sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi riXskyes srog chags/ri skyes srog chag ma ni mi'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang rang byung skyesakhams kyi nang med du mi rung ba zhig red/ ri skyes srog chags la rang byung skye khams kyi 'phel rgyas do snyoms po bzo ba'i nus pa yod pa ma zad dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang yul ljongs nyams dga' bar byed pa/ sman dang 'phrod bsten sogs la dgos pa'i ma rgyu'i thon khungs bskrun thub pa sogs nye ngar mkho nga'i rang byung rgyu nor zhig red/ da ngar bod kyi ri skyes srog chagasatshang ma tshad pa'i zhib bsher tho bkod byas pa rig rgyu med rung spyir gtso che ba dang / grangs 'bor chung ba'i rigs khag la rim bzhin tho bkod dang zhib 'jug byed sgo brtsams yod/ lhag par du rgyal khab rim pa'i rtsa che' srog chags rnams srung skyob byed rgyu'i nang tshud yod/ gzhan yang tshan rigs zhib 'jug dang bod kyi shod rgyun ltar na thog mar bod kyi skam sa chen po 'dir ri skyes srog chags sna tshogs kyis khengs yod pa dper na/ sha rkyang sogs ri dwags rnams stod mnga' ris skor gsum na gnas pa dang / stag gzig sogs gcan gzan rnams dbus gtsang ru bzhir gnas pa/ 'dab chagasarnams smad mdo khams sgang drug tu gnas par grags/de nas 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas byung ba'i rgyud rim nang thog — 40 —

la kyi ma ba la zung ba mar stabs bde'i tshon cha mda' mdung sogs la brten nas ri dwags rngon pa dang de rjes ri skyes srog chags khag gcig mis bdag 'dul byas nas sgo phyugs rnams byung bar bshad/ de yang bod kyi shod rgyun du ri skyes srog chags rnams nod g.yung gnyis su dbye ba dang ‘‘ri dwags kyi nang nas ba glang bung bu sogs dang / bya rigs nang nas 'phur rtsal zhan pa bya de dang gtse/gcan gzan nang nas lho gas mtsha ba'i khye dang / phag pa/ zhum bu sogasakhag gcig mi yis bdag tu bzung nas bkol spyod byas pa la g.yung dwagasasam sgo phyugs zhes grags pa dang de min 'dzin bzung dka' zhing gal srid 'dzin bzung thub pa'i dbang du btang na'ang 'dul bar mi nus shing bkol du mi thub pa rnams la ri dwags sam/ g.yag rgod/ ra rgod/ phag rgod ces pa sogs kyi ming btags te rngon rgyag bya la gyi grags bzhag par grags/mi①mdor na ri skyes srog chags khag gcig mis bdag 'dul byasanas sgo phyugs byung ba dang / da lta ri skyes tshoganas pa rnams rgod kyi khongasas rtogs par bshad/ri dwags kyi dbye tshul zhes gtso bo rigs che ba khag bzhi dang bye brag chung rigs mang por dbye srol yod pa'i rigs che ba ri dwags dang / gcan gzan/ 'dab chags/ chu gnas bzhi dang / bye brag chung rigs rkang med/rkang gnyis/ rkang bzhi/ rkang drug rkang mang / rmig zlum/ rmig pa kha dbrag rwa can/ mche can/ sder can sogs dang / 'dab chags la yang ④ (khyad du 'phags pa'i byang thang ngo mtshar 'os pa'i thon khungs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 89— 41 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga babya dang byi'u/ bye brag du sha zan dang 'dam zan/ kar na/ rgum 'thu/ spu sdug skad snyan sogs sde tshan mang por dbye srol yod/gzhan yang bod kyi srol rgyun la srog chags rnams dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun du dbye ba la gnam la 'phur dgu sal la yodagu bar la 'grim dgu ste gnam la 'phur dgu ni kun zil gnon pa'i bya rgyal khyung chen/ dbyar dgun mtshams 'byed sgra rgyas gas 'brug 'phur rtsal nam 'phang gcod pa'i rgod po/ skad snyan dus kyi la 'dzin khu byug dug 'jom spu sgro mdzes pa'i rma bya/ dran gal mi skad smra ba'i ne tso/ nyin zhag dus tsho shes pa'i khyem bya/ lha mi'i 'jin skyel lce bde'i pha wang / gang la thogs med 'phur shes dzi bya dang dgu'o/ sa la la la dgu ni/ shes bya kun mkhas skye 'gro'i gtso mchog mi/ shugs chen bkra shis rdzas gyur dung dkar/dus 'khor la sa la ldan pa'i rus sbal rkang lag nang sbas 'gro shesasprul nag dgun du nyal chog sgom ldan 'byu ba/ dag tsang grib sel tshangasaldan grum pa/ rig no gzhan sems shes pa'i sre mong / kun shes tshod la mkhas pa'i co ga lus sked sra yang rtsal chen grog ma dang dgu'o/ ngar la 'grim dgu ni/ rtsal kyi sder lnga zil gnon seng ge spu ris bkrag gsal gcan rgyal stag mo/ zhe sdang dpa' gtum ldan pa'i dom nag mdzangs blo ldan zhing dbang mnga'i dred mong / mi spyod ci bslab shes pa'i spre'u/mgyogs 'gros bang rtsal ldan pa'i rta mchog brgya byin chings gyur theg stobs glang chen/ dgos pa bzhi tshang mi la drin che ba'i lug lo rer bcu phrag rgyas pa'i rwa ldan sha ba dang dgu'o/— 42 —

bo kyi ri sa sro cha sa6‘gzhan yang rwa dang sder las dbye ba khag gcig ni sder mo can gyi rtswazan spun gsum/ rwa bzhi can kyi sha zan spun gsum zhes pa dang / pho rwa mo rwa gsum/ pho yu po yugasum/ pho rwa mo yugasum lta bu yin/ 'dir rtswa zan spun gsum ni/ spang rtsar spyod mkhan thang dkar rgod po dang 1 lha bya gong mo/ 'dam kar spyod mkhan ngang pa ser po gsum la go sha zan spun gsum ni dbyar kha'i sha phos bye'u'i sgong nga za/ g.yang dkar lug gis sbal pa za/mdo phrug rta yis dmar chas za bar go dgos/ pho rwa mo rwa gsum ni/'brong / gnyan/ gna' gsum dang / pho yu mo yugasum ni/ rkyang / gla ba/ ri bong gsum1 pho rwa mo yugasum ni/ gtsod/ sha ba/ dgo ba gsuyoyin zhes pa'o/ mi④gong gsal kyi dbye tshul de dag gtso bo dmigs bas khyad chos dang yon tan ldan pa'i ri skyes srog chags khag gcig la rol rtsed dang /sgyu tshal gyi rnam pa'i thog nas dbye 'byed byas pa las ri dwags tshang mtshud pa'i sa ldan dbye 'byed la ngos 'dzin byed mi rung /deng rangs tshan rigs kyis sgal rus can gyi ri skyes srog chagasarnams gtso bo rigs lnga la dbye ba ste/ chu gnas dang / skam chu gnyisa'atsho'i rigs/ stong grod srog chags/ 'dab chags/ de bzhin ri dwagasadang gcan gzan gnyis sgril ba'i ri dwags kyi rigs bcas lnga'o/ khag lnga de dag bye brag nang gses rigs dang / sde tshan bcas gsum du dbye yod/dper na dbyi ni ri dgas kyi rigs dang / sha zan gyi sde/ zhum bu'i tshan du ④ (khyad du 'phags pa'i byang thang ngo mtshar 'os pa'i thon khungs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 93—95— 43 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bgatogs pa'i ri dwags yin pa dang / yang rkyang ni ri dwags kyi rigs dang /rmig zlum gyi sde/ rta'i tshan par gtogs pa lta bu yin/bod ljongs 'di ni 'dzam gling yongs kyi mtho la kyi rtse mor gnas pa ma zad/ yul 'di'i sa chu ri klung dang / nags tsha skyes dngos/ ri skyesasrog chags/ la srol goms gshis/ rig gnas chos lugs rnams la khyad 'phags kyi ngo mtshar ldan yod pa de ni 'dzam gling mi rigs yongs kyi phul byung rgyu nor dang 'gran thabs bral ba'i dmigs bsal gī rgyan cha lta bu yin/ lhag par du rdzad skyon gyi lhad dang dri ma rgya cher ma phog pa'i la 'dir skam/ chu/ nags thang / ri klung gang sar gnas pa'i ri skyes srog chags kyi rigs dang grang 'bor rgya chen po yod pa de dag 'dzam gleng ri skyesasrog chags dang skyes dngos ma lag gi grub cha gtso bo zhig yin/ ljongasayongs kyi rtsa la ri skyes srog chags la bsdoms rtsis byas par gzhigs na/'dang chags rigs488dang / ri dwags142lho bskyod rigs55skam chu gnyis mtsho rigs45chu gnas68de bzhin 'bu srin rigs2300tsam yod pa las/ ri skyes srog chags rigs141rgyal khab rim pa'i srung skyob nang la yod pa dang / rigs41tsam rgyal khab kyi rim pa dang po'i srung skyob byed yul du gtan 'khel byas yod lda gzhan yang rigs mang dag zhig ni mtsho bod mtho sgang kho na las 'dzam gleng sa gnas gzhan du rig rgyu med pa'i rin thang che ba'i srog chags yin pa dper na/ ri dwags kyi khongs su/'brong dang / rkyang / gtsod/ gnyan/ sha ba kha dkar/ bla nag gcan —44—

bo kyi ri sa sro cha sagazan gyi khongs su bod kyi wa dang / dred mong / chu sram/ dom nag ltobaskyod kyi khongs su/ rtsangs pa dang / rtsangs pa sgal ral/ dug sprul mgo zur gsum ma/ sprug 'dab dug ༅/ 'dab gas kyi rigs su khrung khrung dang / chu bye'u/ ri bya ga྾ mdog gong mo sogs dang / skam chu gnyisa'atsho rigs sa bod kyi sbal chen dang / sa cha gzhan du rig rgyu med pa'i mtshon sna'i sbal ba/ chu skyes kyi rigs su bod kyi thig phor dbyibs kyi nya dang /shel ta/ ltasa'i nya/ gro mo'i nya sogs mang po yod1gzhan yang rang rgyal kyi skam thog gi sgal nus can ri skyes srog chags301 tsam grangs 'bor yo la 'tsho gnas kyi cha rkyen zhan pas rtsa stong du 'gro nyer yod pa dang / de'i nang nas rigs90tsam mtsho bod mtho sgang du gnasayod pa dper na/ gzig dang / rkyang / gla ba/ gnyan/ dred mong sogasayin/ zhib pa zhar byung ri'u mig la gzigs shi①①①①gong gsal bod dang mtsho bod mtho sgang gi dmigs gsal sbog chagasadang de bzhin bod du yod pa'i rtsa tsho ri dwags bcas kyis bod kyi ri skyesasrog chags kyi 'jig rten de yongs su grub yod bas zad ri skyes srog chagasakyi sde 'di bzhin 'dzam gling thog rnyed par dka' nga'i dmigs bas rang bzhin ldan pa'i rtsa tsho rgyu nor zhig red/gcig bod kyi ri skyes srog ༅sa kyi khyem tshang 'di'i nang gcan gzan dang ri dwags/ 'dab sas/ chu skyes/ stong grod/ skam chu gnyisa'atsho'i rigs bcas cha tshang nga dang /— 45 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bganyis/ bod dang mtsho bod mtho sgang du yod pa'i ri skyes srog chagasanang sa thang thog 'tsho gnas byed mkhan gyi yul kho nar bdag pa'i srog chagasayod la de bzhin nags tshal dang / chu/ tsha ba dang zha tshan yod pa'i saganas kyi srog chags yang grangs las 'das pa yod/gsum/ 'dzam gling sa khul gzhan dang mi 'dra bar bod du yod pa'i ri skyes srog chags ha cang mang po zhig bod dang mtsho bod mtho sgang gi sa cha 'di kho na las gzhan du mthong rgyu dang rig rgyu med pa'i rtsa che'i rin thang ldan pa/bzhi/ ri skyes srog chags kyi grangs 'bor dang de dag 'tsho sdod bya yul kyi sa cha rgyal nang dang tha na rgyal spyi'i thog rgya khyon che nga'i grags slobasayod/lnga/ byang thang du yod pa'i ri skyes srog chags dang de dag gnas pa'i skye khams khor yug de 'dzam gleng thog gi rang byung skye khams mtho shos yin pa bcas so/phun sum tshogs pa'i ri skyes srog chags dang de dag 'tsho gnas byed yul skor la rang rgyal srid gzhung nas rang byung srung skyob khul mang po gsar du btsugs nas srog chags dang srog chags 'tsho gnas kyi khor yug la srung skyob byas yod la/ spyi lo1988lor ‘‘krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab ri skyes srog chags srung skyob rtsa khrims1 gsar du bton pa dang / de rjes1992lor rtsa khrims de'i lag bstar gyi byed thabs gtan 'khel byas pa nas— 46 —

bo kyi ri sa sro cha sabazung ri skyes srog chags rin thang che rigs la do dam dang srung skyob byed thub pa byung yod/rgya za klog pa po chos rang skyong ljongs kyi gtso gnad srung skyob byed dgos pa'i ri skyes srog chags dang de dag rang skyong ljongs dang rgyal khab/rgyal spyi bcas kyi srung spyob rim pa gang dang gang yin skor shes rtogs yong ra/ nga chos zhar byung nang bod rang skyong ljongs gtso gnad srung skyob byed dgos kyi srog chags kyi ming tho bkod yod/ ming tho de'i nang 'khod pa'i srog chags de dag ni yang na bod kho na las sa khul gzhan du rig rgyu med pa'i rtsa che'i srog chags dang 1 yang na 'dzam gleng thog mthong dkon pa/ yang na srog chags de'i rigs kyi 'byung gyur 'tsho gnas la dka' ngal yod pa/yang na bod ljongs sa srog chags de gras dkon la 'tsho sdod khor yug zhan pa bcas kyi nyen gnas dang khyad chos ldan pa sha stag yin/gzhan yang bod la gong g.yo ming tho'i nang ma 'khod pa'i rtsa tsho ri skyes sred ga chags mang po yod pa/ dper na/ gser sprul dang / sreg pa/srin byu/ so bya/ shing rta mo/ gas sprul/ sman sprul / sbal nag brag zhum/bye stag khra bo/ bya ma bye'u/ 'phyi ba/ phag rgod/ pu shud/ phug ron/mthing ril spyo mo/ ti ti/ gtsang nya/ lcung ka/ co ka/ ngur nga/ grum pa/khā ta/ khug ta/ skyar ma sogs 'dzam gling yang rtse'i skyes khams kyi grub sna'i nang med du mi rung ba dang sman gyi rin thang chen po ldan pa'i srog chags mang po yod/— 47 —
bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga b.le'u 'di'i mchan 'grel/④〈lo༅ba༅༅ma༅’61bza/rṣalo〉①(baḥpho༅༅〉④(yo༅ba༅༅gas bsam〉④〈ba༅༅’bas〉④〈ka pa༅ma—sgo༅〉④(za ba༅༅ pho༅rme6—lo〉

sa bcad bzhi pa/ gtsod/①ming gzhan/ bod gtsod/ pho la gog po dang mo la yu mo/rigs kyi dbye ba/ rmig pa kha dbrag kyi sde/ ba glang tshan/gzugs dbyibs kyi la chos/bod kyi gtsod la byang gtsod dang sgang gtsod kyis dbye ba yod la sbang gtsod rnams byung stobs che la rwa co dang spu mdog snum shas che ba yod/ spyir gtsod kyi gzugs po'i mtho la las mi'i 65—80tsam dang mgo mjug bar gyi ring sa la li rmi'i 120—140tsam yod/ gog po'i rwa la lo mid 55—80tsam yod/ gtsod pho'i long bu g.yas g.yon du pags bya'i khug chung re (yod pa der gog po'i rlung gshog zer zhing thog mar rgyugs skabs de tsam mgyogs po med rung / ji tsam rgyugs pa de tsam gyi je mgyogs su 'gro ba der mi chos gtsod gshog rlung gis brgyangs pa red zer/dang bo/ 'tsho sdod gnas yul/gtsod ni mtsho bod mtho sgang kho nar 'tsho sdod byed pa las yu gru gzhan na rig rgyu med pas/ mtsho bod mtho sgang gi dmigs bas ri dwagasashig yin/ gtsod kyi pha gzhis che shos bod kyi byang thang dang mtsho sngon gyi —49—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi khor ro/ srang ba.a chen khyang thang / shin cang gi ri bo ar can bcas ni rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul yin/gtsod ni ri skyes srog chags mang po dang mi 'dra bar pho mo grus rtsa lang skabs ma gtogs rgyun du pho khyu dang mo khyu logs su sdod pa dang / pho mo 'debs sbyor gyi skabs su pho mo khyu chen sgrigs nas 'khrig spyor byed ngor ngar rtsod khrod pa dang / ngar rtsod khrid sar yang ngar gzhung ces gtan 'khel sacha yod/nag chu nyi ma rdzong khongs khon ra gtsod kyi ngar gzhung tshugs sa che ba 20lhag tsam yod pa dang / ngar gzhung che sar gtsod pho mo stong phrag zin pa/chung sar yang brgya phrag yod/ nyi ma rdzong gi ngar gzhung mang che ba byang rgyud du yod pas byang ga bod kyi ngar gzhung dang yang rdzong gi lho rgyud dang ngang rtse mtsho'i shar rgyud stag rag gtsang po'i g.yas g.yon la sgang gtsod kyi ngar gzhung che ba nyung thar gnyis nas gsum bar yod lda rgyun du gtsod rnams ri klung gang sar pho khyu dang mo khyu sgrig pa las khyu 'dres mnyam sdod mi byed pa ngag rgyun du grags rung / zhib 'jug pa kha gcig ④gis pho re gnyis mo khyu'i nang yod pa'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom yang bton yod pas de skor mu mthud rtogs zhib byed pa'i dgos pa che/ bod zla bcu pa'i nang gtsod pho mo rnams rang rang gi khongs gtogs bar gzhung du 'dzoms nas 'khrig spyor ram ngar gtsod gza' 'khor gnyis tsam byed kyi yod la skabs der ngar gzhung la ma gtog sacha gzhan du yan sdod kyi gtsod rtsa ba nas rig rgyu med/ ngar gtsod tshar — 50 —

tsomatshams gug po rnams kyis lo 'khor ba'i pho gtsod rnams ma dang bral nasabatsan gshed kyis pho khyu'i nang khrid srol yod pa sogs kyi sgrig khrims dam po yod par byang thang gi kha rgyun la yang mtho nas mkha' yangs la bya khrimasadam/ dma' sa gzhi yangs la gtsod khrims dam zhesapa'i gtam dpe ya yod/ bod gtsod la ngo mtshar gyi khyad chos mang dag zhig ldan yod pa lasayumo3mas byang mtha' mi med kyi la du bskyod nas re'u khrid kyi yod pa der sems can gzhan dag gis 'gran rtsod byed rgyu lta shog tha na mis kyang da bar rjes snyegs kyis sa gnas gang du 'gro ba dang re'u ji ltar khrid pa sogs kyi skor rtsad gcod gal po thub med/ 'dir nga chos bshod rgyun dang / byang 'brog pa'i shes rtogs/ de bzhin nye rabs tshan rig brtag dpyad kyisa'abras bu bcas zung 'brel gyi bod gtsod byang du re'u khrid pa'i skor la ngo sprod phran bu zhu rgyu yin/de yang byang thang de sa rgya che la byang thang gi sa gnas mang por zhib la sa ming ri ming nas gas bshad byed dka' bas/ 'dir byang thang gi gtsod lam rnams dum bu gsum la dbye nas zhus na go bde tsam yong ngayosnyam/gcig byangs thang gi nub rgyud/'dir byang thang gi nub rgyud de mnga' ris dang nag la tsamatsha sanyi ma rdzong gi nub ngos dang sger rtse rdzong lte bar gnas pa la ngos 'dzin rgyu yin/spyir nub rgyud kyi gtsod de byang gtsod yin la/ yud rnams lo ltar byang thang —5 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bami med lung stong la re'u 'khrid par 'gro la yod/ 'on kyang da ngar gtsod rnams sa gnas gang du 'gro ba dang re'u gang du 'khrid nas phyir log byed pa sus kyang gsal po ma shes/ rtog zhib bas rjes snyeg byas pa'i la rtsis la gzhigs na khul 'di'i gtsod rnams thog brtsegs gangs ri dang / dpalarab mtsho/ rdo nag mtsho sogs brgyud nas shing cang dang bod kyi sa mtshamasangos su bskyod rjes rim bzhin phyir slog yong ba dang / spyir byang phyogs su spyi le 300tsam 'gro gi yod par grags/ sa gnas de'i 'brog pa'i shod rgyun la re'u rnams 'gro gin bzhin du skye ba las nges gtan gyi sa cha zhig tu re'u tshang ma skyes nas log gi med par bshad/ spyi zla 5pa dang 6pa'i nang gtsod rnamasakhyu bsgrigs nas gtan 'khel gyi gtsod lam ded nas byang du bskyod pa dang /spyi zla 8pa'i nang gtsod ma bu tshang ma sngar gnas sa char log yong gi yod/gtsod rnams byang bskyod byed pa la deng dngas tshan rig bas zhing 'jug byed pa ma zad/ sa gnas kyi mang la sa chos kyang gtsod kyi goms gshis gas rtogs yong la brtag dpyad dang nyams zhing byed kyi yod/gnyis/ byang dbus kyi sa khul/byang dbus kyi sa gnas ni nag ba nyi ma rdzong dang de dang 'brel ba'i mtsho gnyis dmigs bas khul gyi nub ngos bcas yin/ sa khul de'i lasabyed pa dang tshan rig rtog zhib pa'i shes rtogs la gzhigs na khul 'di'i gtsod rnams rong ma dang / ma g.yer gangs ri/ shes g.yer gangs ri/ de bzhin mtsho ste dang de'i brgyud kyi gtsang chu rgyab nas gangs ri tshwa kha'i phyogs—52—

tsosu 'gro ba dang / sa cha de'i brgyud nas phyir log gi yod par grags/gsum/ byang shar gyi sa khul/byang shar de mtsho gnyis dmigs bsal sa khul gyi byang rgyud rang yin/byang shar khul gyi gtsod rnams gtso bo mtsho gnyis dang / g.yo sbug mtsho'i bar la gnas shing de dag cang ngal ri dang / cang ngal gtsang po de bzhin meri sogs kyi phyogs nas rdo skas mtsho ring dang / de'i ngos su 'ang ba pa'i gtsang po che chung rnams brgal nas nor lha mtsho dang / nor lhagangs ri'i nye 'khor dang de bzhin de'i byang shar ngosakyi sa char 'gro gi yod par tshang masayid ches byed/gzhan yang gtsod byang du re'u yod par 'gro ba'i skor la yum mi'i shod srol dang tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rtog zhib byas pa la gzhigs na bshad srol 'dra min sna tshogs pa de dag la mu mthud tshad ldan gyi zhib 'jug byed rgyu las/ da bar don dngos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas gas po rtogs thub pa byung med/gong du zhus pa ltar byang gi gtsod de sbang gtsod dang khyang gtsod gnyis sa dbye nga dang spang gtsod rnams byang thang gi lho ngos su sdod pa dang /gtsod de dag byang gtsod dang mi 'dra bar yu po rnams kyisang ra gzhung khulalam yang na de bas lo phyogs su bskyod nas re'u 'khrid kyi yod pa sa gnasalas byed pa dang / 'brog pas mig mthong lag zin byung 'dug 'on kyang de skor nub phyogs pa'i mkhas pa 'byor rje sha las gsal po gsungs medadi— 53 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bde yang khye spyang mtsho'i stodang / stag rtse mtsho'i lho rgyud kyi zi ling bsdu mtsho'i g.yas g.yon/ skya ring mtsho'i g.yas g.yon/ de bzhin stag rag gtsang po'i nye 'khor bcas la gnas pa'i gtsod rnams dang dge rgyas rdzong 'brong ri rdzong chen gyi mngos su yod pa'i gtsod rnams sa gnas dang dgar khrid pa'am yang na lho phyogs la bskyod kyi yod/ khul der dma' mthar yang ngar gzhung sa gnas bco lnga nas nyi shu bar yod/byang gtsod byang du re'u yod skabs gug po nyung shas bo mo dang mnyam du 'gro ba dang / de dag gis khyu'i sne dang mjug gi gnas zin nas mo khyur srung skyob dang / phyir log skabs gtsang chu khag la pho rwa bsgrigs nasare'u sgrol gyi yod pa yul lung mang po'i shod rgyun du 'dug la tshan rig pasakyang mo khyu'i nang pho re gnyis 'dres pa ga྾ rtogs byung 'dug dper na/'byor rje sha las‘‘gus po na gzhon pa nyung shas rtsa mo dang mnyam gshib kyi byang du bskyod kyi 'dug’’④ces par ltar no/mos rnams byang gi sa gnas 'dra min du bskyod nas ri'u yod kyi yod pa der rtog zhib pa mang pos brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byas pa las/spyir bod kyi byang thang dang shing cang gi ar can kyi sa 'brel dang yang na de bas thag ring sar 'gro gi yod pa mi tshang mas shes gsal yin pa phud/ zhib phra'i sa gnas dngos su bskyod thung mkhan ha cang nyung nyung yin/ shod srol la de snga ru thog gi 'brog pa mi hreng gcig gis lo ru'i rgyud nas gtsod mo yu'i ④ (byas 1yo 6 1998 yo1 1ma1 16༷116'u11cha1yo31'u9༅)— 54 —

tsorjes su bsnyegs te re'u la da sar lta bar phyin/ mi des bshad par gzhigs na gtsod rnams byang gi la du bskyod skabs za rgyu zhan pas bya long gi brun za ba dang / bya long mang po gtsod kyi mu la 'gro bzhin sha ma rnams za ba'i phan tshun gyi 'brel ba yod pa'i skor dang mi des kyang nyin re re'u zasanas byang thang skor ba'i 'pher po dang 'jem po'i gtam bshad rung / der nga chos yid ches skyes dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de tsam ma mchis te/ kho rang mi hreng yin khar yig cha sogs kyi sgyur dpang yang ston rgyu med/spyi lo 2002lo'i zla ba 6nang ga mi ri ka'i nyen brtag pa mi bzhis rig shog zhes pa lag 'jen 'khor lor brten nas zla ba gcig tsam ring dka' sdug la ma 'dzems par gtsod kyi rjes su 'brang ste re'u la da pa'i brgyud rim la rtog zhib byas yod/de yang par mkhan ka len (④za6༅dang rtsom bris pa rus kha ja0smosogs mi bzhi pos nyen brtag dang gtsod la rtog zhib byed rgyu gtso bor byasapa'i las don gyi 'al gzhi bzos nas spyi lo 2002lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes1nyin ru thog dang sger rtse'i sa mtshams kyi thog brtsegs gangs ri zhes pa nas thon te dpal rab mal nub dang / rdo nag byang mal shar la ded nas bod dang shing cang gi sa mtshams bcad de tha ma spyi zla 6pa'i tshes28nyin shing cang gi min hphang rdzong zaḥ༅gi lho phyogs su 'byor ba red/ kho la mthong thos dang par ris khag gcig a ri'i〈rgyal khang log shis〉zhes pa'i 2003lo'i dus deb bzhi pa'i thog bkod yod/ nyin brtag pa rnamasas—55—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bamatshams rgyab ste rdo nag byang mtsho nas byang ngos su med bar brgya tsam song rjes mo yumang po re'u 'khrid pa mthong 'dug pa ma zad de dag gi skor kho tshosapar len byas yod/gnyis pa/ gtsod rdams byang bskyod byedaXdagos donaXci yin/'di'i skor la yul mi 'brog pa chos rgyu tshan kha gsal shod rgyu ka'adug la da bar tshan rig gi thog nas zhing 'jug byas pa yang kha gsal zhig mi 'dug 'on kyang 'byor rje sha la'i ngos 'dzin la de ni zas rigs dang gcan gzan gyi gnod pa sogs dang 'brel ba yod par bshad/ de yang dang po/ zas rigs dang mtsho bcud kyi 'brel ba yin skor la 'byor rjesagatsod pho mo tshang ma rang rang gi dgun yonas gnas spos byed pa dang lhag par du mo khyu rnams re'u 'khrid khar dgun sa'i dzod skya zad sngo thug yin pa dang / gal srid yul byang du bskyod tshe byang gi lha rigs kha shas la spyodakar dang lin (tsho)sogs ldan yod pa de re'u 'khrid skabs med du mi rung ba'i 'tsho bcud yin/ yang gug po rnams de tsam kyi sa thag ring por gnasamaspos par nye 'khor lha kha drag sar 'gro bar bshad/gnyis pa/ gcan gzan gyi gnod 'tshe las g.yol thabs byed skor la/ 'byor rjes dgun sar spyang ki sogs gcan gzan gyis re'u la gsod bcom gyi gnod 'tshe che bas yumo rnams gcan gzan gyi gnod 'tshe chung sabyang khul du bskyod par bshad/— 56 —

lhagasums pa/ gtsod kyi grangs kyi 'bor/da bar 'dzam gling thog gtsod ga la yod med la tshan rig gi brtag dpyad dang grangs rgyag khyon yongs nas byed myong med/ zhib 'jug pa khashas kyis sa khul cha shas la grangs rgyag brtag dpyad byas pa rmang gzhir byasanas tsho rtsis byas yod pa dang / yang sa khul mang la sa dang las byed pa tshos tsho rtsis byas pa'i grangs 'bor 'dra min sna tshogs 'du dug pa las/gtso bo 'byor rjes tsho rtsis byas pa de mang che bas khas len pa dang rgyu tshan ldan par gzhi 'dzin gyi 'dug pas 'di skor gal bshad cung zad zhusan/byang thang gi nub rgyud aru'i nye 'gram gyi sa khul der gtsod pho mo bsdoms khri gnyis dang lnga stong tsam yod pa dang / g.yo jig gangs ris gtsos pa'i byang thang dbus khul du gtsod lnga stong nas bdun stong lnga brgya tsam yod/ byang thang shar brgyud la gtsos lnga stong tsam yod pa bcas byang thang rang byung srung skyob khul der gtsos khri gsum dang lnga stong nas khri bzhi bar yod pa dang /gzhan yang rang byung srung skyob khul min pa'i byang thang sal du gtsod stong khrag kha shas yod par rtsis na khyon bsdoms bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sa khul du gtsod khri bzhi dang lnga stong tsam yod par la rtsis byas yod/ de'i khar mtsho sngon sal lagatso da khri gcig nas khri gcig dang gnyis stong lnga brgya tsayodang / shin cang khul gyi gtsod khri gcig nas khri gcig dang lnga stong tsam bsnan na khyon bsdoms gtsod khri drug dang lnga stong nas khri bdun dang nyis stong —57—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu srang balnga brgya tsam yod par ra rtsis byas yod/gzhan yang sa khul mang tshogs dang las byed pa khag cig gis de bas grangs 'bor che ba'i skor kyi ra rtsis byed kyi 'dug par tshan rig dang dngos mthong gi bden dpang chen mi ldan par sems/ dper na 'brog pa kha shasakyis gtsod phal cher khri 10nas15bar yod par shod kyi yod la/ las byed kha shas kyis kyang khri 10zin thub par ngos 'dzin byed/ mdor na/ da ngar gtsod kyi grangs 'bor la zhib phra'i dzan rig gi thog nas grangs rgyag byed rgyu byung med pas kha gsal gyi grangs tshad brjod par dka'/bzhi pa/ tshonaXrgyag dang srungs skyob/bod gtsod de 'dzam gling thog rin thang dang skad grags chen po chags yod pa der gtso bo rgyu mtshan gsum yod de/ gcig khyad du 'phags pa'i gzugs kyi bkod pa dang / gnyis/ gtsod kyi 'tsho ba'i goms gshis dang gtsod khrims dam pa/ gsum/ gtsod kyi khu lu dang rwa co sogs lus steng gi cha shas mang por dpal 'byor gyi rin thang chen po ldan yod pa bcas red/ de yang gtsod kyi khu lus ske dkris bzo bar dngo drug brgya lhag tsam kyi lo rgyus yod pa dang thog mar gtsod kyi khu lus che'i (kasmir)yum du phyir tshong byas rjes yum der ske dkris bzos nas gtso bo ༅ de ga'i khrom ra'i nang spus tshong byed srol yod pa dang / gtsod khul gyi 'jam tshad dang / spud tshad/ ljid tshad sogs khu lu zhan las khyad du 'phags pas ming — 58 —

rtsal ‘‘sha thu shi (④yo ba①④ )zhes pa ta zig skad kyi ming thog yod/ ‘‘sha thu shi'i (④mas7①bya༅)zhes pa'i go don ni rgyal por rung nga'am khu lu'i rgyal por go dgos/de yang (byams)zhes pa rgyal po'i don dang (la①bya༅) zhes pa bal dang khu lur go ba las byung bar bshad/ gtsod khul las grub pa'i ske dkrisadang / mgo ras/ ga dkris sogs kha che'i (kasmir)yul du thog mar thon pa nas da bar dus rabs mang po'i lo rgyus ldan yod pa ma zad/ thon rdzas de khrom rar thon pa nas zung rgya gar dang pa ki gi than gtso bor byas pa'i o shi ya'i mi rigs mang pos dga' po byed pa dang / lhag par ga lu'i sge dkris de bu mo'i gter sgo'i nang nges par dgos pa'i rgyu nor zhig chags yod/ lo rgyus thog thog mar ban de thang san gyis khu lu'i ga dkris la mngags brjod byas yod pa dang de nas dus rabs17 pa'i lo rabs60 nang hpha ran se'i mi (bams①1④ zazatsho12༅)bod dang kha tsho (kasmir)༅ du slebs pa dang kha dkris de rigs skor lamang gas brjod kyi zin tho bkod yod par bshad/ dus de tsam nas khu lu'i ga dkris de nub phyogs mi grags dang rgyal tshang gi 'dzad spyod du 'gyur yod pa mapho thub/ dper na dus rabs18pa'i lo rangs90 nang hpha ran se'i rgyal po na pho lun (༅yo0za20sa)gyisabud med cu tse phan (10byas2za1mas)zhes par ske dkris gcig gnang rjes kho mos rgyu der dga' po byung ba ma zad/ rjes su gas ༅ nas ske dkris400tsam mngags nyo byas par grags/— 59 —
