bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bgatsod kyi ga lu de dag zog la zog brjes kyi rnam pa'i thog nas kha che la du 'gro gi yod pa dang / la de'i las sgon pa dang tshong gnyer pasagatsod khul gyi yongs khungs la gsang nga byed pa ma zad/ khu lu de dag byang gnyan dang rgya ra sogs kyi ga lu yin khul gyi 'al snang bzos te/ mi nyung shas shig gis nyo tshong der sger 'doms byas yod/ de nas spyi lo 1877—1879ring kha ba yul du mu ge byung nas mi lu'i thon rdzas dang nyo tshong la shugs rkyen byung ba ma zad nub phyogs su phyir tshong byed pa'i nus stongs nyamasargud song ba dang de rjes kyi lo brgya'i ring khu lu'i ske dkris kyi khrom ra gtso bo de rgya gar dang pha ki gi than yin/ gtsod khul gyi dmigs bas la chos dang rin thang la bskyar du ngos 'dzin gsar pa byung nas dus rabs gong ma'i lorabs brgyad bcu tsam nas gtsod kyi khu lu'i ske dkris de nub phyogs rgyal khab gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dzam gleng phyug bdag dang mtho rim mi drag gi rdzas spyod dang mas snyan kyi mtshon rtags lta bur gyur ba dang khu lu dang khu lu'i thon rdzas kyi rin thang yang ldab mang pos 'phar yod pas bar skabs su gtsod khul de khrom ra'i thog rin thang che shos dang khe ngab bzang shos kyi zog tu 'gyur yod/ dper na kha che kho nar gtsod khul gyi 'khel 'thag byed mkhan mi grangs khri bzhi dang tshong gnyer 'khel 'thag byed mkhan bsdoms na khri 10tsam lon yod pa des de'i rin thang dang khrom ra'i dgos mkho gal por shes thub/gtsod re nas khu lu khe 100—50tsam thon pa dang ske dkris rer nyung thar yang gtsod gsum nas bzhi bar gyi khu lu dgos kyi yod/ ske dkris kyi —60—

tsorin gong yang spus tshad dang che chung la gzhigs pas ngo rer a sgor stong phrag kha shas nas khri bar byed kyi yod/dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i nang bod nas nyo grub byasapa'i gas rgya ma rer ga sgor 120tsamathob kyi yod pa dang rgya gar du rgya ma rer a sgor 2500 nas3000bar thob pa'i khebazang yod pas kho spogs 'dod gdung gi lkog rngon pa dang lkog tshong pa mang pos byang thang gtsod kyi pha yul de rang gi rgyu dang longs spyod kyi 'dod pa skong rgyu'i bang mdzod lta bur mngon nas kho tshos go mtshon dang phar rgol gi nus pa rtsa ba nas med pa'i gtsod lanyin mtshan ltos med kyi rjes ded dang mnar gcod btang ba ma zad che chung dang pho mo'i dbye ba med par rig ma thag tu dmar gsod btang te 'dzam gleng thog gi sa gtsang shos dang mtho sgang srog chags dang skyes dngos kyi pha yul de re zhig 'dzam gling thog gi bshas ra che shos su btang nga red/ mdor na/ chung ba rnams sa la ma lhung gong srog shor ba dang rgan pa rnams srog ma shor gong lpags pa shor dgos pa'i gnas bab yong ba zhig byang thang gi gtsod la shar ba de ni deng rabs mi'i rigs kyi lor bas shes rig gi zhabasa'adren zhig yin pas de skor gleng na yang ngo gnong dgos pa zhig red/'dir nga tshos gtsod ga tshod bsad yod med dang gsag tshod khrimasa'agal kyis phyir tshong byas min la dngos yod grangs tshad kyi thog nas dgas la zhig brjod par ma nus rung rgya che'i klogs pos zur bstan leb mthong yong chen lkog rngon dang lkog tshong byas pa'i skor khag gcig bkod pa la/— 61 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga baspyi lo 1999bar rang ljongs su spyi bde tshan pa dang 'gag sgo bcasanas gzhung bzhes btang ba kho nar gtsod lpags6000lhag tsam dang khu lu rgya ma nyis stong zin yod/(dma' mthar gtsod 8000gi khu lu yod)mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi 'brel yod tshan pas1992—1999bar gtsod lpags15243tsam gzhung bzhes btang ba dang la rtsis byas pa la gzhigs na dus yun de'i ring zheng chen de kho nar gtsod khri 3tsam lkog gsod btang yod de yang 1992—1999bar shing cang rang skyong ljongs kyi 'brel yod tshan pa khag nas gtsod lpags4000tsam gzhung bzhes btang ba dang / la rtsisabyas pa ltar na shing cang du gtsod khri 1yan lkog gsod btang ba bcas gong gal gyi sa khul gsum bsdoms na dus yun de'i ring gtsod khri mang po bsad nas gtsod la du gtsod mthong rgyu dkon pa'i nyam nyes byung yod/ rdul ma skyes dgos pa zhig lad dung lkog rngon pa mang pos drag chas spras nas lo ltar byang thang du khrims 'gal rngon rgyag byas te gtsod kyi 'tsho ba dang 'phel rgyasal gnod 'tshe tshabs chen po bzo bzhin mchis/ dper na/ spyi lo 2002lo'i zla ba 11pa'i nang rngon pa mi grangs11mtsho sngon nas shing cang sa khul du 'jab bskyod kyis nyin nyi shu tsam ring la gtsod 745bsad nas gor mor slebs rjesaspyi bde'i las byed pas 'dzin bzung byas pa red/ yang spyi lo2002lo'i zla ba 5pa'i nang sger rtse rdzong drag po shang gi 'brog pa drug gis dzi bor brdzusanas byang thang srung skyob khul du gtsod 300lhag tsam bsad pa dang / tha ma nyi ma rdzong gi nags las nyen rtog pas shes rtogs byung nas rjes ded gtong —62—

tsoskabs nyen rtog par 'phrul mda'i kha phyogs nas nyen rtog pa gcig dkrong pa de ni rang ljongs su thon pa'i lkog rngon kyi gnas tshu tshabs che shos shig red/gtsod lpags rnams lkog tshong pa dang lkog rngon pas lhas ra stabasabade'i thog nas spu lpags dbye ba phye nas spu ga lu )rnams bal la dang rgya gar la phyir tshong byas rjes tha ma kha la 'khel 'thag bzo grwa'i nang slebs kyi yod/ spyi lo975lo'i zla ba 7pa'i tshes kyi nyin stong la nye ba'i ri skyes skyesadangos dang srog chags kyi rgyal spyi'i nyo la spyi la sa nus pa thon pa nasagatsod de spyi chings nang la yod pa dang / de nas979lor yang bskyar spyi chings kyi zhar byung dang po'i nang bcug nas srung skyob byed rgyur sbul lcag btang yod stabs rgyal khab mang po'i srid gzhung gis gtsod kyi ka lu'i thon rdzas kyi nyo tshong la bkag 'gog dang gzhung bzhes yang mi nyung ba zhig btang yod/ dper na/ spyi lo993nas99bar rgya gar srid gzhung gi 'brel yod tshan pas khu ga rgya yo66(gtsod 6460tsam gyi khyad ) dang / ske dkris50bcas gzhung bzhes btang nga dang di spyi lo 994nas99ngar bal yu gyi 'brel yod tshan bas gtsod kyi ga lu bsdoms rgya lo 52(gtsod lnga stong yozin tsam gyi khu lu)tsam rtsad la lag zin thub yod/ gzhan yang yod ri ka dang dbyen ji/ hpha ran rtse sogs 'dzad spyod rgyal khab la mas gtsod khul gyi nyo tshong la bkag 'gog dang de'i thon rdzas kyi khrom ra'i thog med pa bzo rgyur bya spyod sna tshogs spe bzhin yod/ dper na 997lo'i zab2pa'i nang dbyin lha'i rgyalas la na don du rin thang ga sgor khri tsho 60zin pa'i ske dkris—63—

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga ba138rtsad la gzhung bzhes btang yod/gong du brjod pa'i gtsod lpags dang ga lu de bzhin ske dkris bcasakyi skor ni rtsad ra dang lag zin byung ba'i dpe mtshon tsam las dngosasugatsod ga la bsad yod med dang khu lu ga la phyir tshong byas min thad gal brjod byed pa dka'/ gtsod 'bor chen 'di 'dra ba gsod mkhan rngon pa mang po yod pa ma zad gsod stangs kyi thad la yang thabs dang rnam pa sna tshogs yod/ thog mar deng rabs go mtshon la brten nas gzhi rgya chen pos gtsod mang po dmar gsod byed pa de dang byang thang du gser sngog 'don byed pa 'brel ba chen po yod/ de yang dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs brgyad bcu nas bzung mtsho sngon phyogs nas mi mang po (kha che )byang du gser 'don la song ba dang gser 'don pa de dag gis thog mar ri skyes srog chagasarngon rgyab nas sha za ba dang / de rjes gser 'don pa sbyin bdag re zung lasami mang che bar gser las kho phan ma byung stabs/ gser 'don mkhan mang po khamathun byas nas 'phrul chas dang 'phrul mda' khyer nas byang du rngon lachas pa de nas bzung deng dngas go mtshon la ra nas gtsod khyu dmar bsod btong ba'i chag sgo 'go brtsams pa red/gzhan yang mnga' ris dang nag la 'brog la du tshong skor la 'gro mkhan chang mdo'i tshong pa rnams kyis 'brog par 'tsho ba'i mkho chas mkho'adon dang dus mtshungs 'brog pa'i 'brog las thon rdzas nyo grub byed la de khyab che tsam yod pa de yang tha ma gtsod kyi khu lhag bo bor byas pa'i nag tshong —64—

tsodang 'ang mtshong zhig tu 'gyur ba tshang mas shes gsal red/ tshong pa mang po zhig gis thad kar drag chas spras te gtsod gsod pa dang gshas kyis 'brog par tshong zog snga 'don dang zog rin lagatso da lpags las dngul zog gzhan mi len pa'i srol yang yod/byang thang gi 'brog pa tshos kyang zog rin 'jal ched dang rang gi 'tsho ba yar rgyas 'gro chen 'phrul mda' dang rnyi sogs kyi thabs shes la brten nasagatsod rngon pa ma zad 'brog pa re zung gis phyi rol lkog rngon par sa rgyus lamargyus byas te lkog rngon tshogs pa rnams gtsod 'tsho gnas bya yul mang por ngan 'khrid byas yod pa red/gtsod kyi dmigs bsal rin thang dang khyad chos goms gshis(gtsod khrims)rnams rang nyid med par bzo nga'i chag sgo lta bur gyur yod/yu mo rnams byang du re'u 'khrid skabs sngar rgyun lam kho na las sa gsar layogasar du 'gro gi med stabs rngon pa tshos gtsod kyi lam 'phrad khag tu go mtshon 'khyer na sgug brdung gtong thengs rer gtsod brgya phrag gsod thub kyi yod pa de ni jon pa'i thabs shes gtso bo zhig red/ deng skabs yang byang thang du rngon pas bzos pa'i gtsod lam mthong rgyu yod pa dper na sa thang dang yul lung kha srang sar yod pa'i gtsod lamathog rngon pas thun rdo (dkar gong )sgrig nas gtsod lam de rim pas 'phrang dam du btang nas gtsod rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril rjes rngon pa mang pos dus gcig tu 'phrul mdas gtsod gsod kyi yod pa de yang sa khul 'brog pa'i nyam pyong dang phyi nol pa'i go mtshon gcig sgril gyis dmar gsod byed pa'i thabs gtso bo zhig — 65 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bayin/ gzhan yang gtsod rnams bod zla bcu pa'i nang ngar la sa skabasagatsod pho mo mang po nges gtan kyi sa gnas su 'dzoms nas da ga spyor byed skabs rngon pas lung shur re gnyis phud pa'i ngar gzhung sa gnas kyi g.yasagayon du sgra phab snyan 'phrin gyi sbyin shog rtswa'i rtser brkon pa dang sbyin shog la rlung po rgyab nas sgra khyad tshar po zhig go dus gtsod rnams sbyin shog med pa'i lung shur kho nar rgyugs yong ba'i khyad chos la brten nas sa gnas gcig rang du gtsod brgya phrag mang po gsod pa'i bya spyod ngan pa la yod/lkog rngon pas byang thang du gzhi rgya chen po'i rngon rgyag bya spyod 'go tshugs pa nas bzung rang rgyal srid gzhung nas kyang srung skyob dang lkog rngon bkag 'doms kyi las don sna tshogs spe yod/ snga rjes su shing cang sakhongs kyi ar cin hran dang mtsho sngon khongs gtog gi kho kho shi li/ bod kyi khyang thang bcas gtsod gnas yu gtso bo rnams rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul du gtan 'khel byas pa dang lo ltar byang thang gi sa gnas gtso bo khag tu gtsod skor dang rngon 'gog gcig lcogs kyi nyen skyon skor zhib thengs mang byed pa ma zad/ lkog rngon gyi dogs brda dang gal brda 'byor skabs 'brel yod tshan pa khag nas nyin tshan ltos med kyi lkog sngon par rjesa'aded gtong ba dang drag chas sprad pa'i lkog rngon pa dang ngo dang ngo thug pa'i 'thab 'dzings byas te byang thang gi ri skyes srog chags la srung skyob byed kyi yod la/ skabs re las byed pa'i srog kyang shor ba'i gnas tshu tshangs chen thon gyi yod pa dper na/ spyi lo 1994lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes18nyin bsod nams dar rgyas dang las dogs pa mi bzhis kho kho shi li'i khul du lkog rngon pa — 66 —

tsomi grangs nyi shu dang rlangs 'khor 7gtsod lpags600tsam 'dzin bzung dang gzhung bzhes btang nas phyir log byed ring lkog rngon pas 'phrul mda' rgyab nas bsod nams dar rgyas bkrong bde ni 'thab 'dzing 'di'i nang rang srog blos btang gis gtsod srung skyob gnang mkhan dpa' bo dang po de yin/ spyi lo 992lor mtsho sngon zhing la 'bri stod rdzong ud nas kha gshi li'i thon khungs nga skyob byed la nub phyogs las don u yon lhan khang gsar du btsugs pa dang rdzong ud kyi hru ci gzhon pa bsod nams dar rgyas kyis lasadon u yon de'i hru'u ci'i 'gan bzhes gnang nas lkog rngon pa'i khragatad cag yod/de nas1995lor la shul med mangs 'a sal sa khrims skyong u yon lhan khang gi gru'u rin gzhon bgrags pa rdo rjes las gnas phyir 'then byas te bskyar du nub phyogs las don u yon lhan khang sgrig la gsabyas pa dang 'brong ru khag ༅gas lo ) zhes pa'i drag chas ru khag btsugasapa de'i nang ru mi64yod pa dang ru mi mang che ba dmag log pa dang spyi tshogasathog gi las sgug gshon nu dang slob gso thon pa'i lkog rngon pa yang yod/ ru khag des khyod bsdoms lkog rngon pyod gzhi bcu tsam rtsad la thub pa dang /gtsod lpags khri ma zin tsam gzhung bzhes btang yod/spyi lo2002lo'i zab 5pa'i nang rang ljongs kyi nyi ma rdzong nags lasanyen rtog pa nor bu gas rgyal dang de bzhin mi gsum rdzong khongs kyi loganasakhag la nyen skyon skor zhib la bskyod ring se'u gangs ri'i mtshams su lkog rngon pa mi drug dang thug skabs phan tshun 'thabar 'phrod cing tha mnor bu g.yurgyal la mde'u thengs mang phog rjes grong grongs pa red—67—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba/mdor na nye ba'i lo ngo nyi shu'i ring rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor dang srid jus thog rgyab skyor gnang ba brgyud/ bod rang skyong ljongs dang mtsho sngon zhing chen/ shing cang rang skyong ljongs bcas kyis gtsod gnas yum kyi byang thang chen po 'dir (byang thang dang ga kha shi li/ ar cin hran )rang byung srung skyob khul btsugs pa ma zad/ sa gnas dang yul grong gtso bo khag gcig tu gtan 'jag dang dus tshigs 'gag sgo dang srung skyob sa tshigasabatsugs te do dam dang srung skyong byed pa'i lam lugs shig chags yod/gzhan yang zhing chen gsum nas lo ltar byang thang mi med lung stong khul la nyen skyon rtog zhib byas te lkog rngon pa mang po rngon yul dngos nas 'dzin bzung byas yod/ 'on kyang gtsod khul kyi khrom thang che bsad dung mi mang po zhig gi nor dang longs spyod kyi chen du rgyal khab dang rang byung srung skyob khul gyi bca' khrims la rdog rol rtsis med btang nas lo ltar byang thang du gtsod rngon gyi yod pa red/de yang ri shi'i sha rdzong las ge sar rgyal pos ri shi rnams sdug spong dge sgrub la skul ba'i gsung mgur du/ khyang li khri mtshal dmar thang chen la/mtshal dmar po'i 'od mdangs gnam la song / dgong nyi zer srab mda' 'khyug 'dra ba/ mtshal dmar po'i gter kha len sa red/ li khri rdza rgyal mchen lnga de/ bdud nag rgyal khab rtsang nga 'dra/ lo khri de'u dmar sprun bdun de/ bu spun bdun byes la song ba 'dra/ li yum gad thang skya mo de/shar skya rengs nam mkha' langs pa 'dra/ gtsod kham pa chags pa'i pha sared/ gom bde mo gzhung lam bskor sa red/ ra rtse modagung ka'aphyar sa— 68 —

tsored/ dgung nam mkha'i glog dmar lug 'dra ba/ gug pogs kyi gomamyur zer1 rlung ba྾ ma'i thog la zhon 'dra ba/ gug po gas kyi bang khazer/ mgo rna gshog rlung gi gur khang phub/ la bcu rgyab bye'u chung gshog sgra go spyan khra chung ljang khu'i a 'bras la/ kun dmathong blta ba'i sob thub/sa mi 'gyur byang thang mnga' bdag la/ rgyu 'byor phyug rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gcig gdan logazhi byang thang skya mol/ rgyan rtse tog bkra ba'i rten 'brel gnyis/ las bskal ba ༅sa pa'i rten 'brel gsum/ dus ma'ongs mkhoba'i rten 'brel bzhi/ de 'gro don gtsod las che ba med/ gsod mi rung ri shi'i sde gas rnams/ lha brgya byin dbang po'i sde gas kyis/ gug po gtsod la mig 'tsho byed/ lo khri ma྾ dmar bcu bdun gyis/ gug po gtsod la rgyang 'tsho byed/ li dmar sde tshan rigs lnga yis/ gug bo gtsod lakha 'tsho byed ces gsung /le'u 'di'i mchan 'grel/④(ba 'gro༅༅waṃ〉sgo༅tsho41④(gas cig656'i1'i)④(④lo1'u1 6 1998 so1 1ma1 1'uX11 11gas bya1'ub༅)④(byam 'u1 6 1༅8 so ga1'uX11stu'u11ja1ba bya169༅)①(71 ༅coms za〉tsho5①(༅1༅༅ro lo za〉po9—yo— 69 —

sa bcad lnga pa/ 'brong /ming gzhan/ g.yag rgod/ dud 'gro'i rgyal po/rigs kyi dbye ba/ mig pa kha dbrag gi sde/ ba glang tshan/gzugs dbyibs kyi cad chos/'brong ni dud 'gro'i rgyal po dang / rwa can kyi rgyu mal ri dwagasakyi rgyal po yin te/ de ni srog chags gzhan las gzugs stobs che zhing dpa' ngar rgod che bas gcan gzan spyang dred gsa' sogs kyis kyang tshugasapar dka' bas gang la'ang mi 'jigs pa'i snyeng stobs ldan pa/ rkang lag rags shing mjing pa sbom pa/ mgo bo che la dpral ba yangs pa/ gdong thag thung la sna khung che ba/ mig spu ring la mig gnyis 'bur tshugs su thon pa/rna ba krong la mnyen cha ldan pa gnam lcagasang da ma lta bu'i rwa gnyis mdun du cung la la zhing rwa rtse lcags kyu ltar no ba gyen du slangs pa/ khro la pha bong la 'gran par nus pa'i rmig pa kha dbrag gis rdza lam gsheg skabs brag rdo chag tse nyil ler gtong thub pa'i sra mkhregs can/ gnam rgod ser rkang gshib 'dra'i gra rtsid ring la mthug pa/ sprin nag lang long 'phyur 'dra'i rnga ma dgung du g.yob cing 'phong ba brab pa sogs gang 'dod du sgyur thub pa/gcig pur rdza ri 'dzin skabs seng ge gangs la gnas pa ltar nyam nga dang — 70 —

'brong bags med pa1 'brong gsag khyu tshogs rdza ka' gyi skabs nas ma ka'i sprinanag gi gring mas la 'phos pa lta bur mchis/'brong gi mig rgyang de 'dra'i gsal po med rung / rna ba gsang 'dzi skyen pas mi sogs nye bar bcar mi thub cing / gal srid rmas ma lta bu thag nyer 'phrad na 'brong g.yag mang che ba mi'i steng du gdong bzur med par mtshongs yong ste rwa rtser lings kyis mas pas mi rnams kyis do snang dbyed ka med kyi yul du gyur/ de bzhin nyin mor rdza gseb tu nyal zhing mtshan mor dka snyegs pas‘‘ltogs kyang nyin ba'i za ba/ bre ser 'brong gi lo tshulayin1 zhes zer srog yod/ 'brong gi spu mdog bre bo khon las mi 'byung bsami tshos bre ka'abrong dang / 'brong bre ser sogs su 'bod la nang gses bye skya dang pre sprug gnyis yod/ da dung gar shog dang khu 'du zhes rigs gnyisasubashad kyang don du rwa dbyings kyi khyad par tsam las dbye ba cher ma mchis/'brong ni sha gtos che la lpags thamathug pas 'brong g.yag che ba re'i lus kyi ljid sa spyi rgya chig stong lon par bshad/ 'di'i lus la snying dang / snyeng khrag rwa co/ 'bras bu/ gas pa sogs rtsa che'i sman rigs bcu phrag skor yod/ rtsa thang steng gi 'brog pa tshos kyang ‘‘rdza stod mthon po phyi ye lcags ri/bre ser 'brong rgod nang gi nor bu 1zhes pa sogs glu gzhas dang / gtam bshad/ kha dpe sogs kyi nang 'brong la che brjod dang / bstod pa'i nang don mang po gang sar khyab pas rtsa rṣa du brtsib shes thubaḍi① (khyad du 'phags pa'i byang thang ngo mtshar 'os pa'i thon khungs/〉lcags dpar deb ngos 95—97— 71 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba‘‘'brong gi mtho za la/ rbid 1 73—2 03tsam dang / ring sa larngid 3 58—3 81tsam yod pa/ 'brong che ba'i ljid sa spyi rgya 821lon pa/'brong rwar rbid 0 75 dang rwa zheng rbid 0 42tsam yod/’ ④ 'brong gi spu mdog skor la sngar pyi shod rgyun ba bre bo khon las mi 'byung bar bshad rung /deng skabs byang thang gi sa cha mang por 'brong kham pa dang / 'brong nag khra/tha na sa cha nyung shas su 'brong dkar po mthong ba'i skor byang thang gis 'brog pas brjod pa dang mthong rgyu yang yod/ dang po/ 'brong gi 'tsho sgod gnas yul/'brong gi 'tsho sdod bya yul gtso bo ni mtsho bod mtho sgang gi ldang la dang khu nu la/ ba yan ha ri/ ji lan ri bo sogs kha char bu yug 'tshub che ba dang gnam gshes grang ngar dang 'gyur ldog che ba/ rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho sa rngid 3200nas5400yan zin pa'i ri khul du yin/ gzhan yang 'brong nyung shas bod kyi nye 'gram bal yul dang la dwags su 'gro gi yod par bshadadiganyis pa/ 'brong gi grangs 'bor/'brong gi grangs 'bor thad da bar skomang pos ga rtsis dang yang na ④ (cha5811'u1 6 1998 ma1 1611100115'u11cha1mas bya1'u2༅ 2128)— 72 —

'brong stabs bde'i rtsis rgyag la brten nas 'os tshams kyi grangs tshad 'dra min bstan yod/ dper na/ kha shas②kyis 'brong lnga brgya tsam las med zhes pa dang / gshas①kyis 'brong khri gnyis nas bzhi tsam yod par bshad/'dir nga tshos 'brong gi grangs 'bor 'di tsam yod ces brjod pa'i rgyu cha dang grangs rtsis kha gsal med rung / spyir rtogs zhing pa mang che ba'i tshod rtsisadang 'brong yod pa'i sa khul gyi 'brog pa'i tshod rtsis bcas la gzhigs nasadabye zhib byas na da yod 'brong gi grangs 'bor la chod dpag rob tsam zhig byed thub/ de yang 'brong 500tsam las med par bzhed pa de ni rtsa ba nasadangos yod dang mi mthun pa zhig yin te/ dper na aru dang rong ma sogasas du 'brong khyu mang tsam yod pa dang khyu che bar 'brong 80lhag tsam yod bas sa khul de kho nar 'brong 1000yod pa brjod med yin/ gzhan yang 'brong khri gnyis nas gsum tsam yod par bshad pa der yang rgyu mtshan de tsam med pa gsal po yin te/ lo rgyus thog byang thang gi sa cha mang cher bar 'brong 'tsho sdod byed pa dang 'brong gi grangs 'bor yang mang po yod/ don dngosathog dus rabs nyi shu'i 'brong gi 'tsho sdod sa gnas dang grangs 'bor bcasalagator bshig rgya chen po btang yod1 byang thang khul kyi 'brog las 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang dus mchos nor phyugs kyi sa thang rim bzhin byang rgyud mimed lung stong zhes pa ri skyes srog chags 'tsho sdod byed yum du rgya skyed btang ba las 'brong gi lha za 'tsho sdod byed yum rim bzhin rgya ༅ du song ba ma zad 'tsho sdod cha rkyen yang rim pas zhan du song yod/ gzhan yang dus rabs nyi shu'i nang 'brong de rngon pa'i dmigs yum kyi gtso bo zhig du gyur bas de'i ring — 73 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga ba'abrong mang po zhig sngar gyi la sal du da lta rig rgyu med pa la sa yod/der brten byang thang du 'brong khri gsum bzhi tsam yod par bshad pa de ni la rtsis las rgal ba rang red 'dugaspyir rtogs zhing pa mang pos nan tan gyi rtogs zhib dang sa khul ngesacan du rtsis rgyag byas par gzhigs na byang thang ngam 'dzam gleng thog 'brong pho mo bsdoms khri gcig dang lnga stong tsam yod par bshad pa der rgyu mtshan ldan par sems/ de yang bod kyi byang thang rang byung srung skyob khul dang de'i phyi rol du yod pa'i 'brong bsdoms stong dgu tsam ①yod pa dang / mtsho sngon sakhungs su 'brong 2500④tsam yod pa/ de bzhin shin cang sa khul du 'brong 2000—2500④yod pa bcas bsdoms na spyir khri gcig dang bzhi stong nas lnga stong tsam zin gyi yod/gsum pa/ 'brong dang g.yaga'abrong dang g.yag gi byung khungs ba mes gcig yin pa dang / rim bzhin 'brong khag gcig g.yung du phab pa mas 'bri g.yag byung ba ni mi'i rigs 'pho 'gyur byung ba'i lo rgyus las ra 'phrod thung pa zhig yin/ spyir tshan rig gi thog nas ngos 'dzin byas par gzhigs na 'brong dang ri dwagasagazhan rnams sgo phyugs su g.yung nas da ngar lo ngo khri gcig tsam song yodashaṃ'abri g.yag rnams sgo phyugs su g.yung ba dang 'brong rnams thang rgod du ri —74—

'brong dwags la gnas pa'i brgyud rim nang gshis rgyud dang gzugs stobs thad la mig mthong lag zin gyi khyad par byung yod rung 'brong dang g.yag gi 'brel ba de da bar rgyun cad med/'o na 'bre g.yag dang 'brong gi dbar la 'brel bdang mthun pa'i khyad chos gang dang gang yod zhes na/gcig 'tsho sdod kyi sa gnas dang rtsa za'i thad 'brong dang g.yag gnyis ka sab ba mtho las dbye bas rtog pa/ grang ngar che ba/ gso rlung nyung ba'i sa gnas sa 'tsho sdod byed pa dang / sa sna 'dzoms pa dang rtswa spusalegs sar bza byed kyi yod la 'bri g.yag khyu dang 'brong khyu rnams lung gzhung dang brog sring nang phan tshun nye por lha za bzhin skabs skabs khyu 'dresapa yang yod srid/ gnyis/ 'bri g.yag dang 'brong gi gshis ka dang spyod pa'i khyad chosathad/ ma gzhi 'bri g.yag g.yung du phab nas rgyun ring song yod na yang gshis spyod mang po'i thad 'brong dang ha cang 'dra po yod de/ dper na/'jig yag gis rgyus med kyi phyi mir skrag snang byed pa dang lhag par du be'u yod pa'i po phyugs kyis mthong rgyus med pa'i dbe'u khris su bcad du mibacug la der rdung jus byed1 gzhan yang pho phyugs dang mo phyugs rnamasargyun du khyu 'dres mi byed par pho phyugs rnams po phyugs las rgyang ring bral te ri gseng kyi khrod du sdod pa dang chag snam sbyor kyi skabs su gzhi nas mo khyu dang 'dres kyi yod/gsum/ chagashes sbyor gyi khyad chos thad 'brong dang 'bri g.yag gnyis— 75 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bal dmigs bas gyi la par med/ 'brong dang g.yag gi drug dus semasacan gzhan las cung phyi ba yod/ spyir pho mo chags sbyor du lo gsum dang phyed tsam nas zhugs kyi yod/ skabs re loganyis tsam nas chags pa'i re bsabazhon 'jeg 'dra min byed pa las dngos su be'u chags pa nyung zhagazhan yang 'brong dang 'bri g.yag bar kyi la sa spyod 'brel ba de rgyun la med par byang thang du mngon rgyu yod/ de yang 'brong dang sgo phyugs 'bre'i dbar la 6'brong tsha khrid mi mi pa'am ‘'brong tsha shor ba'i 'brel ba yod de/ chagasasbyor gyi dus zin mtshams 'brong pho phyugs rnams rim bzhin mo khyu'i nang du 'dres yong la gal srid mo khyu gcig la pho kha shas tshang kha thebs skabs pho rnams mo la ga thob kyi ched du rwa 'dzing nas rgyal pham dbye ba phye kyi yod/ de yang mjug ma 'gam la zer zhing / ngar skad dang thal rdul slang nas payoshor ma byung bar du 'thab 'dzing byed la thob pas mo khyu la bdag thob byed pa dang / pham pa rnams kha shas khyu las bral te ri gseb lha chu legs par log nas gshed stobs rgyas par byas nas phyi lo'i la sa spyod kyi dus su slar yang 'thang par thon yong gi yod/ yang pham rung ngar rgyal dang 'dod chagasasnon ma thub pa khag gcig nye khor gyi sgo phyugs 'bri khyu'i nang 'dres nasachags spyod byed pa der 'brong tsha shor ba red ces brjod pa dang / 'brong de dag rang gi sdod la phyogs su log skabs sgo phyugs 'bri rnams de'i jesasushor ba la 'brong tsha la da pa red ces brjod srol yod/ gzhan yang 'brong de dag sgo phyugs 'bri dang 'dres nas chags pa spyad rjes 'bri rnams btsan gshed kyis 'brong gi 'tsho gnas sa khul du 'khrid pa yang yod/ nye dusas— 76 —

'brong khul mang por 'brong rtsa shor nas 'bri yod skabs 'brog pas bkag thabasabyas par 'brong gis brdung nas 'brog pa mang por rmas skyon byung yod la 'brog pa dang 'brong gi dngar la yang 'gal zla chags pa'i gnas tshul mang po 'dugale'u 'di'i mchan 'grel/④(baXr1 6 saX165yo6༅ 055ba6nus yo 1tsho1)④(1ma pa0ye 1 'ib6ji 2yo0smo 1986)①(ka5 2 ya za1ya 15 1993)①(za111yo6ra1mi 1993) ①( 11101 mas bya ⑫1 1994)①(cha6ma161 6 1998 yo11611 16༷116'u11mas④1'u9༅)④(thung go'i 'bri g.yag rig pa〉lcags dpar deb ngos 9⑫(grung go'i 'bri g.yag rig pa/〉lcags dpar deb ngos48

sa bcad drug pa/ rbung /ming gzhan/ pho la hreng dang / mo la rgod ma zhes 'bod srol yod/rigs kyi dbye ba/ ri dwags kyi rigs dang / mig zlum gyi sde/ rta'i tshan pa1gzugs dbyibs kyi khyad chos/rkyang gi spyi'i gzugs dbyibs sgo phyugs rta bong dang 'dra ba/ mgo mjug bar la ring tshad rmid gnyis tsam dang ljid tshad la spyi rgya 300tsam yod/rkyang gi sug bzhi ring la mgo 'phang mtho ba rna cog bong bu ltar ring po med rung ha cang 'drong po yod pa/ lus kyi spu mdog dmar la ser sha ldan pa dang/pho long dang brang gzhung kha mtshul bcas dkar la rnga rngog nas nyams ldan pa bcas dang / dzi gsang zhing 'drogs mgo tsha ba/ bang mgyogs shing 'dur skyen pa/ rgyud rgod la gshis stong ba'i ri dwags shig yinashaṃdangaXbo/ byungaXgi 'tsho sgod gnas yul/ri dwags rkyang ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad rmid 2700nas5300nang tshun gyi spang thang dang ri gseb sogs lha chu legs sar khyu che chung — 78 —

nga 'dra min du sgril nas sdod pa dang khyu la yang pho khyu mo khyu dmigs su dbye bas/rkyang ni mtsho bod mtho sgang gi dmigs bas po ri dgas shig yinathadang / gtso bo bod kyi nag chu dang / mnga' ris/ gzhis rtse de bzhin mtsho sngon zhing chen dang / shing cang bcas kyi rgyal nang sa cha khag brkyang mang po yod pa dang / gzhan yang thod dang la dgas dang rgya gar bcas kyi 'brel mtshams su rkyang nyung shas yod pa rtogs zhib pa 'ga' res mthong ba ltar yinashaṃganyis pa/ rkyang gi grangs 'bor skor/gong du brjod pa ltar byang thang du gnas pa'i ri skyes srog chags la da bar nan tan dang zhib 'as gi grangs 'bor rtsis rgyag byed rgyu byung med stabs/ grangs 'bor gyi tshod rtsis thad he bag shin tu chen po 'dugadaper na/ 〈krung go'i rtsa che'i srog gas kyi deb dmar〉las krung go'i sakhongs khon ra rkyang khri nyi shu yan zin gyi yod par bshad pa dang / yang mkhasabadang brtag dpyad pa khag gcig gis rkyang khri lnga nas drug bar yod pa'i tshod rtsis byas 'dug④de bzhin 'byor rje sha las④kyang rkyang khri drug nayobadun tsam yod par gsungs pa spyir khri lnga drug dang khyad par cher ka'aduganye ba'i lo shas ring nga tshos byang thang gi sa mang che bar las don dang rtog zhib la bskyod skabs sa khul 'ga' shas dang lhag par lam gzhung du rkyang la grangs rgyag byas pa dang / de bzhinas khul kyi 'brog pa mang tshogs dang las— 79 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang ba/byed pa bcas la 'dri zhib byas pa'i thog nas rkyang khri bcu zin yod pa'i la dpags zhig byas na 'tshams par 'dug snyam/ de yang byang thang de rang byung srung skyob khul du gtan 'khel byas pa dang / lhag par du rkyang sogs ri skyes srog chags rnams rngon skol pa'i srid jus lag bstar byas pa nasabazung byang thang gi lung pa mang che sar rkyang gi grangs 'bor cung mang du song yod la byang thang dang mnga' ris sa khul gyi lam che mang po'i g.yas g.yon du rkyang khyu sgrig nas stobaza' byed pa mthong rgyu yod pa dang / de bzhin nga chos spyi lo 2002lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i nang dge rtse rdzong brag phug shang dang shan jan shang bar gyi spyi le50nang rkyang stong khrag gcig las mang ba dang / yang spyi lo 2001lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i nang ru thog nas dge rgyas rdzong (byang lam )ngar grangs 'bor rtsis rgyag byas par khyon bsdoms rkyang 834yod pa sogasalas rkyang khyon bsdoms khri bcu lon pa gal por mngon thub/gsums pa/ byung gi lhan mur rdo gong du brjod pa ltar/ rkyang pho la hreng dang rol rgod ma zhes pa'i 'bod srol yod la/ rkyang hreng pho la skya nag gi dbye ba yod pa las hreng skya rnams la 'a ga spyod kyi nus pa med par bshad pa der tshan rig gi brtag dpyad dgos par snyam/ rgod ma rnams rte'u btsa' skabs khyu sgrig pa dang /rkyang pho hreng gis mtha' nas rten srung byed pa dang / kha char bu yug tshugasamatshams la hreng phos 'gram phug tu yod pa'i mur rdo ngoms nas mgo —80—

nga gnam dbyings sung te gas rjes thamachu zengs nas sprin pa dwangs pa dang char 'gog rṣa red ces zer ba/ dper na〈lha chos dang mthun pa'i gtamapadma'i tshal gyi zlos gar〉las‘‘byang thang spangs ljongs nyams dga'i thang na/kha dkar rkyang chung lhan bang chen/ nyi zer 'bod pa'i nor bu yod skad/khong la zhus na mur mur bteg 'gro’3zhes ser sbrang ngag snyan rtse tog padma'i sbubs gsams skabs rkyang la re 'bod byas par rkyang gis‘6pho reng rkyang chung 'u ra de thamachu yid bzhin nor bu yin/ mkha' sgrib ྾ ba'i phyags ma yin/ nga la re ba ma nor 'dug zer nas thamachu gnam du bteg go zhesapa lta bu'o/le'u 'di'i mchan 'grel/①(khyad du 'phags pa'i byang thang ngo mtshar 'os pa'i thon khungs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 97①(gas161 6 1998 yo1 1ma1 1'uX11smo6la1cha1ba bya1'u9༅)④(lo༅ba ༅༅zas bas〉tsho1④(cha 11'u1 6 1998 yo1 1ma1 1'uX115༷11༄1ba bya1bab༅)— 81 —

sa bcad bdun pa/ dred mong /ming gzhan/ dred/ ri dwags za/ rting ril/rigs kyi dbye ba/ gcan gzan gyi rigs dang sder can gyi tshan du gtogs/srog chags dred mong la rigs kyi dbye ba mang ba dang de dag gi lusastongs dang spu mdog yang 'tsho sdod gnas yu kyis rkyen pas byung mi 'dra ba ni srog chags spyi'i 'phel rim mtshan nyid dang mthun pa zhig red/ bod kyi byang thang sa khul du yod pa'i dred mong de dag gzugs stobs byung che la lusaspu stug zhing ring ba dang / 'gram dkyus kyi spu mdog ser shas dod pa dang brang gzhung skya shas dod pa las de byings lus spu kham sprug tu mngon/ dred mong dar ma'i ljid tshad la spyi rgya 100tsam yod/bod kyi sa cha mang por dred mong 'tsho gnas byas pa'i lo rgyus dang da ltayang sa khul mi nyung bar dred mong re zung yong rung / dred mong gi 'tsho gnasabya la gtso bo byang thang yin/ sab ba mtho dma' dang grang ngar che chung gisadred mong gi 'tsho bar de tsam gyi shugs rkyen med/ 'on kyang dred mong 'tsho gnas kyi khor yug la nges par du gab tu rung ba'i sa btsan dang dgun nyal du rung ba'i brag phug de bzhin zas su rung ba'i zas rgyu bcas kyi cha rkyen — 82 —

dre mong tshang dgos/ dred mong gi sdod gnas sa cha mang che ba brag dang yod ma de bzhin brag phug btsan sar gsum bzhi re mnyam sdod byed pa dang yang tshang che sar dred mong bcu lhag tsam yod pa sa gnas mang tshogs dang brtag dpyad bas mthong ba lta bu yin/ 'on kyang dred mong gi 'gul skyod dang bya spyod rnams gsang la btsan pas byang thang du nyin mang po'i 'grul bzhud byas kyang dred mong mthong mi thub pas dred mong gi khyu che chung dang grangs 'bor 'tsho ba'i goms gshis bcas la khags zhig zhu dpog ma phod/yod ba gling gi nyen brtag myul dpyad pa'i mthong thos la gzhigs na bod kyi sa khul byang thang sogs su dred mong mang po yod pa dang / gzhan yang bod kyi yul mang por dred mong yod pa'i sgrung mang po yod pa bcas las sngar dred mong mang po byung ba brjod med yin pa dang rim bzhin mi'i grangs 'bor 'phel rgyas song ba dang dus mtshungs dred mong gi 'tsho gnas khor yug je zhan du song ba ma zad sa khul mang por dred mong rtsa stong phyin pa dang / byang thang de dred mong 'tsho gnas byed yul tha ma de chags ba red/ byung thang du dred mong ga tshod yod med bzhib tshag gi rtogs zhing byung med/ nga chos tshod rtsisal gzhigs na byang thang du dred mong stong tsho gcig tsam zin thub/ dred mong la rang byung ngas lhan skyes kyi dgra med rung / dom mkhris dang dom lhags kyi chen du bar skabs sa dred mong mang po bsad pa dang / dred mong gisaskophyugs gnyis kar thad ka'i gnod 'tsho bzos stobs sa khul 'ga' shas sumiphyugs la gnod che ba'i dred mong bsad bdab/ de bzhin nye ba'i lo50nang byang thang gi 'brog las rim bzhin byang rgyud lung stong ngos su rgya bskyed btang — 83 —

nge kyi lha 'a ma sa nga nga sa kyi zang sa nga bab ma zad ri skyes srog chags tshang ma'i grangs 'bor dang khyu tsho nyams zhan du song ba las dred mong gi 'tsho gnas khor yug la yang gnod 'tshe byung yod/mdor na dred mong gi 'tsho gnas srung skyob la snyamathu da shugs gnon ma rgyab tshe/ grangs 'bor dang khor yug nyams rgud du 'gro ba ma zad/ tha ma dred mong gi rigs khyu mu mthud 'tsho gnas thub min gyi dka' ngal phrad nges red/dred mong de ni byang thang gi srog chags skye khams nang med du mi rung ba'i rigs gcig yin te/ dred mong gi za cha sa/tso bo a sbra dang / gro ma/srog chags gzhan dang sgo phyug gi sha sogs yin la tshang mas shes gsal ltar 'brog khul gyi sa gnas mang por a sbra'i gnod 'tshe shugs chen yod pa ma zad/ rtsa thang mang po rim bzhin bye mas gnan pa'am bye mar 'gyur ba de deng skabs lha thang gi gnod 'tshe gtso bo zhig yin/ gal srid dred mong dang a sbra za mkhan gyi bya rigs mang tsam yod na/ ab ra'i gnod 'tshe rang bzhin gyis med pa chags nges yin lda ma gzhi dred mong gi rigs khyu chung la sdod gnas kyang thar thor ga gram du gnas yod/ yin na yang nye lam dred mong dang sa gnas 'brog pa'i bar gyi 'gal ba rim bzhin mngon gsal dod la de las byung ba'i gyong gun yang tshabs cher 'gro bzhin yod pas/ sa khul mang tshogs dang las byed pasa'agal 'brel 'dir thag gcod byed thabs dgos skor yang yang re 'dun zhus pa yang rgyu mtshan du gnas pa zhig yin te/ nga tshos dred mong gi gnod 'tshe cung che ba'i sa khul dang rdzong khag gi gyon gun khag gcig dpe mtshon du bkod pa gsham gsal/ — 84 —

dre mong spyi lo 993nas2002ngar dred mong gis mtsho gnyis dmigs bas la la gyi shang khag bdun du khang pa dang phyugs zog sogs la gnod 'tshe btang ba'i skoradiyang spyi lo998nas200lo'i zla ba 9bar nyi ma rdzong khongs su dred mong gisabasad skyon byung ba'i skor ri'u mig—85—

dre mong de'i ring nyi ma rdzong gi dzi bo dang lam thog 'grul pa thad kar bsad skyon btang ba ma zad phyugs rigs dang khang pa khyim chas sogs la yang gnod 'tshe btang ba dper na/ ra lug bsdoms2023bsad bdang / khang pa'i sgo dang rab gsal 18tsam bcag pa/ sgrog rtse dang cha sgam 18bcag pa/rtsid gur dang ras gur 22gtor ba/ gzhan yang nang chas dang 'bru rigasal gtor gshig chen po btang yod khrimador na/ dred mong gi gnod 'byung ma 'gal ba de byang thang rang byung srung skyong khul gyi a mdo dang nyi ma/ mtsho gnyis/ sger rtse/ dge rgyas/ ru thog bcas dang / shan tsha/ dpal dgon sogs sa khul mang por yod pas mang tshogs kyis bzod bsran thub dka' ba'i gnas su slobs yod/ de yang mang tshogs dang nga tshos shesartogs byung bar gzhigs na/ dred mong gis gnod 'tshe byed lugs gtso bo gsum ste/ gcig dred mong gis mtshan mor 'jab rgol gyis lhas ra'i nang gi ra lug gsod pa dang / gnyis/ ri khug dang brag zur du medang dred mong glo bur gdong thug rgyab skabs nyen 'gog ched mi la rdzing nas bsad rdzas bzo gi yod pa gong gsal nyi ma rdzong gi rdzi bo rnams las shes thub/— 87 —

bo kyi srol rig sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan zang bgasum/ 'jab ltas kyis gur dang khang pa'i nang mi med pa shes rjes gur dang khang pa'i nang 'dzul nas lo ba bzas ma lo ba gtor gyi yod/ de yang sashul 'brog pa dang las byed pa'i mthong thos ltar na/ dred mong gis khang pa'i nang 'dzul nas sha dang phyur ba/ mar bcas zhim zas sumangon na za ba dang khang pa'i nang gi sgrig chas rnams gcog pa/ za ma lo ba'i 'bru dang /'bras/ gro zhib rnams khang pa'i dbus su spungs rjes de'i thog skyag gcin gtong ba dang / de nas 'bru rigs rnams sa rdo dang bsres nas phan med du gtong nga dang / yang mthong thos byung gsal la/ dred phos khang pa'i nang gi pho chas rnams zer tshal sbar tshal du dbrol ba dang / mo chas rnams gting nas nyal ba dang de ltar dred mos ldog tu byed pa'i mtshan gyi mthong thos lasang tshos dred phos bu mo khrid pa'i sgrung la yang bskyar du zhing dpyad ma byed ka med red/ le'i 'di'i mchan 'grel/①'byor rje sha las dred mong gi brun bsgrugs nas dred mong gi za rgyur brtag dpyad byas pa las ab ra dang gro ma rtswa/gna' ba/ gtsod/ gnyan/ g.yag 'phyi ba rnams dred mong gi za rgyu gtso bo yin par bshad/④mtsho gnyis nags las cus kyi yig cha/④nyi ma rdzong nags las cus kyi yig cha/— 88 —

saXbacad brgyad pa/ khrung khrung dkar po/ming gzhan/ mjug nag mgrin ring /rigs kyi dbye ba/ 'dab chags kyi rigs/ rgum 'thu'i sde/gzugs dbyibs kyi khyad chos/khrung khrung ni 'dab chags kyi tshogs nas ngo mtshar kyi khyad chos dang mdzes nyams gzengs su thon pa zhig yin pa ste/ rkang ring gis bsteg zhing mgrin ring gis 'dren pa/ lus khams dkar gtsang la dmar po mtshal gyi thig ye spyi gtsug la sgron khar kha mdog nag po'i yang zes mgrin dang sgro rtse brgyan par byas/dngaXbo/ khrung khrungaX'atsho gnas byed yul/ khrung khrung ni dus bya'i gras shig yin stabs dgu na dus zhing khul dang dbyar dus byang thang du bskyod pa las lo hril po loganas gcig kon ra sdod pa'i srol med/ bya khrung khrung de yang mtsho bod mtho sgang la gtso bor 'tsho sdod byed pa'i bya rigs shig yin stabs khrung khrung mas che ba dang de dag gi mtsho gnas byed yul gtso bo bod la yod/ de yang dbyar dus su khrung khrung rnams— 89 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang b.ru thog dang / dge rtse/ nyi ma/ mtsho gnyis/ dpal dgon/ lha'i sogasazha rlon che nga'i la du sdod pa dang / dgun dus lhun grung/ mal gro gong dkar/ stod lung/ chu shur/ gong dkar/ pa snam/ rgyal rtse/ gzhi rtse/lha rtse sogs gtsang gzhung zhing khul du 'tsho gnas byed/gzhan yang khrung khrung khag gcig rang rgyal kyi mtsho sngon dang / zi khron/kus kra'o sogs sa gnas su 'tsho sdod byed pa dang / nyung shas shig 'brug yul dang rgya gar sogs su dgun gal 'tsho sdod byed srol yang yod/gnyis pa/ khrung khrung gi grangs 'bor/brtag dpyad pa khag gcig ④gis lo shas ring 1990—1996bod du grangs rgyag byas par gzhigs na/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sa khongasasukhrung khrung 3900tsam yod pa dang / des khrung khrung yongs kyi brgya cha 66tsamazin par bshad par gzhi 'dzin na khyon bsdoms khrung khrung 5900tsam yod pa dang / gzhan yang brtag dpyad pa gzhan dag ①gis bod rang skyong ljongasakyi khul du khrung khrung 3910tsam yod pa gong dang ha lam mtshungs rung / khyon bsdoms nga khrung 5500tsam yod par bshad pa gong dang cung zad ma mthun par gal / gzhan yang bod rang skyong ljongs nags las cus nas2000lo'i zla ba 12pa'i nang rtog zhib byas par gzhigs na bod kyi sa khul khag tu dgun gal 'tsho sdod byed mkhan khrung khrung 7946yod pa dang / de'i nang nas brgya cha 67lha rtse nas stag gru kha'i bar gyi gtsang gzhung dang rlan sar mtsho —90—

nga nga ra posdod byed pa/ dper na/ gzhi rtse'i g.yas g.yon dang myang chu'i khul du khrung khrung 1771yod pa dang 1 lha rtse'i khul du 1101rnam gling du 1055mthong smon rdzong khongs su1130de bzhin brgya cha 26tsam skyid ba rgyugs gzhung du 'tsho sdod byed pa dper na/ lhan grub rdzong du 919yod pa dang / sa rtser 267mal gro gong dkar du 182stod lung du 513 chu shur rdzong khongs su204 bcasayod/ yang brgya cha 7tsam lho kha'i sa khul du 'tsho sdod byed pa dper na/ gra nang du 92dang / gong dkar du 364sne gdong dang rtse thang a du 72yod/gzhan yang 'brong pa dang ngam ring / de bzhin brag gsum mtsho dang nyang chu rgyugs khul du dgun dus khrung khrung nyung shas 'tsho sdod byed kyi yod par bshad/④ de ltar gyi tshod rtsis la gzhigs nas 'dzam gling thog khrung khrung bsdoms khri gcig tsam g.yas g.yon yod dgos/ 'on kyang nga chos da bar tshang mas khas len dang ngos 'dzin thub pa'i zhing phra'i grangs 'bor zhig gtan 'khel byed dka' bas tshod rtsid dang ltab mi 'dra ba de dag 'dir ngo sprod zhus pa yin/khrung khrung la bstod pa'i skor/zhing 'brog khul gyi bod mis bya khrung khrung la dga' po byed pa ma zad 'dab chags der dmigs bsal gyi srung skyong dang gces spras byed srol yod la rgan rabs chos khrung khrung la khye rbad nas dkrogs pa dang / rdo'am 'ur rdo sogs la brten nas gsod rmas dang / don med du 'drogs mgo slong ba gtan nas mi rung zhes lo chung tshor slob gsogatong ba tshang mas mkhyen gsal — 91 —

bo kyis srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bltar dang / khrung khrung chos yang de tsam mi la skrag snang med pa dang / mi nye 'gram du slebs tshe gsang lag dngas snyan pa'i skad snyan sgrogs zhing lus sgur sgur dang / mgo bo gug gug gshog pa'i sgro gur zlum por byas te gdugasaltar bskor nas bro gar 'chams pa'i snang tshur ston gyi yod par/ mi tshosayang khrung khrung gi nye 'gram du slebs skabs‘‘lha bya khrung khrung dkar mo gar gyisashig gur phub cig gshog rtse g.yas pa nga la ston cig ④ces khrung khrung la gar gyi re ba 'don kyi yod/de bzhin khrung khrung gi ri mo yang bod kyi srol rgyun 'tsho ba'i nang thon mang ba dang der mi tshos dga' po byed kyi yod/ dper na/ tshe ring drug skor nang bya tshe ring de khrung khrung gi gzugs su bkod yod la tshe ring drug skor gyi ri mo cha sgam sogs nang chas kyi 'debs la bris srol dar chen po yod/‘‘tshe ring drug skor gyi gzugs brnyan gang du 'tshal bar mi shes rgud pa'i tshogs spyi dang / lhag par dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms shing /bde sgyid dpal 'byor dang / tshe bsod/ mnga' thang longs spyod gong nasagong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis rten 'brel mtshon gyi yod/1 ④yang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las/‘‘bya de khrung khrung dkar po/gshog rtsal nga la g.yor dang /④ (bod kyi dmangs srol gces btus〉lhags dpar deb ngos 589④ 〈khyad du 'phags pa'i byung thang ngo mtshar 'os pa'i thon khungs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 101—102— 92 —

nga nga ra pothag ring sal ka'agro/li thang bskor nas slongs yong / zhes pa de ni rgyal dbang bdun pa'i lung bstan yin par grags shing / ‘‘de yang lha bzang khrung gisatshangs dbyangs pa rgyal ba'i khri las phab ste rgya nag tu phebs pa'i phyi gas bye (spyi lo 1708)la yang srid rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho khams lo thang thub chen byams pa gling gi zhol grong du 'khrungs pa de bstan par grags/ mi④don du rgyal ba'i lung bstan de bya khrung khrung brgyud nas bstan yod/‘‘khrung khrung dkar mo mgul ring ma/gnam la 'phur pa'i gshog ring ma/sa la'ang ba pa'i rkang ring ma/rgum bu po ba'i mchu ring ma/ ④ le'i 'di'i mchan 'grel/④11cha1ci61yo 'us17bo5④bas za1ma byaX1 yi yo71yo④(po tsho so mas lo ma 6 zaza khrims7ma'i lo kro 〉ma za7ཿ༅ ༅ mas ga༅tsho2①2jo3༅① (bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉199yo'i deb gnyis pa245① (khyad du 'phags pa'i byang thang ngo mtshar 'os pa'i thon khungs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 102— 93 —

sa bcad dgu nga/ ri dwags dang sgo phyugs kyiX'abrel ba/gong du 'brong dang 'bri g.yag dbar la 'dod spyod gtso bor byasapa'i 'brel ba'i skor cung zad brjod pa las sgo phyugs dang ri dwags gzhan gyi 'brel ba'i skor gyi shod sbol la 'brel bshad rgyag rgyu'i go skabs ma rnyed stabasagasham du nga chos nag chu sa khul srid gros rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad yig khang nas de'i skor la ngo sprod gnang ba de klog pa po'i spyan lam du 'bul rgyu yin/de'ang byang thang sa rgya che la lha chu 'dzoms pa'i dbang gis ri klung gang sar ri dwags sna tshogs khyu dang khyu byas te 'tsho gnas byed pa dang / che rigasaphud pa'i ri dwags kha shas gsod mkhan nyung sar phyugs zog dang khyu 'dresabyas te sdod/ dus phyis me mda' sna tshogs dang rlangs 'khor sogs bod spyad nas ri dwags phon chen bsad mas btang bas kho tsho mang che ba sa phyogasagazhan du bros pa dang / lhag ma rnams kyang mil dogs 'drogs ji cher song bas ri mgo gang mtho dang lung phu gang btsan 'grim pa las mthong rgyu je dkon du gyur zin/ de'i gong byang mthar sdod mkhan khyem dud mang po'i phyugs zog ri dwags dang rgyud 'dres byung nga'i gnas tshur rtag par mngon gyi yod pa ste lu gu la gnyan tsha dang gtsod tsha zhes gzugs stobs gzhan las che — 94 —

ri dwa sa nga sa kyi 'brel bzhing rkang lag sbom pa1 bal spu shin tu rtsub po dag skye bdang / de bzhin ra la dgo tsha zhes pa'i re'u gzhan dang cung ka'adu ba/ 'bri ye be'u la 'brong tsha zhes nor gzhan las spu sna ring la spu rdzobs pa/ dmas zhes che la su gas bzhi ring ba sogs dang / rta rgod mar rkyang tshe zhes pa'i rte'u rnga rngog thub lagabalag ring ba sogs skye1 phyugs zog de pho thun mong du yod pa'i khyad chosamangon gsal che shos ni/ gzhan las mgo 'phang mtho zhing sna gi skye na pa/ rtswaza 'phro la mgo btegs te ltab/ ded nas 'gro skabs phyugs tsho mdun nam yang na khyu zur nas 'gro nga/ lhas rar yod dka' zhing lhas mthar nyal ba las lha'i dkyil du ka'adzul ba/ pho rigs rnams rgyud gyong la bshasan sha gtos che ba/ mo rigs rnams kyang 'dzin bzung dka' zhing bu gosomakhas pa las bshos na 'o mnyung ba sogs yin/lhag par du 'brong tsha dang rkyang tsha ni de bas bdag bzung dka' zhing /'brong tsha 'bri g.yag gang yin rung rwa tsha la 'am skye na pas dri 'a dris pa'i bdag pos kyang stabs dang bstun ba las gang byung gis 'dzin bzung mebatub bas bkol spyod byed par phibade la/ rkyang tsha ni mthong rgyu dkon zhing re gnyis yod pa de phong rgyud shin du stong bas bdag pos 'dzin bzung byed dka' bas sga srab spras na gzhon rta zer ba spyod dang bral/sgo phyugs ri dwags dang 'dres tshur mang rta nor rgyud gyong ba 'ga' zhig rkyang 'brong dang 'dres nas ri la shor bas bdag bzung ma bcu ba pa gang sar mthong thos yod/ lhag par du stod byang sam྾gas sdod pa'i 'brog pa rnams sngon sa tshwa 'bru sogs zhing 'brog brje ྾ lug gis skyel 'dren — 95 —

bo kyi srol zig sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga babyed pa yin stabs khal gsag lon mtho ba'i g.yung gras ru ba skya rjod skabasakyi 'grel khal tsam las de byings rnams rtsid pa 'breg rgyu dang dgun bshasagatong ba ma gtogs bod spyod de tsam mi byed pas rgyud pyong nga'i khal gsag da nyung ba ri la shor te 'brong lha'i nang 'dres pa'i snang tshul rtag par thon gyi yod la/ khyem tshang 'ga' re'i sgo nor yod tshad sdebs gcig tu 'dres shor ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod/ nor 'brong khyu dang 'dres rjes mi mthong ba tsam gyisa'abrong dang mnyam du bros 'gro bas lag tu tshud thangs dka' zhing / nor phon chen 'brong khyu'i nang shor na rta pa mang pos me mda' rgyag pa dang rdzasadud kyi thabs shes spyad de rdza ri mthon por byen du dkrogs tshe 'brong gis rdza lam gshags nas sngon la 'drogs rjes/ yul nor gyis ni rwas rdza lamaskor par rjes su lus pa rta 'ded kyis dbugs po btang na gzhi nas sngar bzhin 'dzin bzung bed spyod btub ces rgan rabs rnams pas smra/ sngon ma'abrong gshor mkhan gyi me mdas bsad pa'i 'brong 'ga' zhig bsha' skabasanor gyi ske lung sha ko bar du 'thum pa sogs thon ba ni yum nor 'brong du gyur ba bsnyon med la/ nag tshang rmu gar gangs rgyud kyi ri'i nyin srib rnamasasu'abrong sngo khyu ma dang / kham khyu ma zhes 'brong gi spu mdog sngon po dang rag pa sogs kha shas yod pa rnams kyang yuganor 'brong dang 'dres pa'am de tsho rgyud 'dres kyi 'brong yin zhes pa'i shod srol mchis/ rta rkyang dang 'dres pa rna thos tsam las mig mthong byung nga mi snang rung gal srid 'dres na dbyug zhog rgyu rang las 'dzin bzung byed thub thabs med ces pa'i ngag sgros snang /'on kyang spyi lo'i dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lor bas sum cu bzhi btso bar — 96 —

ri dwa sa nga sa kyi 'brel bskabs su/ nag chu rdzong mgong shang khongs geb chags nor dgramatshang zhesapa'i khyem dud gcig gis rkyang rte'u (mo)zhig gson bzung byas te sgo khar nyar ba de cher longs skabs rgyun par rta khyu dang mnyam por 'gro bdang / loltar dbyar ka rkyang dang 'dres nas pa spyor zin rjes slar rta tsho nabs log ste rkyang rte'u skye ba sogs rigs la rigs rgyud kyi rkyang bdun phrag bar du 'phel/ mthar ha sags pa yul 'dir slebs skabs de tshos me mda' brgyang ste bsad song ba las lo mang ring khyim tshang de'i rta khyu dang nye 'gyangasagang mtshams su gnas shing 'tsho ba byung 1 yang snyan nong rdzong sha ru dgon gyi bla mgomatshang 'gyur dga' lags su gson bzung byas pa'i rkyang zhig yod pode sga srang spras te zhon khyodang tu ba rung 'thur 'go brgyud te thag yod chog pas mgar phebs sar khrid 'gro ba sogs de dang de 'dra'i gnas tshulagazhan yang yod tshod la dpe mtshon tsam du bkod ba yin/gzhan yang sngon ra khyim dud phyug pos shas dkar dus du ba gnayomatsho sogs mtsho ga ge mo'i 'gram du sdod skabs mtsho glang gis 'grel she sbyor byas pa'i rigs yin zhes dang / yang na ri ga ge mo'i mgul du sdod skabs ri glang gi rigs yin zhes pa sogs kyi be'u 'ga' zhig cher longs skabs yulanor gzhan dang ka'adra bar spu mdog khas ser shas che ba/ spu rjen la mid thanyung ba rwa dang rnga mas la mjing pa sbom bsogs dang lug la'ang mtsho lug gi rigs yin zhes pa lug gzhan dang cung ka'adra ba 'ga' re dngos sumathong rgyu tsho rung don dngos kyi rigs brgyud thad shod srogs ltar las 'dir zhib tu mi sprol/ de min gyi phyugs zog ngo mtshar can 'ga' zhig yod pa ste/ dgu — 97 —

bo la la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga babargya rwa can zhes pa'i rta rwa co can ni/ rna ba g.yas g.yon gyi gong du rwa dngos ltar skyes pa byis pa lo bzhi lnga'i mje'u la gi la tsam longs pa dang /yang phags rwa zhes pags pa'i ngos nas rdol ba las nang snyeng med pa'i rwa 'bur can kha shas dus skabs dang bstun nas gsar rnying brje ba/ yang spyi gtsug gam ze rngog gseb tu kher rkyang gis rdo la ba lug ril kyi che chung tsam pa sogs yod/ de min rkang lag gang rung gi gcod tshig sgyur yas mas su skyesapa'i rwa 'bur can 'gar dgu brgya rwa can yin zhes 'bod mkhan yang mchis/rwa ka' bar zhes pa'i nor ni nyin mor mi mthong rung mtshan mo mun nag gi khrod du khal g.yag kha shas kyi rwa rtse gnyis nas me lce'i rnam pa'i 'od 'phrob mi tshang mas mthong rgyu yod pa dang / khal g.yag mgo gnyis can yang srid mtha' ma bkag tsam byung myong ba'i lo rgyus snang / g.yang mo mgo gnyis zhesapa'i lug ni/ lus gcig la mgo gnyis yod pa des lha chu sogs gang 'dod za la nga thub pa dang / yang 'ba' ltag kha zhes pa'i lug ltag pa'i sdud sgo'i thad du kha dod pa/ stobaza' bar phan thogs med kyang 'ba' sgra byed skabasarlangs pa thon pa/ shogs pa snga por de'i thad zil pa'am ba mol sa pa sogs 'byung ba de tshor rwa co med pa mang / de min lug rwa bzhi ste mgo gcig la rwa co bzhi re skyes pa/ skye stangs dang che chung nges med sna la sa yod/ra la rwa bzhi dang rtse mdud ces pa gnyis te/ rwa rtse mdud ni rwa gnyis gyen du skyes pa'i rtse mo phan la bsgol ba dang / nyung shas dkyus sgril gyi rnam pa can yang yod/ rwa bzhi ni rwa gnyis re g.yas g.yon drang thad du skyes pa la ring thung phran bu yod pa'am yang na mnyam pa dang / de min rwa gnyis spyi — 98 —

ri dwas nga sa kyi 'brel bamatshungs ltar la rwa gnyis pags 'byur 'gul bskyod ldan pa chung ngu re dang /gzhan rwa gnyis gyen 'greng dang yang na rtse mdud du skyes pa dang / rwa gnyisa.a long gi rnam pa ltar thur du la ba sogs thamatshan can dag kyang re gnyis mthong rgyu yod pa bcas ni phyugs khyu'i rgyan du brtsi zhing mthong chen byed srol dar la/ mtshe ma zhes sdebs gcig la phyugs phrug gnyis re skye ba ni rta nor ra lug kun la dar ba ma zad/ gsum re skye ba'ang nyung shas srid pa rnams g.yang dang grogs su brtsi ba yin/

sa bcad bceb/ rang byung srungs skyong khul/dang po/ rang byung srung skyong khul zer ba de gang yin/skyes dngos kyi rigs mang po zhig nyin re bzhin rtsa stong du 'gro ba dang /chu skyon dang skam skyon rgyun la med pa/ bye thang dang bye sa rgya cher 'gro ba/skyes khams khor yug nyams rgud 'gro ba bcas kyis spyi tshogs dang 'dzam gling dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la 'gog rkyen chen po bzo bzhin yod pa ma zad mi dang skyes dngos thams bcad kyi 'tsho gnas la'ang gnod 'tshe gtong bzhin yod/ de yang nye ba'i lo bcu'i nang 'dzam gling yongs kyi drod tshad 'phar ba dang / rgyal khab mang por sngar byung myong med pa'i chu skyon thon pa/ rgyal nang du 1998lor 'bri la rgyugs khul yongs su chu log dang chu skyon byung ba dang / 20①lor rgyalas pe cing la rlung dmar thengs 12tsam rgyab pa bcasakyis skye khams khor yug dang dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun rgya can po bzos yod pa de dag ni rang byung skye khams dang / khor yug la gtor gshig btang ba'i mtha' 'bras kho na yin/dmigs bas sa gnas dang sa khul khag tu rang byung srung skyob khul btsugs nas skyes dngos dang / srog chags/ de bzhin skyes dngos dang — 100 —

rang nga zang ba la/srog la sa kyi 'tsho sdod byed khul srung skyob byed pa de ni khyon yongs nasa'adzam gleng skye khams la srung skyob byed pa'i thabs shes zhig yin/'o na gang 'dra zhig la rang byung srung skyob khul zer/skye khams kyi khyad chos dang rin thang la gzhigs nas sa gnas ngesacan zhig tu dmigs bas kyi do dam dang srung skyong byed la la gtan 'khel byas pa la zer/dper na bod kyi byang thang sa khul gyi ri skyes srog chags dang / samatho'i skye dngos/ chu dang gser ser dngul sogs rang byung thon khungs kyi dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i khyad chos dang dmigs bas rin thang la gzhigs nas byang thang rang byung srung skyob khul btsugs pa ni ri skyes srog chags dang sa mtho'i skyes dngos gtso bor byas pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul zhig yin pa dang / nying khri brag phyi rgya shug rang byung srung skyob khul de ni dmigs su lo ngo rgya phrag lon pa'i shug pa khag gcig kho na srung skyob yong la btsugs pa ltar rang byung srung skyob khul gyi nang don dang / rgya khyon/dmigs yu bcas la khyad par chen po ldan yod/srung skyob byed la gyi la chos las dbye na/ rang byung srung skyob khul la rigs gsum dang nang tshan dgu yod de/ skyes dngos ma lag srung skyob khul dang / ri skyes skyes dngos rigs kyi srung skyob khul/ rang byung gna' shul srung skyob khul bcas rigs gsum dang / de yang rang byung skyes dngoyom lag srung skyob khul zer ba ni dpe mtsho dang cha tshang rang bzhin ldan pa'i skyes dngos tsho sa pa dang de'i khor yug las grub pa'i skyes dngos ma lag srung — 101 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bskyob khul dper na/ nags tsha skyes dngos ma lag dang / sa thang skyesadangos ma lag thang rgod skyes dngos ma lag rlan gsher skyes dngos ma lagade bzhin rgya mtsho dang rgya mal 'debs kyi skyes dngos ma lag rnams skyesadangos ma lag srung skyob khul gyi khongs yin/ ri skyes skyes dngos rigs kyi srung skyob khul de gtso bo rtsa che la ha cang dkon pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i ri skyesasrog chags dang skyes dngos mang sar skyes dngos dang srog chags de dag lasrung skyob la btsugs pa zhig la go dgos/ der ri skyes srog la yodang skyes dngos kyi rigs gnyis yod/ rang byung gna' shul la rigs gnyis ste/sa gshis gna' shul dang gna' rabs skyes dngos gna' shul srung skyob khul gnyis yin/rang rgyal gyi nags tsha skyes dngos ma lag gi srung skyob khul bsdoms49tsam yod pas/ rigs 'di'i srung skyong khul mang shos kyi rgyal khang cig yin pa dang / thang rgod skyes dngos ma lag srung skyob khul gyi rgya khyon che shosayin pa des srung skyob khul yongs kyi brgya cha 40tsam zin thub/sa gnas kyi khyad chos skor nas brjod na/ rang byung srung skyong khul la skam chu gnyis te rgya mal thog btsugs pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul ni gtso bo chu skyes srog chags dang / la skye khams/ chu bcas la srung skyong dang lugs mthun do dam yong la dang / skam thog rang byung srung skyob khul la skam rlon gnyis ste rlon gsher skyes khams dang skam thog la 'byung khungs la srung skyob byed ra btsugs pa'i rlon gsher rang byung srung skyob ga rnams— 02—

la nga nga nga ba ladang / skam thog skyes dngos dang srog chags srung skyob la btsugs pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul yin pa dang / skamathog rang byung srung skyob khularnams bye brag tu dbye na/ nags tsha dang / ba thang / skyes dngos spyodababye brag ri dgas spyi dang bye brag sogs rigs mang dag yod/ rang byung srung skyob khul gyi dgos mkho dang dmigs bas nus pa chen po yod pas rgyal khang mang pos rang byung srung skyob khul 'dzugs rgyu de skye khams srung skyob las don kyi gtso bor 'jog pa dang / 1997lor bsdom rtsisabyas par gzhigs na 'dzam gleng thog rigs 'dra min gyi rang byung srung skyob khul 30350tsam btsugs pa rang rgyal du'ang rang byung srung smyob khul 1146tsam btsugs yodaldaganyis pa/ bod kyi rang byung srung skyob khul/gong du brjod pa ltar/ rang byung srung skyob khul la snyegs rgyu de ni bod kyi skyes dngos ma lag dang / 'khor yug de bzhin rgyun sring 'phel rgyasagatong rgyu'i thad med du mi rung ba'i bya thabs gtso bo zhig yin/ spyi lo'i dusarabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung bod kyi loganas khag gcig tu rang byung srung skyob khul la dgas rgyu'i las don gyi 'go rtsam pa dang /1985lor nying khri dang / rdza la / me tog spo bo/ skyid grong / gnya' nang sogs sa khul du rang byung srung skyob khul khag gcig btsugs pa nas da bar bod yongs su rigs dang rims 'dra min gyi rang byung srung skyob khul— 03—

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la zang ba/bdun hru lhag tsam btsugs yod pa dang / de'i nang nas byang thang dang /jo mo glang ma/ sbas yu rong chen padma bkod/ smar khams/ gtsang srub/rdza la bcas rgyal khang rim pa'i srung skyob khul lnga dang / sle'u ji sogs rang spyong ljongs rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob la drug de bzhin sa gnas dang rdzong rim nga'i rang byung srung skyob khul lnga bcu tsam btsugs yod pa de dag gis rgya khyon che ba'i bod kyi rang byung srung skyob kyi ma lag zhig grub yod/gong gsal rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul khag lnga dang rang skyong ljongs rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul drug bcas rang byung srung skyob khul de dag la bsdoms rgya khyon spyi le ngos snyoms gru bzhi ma khri 40tsam yod pa des ljongs yongs kyi rgya khyon gyi rgya cha 334zin pa dang rang rgyal rang byung srung skyob khul gyi rgya cha 308tsam zin yod/da yod rang byung srung skyob khul de dag la rigs dang srung skyob dmigs yul 'dra min yod pa ma zad/ de dag la gnas yul khyab khongasayang tshan rig dang mthun yod/ de yang rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul gyi ngos nas bshad na/ lho nub na jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul dang nub byang na byang thang / lho shar na sbal yul rong chen padma bkod/shar na smar khams bcas las mngon/rang byung srung skyob khul de dag gi rigs dang srung skyob dmigs༅ la yang ngo bo ka'adra ba'i he bag che tsam yod/ dper na/ byang thang dang jo mo glang ma/ sbal la rong chen padma bkod sogs rang byung srung skyob khul gyis nags tsha dang / skye dngos/ srog la sa/ de bzhin sa gshes gna' — 104 —

rang nga nga ba lashul sogs kyi ma lag cha tshang zhig la srung skyob byed pa'i nus pa 'don thub pa dang / yang nying khri brag phyi dang smar khams rang byung srung skyob khul gyisadamigs su srog chags sam skyes dngos rigs gcig bsrung skyob byed pa'i nus pa 'don pa lta bu'o/gzhan yang bod kyi rang byung srung skyong khul gyi 'dzugs bskrun lasadon de med gnas yod pa dang / chung ba nas che ba'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim zhig brgyud yod de/ spyi lo 1985nas da bar (2003)bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khongs su ljongs rim pa yan gyi rang byung srung skyob khul khag bco brgyad tsam btsugs myong yod pa zhar byung re'u mig las gas thub pa ltar dang / rang byung srung skyob khul kyi nus pa dang ma lag mthud sgo za du gtong rṣa/ srung skyobs la khag gcig la bskyar zhib byas pa brgyud rgya skyed du btang ba dang /khag gcig ma dang sprul btang ba/ khag gcig rim pa spar yod/ dper na nying khri sa khul du khyon yongs nas yar klung gtsang po'i rgyugs khul gyi skyesadangos hril po'i khor yug ma lag de cha tshang ba'i srung skyob yong chen me tog dang / nying khri/ spo bo/ sman gling bcas rdzong khag bzhi'i sa khul du sbal yul nong chen padma bkod rang byung srung skyob khul gsar du btsugs nas sngar yod kyi me tog dang / spo bo sgang shang / nyis khri bcas ljongs rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul rnams de'i mnga' khongs su bcug pa ma zad/ rong rṣa padma bkod rang byung srung skyob khul de rgyal khab rim pa'i srung skyob khul du gtan 'khel byas yod/ gzhan yang sngar yod kyi smar khams dang rdza yul gyi rang byung srung skyob khul chung gras khag gcig srung skyob kyi rin thang dang dgos— 105 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bamakhor gzhigs te/ da lta rgyal khab rim pa'i khongs su bcug pa/ de bzhin sngar yod shel tshwa rang byung srung skyob khul gyi thog nyi ma rdzong dang nag chu/ amado dpal dgon rdzong bcas snan te dwangs ra g.yumatsho dang skya ring mtsho/mtsho nag zi ling bsdu mtsho/ dpal ldan mtsho sogs mtsho dang mal grangs las 'das pa dang / lha skya gtsang po dang 'bog tshang gtsang po/dpa' nog gtsang po/ nag chu/ gas 'brug gtsang po sogs chu bo dang gtsang po mang dag zhig sa pa'i zing ling bsdu mtsho brlan sa'i rang byung srung spyob khul gsar du btsugs pa de ni 'dzam gleng thog mkha' rlung mtho shosakyi brlan sa'i rang byung srung skyong khul zhig tu 'gyur ba red/ rgya mal klog pa pos dang byung srung skyong khul gang du btsugs yod pa dang da yod rang byung srung skyob khul la ngos 'dzin dang shes rtogs gas po yong la / nga tshosazhar byung nang da yod dang 'dzugs myong ba'i rang byung skyob khul rnams re'u mig nang bkod yod/rang byung srung skyob khul kyi do dam sgrig gzhi dang 'brel yod rtsa khrimasakyis gtan 'beb gzhir bzung na btsugs zin pa'i rang byung srung skyob khuladu gtor gshig dang gnod 'al rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpal 'byor gī la gas bskrun byas mi chog pa dang / lhag don rang byung srung skyob khul gyi lteganas sa khul du gser dngul zangs lcags sogs gter 'don dang / shing gcod/ rngon rgyag sman thog sogs kyi bya spyod la mi rung nga'i gtan 'khel byas yod/ 'on kyang rang byung srung skyob khul gshas nang da dung dpal 'byor gyi bya spyod la bzhin yod bdaper na byang thang rang byung srung — 106—

rang nga nga ba laskyob khul gyi sa gnas re zung du gter 'don byed mkhan gyi kung si yod lasakhul 'ga' rer gter 'don gyis lha thang dang srog chags la yang gnod 'tshe gtong bzhin yod/gsum pa/ rang byung srungs skyob khul 'dzugs dgos pa'i dmigs mi yul dang de'i nus pa/skyes dngos dang srog chagasatha dag gi 'tsho gnas dang 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi ni rang byung khor yug yin la/ gal srid rang byung khor yug la gtor gshig chen po byung tshe 'jig rten gyi skyes dngos dang srog la sal ma'i 'tsho gnas la dka' ngal dang tha na 'tsho gnas mi thub pa'i gnasasugyur nges yin/ deng rabs tshan rig 'phel rgyas dang mi'i rigs kyi ngosa'adzin gong mthor song ba brgyud/ rang byung khor yug la srung skyong byed rgyu de da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshu ang dang po de yin pa tshang mas khas len byed pa ma zad/ nye ba'i lo rabs nang srid gzhung dang srid gzhung min pa'i sgrig la dgas mang pos thabs jus 'dra min gyi thad nas rang byung khor yug la srung skyong byed la kyi bya spyod rgya chen po la yod la thabs jus de dag gi nang nas sa gnas nges can zhig karang byung khor yug srung spyob khul btsugs nasadamigs bas gyi skyes dngos dang sbog la sa de bzhin de dag gi 'tsho gnasal srung skyob byed pa de ni 'dzam gling thog khyab che la nus pa che ba zhig red/rang byung srung skyob khul la shugs dgos pa'i dmigs yu ni skyes— 07—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu srang bdangos thon khungs dang / rang byung shul bzhag 'dzam gling ngams khul gyi thun mong rang bzhin ldan pa'i skyes dngos ma lag stong la nye ba dang gnod 'tshe phog bzhin pa'i srog chags dang skyes dngos rigs kyi 'tsho yul/ de bzhin brgyud 'dzin thon khungs kyi rigs bcas la srung skyob byed ra du yin1rang byung srung skyob khul gyi srung skyob byed a gtso bo khag gsham g.yo/④rang byung sa rgyud rigs mi 'dra ba'i thun mong rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpe mtshon du rung ba'i rang byung skyes dngos ma lag dang / ④rin thang che riga~X gno rdo ༵tshe sna ༵༷ la~X ༵rdo dhi ༵da dhi~Xhūṃ~X ༵da/ ngo~X rang byung skyes da dos ma lag ཿsa sgo tshang la/ rang byung rim 'gyur mngon ga྾ dod pa/ ri skyes dngos rigs kyi thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa'i sa cha/ ④ rgyal khab kyis srung skyob byed ༅ du yo pa'i srog chags dang yang na dpal 'byor gyi rin thang che ba'i ri skyes srog chags kyi 'tsho sdod byed yul gtso bo khag ④ dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan la dmigs bsal don snyeng ldan pa'i sngo khebs dang / rin thang che ba'i shing nags dang rtsi shing gi gdod skyes sa khul lam skyes 'phel rgya che ba'i sa gnas/ ④ srung skyob rin thang ldan pa'i sa gshis bshags ngos dang 'khyags nom gyi je shul/ zhun rdo/ chu tshan/ 'bab chu/ 'gyur tsho thon gnas sogs rang byung lo rgyus kyi rjesashul sa gnas bcas yinashaṃrang ljongs kyi khul 'dir 'dzam gleng sa cha gzhan dang ka'adra bar — 108 —

rang byang zang ba ༄laganam gshis dang / sa'i la sal / mtho la bcas las khyad du 'phags pa dang rin thang che ba'i rang byung skyes dngos dang srog chags kyi thon khungs ngo mtshar can mang po yod pa dang / rang ljongs su yod pa'i thon khungs mang dag zhig ni bod dang mtsho bod sa mtho khon las 'dzam gling sakhul gzhan du mthong rgyu med pa'i sa khul 'di kho nar gtogs pa'i skyes dngosadang srog chags yin pa dang / gzhan yang mtsho bod sa mtho de rang rgyal dang gshe ya'i chu bo chen po khag gi chu 'go yin pa dper na/ 'bri chu dang / rgya mo rngul chu/ yar klung gtsang po/ gang gā jo chu/ rma chu sogs dang / de bzhin nye rabs tshan rigs zhing 'jug byas pa las shes gas ltar/ mtsho bod mtho sgang de lho byang gi sne gnyis dang 'dra bas 'dzam gleng yongs kyi gnam gshis la shugs rkyen che ba'i tshor snang skyen pa'i loganas shig yin/der brten bod ljongs kyi sa khul 'dir rang byung srung skyob khul btsugs nasarang byung skyes dngos dang srog chags la srung skyob byed rgyu de 'dzam bling mi rigs yongs la phan pa'i bya ba zhig yin la de ni 'dzam gling yongs kyi 'osa'agan zhig kyang red/spyi lo 1985nas bzung rang ljongs su rang byung srung skyob khul gyi 'dzugs bskrun byed sgo btsugs pa dang / srung skyob khul de dag gis bod kyi dmigs bsal skyes dngos dang / ri skyes srog la sa de bzhin skyes dngosadang / srog chags/ de dag 'tsho gnas sa khu gtso bo khag gcig la srung skyob dang bskyar gas byung yod bam zad/ rang byung srung skyob khul gyi 'dzugs bskrun dang do dam kyis ljongs yongs kyi rang byung khor yug gi srung — 109 —

la la la la la la nga nga sa la la la nga la skyob las don la yang sbul 'ded nges can zhig bebs yod/ de yang bod du dus rabs gong ma'i lo dngas drug cu dang / bdun cu/ brgyad hru bcas kyi ring rang byung khor yug spyi dang lhag don ri skyes srog chags dang / nagasal / rtsa thang bcas la gtor bshig chen po byung yod/ dper na/ byang thang dang stod khul du rlang 'khor gyi steng nas ri dwags la tshe mda' sbag sbag gis mdel char 'phen pa dang / nags khul du shing gcod gang thub lasatshan rig dang mthun pa'i char gzhi med pa/ de bzhin 'bru rigs thon 'bab 'phar ched du lha thang dang rtsi shing mang po slog pa bcas kyis lo rabasade dag gi ring bod kyi lha thang dang shing nags sogs rang byung khor yug la gtor bshig rgya chen po thebs pa dang / lhag par du sngar yul lung mang por khyab pa'i ri skyes srog chags rnams ming tsam las rig rgyu mthong rgyu shin tu dkon po zhig chags pa de dag ni rang byung gi skyes dngos dang srog chags la nyams rgyad phog pa'i mtshon rtags lta bu yin/lo rabs brgyad cu dang dgu bcu'i nang rim bzhen nga la ngosa'adzin dang byed phyogs la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba dang / rang byung khor yug de rim bzhin spyi tshogs kyi gnad don zhig tu gyur ba ma zad/ khyon yongs nas rang byung khor yug la slar gsodang srung skyob la mtshang yong la bod du rang byung srung skyob khul btsugs pa ma zad/ dmigs bas gyi do dam sgrig gzhi btsugs pa dang / gron dngul gtong ba/ de bzhin rang byung srung skyob khul la srid jus dang bca' khroms kyi rgyab skyor byas yod/ da bar rang byung srung skyob khul khag tu srung spyob dang slar gso'i las don khag gcig — 110 —

rang nga nga ba laspel brgyud/ rang byung khor yug spyodang kṣa par du ri skyes srogasasakhag gcig gi 'tsho gnas khor yug dang grangs 'bor bslar gsog btsamabyung yod/dper na/ byang thang du rang byung srung skyob khul ma btsugs gong la ri dwags mthong rgyu dkon la re zung yod pa rnams kyang rnyi dang dam da'i phrang las thar thabs med pa'i gnas bab long ba zhig byung yod/ byang thang du rang byung srung skyob a btsugs rjes byang thang gi ri skyes srog gas spyi dang bye brag tu gtsod dang 1 rkyang / 'brong / dgo ba/ gnyan/ dred mong /gsa'1 gna' ba sogs la skyes 'phel 'tsho gnas kyi go skabs gsar pa zhig bskrun yod stabs gong gsal ri skyes srog chags de dag gi 'tsho gnasakhyab khongs dang grangs 'bor rim bzhin 'phel rgyas 'gro gi yod pa dang /de dag gi skor byang thang khul du rtog zhib gnang mkhan rgyal nang dang rgyal spyi'i mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs pa ma zad/ khul de'i las byed pa dang 'brog pa chos kyang de ltar ngos 'dzin byed kyi 'dug gzhan yang rtsom pa pos byang thang sa khul du rgyun ring rtog zhib byas pa ltar na/ sngar lam zur dang 'brogs khag du ri skyes srog chags mthong dka' ba dang rngon rgyag byed mkhan de tsho yang yul lung mang po rgyab nas 'gro nga dang / deng skabs ri skyesasrog chags mang po yul grong dang lam zur du khyu sgrig nas sdod pa byang gi sakhul mang che bar mthong rgyu yod ba'i phyug gnyis la yang de tsam gyi skrag snang mi byed pa'i mthun phyogs kyi rnam pa bzang po zhig mngon rgyu yod/ rang byung srung skyob khul gyis bod kyi 'dab chags la yang skye 'phel dang 'tsho gnas kyi — 111 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi khor la zang bgo skabs dang cha rkyen gsar pa zhig bskrun yod stabs dgu na dus su skyed chu dang / yar klung gtsang po/ myang la rgyug gzhung du bya khrung khrung dang /ngang dkar/ ngang ser sogs bya rigs sna tshogs khyu sgrig nas sdod pa dang /dbyar dus su bya tshogs rnams byang gi mtsho dang gtsang chur bab sdod byed pa ma zad bya rigs de dag gi grangs 'bor yang 'phar bzhin yod/gzhan yang jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul dang sbal la rong chen padma bkod rang byung srung skyob khul/ rdza la rang byung srung skyob khul rnams btsugs rjes ri bo hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud de'i nags tsha dang / nagasakhul srog la sa/ nags sing rtsi shing bcas la khyon yongs nas srung skyong kyi nus pa thon yod pa ma zad sa khul dga' rer slar gas yang byung yod me tog sogs nying khri'i sa khul 'ga' rer de sngon stag yod pa bar skabasasurig rgyu med pa chags rung nye char stag re zung me tog gi nags sing du sdod pa de dpe mtshon tsam yin/mdor na/ bod du rang byung srung skyob khul btsugs pa nas bzung rang byung srung skyob kyi las don der tshan rig dang / srid jus/ bca' khrims bcas kyi rgyab skyor thob yod la khyon yongs nas sa mtho'i skyes dngos ma lag dang de'i khor yug la slar gso dang srung skyob byed rgyur rmang gzhi gting yod pa ma zad srung skyob khul khag gcig la srung skyob 'bras bu yang yag po byung yod/ 'on kyang dpal 'byor dang mi'i nus shugs kyis ma ldeng bsarang byung srung skyob khul mang por srung skyob dang do dam thad lkog rngon dang gter 'don sogs dka' ngal mang po phrad yod par snyamathu da dka' ngal— 112 —

rang nga srang ba ༄lakhyad bsad kyis dang byung srung skyob khul gyi 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon rgyag rgyu de nga tsho tshang ma'i 'gan khri zhig yin/bzhi pa/ rang byung spung skyob khul gyi do dam/spyi lo 1956lor rang rgyal gyi rang byung srung skyob khul thog ma de btsugasapa nas bzung / rang byung srung skyob khul gyi 'dzugs bskrun byed pa'i rgyud rim nang gtso bo myur skyob byed rgyu'i rtsa don lag bstar byas yod pas/ rang rgyal gyi rang byung srung skyob khul rnams rim pa dang / rigs/ do dam tshan pa bcas su dbye nas sde tshan mi 'dra bas do dam byed pa'i sgrig gzhi dmigasabasal zhig chags yod/gcig spung skyob khul rigs su dbye nas do dam byed pa/gong du gsal bshad byas pa ltar rang byung srung skyob khul rnamasarigs che ba gsum dang chung ba dgur dbye ba rnams srid gzhung gi tshan pa dang sde tshan mi 'dra bas 'dzugs bskrun dang do dam byed pa/ dper na/nags las tshan pas gtso bo shing nags dang / brlan sa/ de bzhin ri skyesasrog chags dang 'brel ba'i rang byung srung skyob khul 'dzugs bskrun dang do dam byed pa dang / rgya mtsho'i do dam tshan pas rgya mtsho'i thog gi rang byung srung skyob la 'gan 'khur ba/ zhing las tshan pas gtso bo rgyugs chu dang ma tshe'ur gnas pa'i nya rigs la srung skyob dang do dam byed pa/ thon khungs tshan pas— 113 —

la kyi la la la sa nga nga sa la la la nga b.rang byung gna' shul dang 'brel yod srung skyob khul la do dam byed pa bcasayin/gnyis/ spung skyob khul rim par dbye nas do dam byed pa/srung skyob bya la gyi thun mong rang bzhin dang gal la rang bzhin la ba/zhigs nas/ rang rgyal gyi rang byung srung skyob khul rnams rgyal khab dang / zhing chen(rang ljongs) grong khyer/ rdzong bcas rim pa bzhi ru dbye yod/de dag gi do dam thad〈rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dam srol yig〉las rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dam de yang na sa khul de ga'i zhing chen dang / rang skyong ljongs/ thad gtogs grong la / srid gzhung gi rang byung srung skyob khul gyi srid 'dzin gtso gnyer tshan pas byed rgyu dang / yang na rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi rang byung srung skyong khul kyi srid 'dzin gtso gnyer tshan pas byed rgyu dang / sa khul rim pa'i(zhing chen dang / grong khyer/rdzong )rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dam de sa khul de ga'i rdzong rim pa yan gyi sa gnas mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'brel yod rang byung srung skyob khul gyi srid 'dzin gtso gnyer tshan pas do dam byed rgyu zhes 'khod yod/ don dngosathog rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul re zung la rgyal khab nagasal cus nas thad kar do dam byed pa phud/ de byings tshang mar sa gnas de ga'i nags las cus dang khor yug srung skyob hrus/ thon khungs cus/ zhing las tshan pa bcas nas do dam byed kyi yod/— 114 —

rang nga nga ba lagasum/ rang byung spung skyong khul la tshan pa dang sde tshan mi 'dra bas do dam byed pa/rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dam srol yig nang gtan 'a po byasapar gzhigs na/ rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dmathad phyogs bsdus do dam dang tshan par dbye nas do dam byed rgyu zung 'brel gyi do dam sgrig gzhi lag len bstar rgyu yin pas/ rgyal khab khor yug srung skyob tshan pa'i srid 'dzin gtso gnyer nas rang byung srung skyob khul gyi phyogs bsdus do dam kyi 'gan 'khri khur rgyu dang nags las dang / zhing las/ thon khungs/ chu bed sogs 'brel yod srid 'dzin gtso gnyer nas rang rang gi 'gan yo sgrub khongs kyi rang byung srung skyob khul la do dam byed rgyu bcas red/ spyi lo1997bar gnyer tshogs byas pa'i rang byung srung skyob a rnams gsham gsal tshan pa khag nas do dam byed kyi yod/sa pa khag nas do dam byed pa'i srung skyob a/4— 115 —

nges spyod dros bab dpa ba nga nga na (1 zad ldan nga zab bzhi/ bod kyi rang byung srung spyob khul gyi do dam/bod kyi rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dam sgrig gzhi de spyir rgyal yongasakyi do dam byed stangs dang cha 'dra rung / don dngos thog rang ljongs kyi srung skyob khul 'bor chung la rigs yang nyung bas gtso bo nags las tshan pa dang khor yug srung skyob tshan pas do dam byed kyi yod/ da yod rang byung srung skyob khul gyi nang nas lha klu brlan sa dang gnam mtsho brlan yodang byung srung skyob khul gnyis la khor yug srung spyong tshan pa nas do dam byed pa phud/ de byingasarnams la ljongs nags los tshan pa dang sa khul nags las tshan pas thad kar do dam byed pa'i sgrig gzhi zhig chags yod la rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul mang che bar nags las tshan pa dang sa khul rim pa'i srid gzhung gnyis mnyam 'brel thog dmigs su bkar nas rang byung srung skyobakhul la do dam byed mkhan gyi do dam tshan pa btsugs yod pa/ dper na/jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul de rgyal khab rim par gtan 'khel — 116 —

rang nga nga ba labyung rjes ltas ra jo mo glang ma rang byung srung skyob khul las don u yon lhan khang zhig btsugs nas 'char gzhi dang las don che khag la 'gan khur dang las don chung khag la mthun spyor byed pa dang / gzhi rtser dmigs su jo moglang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul do dam cus btsugs nas rang byung srung skyob khul kyi zhib phra'i 'dzugs bskrun do dam gyi las don spel ba dang de bzhin rang byung srung skyong khul gyi skyed grong dang ding ri/ gnya' lam/ gting skyesabacas rdzong khag bzhir do dam yan lag cus re btsugs nas rang rdzong khongasakyi zhib phra'i las don rnams gong gsal las don u yon lhan khang dang / do dam cus/ de bzhin rdzong srid gzhung gi 'go khrid 'og sgrub kyi yod/gzhan yang rdzong rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob khul la gtso bo sa gnasadang rdzong srid gzhung nas thad kar do dam byed pa las da bar srid 'dzin do dam gyi chen mngags sgrig gzhi btsugs med/rang byung srung skyob khul gyi zhing phra'i srung skyob dang do dam gyi las don thad byed thabs 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa de ni sa khul khag gi khyad chos dang /srung skyob bya yum gyi srog chags dang skyes dngos dang 'brel ba chen po yod/dper na/ nags tshal gtso bor byas pa'i srung skyob khul du nags srung babakod sgrig byas nas zhing pa'i srung skyob dang lta zhib byed pa dang / ri skyesasrog chags srung skyob byed yul khag tu srog chags srung skyong pa mngags nasasrung skyob dang do dam gyi zhib phra'i las don spel blta bu yin/ nga tshosasakhul dngos su rtogs zhib byas pa dang srung skyong khul kyi las don khag gcig nang bzhugs pa bcas kyi myong tshor lagazhigs na/ byang thang rang byung srung — 117 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bskyobs la gyi srung skyob dang do dam las don der sa khul gzhan dang ka'adra'i yo chos dang nus pa ldan yod de byang thang rang byung srung skyob khul gyi srung skyob dang do dam las don bzhib phra'i byed thabs gnyis te/ dus bkag dang nges med kyi nyen skyon skor zhib dang / srung skyob kyi 'gan la 'i lamalugs gnyis yin/ byang thang rang byung srung skyong khul du sa gnas dang rdzong nags las bcas kyis lo ltar byang thang mi med lung stong du gtsod gtso bor byas pa'i ri skyes srog la sal nyen skyon skor zhib byed pa dang rdzong khag sosos kyang shang la bskul slong byas nas shang de ga'i sa khongs su nyen skyon skor zhib byed pa'i srol lam yag po zhig la sa yod/ spyi zla lnga pa'i g.yas g.yon du ga bod khyu sgrig nas byang du re'u khrid du 'gro srol yod pa dang dus der rngon rgyag pa yang byang du la yonas lkog rngon byed kyi yod stabs sa gnas dang rdzong khag rnams gcig bsgril gyis dus bkag nyen skyon skor zhib byas te gtsod rnams re'u khrid lam du lkog gsod mi yong ba byed pa dang / gzhan yang lkog rngon dogs nyen che sar dus tsho nges med kyi skor zhing byed srol yod/ byang thang srung skyob khul kyi sa gnas dang rdzong khag gcig tu lo ltar ri skyel ga la sa srung skyob dang / khor yug srung skyob kyi dril bsgrags slob gal da rgyur rdzong nags las cus kyis grong tsho ngo re dang 'gan yo'i gan rgya 'jog pa'i byed thabs la brten nas srung skyob kyi las don de zhing phra'i thog don la yong ba byed kyi yod/ khyang thang rang byung srung skyob khul gyi mtsho gnyis dmigs bas chus dang nyi ma rdzong gnyis kyi sa khul du 'gan la 'i lam lugs de lag bstar byas nas lo shas song ba dang des ri skyes— 18—

rang nga nga ba lasrog chags srung skyob byed rgyur phan thog che ba ma zad/ mang tshogs kyisa'agan 'khri khyer nas rang byung srung skyong khul la do dam byed rgyur sbul slong yag po byung yod/ 'gan yo'i dge'i nang don dang zhib phra'i 'gan 'khri gang yin skor gsal po yong chen/ 'dir nga chos mtsho gnyis dmigs bsal chus kyi 'gan ba'i dge de zhar byung du bkod yod/mdor na bod kyi rang byung srung skyob khul tshogs bskrun gyi las don la grub 'bras mngon gsal dod po thob yod de/ gcig dmigs bsal gyi sa gnas su srung skyob khul btsugs nas bod kyi srog chags dang skyes dngosaspyi dang bye brag tu rin thang che la mthong rgyu dkon pa'i skyes dngos dang srog chags bod dang mtsho bod mtho sgang kho nar bdag pa rnams la 'tsho sdod kyi khor yug bzang po zhig bskrun yod/ spyi lo 2000lo'i bsdoms rtsis la gzhigs na ljongs rim pa yan gyi srung skyob khul yongs kyi rgya khyon la spyi le ngosasnyom gru bzhi ma khri 40tsam yod pa des ljongs yongs kyi rgya cha 30yan zin pa dang / sa cha de dag gi nang stong la nye ba'i ri dwags dang / gcan gzan/'dab chags sogs ri skyes srog chags khag gcig gi 'tsho gnas sa khul la srung skyob byung ba dang / kung ching khri 156tsam gyi gdod ma'i nags྾ la srung skyob byung yod/gnyis/ rang ljongs su rim bzhin ri skyes srog gas dang skyesadangos kyi do dam las khungs khag btsugs nas srid 'dzin do dam dang khrimasalugs lag bstar byed pa'i ma lag zhig chags bzhin yod/ spyi lo 1958lor rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas nags tshal tshan pas ri skyes srog chags kyi rngon — 119 —
