bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra la srang brgyag byed par do dam byed dgos kyi chog mchan gnang rjes snga rjes su zhing 'brog do dam tshan pa dang / nags las do dam tshan pa/ nags las srid 'dzin do dmatshan pa bcas nas ri skyes srog chags dang skyes dngos kyi lasadon de'i 'gan la 'khur yod/ de nas spyi lo 1988lor bod du nags lasaspyi bde khru'u btsugs pa dang da stan gas las kyi las byed nyen rtog pa mi 200tsam yod pa de dag gis khrims lugs gzhir bzung gis srog chags dang skyes dngos la srung skyong byed kyi yod/ de nas spyi lo 1996lor ljongs nagasams thing gi nang du ri skyes srog la yodang / skye dngos/ rang byung srung skyobs la do dam khru'u zhes pa btsugs pa nas da bar bod du sa gnas rim pa'i do dam khru'u bdun dang / rdzong rim pa'i do dam khru'u 74btsugs yod pa de dag gis rang byung srung skyob khul kyi las don rnams sgrub kyi yod/gsum/ ri skyes srog chags dang / skye dngos/ rang byung thon khungs kyi srung skyob/ rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dam byed rgyu bcas khrimasalugs thog nas rgyab spyor byed pa'i khrims lugs kyi ma lag zhig chags bzhin yod/ rgyal yongs la sa tshogs dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas dang byung khor yug srung skyong skor la srol yig dang khrims lugs rang dang rim pa bton khar rang ljongs kyi mi dmangs la sa tshogs dang ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung nas kyang khrims lugs dang srol yig de dag gi lag bstar byed thabasakhag gcig bton yod/bzhi/ rang ljongs kyi rang byung thon khungs la tshan rig gi zhib 'jug — 120 —

rang nga nga ba labyed pa'i go skabs gsar pa zhig bskrun pa dang da bar skyes dngos dbasachags khag gcig la ra mngags kyi zhib 'jug byas pams/ ljongasayongs kyi thon khungs kha shas la yang cung zhib 'tshag pa'i rtog zhib byung yodashaṃlnga pa/ rang byung spung skyong khul dang / de bzhin ri skyes prog chags dang skyes dngos la srung skyob byed pa'i las don gyi dka' ngal dang gnad don/ma gzhi bod kyi rang byung srung skyong khul gyi 'dzugs bskrun dang ri skyesasrog chags dang skyes dngos kyi srung skyob thad grub 'bras yag po thon yod rung / da dung dka' ngal dang gnas༅ yang mi nyung ba zhig yod/gcig spung skyob dang do dam las don gyi dpal 'byor gyi ma rtsa zhan pa/da bar ri skyes srog chags dang skyes dngos kyi srung skyob dang rang byung srung skyob khul gyi tshog sa bskrun de sa gnas rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi char gzhi'i nang sa med pas gzhi rtsa'i yogasabaskrun dang srung skyob kyi 'gro gron mang che ba nor srid sngon rtsis nang yo med1da yod ljongs rim pa'i srung skyob khul la nags las ga pas dpal 'byor gyi rgya bskyor byed pa dang yang srung skyob khulas shas la rgyal spyi'i rogs skyor gyi las grwa phran bu yod pa las gzhan gyi dpal 'byor rgyab skyor med/ der — 121 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba1brten rang byung srung skyob khul mang che bar 'kho can gyi las don sgrub dka' ba'i gnas lhos yod1gnyis/ do dam sgrig gzhi cha mi tshang ba/ri skyes srog chags srung skyob kyi rtsa khrims ltar na/ rim pa khag gi ri skyes srog chags dang skyes dngos gtso skyong tshan pa rnams srid 'dzin do dayolas khungs yin dgos rung / da bar bod du rang skyong ljongs nags lasacus las de byengs sa gnas dang rdzong khag tu srid 'dzin do dam las khungasabatsugs pa shin tu nyung la chen mngags kyi las byed mi sna yang dkon po yod/loganas dang rdzong mang che ba'i las byed pa rnams las 'gan gcig lcogasayin bas srung skyob las don gyi las chod la shugs rkyen chen po yod/gsum/ las byed pa'i ched las dang nus thugs zhan pa/rang byung srung spyob khul gyi rdzong mang che ba'i zhib phra'i las don nang zhugs mkhan las byed pa rnams la ched las kyi spyong brdar zhan pa dang /khong tshor chen las kyi slob sbyong byed pa'i go skabs yang dkon po yod/dper na byang thang srung skyob khul gyi las byed pa mang che bar ri skyes srog chags sam srog chags rig pa'i chen kyi spyong brdar thob myong med bsalasadon mang po zhig slob sbyong dang mnyam du grub dgos kyi yod/— 122 —

rang nga nga ba la/bzhi/ rang byung spung skyong khul gyi do dam dang spung skyob la mu mthud gugs snon rgyag dgos pa/da bar rang byud srung skyob khul du dka' ngal mang po zhig yod pa dang de'i nang nas gtso bo gsum yin te/ lkog rngon dang / gter 'don/ yul mi dang ri skyes srog chags bar gyi 'gal zla bcas yin/ rang byung srung skyob khul dang de bzhin ri skyes srog chags yod pa'i sa cha mang che ngar lo ltar lkog rngon gyi gnas tshul thon gyi yod la lhag par du bod kyi byang thang sa khul der sgrig 'dzugs rgya che ba'i lkog rngon thengs mang byung nas gtsod gtso bor byasapa'i ri skyes srog chags kyi 'tsho sdod dang 'phel rgyas la gtor bshig chen po gtong gi yod/ byang thang srung skyob khul gyi sa khul kha shas su gter 'don gyi bya ba spel gyi yod pa des srung skyob khul gyi las don la dka' ngal bzo ba dang byang gi lha thang la'ang gnod 'tshe shugs chen bzo gi yod/yul medang ri skyes srog chags kyi 'gal zla de ga bo bo bzo dang /dred mong gis 'brog par gnod 'tshe gtong nga/ 'brong gis 'char can 'brog las la 'gog rkyen bzo ba bcas yin/ rkyang dang gtsod sogs ri skyes ston ga chags gshas kyi grangs 'bor cung mang du phyin pa dang kho tsho'i 'tsho sdod bya yul yang 'brog pa'i sa kha dang nye du song bas sa khul kha shas gas sa'i thad ri skyes srog chags dang 'brog zog ngar la 'galas chags yod/dper na rkyang gis dgun lo sa rwa'i nang tshul ba dang / 'brog pa'i rtswa — 123 —

bo kyi la la za la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bakha'i thog ngar gtsod tshugs pa lta bu'o/ byang gi sa khul mang por dred mong gis 'brog pa'i khang pa'i nang la la nas gtor bshig gtong ba dang skabasare mi phyug la gnod 'tshe gtong gi yod pa de 'brog pa'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i nang gi dka' ngal gtso bo zhig red/ gzhan yang sa khul 'ga' shas su'abrong gis mo phyugs khrid pa dang skabs re 'brog par mang brdung nas bsod kyi yod/ gong gsal gnas tshul de dag la da ngar rtsa ba'i thog nas bkag 'gog dang thag gcod gtong rgyu'i bya thabs zhig spel thub med pas srid gzhung dang tshogs pa khag gi mu mthud zhib 'jug byas nas thabs shes 'don dgos/ lnga/ dril bsgrags dang slob gso ma ldang ba/ri skyes srog chags dang skyes dngos de bzhin rang byung khor yug spyi 'a srung skyob byed rgyu'i skor gyi dril bsgrags dang slob gso'i thad da dung shugasasgon rgyag dgos/ da ngar mang tshogs la gtso bo khrims dang srol yig rnamasadril bsgrags byas pa las zhing phra'i khor yug srung skyob kyi slob gso dril bsgrags byung med bas mang tshogs dang tha na las byed pa mang pos rang byung khor yug la srung skyob byed pa'i gal la rang bzhin de rtog thub kyi med/mdor na/ khor yug srung skyob kyi go rtog dang shes bya zhan pas bod kyi sa khul mang por dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang khor yug skye khams srung skyob bar lag la zla che ba dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi las grwa mang pos thad kar khor yug la gtor bshig gtong ba'i dpe brjod kyis mi langs bzhig yod/— 124 —

rang nga srang ba ladrug tshan rig zhib 'jug gi nus pa zhan pa/tshan rig zhib 'jug pa'i mi 'bor nyung la zhib 'jug gi stobasashugs zhan bas rang byung khor yug dang skye khams ma lag srung skyob kyi lasadon nang sne khrid kyi nus pa 'don mi thub/ tshan ris zhib 'jug pas skyesadangos rigs nyung shas shig la hrung cha tshang ba'i zhib 'jug byas pa las skyesadangos dang skye khams ma lag thad zhib phra'i rtogs zhing byed rgyur dka' ngal che tsam yod/—le'i 'di'i mchan 'grel/④(gas zas lha'i mas1sgo༅dzi༅tsho༅om〉①(ba4sgoms༅ja༅gas〉923④〈lo ze rke〉༅glo༅gas7ba 4 rdo shā1 za khu gas21〉2001—2055yo༅khye zlams༅za910

sa bcad bce gcig rgyun sring 'phel rgyas dang rang byungaXkhor yug lo rabs drug bcu pa tsam nas khor yug gnad don de 'dzam gleng yongs kyi gnad don zhig tu gyur ba dang / gnad don der bkag 'gog dang thag gcod byed pa'i rgyud rim nang / sa khul dang rgyal khab so sos dzad skyon tshod 'dzin kyi lag rtsal dang thabs 'jus 'dra min bton pa dang / bya thabs 'dra min spyad yod rung khyon yongs nas khor yug srung skyob byed rgyur rtsa ba'i thog nas legs 'gyur byung med/ de rjes mnyam myong las ra 'phrod byung bar dpal 'byor dang skye khams gnyis ka rgyun sring 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu'i rmang gzhi'i thog dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kho na gtong nga'i ltang dang thabs jus rnying pa dang / dpal 'byor kho na la gas bskrun gyi byed lugasarnying pa/ thon skyed dang 'dzad spyod kyi goms gshis bcas la bcos bsgyur dang / mi 'bor la cad 'dzin/ rang byung thon khungs la gron chung / lag rtsal dang thon skyed grub char bsgyur bcos byed rgyu de ni deng rangs khor yug srung skyob kyi srog shing yin par ngos 'dzin thob thub pa byung yod/— 126 —

sring 'phel rgyas nga rang nga ra yudang bo/ gang 'dra zhig la rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi zer/de yang lor bas60dang 70nang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang khor yug gnad don thad rgyal spyi'i thog zhib la ga dang rtsod gleng mang po byas pa brgyud/ mkhas pa dang srid 'dzin pa mang pos rgyun sring 'phel rgyas de gong gal gnad don gnyis kar thag gcod thub pa'i thabs shes gsar pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin byung ba nas bzung rgyun sring 'phel rgyas zhes pa'i ltab dang bsam blo de rim bzhin rgyal spyi'i thog dar 'go brtsams pa red/spyi lo 983lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tsho sa kyis khor yug dang 'phel rgyal yon lhan khang zhes pa gsar du btsugs te khor yug srung skyob dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas bcas phyogs gnyis kar la gshor mi yong ba'i la du rgyun sring 'phel rgyas gtso bor byas pa'i thabs la yogs ra par zhib 'jug byas pa brgyud spyi lo987lor u yon lhan khang des〈nga tsho la ma'i 'byung 'gyur 〉zhes pa'i snyan zhu'i thog rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi gzhi rtsa'i byed phyogs thad dngos su 'grel bshad byas yod/ de yang deng skabs mi'i dgosapa skong thub pa mas da skor bas rjes ma'i dgos pa skong rgyu'i 'byung khungs la gnod 'tshe mi yong ba de ni rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi la na nyid yin pa dang /deng skabs 'phel rgyas kyi dka' ngal dang nus pa'i 'byung khungs kyi nyamasargud/ khor yug gi gnad don rnams dpa 'byor la dgas bskrun gyi byed — 27—

la kyi srog nga sa nga nga sa ku nga sa zang baphyogs dang thabs jus yang ma dag pa las byung ba yin pas/ sngar rgyun kyi byed phyogs dang thabs ju se rnying pa rnams spangs nas rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa don lag len bstar rgyu de ni gong gsal gnod 'tshe dang dka' ngal rnams bkag 'gog thub pa'i 'gag rtsar ngos 'dzin byas yod la/ spyi lo 1992lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis gtso skyong gnang ba'i khor yug dang 'phel rgyasatshogs chen thog rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa don de mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs yong ba byed rgyur skul lcags btang ba ma zad/ 〈dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i 'char gzhi〉bzos pa nas bzung / rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi lta ba der rim bzhin khas len byas pa dang / rgyal khab mang pos rtsa don 'di bzhin lasadon dngos kyi thog lag bstar byed 'go brtsams pa red/lugs mthun dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas rnams skye khams rgyun mthud nus par rten dgos pa de ni rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi snyeng don yin la khor yug dang dpal 'byor gyi mtshams sbyor yin pa dang / de bzhin mi dang rang byung khams bar kyi gzhi mthun yong rgyu de ni rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi dmigasal yin/rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi snying don de cung rgyas par bshad na/gcig mu mthun dpal 'byor phel rgyas gtong rgyu/deng skabs 'dzam gling khor yug nyams rgud kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gcig dbul phongs yin stabs/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyis 'tsho ba'i dka' — 128 —

sring 'phel rgyas nga rang nga ra yungal sel rgyu ma zad/ skye khams nyams rgyud kyi gnad don la thag gcod yong ba byed rgyu de yin/ de yang 'dzam gling thog gi rgyal khab mang che ba dang / mi 'bor dung phyur 12tsam dbul phongs kyi gnas babs las thar thub med la/deng skabs 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab kyi ngos nas bshad na/ skye khams nyams rgyud kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gcig dbul phongs rang yin/gnyis/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang khor yug spung skyob zung 'brel byed rgyu/khor yug dang rang byung thon khungs ni dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi rmang gzhi yin stabs dang la 'byor gyi rgyun sring 'phel rgyas de khor yug dang de bzhin thon khungs dang ga bral thabs med pa zhig yin/ gzhan yang khor yug srung skyob byed rgyur dpal 'byor dang lag rtsal kyi rgyas skyor dgos pa mazad/ khor yug srung skyob kyi legs nyes de dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi spusatshad la 'dengs 'jog byed pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo zhig yin/gsum/ mi rabs rjes ma'i 'phel rgyas la bsam shes byed rgyu/skor bas gong 'og tshang mar 'dzam gling khor yug dang thon khungasasrung skyong dang bdag dbang gi 'gan khrid yod stabs1 deng skabs mi rabasakyis khor yug dang thon khungs bod spyod gtong skabs med bas rjes ma'i 'tsho gnas dang 'phel rgyas la bas yogazhigs byed dgos/

'du kyi slob ga 1— ba pa nga ba kyi zag ldan pa thababazhi/ thon skyed dang 'dzad spyod kyi goms srol gsar ba 'dzugs rgyu/sngar rgyun gyi thon skyed dang 'dzad spyod byed lugs kyis thon khungasachad zos dang khor yug la gtor bshig che ba/ dper na/ thon skyed kyi rgyud rim nang thon khungs gsar pa kho na bed spyod pa las bod spyad zin pa rnamasabaskyar du bed spyod byed pa'i lugs srol med pa dang / thon skyed las byung ba'i chu ro dang dug rdzas rnams thad kar gtsang po'am rgya mtshor 'dibs pa dang / dpal 'byor gyi 'khos ka drag pa'i rgyal khab dang mang tshogs kyisargyas sprod kyi 'tsho bas thon khungs dang khor yug la thad ka'i gnod 'tshe bzo kyi yod/ der brten rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi byed thabs gsar pa des thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i rnam par 'gyur ldog btang nas lugs mthun gyi thog nasathon khungs bod spyod gtong rgyu dang khor yug la srung skyob yong ba byed rgyu de red/lnga/ rang byung khams la gces spyong dang dga' zhen byed rgyu/sngar rgyun gyi ltab dang bsam blo rnying pa'i thog nas bshad na/ rang byung khams ni spyi la bdag pa'i rgyu yin stabs thob gang thub dang gtor gang thub byed pa las dga' zhen gyi bdag srung byed pa ha cang nyung nyung yin/nor khrul kyi ngos 'dzin de dag gi shugs rkyen 'og nye ba'i lo dngas nang 'dzam gling thog gi srog chags dang skyes dngos mang po rtsa stong du song ba dang /khor yug gnad don de rgyal spyi'i thog gi dka' ngal che shos sa gyur ba red/— 130 —

sring 'phel rgyas nga rang nga ra yudon dngos thog rang byung khams de mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas kyi rmang gzhi dang srog rtsa zhig yin pas/ nga tsho tshang mas rang byung khams la dga' zhen byed rgyu ma zad rang nyid de'i nang gi cha shas sumangon thub pa byed dgos/gnyis pa/ rgyun sring 'phel rgyas mngon 'gyur yong ba'i thabs shes mi gtso bo/spyi lo 1992lor mnyam 'brel rgyal la sa kyi la sa chen thog〈dusarangs nyer gcig pa'i 'char gzhir〉gros 'cham byung ba dang / 〈'char gzhi〉des rgyal khab tshang mas rang rang gi rang byung khams dang dpal 'byor/spyi la sa/ rigs gnas bcas kyi cha rkyen dang la chos la gzhigs nasargyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi thabs shes gsar pa 'don rgyur skul lcags byas yod/ma gzhi 'dzam gling thog rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi gcig 'gyur ram rgyal khab tshang mar mkho ba'i thabs lam zhig med rung rgyun sring 'phel rgyas gyi snying don la gzhigs na/ de mngon 'gyur yong ba'i thabs lam gtso bo khag cig yod pa gsham gal ltar/gcig khor kyi lhag spung skyob de spyi'i 'char 'god nang 'jog rgyu dang sngar rgyun 'phel rgyas kyi byed phyogs la 'gyur ldogs gtong rgyu/sngar rgyun 'phel rgyas kyi dmigs yu gtso bo de dpal 'byor gyi thon 'bab yin la rgyal dmangs thon skyed kyi rin thang bsdoms 'bor 6a2gyi — 3 —

la kyi la la la la nga nga sa la la la nga ba'aphar la de spyi la sa yar thon la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ dpal 'byor thon 'ang ba kho na 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu dmigs yu du 'dzin pa des khor yug dang thon khungs la la zos dang gtor bshig shugs chen bzo gi yod/dper na/ de sngon gyi u ru sa dang / rang rgyal gyis lag bstar byas pa'ibaskegs brgal 'thab jus kyi rgyud rim nang bag med kyis thon khungasa'adzad spyod byas pa dang khor yug la rdzad skyon gtong ba'i bzo las thon skyed spel ba/ gzhan yang a ri dpe mtshon du byas pa'i nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab mang pos thon skyed gang mang byed pa dang 'dzad spyod yang gang mang byed pa'i 'tsho ba'i goms gshis kyis thon khungs dang khor yug la pyong gun chen po bzos yod/sngar rgyun 'phel rgyas kyi byed phyogs la 'gyur ldog gtong thabs gtso bo ni/ dpal 'byor yong 'bab kyi 'phar la de spyi tshogs yar thon su ngosa'adzin byed pa'i bsam blor yong srang dang / thon khungs kyi rin thang dngosade khrom ra'i thog lag bstar byed rgyu/ thon khungs bod spyod kyi nus pa gong mthor gtong ba/ de bzhin khor yug rdzad skyon gyi kha gsab mtho ru gtong rgyu bcas yin/gnyis/ lta ba rnying par 'gyur rdog btangs nas bab chags 'dzad spyod kyi rnam pa gsar pa 'dzugs rgyu/sngar rgyun dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi spyi la sa 'gul shugs ni bag med 'dzad spyod dang thengs gcig bed spyod btang nas tshang ma gad snyegasasu— 132 —

sring 'phel rgyas nga rang nga ra yu skyur nga'i 'tsho ba'i goms gshis de yin pa dang / 'bor che ba'i dngos rdzasathon skyed kyis bag med 'dzad spyod la go skabs bskrun yod/ dper na/dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab kyis 'dzam gling ka' bor gyi rgya cha 25las zin gyi med rung 'dzam gling tshong las thon khungs kyi brgya cha 80'dzad spyod byed kyi yod/ tshan rig bas chod rtsis byas par gzhigs na dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang 'dzam gling ka' bor dung phyur 70zin gyi yod pa dang / de dag tshang mas da lta'i nub phyogs rgyal khang lta bu'i 'dzad spyod byas na/ nga tshor sa'i go la 10tsam dgos kyi yod/'dzad spyod goms gshes gsar pa 'dzugs rgyu'i thad/ thog mar dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab kyis bag med 'dzad spyod la 'gyur ldog gtong rgyu dang / dus mtshungs yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab kyi 'dzad spyod yang khor yug srung skyob dang zung 'brel byed dgos/ yang 'dzad spyod dngos rdzasakyi khyad chos thog nas brjod na/ spyod shas che ba dang bskyar bas byed lo ba/de bzhin gtsang bzo byed bde ba'i dngos rdzas thon skyed dang 'dzad spyod byed rgyu/gsum/ khor yug spung skyob la dge che ba'i lag rtsal 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu dang / thon skyed gtsang ma mngon 'gyur yongs ba/ rang byung la gnod 'che med pa'i thon rkyed ma lag 'dzugs rgyu/tshan rig lag rtsal gyi gong 'phel dang rang byung khor yug bar 'brel — 133 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga tshobab dam zab yod de1 nye rabs tshan rig lag rtsal gsar pa mang pos mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gong mthor btang ba ma zad/ khor yug srung skyob la yang phan thog chen po byung yod/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad/lag rtsal gsar pa mang pos khor yug gtor bshig gtong ba la cha rkyen bskrun yod/thon skyed gtsang ma'i lag rtsal 'phel rgyas btang nas tshan rig lag rtsal dang khor yug srung skyob bar mtshams sbyor gyi 'brel ba zhig 'dzugs rgyu yin/ thon skyed gtsang ma'i lag rtsal gyi dmigs yul gtso bo ni thon skyed dang thon rdzas zhabs zhu'i rgyud rim las byung ba'i khor yug gnod 'tshe tshod 'dzin byed thub pa byed rgyu de yin/ de yang thon skyed byed pa'i rgyud rim nang gcig nas thon khungs la gron chung dang gnyis nas gang thub kyis dug ldan rgyu cha bed spyod migatong ba dang thon skyed kyi snyigs rdzas la tshod 'dzin byed rgyu/thon rdzas dang zhabs zhu'i nang gang thung kyis khor yug gnod 'tsher tshod 'dzin byed rgyu dang / thon rdzas dang zhabs zhu'i rgyu cha nyung du gtong rgyu/thon rdzas kyi spyod shan dang spus tshad gong mthor gtong rgyu ma zad gang thubakyis bskyar bsdu bskyar spyod byed rgyu yin/bzhi/ khor yug srung skyob kyi bca' khrims dngas srid jus 'thus tshang bzo rgyu/ma gzhi mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs dang 'dzam gling rgyal khab so sosabaca' khrims dang srid jus mang po bzos nas khor yug la srung skyob byed — 134 —

sring 'phel rgyas nga rang nga khor yubazhin yod rung/ khor yug gi gnad don mang por thag gcod byung med lakhor yug spyi'i gnad don de da dung yang rgyal spyi'i gnad don gtso bo thig yin stabs/ mu mthud khor yug dang thon khungs srung skyob kyi bca' khrimasadang srid jus 'a sa sgo tshang du gtong rgyu de rgyal khab tshang ma'i 'os 'gan zhig yin/lnga/ khor yug spung sgrob kyi 'du shes gong mthor gtong rgyu spyi dmangs ni 'dzad spyod pa yin la thon skyed pa yang yin/ spyi dmangs kyi spyod lam dang khor yug dbar 'brel ba dam zab yod stabasakhotshol ra yug srung skyob kyi bya spyod nang zhugs tshe 'dzam gling khor yug la rnayopa gsar pa zhig chags nges yin/

sa bcad bcu gnyis/ srol rgyun lhag gnas kyis khor yug spung skyongs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu'i skor/gong gi ga bcad mi nyung ba zhig gi nang nga tshos bon dang nang pa sangasargyas gtso bor byas pa'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang lhag par rig gnas 'di bzhin dang rang byung khams kyi 'brel ba'i skor la zhing 'jug dang gal bshad zhus pa'i dmigs yul dang dgos pa gtso bo ni/ khyad du 'phagasapa'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang goms gshis/ kun spyod/ de bzhin rang byung khams la 'dzin pa'i thar bas kyi lta ba rnams mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs dang lhag par du mi rabs gsar pa rnams la rig gnas 'di dang mthun pa'i kun spyod kyi slob gso thob thub pa byas nas bod kyi sa khul 'dir 'gro ba mi'i rigs dang rang byung khams gnyis dang ra sngar rgyun lta bu'i zhi mthun kyi 'brel ba rgyun la dngas yong cad du yin/de yang nang pa sangs rgyas gtso bor byas pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugasakyi slob gsodang shugs rkyen bzang po'i 'og rang rigs rnams gshis rgyud 'jam la kun spyod bzang ba'i lor bas tshu ldan du gnas pa ma zad/ rang byung khams dang lhag par du skyes dngos dang sbog chags gtso bor byas pa'i — 136 —

srol la sa kyis ra yu nga ba la bas 'a la 'i rathon yangs rnams la bdag skyong dang gces spras byed pa'i gshis rgyud dang gom srol bzang po zhig la sa yod pa de ni rang mi rigs kyi khyad du 'phagasapa'i yon tan dang rin thang bral 'i rgyu nor zhig kyang yin/ deng skangasa'adzam gling khor yug gnad don kyis medang skye khams yongs la dka' ngal mang po bzo gi yod bas sa khul dang rgyal khab mang pos thabs shes rnam pa sna tshogs la rten nas khor yug slob gso'i las don la nga ma zad/ bca' khrims dang srid jus gsar pa lag bstar byas te mi rabs nas skor bsal mkho ba'i rang byung thon khungs la bdag skyong byed kyi yod rung / 'dzam gling loganas mang po'i mi dmangs kyi 'byor pa dman pas khor yug srung skyob kyi grub 'bras zhan pa dang / yang 'byor pa che ba'i sa khul dang rgyal khab nang dpal 'byor gyi khe phan khona'i la du khor yug la rdzad skyon dang thon khungasal gtor bshig rgya chen po gtong gi yod/ 'on kyang rang re'i bod kyi sa khul mang che bar khor yug dang thon khungs la da bar bzod du mi rung ba'i gnod 'che dang gtor bshig chen po de 'dra byung myong med/ lhag par du deng rabs kyi la snyegs bskrun dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi las don rgya la po ma la gong bod kyi sa khul mang che bar khor yug gi rnam b.rang byung ji bzhin du gnas pa ma zad/ la ljongs mdzes la skyes dngos dang srog chagasarnams kyang rang rang gi thun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i sa gnas su zhi bder gnasayod la / khor yug dang thon khungs gtor bshig gi gnad don yang ha cang nyung nyung red/bod rigs rnams kyis byams snying rje dang las rgyu 'bras de bzhin — 37—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu srang bskyes dngos tshang mar srog gnas pa 'dra mnyam yin pa'i 'du shes kyi thog nasabag med kyi gnod 'tshe mi byed pa dang lhag par du bod mi'i gzhan 'dring 'jog medagos pa'i lhan skyes kyi byams snying rje'i sems rgyud dang ma skral rang bzhin du sbog gcod sgangs nas dge ba'i lam la 'jug pa'i dmangs srol 'dis mi lo stong gi sngon nas da bar rang byung khor yus/ gi bdag/ skyong thad sman pa'i nus pa chen po thon yod/ dper na/ bon gyi ston pa gshen rab kyis gzan dpar gsar du gtod pa dang btsan po'i dus su dge ba bcu rgyal khrims nang bkod nas bag med srog gcod la tshod 'dzin dang rgyal rtse chosargyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi skabs nas bzung dus dang sa gnasanges can du ri rgya dang / klung rgya/ lam rgya sogs bsdams nas skyes dngosadang srog chags la bdag skyong byed pa'i srol bzang gtod pa dang / lhag par du yul lhagazhi bdag la bsnyen bkur gyis bod la kyi grags can ri dang / mtsho/ nags tsha sogs rang byung khor yug dang thon khungs kyi saganas mang po zhis/ la lhagazhi bdag gi gnas la du ngos 'dzin nas bsnyen bkur gyi la du gang byung gi sa rko rdo rlog mi byed par sa gtsang chu gtsang gyi byung ba do snyom par gnas thub pa byung yod/ de yang mang tshogs tshang mayoganas ri dang gnas mtshor dad zhen gyis sa khul de dag tu gang byung gi mi 'dzegs pa dang / rtsi shing gcod sreg dbyed pa/ srog mig bod pa/ rdzad skyon mi gtong nga/ skad ngan gyi brdab zing mi bzo ba/ yod rdo rlog mi byed pa'i dmangs srol de dang / gnas ri dang gnas mtsho nus pa rnams deng rabs kyi rang byung khor yug srung skyob khul zhes pa'i phan 'bras dang mthun gyi — 138—

srol ri sa kyis/ ra yu zang rab la zhabs 'a sa 'i rayod stabs don dngos thog tha snyad kyi khyad par tsam las ba yum na 'dir lngathog ngo mtshar can kyi yum ljongs dang skyes dngos dang srog ༅sa sna 'dzomasapa'i ri klung rnams la dmigs sa bkar nas bdag skyong byed pa'i srol de dar yod/ gzhan yang ri rgya dang klung rgya de bzhin dga' ldan pho brang gi ri klung rtsa tshig gis ri klung khag bsdams te srog gcod gtso bor byas pa'i sdig tshasarnams bkag srol yod pa ltar/ skabs de ri chos srid gnyis ka'i thog nasakha ba can gyi yul ljongs dang / thon khungs1 khor yug bcas la mig mthong lagazin gyi srung skyob thub yod pa ma zad 'gro ba mi'i rigs dang rang byung khams gnyis mthun 'jug mnyam gsos gyi rnam pa bzang po 'ig byung yod1/'on kyang nye dbas dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi las grwa rgya cher spos ba dang /gzhi rgya che ba'i thon skyed rgyu cha'i re nga skong ched shing nags dang / gter kha/de bzhin ri skyes srog chags bcas la nyams nyes byung ba ma zad 'tsho ba dang thon skyed kyis cha dang khor yug spyi badzra da skyon gyi gnod 'tshe bzo bzhin yod pa tshang mas shes gsal ltar yin/'o na nga tshos ji ltar byas nas srol bzang de dag rgyun 'khyongs kyisabod kyi rang byung khor yug dang ri skyes skyes dngos kyi bdag skyong la phan nusaji ltar 'don dgos zhes na/ de yang deng skabs kyi khor yug srung skyob lasadon nang srol rgyun rig gnas kyis khor yug srung skyob la khyad du 'phags pa'i nus pa dang kun spyod kyi mig dpe 'don thub kyi yod par tshang mas khas len byed dgos pa dang / dper na yod khru lo5dang chagatsun du yod pa'i saskyes do skyes kyi yul mi rnams kyis skor bas mang po'i nyams myong la bsten — 139 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi khor yu zang banas nags sing du 'tsho nga ma zad/ nye bar mkho ba'i nags dang nags khrod srog chags dang ra du zhi dul gyi 'brel ba btsugs pa dang / lhag par du stong la nye ba'i srog chags dang skyes dngos rnams la dang rten 'brel gyi mtshon rtags su 'dzin nas srung skyong byed pa'i la srol bzang pos sa khul de dag gi nags tsha dang srog chags la bdag srung yag po byung yodas de bzhin 'dzam gleng la gru gzhan du yang srol rgyun rig gnas dang yul srol kyi khyad chos dang dge tshan la rten nas khor yug srung skyob skor kyi spyi dmangs slong gsodang las don la gyi yod pa de dag la dmigs bsal gyi phan 'brasathon yod/'on kyang rang re'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs khor yug srung skyob las don bar rang bzhin gī mthun cha yod pa tsam las de gnyis dbar gcig khu gnyis thim kyi 'brel ba gsar pa zhig la gas thub med la/ srol rgyun rig gnas dang la goms kyi dge char ngos 'dzin thub pa dang / de dag la brten nas deng rabs srung skyob las don nang phan nusagasar pa 'don rgyu'i thabs shes dang bya ba ha cang nyung nyung yin/ 'o na ji ltar byas nas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi rnams dang la chos la brten nasadeng rangs khor yug srung skyob kyi las don la zhabs 'digs zhu thub pa byed dgos zhes na/ 'dir nga tshos bod du la zin pa'i las don gī nyams myong dang de bzhin rgyal spyi'i thog gi dpe mtshon la gzhigs nas bsam 'char dang ltal khag gcig ngo sprod zhu rgyu yin/dang po/ rang byung khams dang khor yug srung skyob la phan pa dang dge —140—

srol ri sa kyis ra yu nga ba la bas 'a sa 'i ramatshan che ba'i ༅srol dang kun spyod rnams rgyun yongs dang slar gso྾ ba byed rgyu/ nye rabs 'dzam gling dpal 'byor dang spyi gas mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang dus mtshungs nub phyogs gtso bor byas yo phyi rolapa'i rig gnas kyi shugs rkyen 'og rang re'i bod tsho 'du shes dang kunas la 'gyur ldog rṣa po byung yod/ deng skabs mi mang pos lto gos gtamagasum kho na'i chen du bag med kyi 'tsho bar nol ba ma zad lon chung nga rnamasakyis de lta bu'i 'tsho bdang kun spyod mig dper 'dzin pa ha cang mang po yod/dper na/ bza' ཿnga gi longs spyod lar 'dzin dang mu mtha' med la/rang rang gi ming grags dang 'byor pa mar rṣa du rtsa za thon khungs dang stong la nye ba'i ri skyes srog ༅sa las grub pa'i zas rigs kyi gsol bston gshom pa dang / gtam 'dod kyis gyon chas dpe gsar mthong tshad nyo ba/de bzhin dgos nges kyi 'tsho ba'i mkho chas ma yin pa'i bag med 'dzad spyod rgya chen bo byed pa sogs las/ de dag gi gcig nas khor yug srung skyob kyi ngo bodang 'gal ba ma zad/ gnyis nas rang re'i nyams chung la lor ba pa'i srol rgyun kun spyod dang yang mthun thabs med pa zhig yin/ srol rgyun rig gnas dang yul srol nang gi 'dzem cha dang dge ba sgrung rgyu'i sgul lcags lasami'i gshis spyod zhi zhing dul ba ma zad 'byung ba do snyoms par sman pa'i kun spyod rnams rgyun 'dzin thub pa byung yod/ 'on kyang deng skabs kyi mi rnamasal khor yug srung skyob kyi shes bya dman khar/ srol rgyun gyi 'dzem cha rnamasaskyon du ngos 'dzin nas de dag la 'dzem bya dbyed pas kho tsho'i bya spyod mang pos rang byung khor yug la shor skyon chen po bzo gi yod/ der brten nga tshos— 141 —

bo kyi srol rba ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bsrol rgyun rig gnas kyi legs phyogs 'dzem cha rnams rgyun 'dzin gyi thog nasarang byung khams dang skyes dngos tshang mar gus bkur dang bdag skyong yong ba byed dgos/ zhi zhing dul ba'i gshis spyod de ni rang mi rigs kyi khyad chosayin la des rang byung khor yug gas don la dgos nges kyi nus pa snyamathu da thon rgyu nyag gcig yin stangs pha yodang slob grwa de bzhin spyi tshogs yongasakyis srol rgyun rig gnas de lta bu rgyun la ngas yong rgyur 'bad pa byed dgos/dpeng na/ rig gnas yod pa'i pha mas zhar zhor la la srol goms gshisadang khor yug srung skyob kyi mthun la skor bu phrug la ngo sprod byed rgyu dang /slob chung dang slob 'bring nang gi rig gnas slob tshan nang srol rgyun rig gnas dang khor yug srung skyob skor gyi zhing po'i nang don khag gcig ngo sprod byed thub na phan yon chen po yong nges red/gnyis pa/ srol rgyun goms gshis dang chos kyi bslab bya'i thog nasaspyi dmangs la khor yug srung skyong kyi slob gsogatong rgyu/ rang re'i la srol goms gshis dang chos kyi bslab bya'i nang 'khor yug srung skyob la sman pa'i sgrung dang / bslab tshig par ris sna la g.yod rung da bar khor yug srung skyob kyi las don dang slob gso'i nang de dag gang legs kyis bod spyad pa ha cang nyung nyung yin/ gong gal sgrung dang / bslab bya/ par ris rnamasadang deng rabs khor yug gi snyeng don phan tshun sdeb spyor gyis dril bsgragayoyig rigs dang par ris bzos nas spyi dmangs la khor yus/ srung skyob kyi slong gas byas na go bde ba dang / 'gro gron chung ba/ bag chags zab pa skornams kyi sems la ngab thub pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod/ nye ba'i lo shas ring —142—

srol ri sa kyis ra yu nga po la bas 'a sa 'i ra'adzam ming khor yug thebs rtsa dang ljongs nags las rgyus gas 'bros gyisabaslab gas dang / ri mo/ khor yug srung spyob kyi shes bya bcas tshud pa'i dril bsgrags par ris 'grem spos byas par zhing 'brog mas gas kyisadaga' po byed pa ma zad dril bsgrags kyi nus ba yang chen po thonas/gsum pa/ dge 'dun pa dang chos pa khag gcig gis deng rabasakhor yug srung skyob kyi shes bya khongs su༅ pa byas nas khor yug srung skyob kyi dril bsgrags la shugs bsnod rgyag rgyu/rang re'i ljongs 'dir rang byung thon khungs dang ri skyes skyes dngosaphun su mtshogs po yod bam zad/ de dag mang che ba bod ljongs gon lasas khul gzhan du mthong rgyu med pa'i rin thang ldan yod/ 'on kyang bod kyi sargya che ba'i 'bor nyung bas srid gzhung kho nar brten nas thon khungs dang khor yug la bdag skyong dang do dam byed par dka' ngal yod stabs spyi dmangs tshang mas las don der 'gan khri 'khyer dgos/ spyi dmangs tshang mas khor yug srung skyob las don la rgyab skyor dang the jus yong za deng rabs khor yug srung skyong kyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya'i skor khyab gdal dang drilabasgrags yag po byed rgyu de las don gtso bo zhig yin/ ma gzhi srid gzhung gi 'brel yod tshan bdang rgyal spyi'i sgrig tshogs khag nas rang byung khor yug srung skyob khul gtso bor byas pa'i sa gnas khag karmang gzhi'i shes bya dang bca' khrims kyi dril bsgrags byas ba brgyud/ phan 'bras chen po thon yod rung / da dung yumathu da spyod mangs la dril sgrag dang slob gsogatong rgyu'i dgos pa chen po yod pas ri skyes skyes dngos dang sto gsas phun sum pos— 143 —

la byung da 'a nga sa nga nga sa kyi zang sa sa nga bapo yod pa'i sa khul dang yang na khor yug srung skyob la gnod 'tshe che nga'i saganas su gnas pa'i dgon pa'i nang chos kyi don dang mthun pa'i sgo nas rang byung khor yug srung skyob skor gyi shes bya khyab gdal byed rgyu dang / dge 'dun pa chos sems can thams cad bde nga dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par 'gyur cig sems can thams sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar 'gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar 'gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms su gnas par 'gyur cig ces pa'i don dang mthun pa'i shems de dag dang 'brel yod chos kyi bslab bya dang zung 'brel byas nasamang tshogs la dril bsgrags byed thub na dmigs bas gyi nus pa thon ngesayin/ bzhi pa/ yul srol goms gshis kyi 'dzem cha dang deng rabs kyi khor yug srung spyob kyi snyeng don zung 'brel byas nas dril bsgrags dang slob gsogatong rgyu/ yul srol goms gshis dang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi ngos 'dzin ltar na srog mi gcod pa dang byams snying rje de bzhin srog dang ldan pa'i phung po thams cad btang snyoms kyi gnas rtsa 'jog gi yod pa de ni deng rabasakhor yug srung skyob kyi ngo bo dang mthun gyi yod stabs 'dzem cha dang yul srol de dag la deng dngas khor yug srung skyob kyi shes bya'i thog nas tshan rig gi 'grel bshad byas na gcig nas mang tshogs kyi dang len byed bde ba dang gnyis nas lag bstar byed rgyur de bas bsgul lcags yong rgyu yin/ gal srid de lta bu zung 'brel byung tshe skyes dngos dang srog la mtshang ma btang — 144 —

srol ri sa kyis ra yu srang ba la bas 'a sa 'i rasnyoms dang bde ba'i nang nas 'tsho rgyur cha rkyen bskrun thub nges roladadzichos kyi nang don yang yin/gong du brjod pa rnams ni rang re'i srol rgyun rig gnas dbayosrol goms gshis kyi legs po ma rang byung khor yug la sman pa'i phyogasarnams yin/ 'on kyang yul srol dang goms gshis kha shas kyis khor yug dang thon khungs srung skyob la gtor bshig dang gnod 'tshe bzo gi yod pa dper na/ ri dwags kyi lhags pas ston chas bzo ba'am yang na gos gong dang gos 'dang la lpags rigs kyi rgyan klungs pa'i goms gshis 'disagacan gzan gtso bor byas pa'i ri dwags mang po'i lpags rigs la khrom ra'i dgos mkho bskrun pa ma zad khrom ra de'i dgos mkho dang rin thang nyin re bzhin je mthor 'gro gi yod/ de yang gangs ljongs kyi ༅ gru mang che ba sabab mtho la grang ngar che bas lo rgyus thog grang skyong kyi ra du srog chags kyi lpags rigs las dro chos kyi gos rigs bzo ba'i srol de mnga' ris dang /nag chu/ chab mdo gzhi rtse sogs sa khul du dar che tsam byung yod/ tshang la 'do la 〈pe yang bde mngoms mkhyan g.yo ltar gad ma' dus su rnams rdo kyi nyis dwags dun nas sha lpags bod spyod byed pa de ni dgos nges kyi nyin re'i 'dzad spyod las bag med dang rgyas spras kyi 'tsho nga min la skabs de'i mi 'bor nyung bas ri skyesasrog gsal de tsam gyi mna' gcod dang gtor bshig byung med/ 'on kyang spyi gas dang dpal 'byor rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung bdang dusamatshungs 'byor pa dang dbang shugs kyi dbye brgya za song bas spyi gas nang gral rim gyi dbye ba byung ba nas bzung tsos ri dwags dang lhag par du —145—

bo kyi srol la sa nga deng sa kyi ra yu nga nga/gcan gzan stag gzig gi lpags rigs rnams dbang sgyur pa dang dgragasarnams kyis dbang thang dang snyan grags ma tshon la du gos dang / gos rgyan/gdan du spyod srol dar ba dang / gzhan yang btsan po srong btsan kyi dusasakhrims dang lugs srol mang po gtan 'bebs mdzad pa'i nang gses rkyen drug ces thob thang drug yin te/ ④dpa' bo'i rkyen du gung dang stag 'u slog pa dang / ④sdar ma'i rkyen du wa'i zhwa/ ④bar bas rkyen du lha chos/①mdzangs pa'i rkyen du yig tshangs/ ⑤g.yung po'i rkyen du thags dang bon/ ④ngan pa'i rkyen du rkun ma bcas dang yang dpa' mtshan drug ces pa dpa' bo rnams kyi mtshon rtags su stob/ stod dang stag smad gnyis/ zar chen dang zar chung gnyis/ gong ras dang stag slog gnyis④la gtan 'khel mdzad de khro zhing gtum pa dang rtsa che ba'i srogs chags stag gi lpags pasadapa' bo'i ming grags dang gshes spyod mal par byed pa'i srol de dar ba yin/bcol ra ma btang gong du yang bod kyi mi drag dang 'byor pa can rnams kyis stag lpags dang gzig lpags de bzhin sram lhags kyi gos dang gos rgyan bzos nas rang rang gi dbang thang dang ming grags mtshon par byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang skabs de'i mang la sa mang che ba dpal 'byor gyi 'khosaka zhan pas de ltar gyi longs spyod la rol ba'i nus pa med la sku drag dang 'byor pa can gyi mi 'bor yang ha cang nyung bas mi rigs gyon chas kyi la srol des ri skyes srog chags la bzod du da rung ba'i gnod 'tshe de tsam byung — 146—

srol la sa kyis ra la nga ba la bas la la la ramed/ snye ba'i lo bcu'i nang dpal 'byor dang 'tsho ba'i chu ba gong mthor phyin pa dang dus mtshungs mi rigs kyi pyon chas la yang dang 'dod dang dar la na po byung bam zad pyon chas de dag gi yo chos gtso bo'i rtsa che ri skyes srog la sa stag dang / gzig sras sogs kyi lhags pas sa mtha ra shan sbyar ba sha stag yin/ logs ra dang gal che ba'i dus bston skabs lhasadang / chab mdo/ nag chu/ gzhis rtse/ seng ge kha' bab/ rtse thang sogasagrong khyer nang pho mo rgan gzhon mang che ba'i lus steng du stag lhags dang /gzig lpags/ sram lpags bcas kyis rgyan pa dang / rgyu dang dpal 'byor che ba rnams kyis lpags rigs 'bor chen btang nas phyu pa'i phyi sha ha lamalpags pas bcums ltar bzo gi yod pa de dag ni lug mthun gyi rgyan tsam mayin par ha cang thal ba'i rgyas sprod dang bag med longs spyod 'ba' zhig yin/'on kyang khor yug srung skyob dang ri skyes srog ༅sal srung skyob byed rgyu'i shel dang go rtogs dman pas mi mang pos ri skyes srog la sa kyi lpagasarigs lus la pyon pa de dmyal bar 'gro nga'i sdig pa'i rgyu yin pa dang / ngo snong dgos pa'i bya ba zhig yin bas chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka'i cha nasaskyon 'ba' zhig ma gtogs dge spu tsam yang med pa de ma rtog par bag med kyi rgyas spros de dag mig ltos su 'dzin nas gsog 'jog gang thub byas te lpags rigs de dag nyo gang thung byed pa'i la min gyi dar srol des bod kyi sa gnas gang sar phrags rigs de dag la khrom ra rgya chen po yod/ de ltar gyi khrom ra'i dgos ma khodang khe spogs kyi 'dod zhen 'og lkog rngon pa mang posarang ljongs kyi khul du yod pa'i stag gzig rnams rngon nas rig rgyu med pa — 47—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bdang rgya gar dang pha dzin than gyi stag dang sram sogs ri dwas/sa kyi khyu la nyamasargud chen po byung yod/der rten nga chos gtam 'dod kyi bsam pa dang bya spyod de rigasaspangs nas rang byung khor yug dang ri skyes srog chags kyi srung skyob las don la brtsi 'jog dang rgyab skyor byed rgyu de ni nga tshos spyi 'bangs tshang ma'i 'gan 'khri yin pa blor 'dzin dgos/le'i 'di'i mchan 'grel/④〈sa'i1yo'u⑪bas kyi0༷ba〉2329④〈mkhas pa'i dga' bston〉lcags dpar deb ngos 191— 148 —

sa bcad bce gsum/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo ches bon gyi bstan pa spyong ba'i dus/de yang thog mar bod kyi sa khams chags tshul skor la‘‘stod mnga' risabaskor gsum rdzing gi ྾/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba 'dra/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum zhing lta bu/ kun kyang mtsho ye gyur pa'i nang mi zhesadang / ‘‘mtsho de 'khol ba zhi zhing rab ru bsil1 kong gi chu ba/gces bya'i zos bye bas/ ru bzhi chu yis gang ba de ru thim/ chu gzhan da kyang de ltar jim pa yis/ bod khams yug gyi rnam pa gsal por dod ④ces bod ga ba'i ljongs 'di thog mar yul stod smad bar gsum thams cad chu yis gang ba rgya mtsho chen po zhig yin pa dang / de nas rim kyis chu rnams thim ste bod yul kyi rnam pa gsal por thon pa yin zhes bstan yod/ de nas dus yun ha cang ring po zhig brgyud de mtsho ngos las 'phags pa'i skamasa'i thog bskyes dngosadang ri skyes srog chags ha cang phun gsum tshogs pa byung yod/ de yang ‘‘mnga' ris bskor gsum sha rkyang ri dwags gling / bar gyi ru bzhi stag gzig gcan gzan gling 1 smad kyi sgang drug 'dab chags bya ye gling 11④zhes④ (chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉lcags dpar deb ngos 14mi 150④ (chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉lcags dpar deb ngos1yo— 149 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bapa dang / yang ‘‘bod khams gsum gling dgu bya nga na/ rin po che 'od kyi gleng dkar po/ stod khams gsum gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba dzing 'dra ba na/sha ba dang dgo ba la sogs pa ri dwags kyis yul 'dzin/ ru bzhi sog kha'i gling skad pa/ bar khams gsum brag dang sgang gi gshong yur ba 'dra ba na/spre'u dang brag la sogs pa gnas/ ma bya 'od kyi gling skad pa/ smad khamasagasum nags kyi ljongs zhing dang 'dra ba na/ glang po che dang 'dab chags la sogs las/ 'gro nga mi bya ba gcig kyang med3 ①ces 'khod yod/ de nas‘‘yar klung gtsang po'i chu rgyud kyi nags྾ du gnas shing shing 'bras za ba'i spra rigs che ba ba dang brag phug tu sdod cing sbog chags kyi sha khrag la rol ba'i spra rigs che / ba / gnyis phan tshun 'dus pa las 'phel ba'i phru gu rim 'gyur gyis byung ④zhes bod kyi yul grur thog mar 'gro nga mi ye rigs byung ba dang /de nas ri dwags sngon pa/ 'brog las byed pa/ sab ba kyi cha rkyen la brten nas la lar rags rmo dgas 'debs kyi zhing las kyang dar bar grags/de nas bod kyi yul grur mthog srid pa'i bon zhes pa'i gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi rmang gzhir byas pa'i chos lugs shig dar ba dang / chosalugs de ni gdod ma'i dus su dar ba zhig yin stabs/ chos 'di la dad pa byed mkhan tshos/ rtse lha/ chu lha/ sa lha/ de bzhin yul lha/ dgra lha/ pho lha sogs bsten pa dang / da dung sems can ba phyugs dang / ra lug sha ① (chos byung me tog snying po sprang rtsi'i bcud)lcags dpar deb ngos 144—145① (bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu ye phreng ba〉lcags dpar deb ngos 17— 150 —

pa rab mi bo ches bo ba pa nga ba'i sab sogs bsad nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i srol zhig yod par grags de yang mkhas pa'i dbang po dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i deb ther nang ‘‘chos lugs de ni sngar yod gdod yo'i chos lugs kyibasamablo'i rmang gzhi'i thog 'byung ba lnga'i lha dang / yum sgyu snya/ khyim lha/ dgra lha/zhang lo sogs lha rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yo da pa de tshor sems can ba phyugasadang / ra lug sha ba sogs bsad nas mchod pa 'bul mi①zhes gsal bar 'khod yod/ de nas bod kyi yum 'dir g.yung drung bon gyi chos lugasagasar du gtod mkhan ston pa gshen rab mi bo che bya bzhig sku 'khrungs/ de yang ‘6bskal ston sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis byon pa'i nang nas thog mar 'gro 'dul rnam 'dren stong/ pa rab dgu'i nang sa rnam 'dren brgyad bde yin la/yang dmu rigs rgyal bon thod dkar dang yum yo phyi rgyal bshad ma gnyis kyi sras su lo rgyal shing byi lo'i dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga gza' skar rgyal phur 'grub spyor nyin sku 'khrungs/ spyi lo'i sngon 'das lo 16017phyin pa'o1’①zhesapa dang / yang mkhas dbang nam mkha' nor bus‘‘gshen rab 'khrungs nasad lta bar (spyi lo1991)lo 3908song yod1 ②ces 'khod yod/de nas ston pa gshen rab mi bo ches/ gdul bya'i sems can yang dag lam la dkri chen du/ spyir mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ sgos sumadzad ba drug bcu/ bye brag tu mdzad ba brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi thog nas/ bon gyi bstan ① (bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor〉lcags dpar deb ngos 7① (theg chen sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi ngo sprod blo gsar sgo 'byed〉lcags dpar deb ngos 4④ 〈'ang bod lo rgyus ti si'i 'od〉lcags dpar deb ngos 69— 151 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bapa'i 'khor lo rgyas par bskor/ sku nyid mal gis gdul bya sems can gyi spangs bya'i nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong la ltos te 'dul byed gnyen po bon sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / nyon mongs dug lngal ltos te bon sgo sgo bzhi mdzod lnga/ dug gsum la ltos te bon gyi phyi nang gsang gsum/ de'i nang nal do sngags kyi gzhung lugs la cha mtshon na phyi mdo ye gzhung lugs/gtso bo mtshan nyid lnga ste zab mo ston pa/ 'bum ste dang / la khrims rnam dag gi 'dul ba'i sde/ las 'bras ston pa mdo ye sde/ chags gnas ston pa mdzod kyi sde/ gzhal bya dbu rigs pa'i sde dang lnga'o/ nang gsang sngags kyi gzhung lugs gtso bo spyi spungs bsgrags pa skor gsum ste/ 'chi med yum sras gshen sogs brgyud pa'i steng lhal du bsgrags pa don rgyud rgyas pa'i skor dang / 'og klu la bsgrags pa bsdus don man ngag gi skor/ bar mi la du bsgrags pa lung don 'bring po'i sgor gsum la spyi 'bum bsgrags pa skor gsum mo/ gsang ba sems phyogs kyi gzhung lugs gtso bo zhang zhung snyan brgyud/ bka' rgyud skor bzhi ste/ ltang/ spyi gcod dang / nang man ngag dmar 'khrod/ gsang ba rig pa gcer mthong / yang ga/sang gnasalugs phug chod dang bzhi bcas gtso bor 'dzin dgos/④khyad ngar ston pa gshen rab dbo ches bka' 'khor dang po rnam par rgyal mtshan rgyal po'i mdzad pa bzhes pa'i skabs su/ rgyu ye theg pa bzhi/ 'bras bu'i jeg pa bzhi/rgyu 'bras dbyed med la par bla na med pa'i rbeg pa ces bon spi thun mongs④ theg chen sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi ngo sprod blo gsar sgo 'byed 〉 lcags dpar deb ngos 7— 152—

pa rab mi bo ches bo ba pa nga ba'i sam yin pa'i jeg pa rim dgu'i bon gyi 'khor lo bskor de yang rgyu ye theg pa bzhi ni/ phywa gshen kyi jeg pa/ snang gshen kyi theg pa/ 'phagashen gyi theg pa/ srid gshen gyi theg pa bcas dang / 'bras bu'i thegs bzhi ni/dge snyen gyi theg pa/ drang srong gi theg pa/ yodakar gyi theg pa/ ye gshenagyi jeg pa bcas dgu'o/ de dag las/ dang po1 phywa gshes gyi theg par cha mtshon na/ ‘‘phywa gshen la 'jug pa'i sgo ni/ gdon la mo gto dang /mdos klud dang / nad la sman dpyad gtar bsregs kyi sbyangs ba la 'jug pa'o/ spyod pa'i mas ni gdon bcos gto thabs sum brgya drug cu dang /nad bcos gnod pa/ rlung mkhris bad kan gsum/ rtsa chu ngag gsum la brtag nas sbyangs pa'o/ rtogs pa'i lta ba ni/ phywa gshen la mkhas pasasems bskyed rnam par dag pa 'du shes bzhi ye sgo nas bskyangs te/ nad rigs sum brgya drug cu/ dpyad dang sman gyis spyangs/ dung yod pa dang /gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ yodang gto yis bzlog rgyu yod pa ④zhesaston pa gshen rab mi bo ches bon gyi theg pa rim dgu'i phywa gshen gyi theg pa'i nang du nad rigs sum brgya drug hrur/ sman dpyad gtar dang mdo yisabazlog thung pa'i la zhig gsar du gtod/ khyad par ston pas‘‘bstan pa'i mas ni snyeng rje yin/ bsam pa bzang po gser ltar 'chang mi①zhes sems pa bzang po'i sems bskyed dang / snying rje chen po'i las 'di g.yung drung gyi ① (bon gyi bstan 'byung 〉lag bris ma dpe ngos 99④ (theg chen sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi ngo sprod blo gsar sgo 'byed〉lcags dpar deb ngos 10— 153 —

za kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang brob1bon bstan pa'i gzhir bzhag nab/ mthog srid pa'i bon gyis ra lug dang /sha ba sogs bsad de mchod pa 'bul ba'i srol ngan pa 'di/ bkag cing med pa bzo chen du/ gto thabs sum brgya drug cu'i nang / gal srid cho ga sogs kyi nang du sems can gang rung zhig bed spyod byed dbo/sa tshe/ semasacan thad la/ra srog bcod medagos par dpar shing thog yod pa'i sems can gī gzugs brnyan 'di zan gong ste sbags ril thog blangs te chos rdzas kyi tshab byed thub kyi yod/ srol 'di ston pa gshen rab mi bo che'i rjes drangs g.yung drug bon gyi bon rgan tshos lo ngo stong phrag ring nyams su blangs nas da lta yang zan dpar bed spyod byed pa'i cho ga 'di mig lam du mngon rgyu yod/ zan dpar gyi srol rgyun 'di gsar du gtod pa nas bzung / bon pos semasacan bsad de dmar mchod 'bul ba'i lo rgyus 'di yongs sumajug sgril ba red la/ bod mis srog chags la bdag skyong dang khor yug srung skyong byed pa'i spyod bzang de yang 'di nas dbu tshugs so/

sa bcad bcu bzhi/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis srid skyong ba'i dus/dang bo/ btsanaXpo srong btsan sgamabos srid skyong ba'i dus/de yang btsan po srong btsan sgam po ni/ spyi lo 617bod kyi glang lor mal gro rgya nang gi pho brang byams pa mi gyur gleng du sku bltams/ btsan po 'di'i sku dus su bod yongs tshogacig sgyur mdzad pa des/ bod mi rigasa'adi bzhin du gcig tu bsgril nas dpa' mdzangs shes rig dang ldan pa zhig chags pa rgyud/ rang gi stobs shugs mtha' bzhir bskyed cing / phyogasadang phyogs mtshams tshoganas pa'i shes rigs stongs 'byor dar ba'i rgyalakhab spyi dang / lhag par thang gi rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba dam zab btsugasanas shes rig 'phel rgyas che shos yin pa'i rgyal khams de dag las chos dang /'jig rten lugs kyi gtsug lag phul du byung ba rnams blangs te/ slob sbyongs byas shing de dag mi rigs kyi srol rgyun dang zung 'brel legs par byas nas/ kha ba'i ljongs kyi bod mi rigs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/rig gnas/ dmag don/ khrims lugs la sogs phyogs gang spyi'i thad — 155 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga rbo bamadzad pa rlabs chen spel gnang mdzad yod/ de dag gi khrod nas bod kyi spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi dang / khrims srol khod sum cu so drug gsar du gtod gnang mdzad pa des/ bod gcig gyur gyi srid dbang de sra brtan yong ba dang / stobs dang ldan pa/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi sgo nas zhing 'brog thon skyed gong spel gtong rgyu/ mtha' mtshams brtan srung yong nga byed rgyu bcas la phan nus chen po thon yod/ de yang btsan po 'di'i sku dus sugasar du gtod pa'i khrims srol khod so drug la cha mtshon na/ dang po/bka' ye khrims chen po drug ces srid 'dzin sa khul khag gi dbye mtshams dang / srid 'dzin dang dmag dpon gyi sgrig gzhi/ blon po sogs dpon rigs kyi go gnas dang 'gan 'khri/ zhing 'brog gi dbang ris/ mi'i spyod pa/ 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi/ rje blon gyi blangs dor rim pa dang / mi'i spyod bzang la gtogs pa'i gnad don ha cang mang po cad yod/ gnyis pa/ bka' gros chen po drug ces pa ni rgyal srid skyongs thabasakyi sgrig srol gtso bo che ba 'ba' zhig gtan la phab pa'i skor dang / gsum pa/yig tshang drug ni/ blon 'bangs byas pa can la gzengs bstod kyi rim pa ji ltar gtan la phab pa'i skor/ bzhi pa/ phyag rgya drug ni/ rgyal po'i mdzad pa gtso bo rigs mi 'dra nga so so'i mtshon byed kyi rtags mtshan gtan la phang pa'i skor/ lnga pa rkyen drug ni/ bzang la bya dga' dang / ngan la dma' 'bebs kyi bdag rkyen gtan la phab pa'i skor/ drug pa/ dpa' mtshan drug ni/ rgyal khams kyi bde 'ang gas dang / mtha' mtshams brtan srung gi byas rjes yod pa'i dpa' bor gzengs bstod byed lugs zhib par bkod — 156 —

chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i sayod/ lhag par rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims ni gsum pa rgyal khamasadaper blangs khrims zhes pa/ bya bar 'os dang dngos ston pa ste ④zhesaskabs de'i spyi tshogs nang yongs khyab tu gnas pa'i spyod la snal yodaper blangs thog legs pa'i phyogs mu mthud rgyun la snyings gtong dgos pa dang /nyes pa'i phyogs dngos shugs bkag 'gog ji ltar byed dgos pa bcasasnyegs dor bcud len gyis khrims lugs gtan la phab pa de yin/ de'i nang btsan po rgyal blon rnams kyis skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi dngos yod gnasal che ga sna tshogs la rtog dpyod zhib mo mdzad de gtan 'bebs gnang ba zhig yin pa nga chos gas por rtogs thub/ 'di la nang gses dbye na/rgyal khrims bco lnga dang / khrims chen bdun/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug bcas bsdoms pas khrims phran sum cu song rgyad bsdus yod/ de yang rgyal khrims bco lnga ni/ mi mdzad pa gsum/ bstod pa gsum/ dmad pa gsum/mnar ba gsum bcas dang / khrims chen bdun ni/ sangs rgyas chosalugs kyi lha chos dge ba'i nang nas srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par mi len pa/ log par mi g.yem pa/ rdzun du mi smra ba bcas rtsa ba bzhi dang / chang spong ba bcas lnga'i khar/ khengs mi ldog pa ste 'bangs 'gyen log dbyed pa dang / bang so mi 'dru ba gnyis bsnan pas bdun byung ba rnams la byed michog pa'i khrims bdun zer/ gzhan yang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug ni/dkon mal la dad gus byed pa/ chos dang dge slob sbyong byed pa/ rigs④ chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 lcags dpar deb ngos 9— 57—

bo kyi srol 11 la nga nga sa kyi zad ldan nga ba/mtho ba dang / rang las rgan pa'i grol zhe yodang gus bkur zhu ba/ rang gi grogs po la phyi thag ring po byed pa/ yul dang khyim mtshes la phan 'dogasagang thub byed pa/ bsam blo dang bya spyod drang bzhag byed pa/ lor bas spyod bzang ldan pa'i grol mig dpe lta ba/ zas dang rgyu nor la chog shes dgos pa1drin chen gyi mi la drin lan 'jal dgos pa/ bre srang lab/ yo sgyu med pa/ spyi la phan sems che zhing phrag dog med pa/ ngag 'jam po'i sgo nas skad cha shod pa/ bzod sgom che zhing blo khog yangs po dgos pa/ bud med kyi khal minyan pa bcas yin/ lhag par btsan po 'di'i sku dus sumadzangs blon thon mi rgya gar du bzangs nas rang cag bod mi rigs la da lta spyod bzhin pa'i yege rmad du byung nga 'di gsar du gtod pa dang / de bzhin rgyal po'i bka' ltar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dpe cha spyan das gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gi gzungs/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin/ dam pa tog dkar gi mdo/ dge ba bcu'i mdo/ sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa la sogs dam pa'i chos mang du bsgyur ba dang / de ltar khong gis bod yul 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar dar zhing rgyas pa yong ba byung ra/ bal po'i yul nas lhagacig khri btsun dang / rgya nag yul gyi lhagacig kong jo gnyis 'jig rten mi chosadang bstun pa'i sgo nas btsun mor bzhes pa dang chab gcig bal ༅ dang tsi na'i yul nas ston pa shākya thub pa dgung lo brgyad pa dang / bcu gnyis kyi sgu sa can gyi snang brnyan bod yum du gdan drangs/— 158 —

chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i sa de yang de ye skabs gas skya bsod nams rgyal mas gyis de ltaramadzad pas rje btsan 'bangs rnams skyid/ bstan brgyas shing༅shkaphyogs bcur 'phel/ chos kyi bka' khrims྾da pas 'bangs rnamasabaka' la nyan/ da rje lha yis mdzad pas rgyal khams thams༅ skyid/ pho dpa' rta mgyogs longs spyod lha dang mnyam/ blo gtod chos la byas pasa'adi phyi gnyis kar skyid/ 'thab dang rtsod pa spangs pas thams cad pha mar shes/ kun la dge bslabs pas sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ medage'i bshes gnyen med pas dge bcu'i nor bu rnyed/ kun gyi gtsug du khur bsaskyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ thams cad sprul pa yin pas khral dang 'u lag med/nam mkha'i mthongs la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad shar/ dog lo sa la padma 'dang brgyad skyes/ bar gyi ri la bkra shis rtags brgyad rsha / ljon shing thams cad dga' ba'i tshal du thibs/ bya rnams kun kyang ca co du ma sgrogs rnams kun kyang rnam pa drug tsugayos/ lha rnam kun gyis rtse tog char pa phab/ bkra shis nyams su dga' ba'i brag lha'i ྾/ ljon shing star ga sdong po'i bsil grib la/ chos rgyalas po khri ye steng na bzhugs/ dpa' mdzangs 'a༅ ldan blon po'i gas dang bcas/ bod 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pas mtha' ma bskor/ kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa 'ja' ye gur/ rgyalapo bzhugs pa'i mkha' la gdugs ltar 'am/ bu ram rgyan 'brum ka ra zhal zas sogs/ ro brgya ldan pa'i zas kyi tshogs rnams kyang / rgyal posagasol zhing 'khor rnams tshims par byed/ chos rgyalas po'i sku ye skyo sangs la/ 'bag dang seng ge g.yag seng stag seng dang / rnga bro mkhan dang — — 159 —

la la la la la sa nga nga sa la la la nga bgar mkhan la sogs kyis/ re re bzhin du gar dang rtsed mo 'bul/ lhayernga bo che dang pi wang dang / rol mo la snyan rnams kyis mcho pa dang /sman mal log ru dang tsandan dang / dri zhim bdug spos rnams ni rlung ltar g.yo/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lhab lhub dang / sna tshogs dar gyisanam mkha' gang bar chod/ yid 'ongs mdzes pa'i bu mo bcu drug gis/mdzes pa'i rgyan bcas me tog thog nas ni/ glu dang gar gyis rna ba'i dga' ston byed/ dga' bde skyid pa'i bka' khrims mdzad pa'i tshe/ bod 'bangs mi res rta re la nas rgyug shong re'i rtse la dar re phyar gin bzhagadam pa chos kyi rnga chen dam pas brdungs/ dge ba bcu la bstun pa'i rgyal khrims bcas/ 'dod yon lnga dang bstun pa'i longs spyod spel/ kha ba can gyi zhing khams de nyid du/ dge bcu'i rgyal khrims mkha' la nyi zla bzhin/bod yul gangs can khrod 'dir khyab par mdzad/④de dag thog nas rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi thad spyan rgyang shin tu ring ba/ mkhas mdzangs ldan la dpa' zhing brtul phod pa'i mkhyen rlangasamachog tu mnga' ba'i rgyal po zhig yin pa mtshon thub pa ma zad/ gzhan yang sgu nyid sangs rgyas chos lugs la thugs kha phyogs nas/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs nang du gnas pa'i 'bangs mi ser kyi kun spyod rang gshis thar pa'i srog 'phrog par byed cing rang rgyud sdug bsngal bar byed pa'i snyigs ma'i rgyu/'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ zad ga sogs med par ④ rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long lcags dpar deb ngos 75—77— 160 —

chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i saphan tshun 'cham mthun yong phyir/ khrims bdun dang / mil gal yobacu drug sogs khrims nang bkod yod/lhag par khrims chen bdun gyi nang nas srog migacod pa zer bdesasnyigs ma'i dug lnga zhi bar byas nas/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang la kyi sems skyed par byed dang / sdig pa bshags pa/ kun la khyab pa'i brtse ba chen po bcangs nas 'gro ba thams cad btang snyoms ris med du gnas pa/de bzhin srog la sa la'ang / 'tshe ba med par brtse bdang ldan pa byed rgyur phan pa'i gsogs smin pa byas pa mtshon thub/ sgos su khrims che bdun pa'i nang gses ma byin da len pa'i khrims gleng skabs su dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bsam byen par mi len pa'i khrims dkon mal gi nor brkus na brgya 'jal rgyal po'i nor la brgyad cu 'jal 'bangs kyi nor la brgyad 'jal du bcas④zhes lha khang dang rten gsum bcas kyi nor brkus na de'i nyesal la brgya 'jal zhes brkus pa'i nor ngo ma phyir sprod byas pa'i thog 'jal thob rku dngos kyi ldab brgya dang / rgyal po'i nor rkus na brgyad cu 'jal zhesarku dngos kyi ldab brgyad cu dang 'bangs mi'i nor rkus na brgyad 'jal zhes rku dngos kyi ldab brgyad 'jal dgos kyi yod pa gal bar 'khod yod/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas de ltar 'di phyi kun du phan pa yi/ bzang po'i btsan khrims gnya' zhing dam par bsdams/ ri dwags rnams ni rgyal po'i ④ chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉lcags dpar deb ngos92— 6 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bdakor nor mdzad ra lug be'u la sogs rang yin gtong ①zhes 'khod nas ri skyes srog la mtshang ma rgyal la nor rdzas kyi khongs su gtogs par byas yod/ btsan po srong btsan sgam pos bod kyi srid la 'khor lo bskor ba'i skabs/ ri skyes srog chags la lkog rngon rgyab mel pa'i khrims lugasadangos su gtan 'bebs byas pa med mod 'on te gong gal gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha de dag lasang chos gas por rtogs thub par/ gal srid 'bangs mi zhig gis rgyal po'i bka' med par gang byung du lkog rngon rgyab tshe/ri skyes srog la sa ni rgyal po'i dkor nor gyi khongs su 'du bas/ de yang rgyal po'i dkor nor brkusapa dang la par med par 'dzin nas/ sha ba gcig bsad na sha ba brgyad cu 'jal dgos pa dang / gtsod gcig bsad na gtsod brgyad cu 'jal dgos pa'i ma byen mi len pa'i khrims ltar gcig rkus brgyad cu 'jal ba'i khrims cha phog rgyu yin par sems/ gal te dngos su khrims yo ma 'phogs pa srid kyang phyis byung lkog rngon byed mir sems nang khrims lugs kyi 'gag rgya chen po zhig bzos yod/mdor na/ btsan po srong btsan sgam pos bod kyi srid dbang 'dzin pa'i skabs phyogs gcig nas 'bangs mi ser rnams dug lnga'i 'ching rgya lasabakrol te byang chub sems kyi kun la khyab pa'i brtse ba chen po skyes su bcug pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas khrims lugs kyi tshangs thig la brten nasabod kyi ri skyes srog chags rnams la srung skyong mdzad yod ces kho bos kha pho ④ chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 lcags dpar deb ngos 94—162—

chos la mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i saches bshad par nus/gnyis ba/ btsan po khri prong lde btsan gyis srid skyong ba'i dus/btsan po khri srong lde btsan ni/ spu rgyal gdung rabs kyi phreng ba'i nang rgyal thabs kyi 'phrin las phyogs brgyar bskyed cing / bod khams kyi stobasa'abyor dge mal dar la drag par mdzad pa'i phyag rjes rlabs po che dang ldan pa/ chos srid lugs gnyis kyi dpal lamang 'a dbang bsgyur bas chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum zhes mtshan snyan kun tu grags pa'i brgyal srong btsan gnyis pa lta bu gzhan gyi do zla med pa zhig yin/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan de nyid ni spyi lo ste 792bod chu pho rta'i lor yab khri lde gtsug btsan dang yumasnanam bza' mang po rje gnyis kyi sras su pho brang brag dmar du sku bltams/ de yang btsan po de'i mdzad pa gleng ba'i skabs su‘‘btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus su/ gzhung lugs bzang zhing chang srid dar te rgyal po ni gnamasaganyis kyi bar du mel na lham mer bzhugs shing / 'greng na mgo nag meedang dud sgo phyugs gnyis kyi rje dang bdag po mdzad pa'i gtsug lag la po/mi'i rigs kyi mig dper 'os pa mdzad do/ mkhas pa dang dpa' bo'i rigs la bkur bzos kyis bsdad do/ ngas pa mar bas rnams ni thabasakyil so bar gnang / de'i tshe blon po srid kyi bya ba byed pa rnams kyang blomathun zhing gros gcig ste/ phyi'i dgra byung ba la thabs mi' la ba dang /— 163 —

la kyi la 'a la sa nga nga sa mi la sa nga babag mi tsha ba byed/ nang gi rgyal thabs bya ba la drang zhing brtson 'grus su byed/phrag dog med la/ nyes pa mi byed/ dpa' mdzangs gnyis kyi nor brlag pa bzhin gang sar btsal te/ mdzangs pa dang dpa' bo ni 'os shing rigasapar bstod nas gang la gang 'tsham kyi gnas su bkod do/ 'bangs 'og marnams dal zhing la na gnas pa rnams ni/ mdzangs pa dang drang po la slob bo/ dmag med srung la 'khod pa rnams ni dpa' ba'i thabs dang drag rtsal la slob bo/ blo gros dang sgyu rtsal rlabs chen ldan pas/ sdang dgra lhags pa yang ma mchis/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bla na med par mnga' brnyes te de bzhin mdzad nas dbus mtha' kun blugatsug lag khang brtsigs te/ chos srolabatsugs nas thams cad kyang byams dang snying rje la zhugs shing dran shes kyi 'khor ba las bsgral nas rtag brtan gyi bde ba la bkod do 3①zhes gas bar bkod yod pa dang 1 gzhan yang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas‘‘shar phyogs rgya mal bar du mnga' mdzad de/ rgya nag rje bskos lo ye ming lasogs/ bod ltar bya ba'i 'ja' sa chen po bsgrags/ lho phyogs skar ma rtsebazhi 'char nga'i mtha'/ rgya gar chu bo ga lha'i 'gram la thug dza lha'i gling gi sum gnyis mnga' dbang mdzad/ mgos kyi blon chen khri bzang yab lhag gis/mdzangs pa'i las su gsos thang stong thang bcad/ phyi rangs blon po g.yar khral chung bar byas/ stag btsan gdong gzigs blon po gnyer gyi bus/mdzangs pa'i las su dbyar rtsa dgun du bskams/ mdzangs mi bdun las tha ④ (bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu yi greng ba〉lcags dpar deb ngos 280— 164 —

chos rgyal mes bo ma sam sa sri nga ba'i sam gnyis su grags/ gzhan yang zhang blon tshe dgur grags pa byung / rje yebaka' lung khri gdugs brdal ba 'dra/ bod 'bangs thams cad bde skyid chos la spyod ①ces rgya bal/ nub phyogs ta zigadab/ byang phyogs la bcas bod kyi chaba'og btsud pa dang / de bzhin khri srong gi blon po gnyer stag btsan gdong gzig gis 'bangs mi khyim re la rta re dang / mdzo re/ba re/ glang re sogs po gnyer skyongs byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs bzosapa dang / dbyar kyi dus gas sngon bzas nas skams dang / dgun gyi dusas phyugs gsos gsog 'jog byed dgos pa sogs kyi srol byung yod/ de dag gi thog nasang tshos gas por rtogs thub pa zhig ni rgyal po khri srong ldobatsan gyis bod kyi srid dbang la 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skabs bod kyi chab srid dang / rig gnas/ dpal 'byor sogs gang gi thad la'ang rigs gzhan la gzhan dring 'jog mi dgos pa'i 'phel rgyas che po byung yod la sku nyid kyis mkhan slob gnyis gdan drangs te bsam yas gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs nang ba dang / dge 'dun gyi 'dul ba'i sde sogs btsugs nasabod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya cher la yod/ rgyu de dag gi mthus/bod mi rigs kyi rang bzhin gshis ka dang / 'tsho ba'i goms gshis sogasala'ang bzang ba'i phyogs su gyur ldog chen po byung yod/ de yang bod kyi deb ther nang du mdor na/ btsan po khri srong ldebatsan gyi sku la ring la/phyogs cig btsan po'i chab srid phyogs bzhir rgya bskyed pa sogs bod sko④ chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉lcags dpar des ngos 76— 65—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga b.rigs dar ba'i rtse mor son bdang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgya gar dang /rgya nag li yul/ kha che/ bal po sogs phyogs kun nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' gtso bor byas pa'i chos kyi gzhung lugs dang / de min gyi rig gnasamang po zhig yig rigs sna tshogs pa las bod rang gi dger bsgyur ba'i mtho rlabs shig 'phyur ba/ dge 'dun gyi sdebatsugs nas 'a༅ rtsod rtsom gsumagyi byu ba rgyas sumadzad pa des bod yum du sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spelaganang ba dang / dus mtshungs mi rigs kyi shes yon/ sems khams/ kun spyod/ yul srol goms gshis sogs phyogs gang sar 'gyur ldog gting zab po zhig 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs pa yin no ①zhes bkod yod/ de yang btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis mkhan slob gnyis gdan drangs te/ bod du sangasargyas kyi bstan pa dar spos mdzad pa'i skor la cung zad zhig gleng na/ btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus su bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs thog ma dar na yang / de rjes mang srong dang 'dus srong gnyis kyi skabs su chos lugasa'aphel rgyas de tsam byung med/ yang btsan po khri lde gtsug btsan gyi skabasasuslar yang chos lugs dar spel yong ra du sang shi rgya nang du chos bam po stong phrag gdan drangs su bzangs/ 'on te btsan po khri lde gtsug btsan sku gshegs rjes de yang nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal nas skabs shig ring bar mtshams chad/ de nas btsan po khri srong lde btsan yang sku na cher song ba dang /sba gsal snang gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'tshol phyir rgya gar dang bal yul ④ (bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu yi zeng ba〉lcags dpar deb ngos 323— 166 —

chos la mes bo ma ma sa sri nga ba'i sadu 'gro chog pa zhes btsan por zhus pa ltar bka' khrol byung nas mang yul gyi kha blon du bsko'o zhes mang yul du mngags/ ma zhang gis khrims bcas pa'i lungadabadagosanasargya gan du gnas mjal du song ba dang / tshur lam b.layul du gnas bcas nas mkhan chen bo rnyi satwa mjal bdang / mkhan chen bod yum du phebs rgyu'i re bzhus pa ltar mkhan chen gyis kyang khas blangasabar grags/ de nas btsan po khri srong ldong tsan dgung lo nyi shur slebs pa'i lor/ thog mar phyag la sbrid nad phogs pa dang / mtshan ltas kyang ngan par byung / phyag gi sprid nad la drag skyed ma byung ba dang/ ltas dang mtshan yongan pa snyamathu da de byung nas thugs la yab mes kyi dus nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad bzhin pa yang btsan po yang gshegasapa'i rjes gsangs rgyas chos lugs la hol rgyug song bar dgongs nas dkon mchog gsum lams pa sngar ltar byed ces bka' bstsal nga dang / btsan po'i snyung gzhi dang ltasang na pa rnams kyang je bzang du song ba/ btsan posakyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten te chos gsan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs 'di bod du spel bar 'dod pa'i dgongs pa zhig kyang skebs/dus de ye skabs su sngar yab mes kyis rgya nag tu chos len par mngags pa'i sang shi 'khor dang bcas pa bya ba thams cad legs par grub nas bod du 'khor ba dang / thang gong ma'i 'phrin lan dang skyes bcas btsan po'i phyag tu phul/ sang shi la blon rṣa po'i thob dang ming yang bstsal ba dang / rgya nag nas drangs pa'i chos dpe rnams kyang re zhig ring rdza seb ru sbas par — 167 —

bo kyi sro' la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bgrags/ de ye skabs sa dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas‘‘de nas rgyal po sku nar son pa dang / yab mes kyi dge gzigs nas zhang blon rnams dang grosamadzad de nga'i yab mes kyi ye ge na 'bangs bde la 6rma'i le'u tshe dang sbyar na nga'i yab mes kyi rdzu 'phrul brnyes pa 'dra gsungs/ blon po dag na re la mes kyi le'u tshe de ci 'dra ba zhig mdog zer/ der btsan pos rgya bza' me mgo la gsungs pa nga'i yab kyi sku ring la rgya'i gtsug lag le'u ke tshe zhes bya ba zhig byung grags na de ji lta zhes gsungs pa dang / tshe mgos le'u tse ji lar lags pa ye ge bklags pa dang / btsan po'i zhal nas gtsug lag de ni te por bzang ngo nga'i yab mes kyi chos lugs bzang po zhig sbu nyams bzhes so/da lta 'jig rten gyi spyod pa bzang po ci 'byung na blta zhes gsungs pa dang /sang shis bsam pa hā shang mngon shes can gyis nam rgyal po mu stegs kyi chosagleng ba'i dus su la chos snyan du gsol zhig bya ba de ni yin pa 'dra zhesabasams nas rgya'i lha chos bzang po'i gtan tshigs khyed la yod dam zhesabaka' gnang ba dang / bdag cag rgya lamachis so zhes gsol nas rje 'bangs dben par gsang ba ste dha rma mchis bu'i rdza la sbas pa blangs te kim hā shang gi lung bzhin du sboms pa ni/ dang por dge ba bcu'i mdo bklags/de la rgyal po dad pa skyes spyod pa dag par go de nas rdo rje gcod pa bklags/des lta ba dag par go rgyal po dad pa ches skyes/ de nas sta lu ljang pa bklags lta spyod zung 'brel du go nas cho la yid ches/ la la nas dang podage ba bcu dang phung po lnga spyan sngar brim bzang rab ces gsungs/ de nasasā la ljang pa khrims pas chos thams cad rgyu rkyen las byung bar thugs ches— 168 —

chos la mes bo ma ma sa sri nga ba'i sanas kyang zer/ btsan po'i zhal nas 'di lta bu'i chos bzang po 'di nga'i sku ring la rnyed pa gnam byams sa byams lha thams cad lagatang ran btang ngo mi④zhes 'khod/ de nas btsan po dang zhang nya bzang / ྈropobagos la sogs bsangs rgyas kyi chos la mos pa rnams 'tshogs nas sa sargyas chos lugs ji ltar bod du dar spel gtong rgyu'i thad bka' gros yod pa dang / btsan pos kyang rgyal blon gas pa'i mdun sar slad bod du sangasargyas chos lugs kyi bstan pa dar spel bya dgos zhes bka' phabs te sba gsal snang mang yul nas bkug cing rgya gar dang bal po'i mkhan po las chos bsapa'i lo rgyus can g.yod ces bka' phabs par gas po snang gis za hor rgyalapo'i sras dge slong shurnya rin ta bya ba gtsug lag mkhas pa zhig da ltabs yuladu gnas lugs zhus par btsan pos de mi sgug dun rung gis lo bal yuladu song nas bal rje dang gnyis kas mkhan po bod a la gshegs par zhu zhes pa ltar zhal gyis bzhes nas lotsā ba zhig zham ring du 'khrid de mang yuladu ston1 bde btsan pos gsan nas nang 'khor lang 'gro snang ra dang /gnyer stag btsan dong gzig sbrang rgyal legs gzigs gsum mang yul du bas bar mngags nas mkhan po ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs/ de yang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas‘‘de nas pho brang rlung tshubasasu ldan ces lotsā bgyis te dge ba bcu dang / khrims bco brgyad dang /rten 'brel bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i chos bshad de zla ba bzhing ma gnyis lon ① (chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉lhags dpar deb ngos 308— 169 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bapa dang 'dre srin nag po la dga' ba kun khros nas pho brang 'phang thang chusakhyer/ dmar po ri la thog rgyab/ mi nad dang phyugs nad dang lo nyes byung bas bod 'bangs thams cad ga log nas btsan pos chos byas pas lan phra tswa bya yar sgyug shig zer te chos bgyid du ma ster ro/ ①de nas btsan posamakhan po la gser mang po phul nas re zhig mkhan po phyir phebs la bal la du bzhugs shig slad thabs bgyis te cha rkyen 'dzoms ma thag mkhan po slar bod du gdan drangs par zhu zhes bka' gnang / mkhan pos kyang bod kyi lhaklu chos srung rnams ma btul na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs bod du dar la mi thub pas o rgyan yul du song nas padma sambha zhes bya ba 'di bdag gis spyan drangs yong / slad phyin rgyal po'i dgongs pa 'grub cing bod khamasasusangs rgyas chos lugs kyang slad nas rjes su brtan par gyur rgyu'i dam bca' yang mdzad/ de nas lo gang tsam song rjes btsan pos da ni mkhan chen bo dhi satwa spyan drongs zhes bka' la / gal snang gis kyang mkhan po spyan 'dren par ngal du phyin pa dang / bo dhi satwa sa padma sambha nga spyan drangs te mang yul du phebs pa dang mjal nas rim gyis byon pa'i lam bar du bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / gnyan chen thang la sogs bod kyi lha klu gzhi bdag rnams slob dpon gyis rdzu 'phrul bstan nas btul te bka' bsgo dma'adogs gnang nas phebs par grags so/ mkhan chen dang slob dpon gnyis btsan po dang zhal mjal/ mkhan chen kyis sngon la chos mdzad du ④ (chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉lcags dpar deb ngos 316— 170 —

chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i sa —— bgyid mi bgyid par rtags mtshan ma ngan rgu gtong zhing bar chad bgyid pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams da ltas rgyan yul gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnasakyis 'dul bar nus pa gdan drangs yod/ da ni gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs nas rgyal po'i dgongs pa rnams grub par mdzod ces gsungs/ de nas btsan pos bsam yas gtsug lag khang gsar du skrun rgyu'i thugs thag bcad/ de yang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas6‘de nas yos bu'i lo de nyid la bsam yas migs par chad de bka' bgros pa las blon po mgos kyi mched nas/ rje gcig lags thabs kyis ma mdzad na bod 'bangs kha log nasachos bsgyur dang tub thugs dam bzheng ba'ang ka'agrub pas gdam ka bor ba zhig bgyi bar mchi zhes lkog tu chad nas bod 'bangs kun tshogs te 'dus pa na rjes bka' bstsal ba/ rdzas gling na bod kyi rgyal po che/ bod kyi rgyal polang bas che ba ni sngar ma byung na nga la phyag ris med pasang phyag ris che ba zhig byed pas khyed bod 'bangs mdzangs pa rnams glengs zhes gsung bas blon chen mgos na re/ rje'i bka' bstsal ni 'dud pas gnyan/ khrims kyi la rtse dgung bas mtho/ phyag rjes gang mdzad pa bka' lung zhu'o zhes gsol ba dang rje'i zhal nas ba'i mkhar po che rgya'i yul mthong ba zhig rtsig gam/ shel gyi mchod rten shar ri tsam pa zhig rtsig gam/ wa lung grog po gser phyesa'agengs sam/ has po ri zangs kyis btums nas gzer mgo thams cad nang du bstan pa zhig bya'am/ gtsang po 'di zangs kyi sbubs su bcug la'aphyong du rung ba zhig bya'am/ ka chu'i thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa 'khru'am/ lha khang bre tsam bzhig rtsig gam de rnams— 171 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bgang byed 'doms shig ces bka' brtsal bas rje'i bka' lung che bsgrub dka' bas gdam ka gang yang khas len par ma phod de 'bangs kun bred pa dang / zhang nya bzang na re/ rje gcig lags mkhar po che de lta bu 'phros na 'jig che na ka'abyongs/ shel rin po che dka' bas mcho rten de tsam yang mi 'byongs/ wa lung grog po gser phye bas bye mas kyang mi khengs/ has po ri gzar bu tshun zangs su song yang gros mas/ gtsang po sbugs su dgun ༅ kyang dbyar la ra/ ka la thang la khron pa 'dom gang brus pas chu rdola'ong na dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gcig ji ltar bru/ lha khang bre tsam pa zhig bya/ de las 'os cang gda' 'am zer/ bod 'bangs dga' nas de la 'od che btab①zhes gas bar 'khod pa'i gtam rgyud las skabs der sangasargyas chos lugs kyi lha khang bzhengs rgyur 'gog rkyen yod pa gal por mthong thub/ de nas lta khang bzhengs ba'i rgya khyon la gzhi ni/ btsan pos phyogasabazhi'i lcags ri la nga'i mda' rgyang gang gang byed gsungs pa la lkog tu blon po rnams kyis de ni phal ba'i mda' rgyang gsum las ring bas mda' de blon po'i mda' lamadzad par zhu zhes mda'i nang dngul chu blugs te phul ba 'phangs pas sngar gyi sum cha gcig tsam du lus par grags/bsam yas gtsug lag khang de mkhan po'i gsung ltar lha khang de'i dbul steng du ga mi tra bha gtso 'khor lnga'i lha khang zhig brtsigs srol byung ngar grags/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi dpe gzhi ni rgya gar o tan ta pu ④ chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉lcags dpar deb ngos 333—334—172—

chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i sari'i gtsug lag khang la byas nas bzhengs par grags shing / dbu rtse la thogargya gar gyi lugs su shing las grub pa dang / bar thog rgya nag gi lugs susophag las grub pas gtsug lag khang de'i mtshan la'ang bas yas lhagasagasum mi gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes su grags de ltar sngon chad mes srong btsan sgam po'i dus ra sa dang ra mo che sogs lha khang du mabazhengs ba dang / yab khri lde gtsug brtan gyi skabs brag dmar mgrin bzang sogs bzhengs nas sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa'i tshe ra sa dang / ra mo che gnyis kyi gtsug lag khang na rgya'i hwa shang gis dkon gnyer byed kyi yod pa las/ bod rang gi skosangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor bzhugs pa ni byung med/ skabs der btsan po'i thugs la sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan pa ni/ dge 'dun gyi sde lor gas lus pas phyis su bod la bstan pa dar zhing yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir/ dge 'dun gyi ka'adzugs par bzhed nasamakhan po bzhus te/ lang gro snang bzher dang / gnyer stag btsan gdong gzigs/ seng mgo lha lung gzigs/ 'chims yod lha rnams rgya gar du mngags te bṛ ka ma sha la'i gtsug lag khang nas gzhi thams cad yod par grags pa'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs go btsan lo zhal nas pa'i bod bdage slong med pas pa'i zhang blon dag la dge slong btub bam zhusabs slob dpon gyis bcub bams da cig gsungs nas/ bo rnyi satwasamakhan po mdzad nas sba ratna dang / sba gsal snang / ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ lha lung rang 'byor dbyang ga mab la rin chen mchogal gsum tseng chub rgyul/ pa gor bai ro tsa na sto༅ mi bdun rab tu byung ngo /— 173 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bde nas ye shes dbang pos btsan po la gal bar dkon mchog gsum kyi rten rnams mi nyams par yun ring bod du gnas pa'i phyir/ dkon mal gi mal pa dang / dge 'dun gyi gal chas rnams rje 'bangs su dang yang mi dres par/ de'i sgrub rten 'byung khungs khrims thog nas skur bcad gnang na/ slad phyin legs lam che zhus pa ltar btsan pos zhal gyis bzhes nas grwa btsun re la 'bangs mi khyim dud gsum re rtsis gzhis su byas nas skur du bcad thog de'i dbang cha tshang ma dge 'dun la yod pa dang / dmag dang khral gyi la pa med pa sogs gtan phebs mdzad pas spyir de'i dus su rab byung ba dgrangs sum brgya lhag tsam byung yod ces dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas gsungs yod/mdor na/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis srid skyongs ba'i lo zla'i nang bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor thad g.yur du ba ba'i la 'phags kyi 'bras bu gzengs su thon yod pa ni sbos mi dgos pa zhig red/phyogs mtshungs sku nyid kyis bsam yas gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengasaganang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bstan mang po bod yig tu bsgyur ba/dang byung gi srol thog ma btsugs nas dge 'dun gyi sdel bkur ba/ lhag par bslab pa 'al ba'i rgyu bslab pa bcas pa'i phan yon/ bslab pa 'al nga'i la dang ltung ba'i rnam bzhag sogs mnga' nga'i dge slong ba'i rnam 'byed kyi so thar ltung rkang nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang / dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed ltung rkang sum brgya drug bcu rtsa bzhi bcas 'dul ba'i bslab pa de dag bod kyi la grur sa bon 'debs shing myu gu rgyas pa dang / yang —174—

chos la mes bo ma ma sa sri nga ba'i sasgos su 'dul khrims kyi sdom pa'i rtsa ba bzhi/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin lenapa/ mi tshang spyod pa mi chos rdzun du smra ba bcas sor sdom gyis ba bal pa sogs kyi sa bon de dag bod mi rigs kyi sems khams kyis ga gshinapor 'bras bu'i snyen yongs su btags nas/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ rang bzhin gshis ka la zugs gom gshis sogs phyogs gang spyi'i thad legayopa'i phyogs su goms spos rgyur sman pa'i nus pa rṣa po thon yod/ de ltar rgyu de dag gi mthus/ bod mi rigs kyis byang chub sems pa'i snying rje rṣa po dus kun tu rang gi mig 'bras ltar gces par 'dzin nas gang byung du 'gro ba gzhan la gnod sems bcangs ba'i kun long ngan po de dag kyang rang bzhin gyis zhi ngar byas yod do/gsum ba/ btsan pos khri gtsug lde btsanagyis thrad skyong ba'i dus/btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can ni/ spu rgyal gdung rabs kyi 'phreng ba'i nang grags pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur khyab pa'i chos rgyal mesadapon rnam gsums rgyal zhig yin/ btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan ni btsan po yab khri ldo srong sad na legs dang / yum btsun mol ma 'bro bza' khri mo legs gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo ste 802bod chu pho rta'i lor sku bltams/btsan po de'i sku tshe hril po'i mdzad pa che shos ni yab kyi dgongs pa snyamathu da de rgyun la ngas byas te/ thang bod dbon zhang gnyis bar gyi sa mtshams— 75—

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bdamag 'khrug zhi bar byas pa dang / rgya bod mi rigs dbar mdza' mthun yun brtan 'phel rgyas yong rgyur mdzad rjes chen po 'jog gnang mdzad yod/dus mtshungs bod kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa sngar las khyab la chen po mdzad yod/de yang btsan po khri gtsug ldebatsan ral pa can gyis rgya bod mi rigasadabar kyi mdza' mthun skor gleng ba'i skabs su rgya bod gnyis ni snga sanasaphan tshun 'gro 'ong dang / shes rtogs/ slob sbyong bcas byed pa'i 'brelazab kyi mi rigs gnyis yin la/ lhag par srong btsan sgam pos bod gcig gyur mdzad pa nas bzung snga rjes su thang gi kong jo gnyis btsan po'i khab tu bsus te rgya bod dbar dbon zhang gi 'brel ba gtsugs pa dang kong jo gnyis ka bod du yun ring tsam bzhugs pa/ mi lo brgya tsam gyi ring phan tshun gzhung phyogs kyi mdza' mthun pho nya'i 'gro 'ong rgyun la ma myong zhing / de dag rgyud mi rigs gnyis rim bzhin phan la cha rgyus lon pa dang / 'brela'adres ji zab tu 'gyur ba'i thad nus pa chen po thon pa ma la / rgya rigs kyi cung sngon thon yin pa'i thon skyed byed la lam bzo las rigs kyi lag rtsal/dmag don gyi 'thab jus sogs bod la rim bzhin dar ba dang da dung thang rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sar bod kyi slob gnyer ba mngags te rgya'i lo rgyusadang / chab srid/ rig gnas sogs la slob spyong byas yod la/ de bzhin rgya rigs pho nya ba dang hā shang la sogs pa du ma mngags te bod kyi spyi tshogasadang chang srid/ lo rgyus yu lugs goms gshis sogs la slob spyong dang —176—
