chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i sa — zhib 'jug kyang byed myong yod par grags ①zhes gsal bar 'khod yod/gzhan yang / bod kyi sangs rgyas bstan par bkur bstod ba rimagromadzad pa'i skor cung zad cig gleng na/ de yang thog ma btsan pos 'o shang rdodape med bkres dge 'phel gyi lha khang bzhengs skabs su dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas‘‘rje'i zhal nas/ lhas mkhar dang 'dra/ bsam yas grod dang 'dra/ skar chung mas pa dang 'dra/ nga lha khang gsha' ma zhig byed gsungasanas bka' bstsal pa ltar/ rgya dkar po/ rgya nag po/ lo yul1 kha che/bal po/ bod yul gyi bzo bo mkhas pa thams da bkug ste/ rgya nag gi ju zhag mkhas pa zhig gis sa btsal/ 'on kyang do'i bzo bo mkhas pa zhig li'i yul du lcang ra sprug po na la'i rje la yod pa thos nas/ gla ba bzung nasalcags kyi dra bar bcug nas1 bod kyi btsan po'i spos kyi glang po yin pasa'adi bzhes la/ li yul spyod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzo bo mkhas pa gcig yod zer bas/ de bod kyi btsan po'i thugs dam lha khang gi bzo bo byed bal gnang bar zhu bya ba dang / de ma gnang na rgyal po thugs khros nas dmag 'dren no bya ba'i bka' shog gi sgrom bu bskur nas pho nya btang / pho nya bsali rje la bka' shog gi sgom bu phul/ li'i rjes bka' shog gi sgrom bu gzigasapas spos kyi glang po'i ril ma tshun chad spos kyi dri snom pa byung bsazhu rten layang mnyes/ btsan po'i bka' la ma nyan na1 dmag yong ba la yang 'jigs nas bka' shog sgrom bu na ji ltar yod pa bzhin bzangs bar cha nas1① (bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu bzang ba〉lcags dpar deb ngos 391— 177 —

bo kyi srol zig sa nga nga sa kyi zad ldan nga b.li yul spyod pa'i rgyal po la bod yul du mchi 'tshal bar bsgo bas ngos rgal bas ba'i bu gsum btsan po'i phyag tu 'bul lo zhes so/ li rje na re/ khyod dang btsan po g.yar ma mjal na/ li yul du btsan po'i dmag yong bsasngon mang btsan po sgam po'i rta dmag drangs nas li phung / cham la phab zer bas khyod li yul spyod pa'i rgyal po lam du gum yang mgo bo btsan po'i phyag ṭuphul zhig bu li gser gzungs/ gser 'od/ gser thog gsum ni lhabazo ba'i mkhas pa'i mchog yin bas bod du bzo byed du rdzong / pho nya ba la skyes bskur nas btang / der li yul spyod pa'i rgyal po yang ma gus par btsan po dang zhal mjal te rgyal po mnyes so/ de nas 'dzam bu gling na rdo bzol mkhas pa'i bal po rdo mkhan la sogs pas bzo gyis te/ 'og khang gsum thog sgo ru bzhi man chad rdo la byas pa'i rdo bzos khyad par 'phags pa byung ste/ de'i phud la ra sa'i gtsug lag khang du mes kyis chos kyi srol gtod pas bka' drin che bas rdo ring phul lo/ ri mo'i phud du dar la bris pa'i yodape be 'bum brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ lder tsho'i phud la lha tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis bzhengs nas phul/ lugs ma'i phud la cong chen po dril bu tshuladu btags nas phul/ ngar thog lha khang gsum po so phag la byas/ steng 'og lha khang gsum shing dang ko zangs ma la byas/ rgya phigs kyi 'og tu rlung gi 'khor lo bskor te/ rab du byung ba mang po skor ba rgyun du byed do/ bya 'dab la phyogs bzhir lcags thag bzhi mchod rten chen po bzhi la brtod/rlung shar nas gtso tsa na/ nub kyi lcags thag lhod tsam song bas rgya phig cung zad nub tu yo tsam 'gro ri nag gi rtse la na bun byung ba dang / lha khang gi — 178 —

chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i sakhyung mgo la yang na bun thul le yong ba'i mthon po zhig ngan srong spyodasaba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs su gsol/ bya 'dab dgu brtsegs la sogs pa yab mes kun gyi lha khang lhag pa/ bzo sna bcu gnyis kyi khyad par 'phags pa ngo mtshar du gyur pas/ sna drangs pa'i 'gur yodang gang ngar dang / btsan thang dang / myang ro rtsibs kyi lha khang khrab sgo can gyis kha bskangs nasabazhengs so/ de dag gi dge bskos su 'os pa rnams la gnyer bskos nasaganyen bkur dang gnang sbyin che thang du mdzad do’ ④ces gas thabar bkod yod pa dang / de nas btsan po khri ral pa can gyis yab mes kyi bzhed pa māmathud rjes 'dzin gyis nyi 'og gi mkhan po rdzi na skor dang / sa rin bo rnyi dang / shi la ji bo rnyi dang / bo dhi mi tra dang bod kyi mkhan po dharma dka ta dang 1 bharma shi la/ lo tsā ba mkhas pa dza na rtsen dang / dza thard ta dang /ma lha ྾rma dang / lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / cog ro klu'i rgyalamatshan dang / sna nam zhang ye shes sde la sogs pa rnams kyis bka' dang bstan bcos sngar ma bsgyur ba mang dag zhig bod kyi skad du phab sgyur mdzad pa dang / lhag par btsan po khri ral pa can gyis srid skyongs ba'i dus su chosaphyogs la bkur bste tshad med par mdzad yod do/ de yang bod kyi lo rgyusadeb ther nang du‘6de nas btsan po chos la dad bas bod yul du sgom grwa dang /bshad grwa 'dul grwa sogs bcu phrag 'ga' btsugs/ rgya nag yodang /bod yung dang 1 gzhan yang rje ral pa can gyi mnga' 'og na yod pa rnamasal① (chos byung me tog snying po〉lcags dpar deb ngos 418—420— 179 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babaka' bstsal nas lha khang stong rtsa dang / mchod rten bye ba bzhengs so ①zhesadang yang ‘‘chab srid kyi mdun sa chung ba rab tu byung ba la 'bul gsungasapar/ lo tsā ba kun gyi zhal nas/ bod 'bangs 'dul dka' bas chad pa la brten dgos/ rab tu byung ba ston pa'i bka' bzhin byed 'tshad bas/chad pa bgyid mi rung / mdun sa gnang ba mi len zhes gsol bas/gsungs bzhin mi bgyid pa la ngas zhang blon kun bgyid du stsal/ chab srid bzhes par zhu zhes gsungs so/ thugs dad bas rje'i dbu thod phud rab ṭubyung ba'i gdan gting / rab tu byung mthag zhabs spyi bor len/ gos ngur smrig skye bos gos gyon pa gzigs na yang phyag der mdzad/ dan gyi lcang tshaladu bla sgo dang po dge 'dun la phul/ zhang blon gyis snyung phyag gi rten phul nasasnyung phyag nyi shu rtsa gcig phul yang lan miganang / bod yongs la rje'i dpya bsdus nas/ dge 'dun la bla nas 'tsho ba 'bul/ rab tu byung nga re re layang 'bangs mi khyem bdun bdun lha ris su phul nas na bza' spyor/ rab byung gi gos ldan pa can gzigs nas/ de'i lha ris la dris nas bka' drag tu stsal’mi④zhes de dag gi thog nas btsan po khri ral pa can ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan par ha cang dad pa chen po zhig yod par rten ngal ba du ma spyad pa dang /'gro song 'bor chen btang nas bkod legs shing brjid du gas pa'i 'o shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi lha khang bzhengs pa dang / lo tsā ba ④ (bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu bzang ba〉lcags dpar deb ngos 401④ 〈chos byung bstan pa'i rgyal tshan〉lhags dpar de' ngos 135— 180 —

chos rgyal mes bo ma sum sa sri nga ba'i sadang paṇa chen du ma gdan drangs nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' bstan mang po bod yig tu bsgyur ba/ sgos su dge 'dun kyi sde la sngar las lhag pa'i thob thang chen po gnang ste/ chos rgyal khri srong gi rjes su slar dge 'dun re ka' bangasami khyim bdun re sprad pa dang / gal te 'bangs mi zhig gis dge 'dun sde lamig ngan bltas tshe de ye mig 'don pa dang / 'bangs mi su zhig gis dge 'dun sde la mdzub mo btad na de ye mdzub mo gcod pa/ yang gal srid dge 'dun sde ye 'tsho gos sogs la dka' ngal 'phrad tshe chos gzhis 'bangasaskoser la khrims bca' ba sogs dge 'dun gyi sde de dag spyi tshogs yongs kyi gnas babs rim pa dang po'i grags bzhag yod/ 'jig rten thog 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i mi ci 'dra zhig yin kyang de dag la rang rang gi sa khul dang /goms srol/ rig gnas sogs khor yug gi cha rkyen ka'adra ba las mi rigasami 'dra ba khag mang po zhig grub kyi yod pa dang / mi rigs khag ka'adra ba de dag kyang skabs de'i spyi tshogs khor yug gi cha rkyen ka'adra ba las rang so so'i bsam pa'i khyer so'am 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyang ka'adra ba zhig chags kyi yod/ der rten tshigang rung zhig gson por 'tsho gnas byed thub pa de yang mi'i bsam blo'i re 'dod 'ba' zhig la thug yod pa dang / rang gi 'tsho bdangos rang gi dad pa dang snyeng rje bde sdug dang dga' skyo/ khong khro dang zhe khon sogs tshang ma phyi rol yum gyi dngos po'i cha rkyen dang spyi tshogs khor yug gi bag chags las 'gyur ldog 'gro ye yod/ de ltar gong du lung drangs zin pa ltar btsan po khri ral pa can gyis srid skyongs ba'i lo zla'i nang / bod kyi yul gru kun la sangs rgyas kyi bstan brgya cher spel ba dang / dge 'dun gyi — 181 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bsde la tshad med bkur bste mdzad stabs de 'khod 'bangs mi rnams kyang chosal dad pa chen po skyes nas rnam par 'tshe ba'i rang gshis rtsub po zhi la byamasadang snying rje chen po'i sems skyes pa/ khengs dang dregs pa'i khong khro'i me lce shi la dal la lhod pa'i btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin dang ldan pa/ nga rgyal gti mug med par gyur la dge zhing legs par sgrub pa'i bag yod tshur dang ldan pa sogs byung nas skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi brtan lhing dang / yang sgos lhag par can du srog chags la gang byung du gnod sems 'chang rgyur bkag 'gog gi dmigs bsal nus pa thon yod do/ /

sa bcad bce lnga/ bod kyi dmangs srol gyis rang byung khor yug la bdag skyong gi nus pa thon pa'i skor/de yang ‘‘dmangs srol ni spyi tshogs dang 'gro ba mi thun mong gisagasar gtod byas pas1 med mangs kyi 'tsho ba'i gshin sa ru rmang gzhi brtan brling can zhig ldan/ dmangs srol gang yin yang 'byung tshus der dmigs sa zhig nges par ldan pal/ migang zhig gi rang ngosakyi bsam spyod la dbang ba zhig min/ spyi tshogs dang mthun mong la dbang ba'i dmangasasrol des/ phyir spyi tshogs dang thun mong la phan nus shig nges par mchisabs dmangs srol la rang gi dgos pa ltar slob gso'i nus pa ldan zhing /slob gas byed nus des skorang ngosakyi bsam spyod de spyi gas dang thun mong gi goms gshis su 'dris par skul ba na da gzod gson nyams dang ldan pa red/ ①de ltar bod ga bcan gyi yul gru 'dir cha mtshon na/ thog mar lothog srid pa'i bon zhes dngos po kun la rnam shes ldan zhing / lha klu gnyan btsan sogs lams pa 'bul ba'i chos lugs shig dar bdang / de nas① (grung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉1993lo'i dus deb gsum pa lhags dpar deb ngos 127— 183 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babon gyi ston pa gshin rabs mi bo ches g.yung drung bon gyi chos lugs gsar du gtod de gdul bya'i sems can yang dag lam la dkri ba'i ched du bon sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang sgo bzhi mdzod lnga sogs bon gyi 'khor lo rgyas par bskor/ mjug tu spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa nas sgo btsugs te nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di bod kyi yul grur dar spel shugs chen byung ‘‘sangs rgyas chos lugs 'di ni mi rnams kyi sems rgyud dang kun spyod ji bzang du gtong nga dang / blo rig ji gsal du btang nas blangs dor ma nor bar byed pa'i sgo nas rgyal khang dang mi rigs spyi tshogs thams cad phan bde lor bas kyi lam la 'god pa'i slob gso'i lam lugs shig yin/ mi④'di bzhin nang pa bangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bod du dar spel byung ba desabod mi'i dge sdig gi blo sgo yangs par phye ste bsam spyod gnyis ka thar bsashes rig ldan pa'i phyogs su bskyod thub ba byung nas rang byung khor yug gi bdag skyongs thad nus pa khyad du 'phags pa zhig thon yod/dang po/ dge sdig gi 'du shes las rang byung rdor yug la bdag spyong kyiXnus pa thon pa'i skor/ de yang thog mar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi ngo bo'i thad nas bshad na/④ (sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad〉ces pa'i ('go brjod lha spul 'greng rgyan〉lcags dpar deb ngos 6— 184 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i ra 〈mdo〉las‘‘dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ ba 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ ྾sasurdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba zhes dang/ yo(sasbyong gi gas su bcad pa〉las‘‘sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / dge ba phunasum gas par spyad / rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ 'di ni sangasargyas bstan ba yin1mi zhes thog mtha' bar gsum du rang rgyud kyi sems gtumapo 'di med par bzos te sems can thams cad la mi 'tshe bar bde ba sbyin pa'i dge ba'i las su pog dgos pa 'di ni sangs rgyas྾lugs kyi boboyin pa dang / spyod pa'i cha nas bshad na/ ston pas66'tshe ba'i srog gcod pa'o/ de las ldog pa ni ka'atshe brngo zhes dang / ‘‘sems can gang la gnod pa dang / 'tshe ba byed pa po ni gang yin yang nga'i rjes su 'brang bar skorigs so zhes dang / gzhan yang ‘‘gzhan gyi srog gcod pa rnams pa'i rjesagasag par mi rigs te des dge ba'i tsab gcod do1mi zhes dang / de bzhin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis‘6snying rje ba pos 'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs 3zhes dang slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis‘‘ga rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul zhes sangs rgyas kyi bstan ba ni snying rjes rabs bye ba yin bas rje byed po ni cho kyi nyi ྾ ginyistab nga sangs rgyas sa lugs nga khu' nang nga khyaltabu yin te srog gnas pa'i sems can thams cad pha mar mgyur ba gcig kyang med pa'i kun slong bzang po⑩ra nas de dag la gnod pa dang 'tshe bar gyur pa'i bya spyod spangs bdang / 'a༅phugs kyi tswa ba'i ra du snying rje rṣa po'i bsams sbyong rgyu ni yos rgyas chos lugs kyi spyod ba yin pa dang 1— 185 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga blta ba'i cha nas bshad na/ ston pas‘‘mkhas pas rten 'byung chos rnamasayongs shes nas/ mthar ltab la brten par yang mi byed/ rgyu dang bcasashing rkyen bcas chos shes kyi/ rgyu med rkyen med chos nyid yod ma yin11zhesadang / ‘‘ci phyir rten cing 'brel ba 'byung zhes bya ba/ smras pa rgyu dang bcas/rkyen dang bcas pa la bya yi/ rgyu med rkyen med pa ni ma yin te/ de phyir rten cing 'brel ngar 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ 1zhes pa dang / yang ‘‘gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ rkyen la rag las gang de stong par bshad/11 de bzhin 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis‘6rten cing 'brel nga 'byung ba gang / de ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ mi zhes dang / yang ‘‘gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / mthong ba des ni sdug bsngal dang /kun 'byung dang ni 'gog pa dang / lam nyid de dag mthong ba yin11zhes phyi nang gi chos thams cad phan tshun 'phrad pa dang / ltos pa/ 'brel ba/brten pa sogs kyi sgo nas grub pa zhig yin pa mas rang bzhin nam rang dbang can du 'byung mi thub ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi ltab yin pa dang /phugs bsam gyi cha nas bshad na/ 'gro ba mi'i dal 'byor mi lus kyi rten 'di ni shin tu rnyed dka' ba zhig yin pas dal rten gyi mi lus rin chen thob pa'i dus 'dir tha na 'bu srin la sa pa'i sems can thams cad 'tsho gnasakyi thob thang yod pa 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / de dag la'ang skye rga na 'ching chos nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i kun slong gi 'du shes thog nas 'tshe ba spangs te dge spyong ka' bad pa/ de bzhin bde ba gzhan la sbyin pa dang sdug bsngal— 186 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rarang gis len pa sogs byas nas sems can thams cad 'phral phugs kyi bde ba'i go 'phab thob rgyu 'di ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i skor re sgyu snang 'am phugs bsam zhig yin/de ltar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi ngo bod ba/ spyod pa/ ltab/phugs bsam sogs gang gi thad nas brjod kyang sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed par 'a zas sgyu thugs kyi bde ba'i go 'phang thob rgyu 'di sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur gyur yod/ slob dpon 'phags pa zhi ba lhasakyang 6‘chos ni mdor na ka'atshe bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyisagasungs zhes dang / ston pas‘‘'tshe ba ni srog gcod pa'o/ de las ldog pa ni mi 'tshe ba'o zhes srog migacod pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos kyi snying po yin pa dang / srog gcod pa zhes pa ni‘‘gzhi ni rang las rgyud tha dad pa'i yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i sems can dang / bsam pa ni der 'du shesashing ma 'khrul ba ni mtshon cha dang / dug rig sngags sogs kyis dang gisagasod pa dang / yang na gzhan lagasod du 'jug pa yin pa dang / nyon mongs ni 'dod ༅sa/ zhe sdang / gti mug ste dug gsum spyi dang a par zhe sdang dang / mthar thug gi ga༅ bya de gsod pa po'i sngon du shi ba'o10zhes srog gcod pa'i rtsa ba stong dod chags kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa dang / zhe sdang gi sgo nas srog gcod pa/ gti mug gi sgo nas srog gcod pa sogs gas pa por bstan yod pa dang / ston pas〈dge ba bcu'i mdo〉zhes① (sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad〉lhags dpar deb ngos 204— 187 —

nge kyi da ba zil sa nga nga ba kyi ba pa'i nga ma pa'i nang du‘‘srog gcod gong na sdig ba gzhan med ces dge ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhi ni srog migacod pa de yin pa dang / gal srid sems can gcig gi srog bcad na srog lan lnga brgya 'jal dgos pa dang / yang na bar gyi skal bzhig tu dmyal bar gnas lugs bstan yod/ de ltar nang pa sangs rgyas bdang / de'i rjes 'brang pa zhig yin na/ sems can larsha'atshe ba'am srog tshigacod pa ni bstan pa'i gzhi 'am rtsa ba 'ba' zhig lags/de yang dzod pa la lha sku 'jigs med chos kyi dbang pos‘‘nang pa sangs rgyasapa'i chos lugs yin na/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba sgang dgos rgyu yin pa la/ gang du 'gro yang der sems can re'i srog la 'tshe byas bsod de sha khrag la longs spyod na skyabs 'gro dang ci'i phyir mi'agal ①zhes dang / yang ‘‘sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa'i sems can zhig yin nas bzung ste sems can gyi srog migacod pa ni dge ba bcu'i thog mar 'jog pa ni rtsa ba yin no1 gzhan yang ri dwags rngon pa dang / nya bshor ba dang / shan pa byed pa'am byed du 'jug pa dang / gzhan la rin byin te srog gcod du bcug nas sha nyo tshong byed pa sogs la'ang nyes dmigasashin tu che bas rab tu byung bas lta ci/ skyabs 'gro tsam gyi dge bsnyen gyi sdoms pa blangs pa'i khyem pa tshun cad kyis kyang de 'dra gtan nas byed mirung1④zhes gsungs yod do/① (snying thig sngon 'gro'i khrid yig〉lcags dpar deb ngos332④ (sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad ces bya ba bzhugs so〉lcags dpar deb ngos 198— 188 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga 'a pa'i rachos lugs ni bsam pa'i 'du shes shig yin pas des mi rigasa'adi'i chab srid dang / rig gnas/ dpal 'byor/ dmangs srog sogasal shugs rkyen drag po thebs kyi yod/ de yang bod la cha mtshon na1 thog mar mthog srid pa'i bon dar ba dang bar du g.yung drub྾sa dpa'i bonadar ba mjug tu nang pa sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs sogs dar te dge sdig spang blang gi blo sgo yangs par phye ba dang / bod mi kun gyi sems rgyud dang kun spyod lor bas shes rig ldan pa'i phyogs su bskyod de srog gas che chung gang 'dra zhig mthong yang srog gnas pa 'dra mnyam yin pa'i 'du shes thog nas de dag la thung tshod kyis 'tshe ba'am gsod ba ni shin khyodakon par gyur yod/ de ltar‘6nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dam pa'i chos ni rang re bod kyi rgyal po lha tho tho ri'i sku ring la dbu bsnyes/ srong btsan gyi dus su srol gtod/khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su dar zhing rgyas par gyur te bod mi rigs hril po'i ba rmebrel ba gting zab cig gas te/ gangs can pa spyi'i rig gzhung yongs kyi rtsa ba dang gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ de'i dbang gis rig gzhung thams cad kyang gzhan 'phan pa 'ba' zhig lhar len gnyid du gyur cing / tha na dud 'gro yan chad la byams dang snyeng rje byed shes pa dang /spyod ngan rnams la dang 'di byas na bdag la mi rung snyam du 'dzes ba ga shesabasogs bsams dge6 mtshan mang po zhig snang ba 'di rnams dam pa'i chosakyi drin rang du 'dug ①① (dus rab nyer gcig par skul ba'i kyi gtam〉— 189 —

bo kyi srol 11 sa nga nga sa kyi ra nga bamador na/ bod mi'i gzhan 'dring 'jog medagos pa'i lhan skyes kyi byams snying rje'i sems rgyud dang / ma skul rang bzhin du srog gcod sprangasanas dge ba'i lam la 'jug pa'i yo du 'phags pa'i dmangs srol 'disaskolo stong gi sngon nas da bar rang byung khor yug gi bdag skyong thad sman pa'i nus pa rṣa po thon yod la phyis kyi ma'ongs pa'i lo zla'i nang du'ang da dung māmathud de bdag spyong kyi nus pa thon rgyur gor ma ༅ par sems/gnyis pa/ yul lha gzhiXbadag la bsnyenaXbakur ba las rang byung khoraXyug la bdag skyong giXnus pa thon pa'i skor/yul lhagazhi bdag la bsnyen zhing bkur ba ni/ bod kyi yul gru stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ smad mdo khanas sgang drug bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi bcas bod rigs gang du yod pa'i sa phyogs 'dir dmangs srol gomasagashis 'di khyab bzhin mchis/ de yang bod rig pa mkhas can sku zhabasachab spel tshe brtan phun gas kyis‘‘bod rigs kyi lhag sol ba'i a gomasade ni mi lo stong khrag du ma'i gong rol nas yod par mngon —zhes dang /mkhas pa lde'u sa‘‘dang po bskal pa bar bskal srid ma srid tsam na/ phywa yemakhyen chen po bya ba gcig srid pa phywa yis bskos te/byung / de las kho ma 'bro rje'i legs pa'i hor drug ces pa gcig srid/ de'i zhal gyi ngad pa spyan gyi sgros ma/ dbu skra phyar phyor tsam gcig gnas pa ste/ gnam sa cha ma phyed kyi — 190 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rabar du phus btab pas/ gnams cha phyed de/ gnam rims bcu gsumadzikhang rimakhang du yas phung/ sa rim pa bcu gsum ni gdan rim gdan du mas gting / gnams gzhu kha sbyor de'i nang du 'od dkar na gaganyisasusrid/ dkar po yod kyi kha'adzin/ nag po med kyi kha'adzin/ yod med gnyis kyi 'phro 'du las/ gser gyi tshe tog ser po dang / g.yu'i tsetog sngon por srid/ gser gyi rtse tog ser pos yab kyi rgyu byas/ gas ri padma sngon pos yum kyi rgyu byas nas/ yab yum gnyis kyi 'phro 'du las/ srid pa'i lharje kha dang skyol med bya ba srid/ de dang yum dbyings kyi sgrol med srid pa'i sras/ mes rnal la dkar gsum du srid/ de phywa tha ye than mdu srid pa'i sras skar ma yos sde/ de dang g.yuri phyug mo srid pa'i sras lhar bsams bzhi srid/ dkar nas rgyal ba/ lteng rgyu dkar po/ lha khri shel dkar/ tha chung rtser rtser dang bzhi srid/ lteng rgyu dkar po shar lus 'phags po'i lhar gshegs/ dkar nam rgyal ba/ nub ba lang spyod kyi lhar gshegs/ khri sheladakar po/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi lhar gshegs/ tha ༅ rtser rtser byang sgra misnyan gyi lhar gshegs/ khri shel dkar po las rje'i mgur lha mched gsumasrid/ phyi lha thog dkar/ bar lha'od 'bar/ nang lha gul rgyan gsum du srid/ de gsum gyi ljags kyi mchil ma gnam du gtor ba las/ sprin dkar phying chung tsam gcig chags/ de'i dkyil na dung gi mi pho dkar po la/gas ri rwa chag gang skyes pa gcig tu srid/ de la ming btags pa gnam then che/ de'i sras rgyung then che/ de'i sras sprin then che1 de'i sras zil then che/de'i sras char then che/ de'i sras mong then che/ de'i sras gnam la rong — 191 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga b.rong / de dang dbyal cha ma ting du bshos pa'i sras yab stag cha yong yol zhesabya/ de gnam rim pa bcu gsum/ kha྾ dang bcu bzhi/ steng mer dang bco lnga'i steng pho brang rgyu rin chen sna lnga las grub pa/ rmang gzhi lcags la byasapa/ zur bzhi gser gyis spras pa/ ba gam shel dang mchong / kha khyer g.yu'i bad/ lcog bzhi dung la byas pa/ thog ni shel gyis dgu ris su phub ste/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal/ nang nas bltas pas phyi gsal ba'i nang na/ rgyu rin pho che sna tshogs kyi khri steng na/ yab stag cha nga yol tsam gcigasku ma thang gser gyi slag chen la1 shel gyi phu dung can/ g.yu'i cha ga can/spu tshar pa re re la dmag skya re 'ong ba gcig sku la gsol/ phyag na gser gyi 'gying 'khar bsnams nas bzhugs so/mi④zhes gna' rabs bod mi lorang byung khams kyi stongs shugs la ngos 'dzin kha g.yo zhig byed mi thub par gnam sa phyogs gang sar lha yis gang ba dang / de dag thams cad kyang lhayis bkod 'doms byed kyi yod pa'i 'du shes gas por mthong thub/ de bzhin bon gyi〈mdzod 'grel〉nang du‘‘das yad kyi lha bco brgyad de/ rta lhadamar po/ g.yag lha du ma bu/ ba lha bzhon mo/ lug lhagasang po/ ra lha'akho po/ stag bu gzigs bu gnyis/ dom bu dred bu gnyis/ 'phar bu spyang bu gnyis/ dbyi bu gsa' bu gnyis/ wa mong ser dang dgu3’zhesadang ‘‘gnam la gnam lha dang sa 'og na klu/ bar snang du gnyan/ brag la btsan/ yul la yul lha/ chu la chu lha/ nags la nags lha/ khyem la khyem lha/④ (lde'u chos 'byung 〉lcags dpar deb ngos 227— 192 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i ramakhar lamakhar lha/ thab la thab lha/ sgo bsgo lha/ rus la rus lha/ lusal lus lha/ pho la pho lha/ rol mo lha/ zhing la zhing lha/ rta la rta lha/ g.yag lag yag lha/ ba la ba lha/ lug la lug lha1 ra lar lha sogs 'jig rten yod rgu la lhag nas par bsam ①zhes bod da rnams kyi 'du shes phung por dngos po tshang mar sog lha re gnas pa'i ngos 'dzin byas te ༅lha dang zhi bdag skyes lha/ btsan/ steng lha/ lha mo1 klu bdag zhes de dag gnasapa'i ri dang / gtsang po/ mtsho/ na gas tshogasogs la la brtse dang ma'i rdo 'bum brtsigs pa dang / dar lhog sgrog pa/ gsang gtong ba/ gser skyem dang ja phud/ zad phud sogs bsnyen zhing bkur te‘‘de ltar gus pasamar cing bstod pa yin/ lha srung yor dang bcas pa dgyes gyur nas/bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde ma lus pa/ yar ba zab bzhin du rgyas par mdzod1 yo par bdag cag sa phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ skye 'gro bde skyid kun gyi gshed gyur pa'i/ nad gdon ྾sa rkun dgra jag than bdang /sad dang ser ba lo nyes phyugs nyes sogs/ bar ༅ sgo nyer gnod 'tshe malus pa/ che za zhi zhing rab tu bzlog pa dang / bde skyid dga' ston lhan gyis lngab par mdzod mi①ces tshe ring nad med/ dbang rlung yar skyed/ tshe bsod yar 'phel1 lo phyugs legs pa/ de bzhin phral phug gi 'gas rkyen thams cad zhi bar byed cing mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs④ (grung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉2001lo'i dus deb gsum pa/ lcags par deb ngos 134④ (gnyan chen thog lha mchod gsum gyi gsang mar〉— 193 —

nges (1 11bka 11 sa nga nga sa spyod zad ldan nga babacol lam grogs sung sten gyi yod/ de ltar bod kyi yul grur gnas ri dang gnas mtsho sogs shin tsamang po yod mod/ 'on kyang snyan grags dang ldan par cha mtshon na/ rdo je grags ma/ rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / rdo rje kun bzang /rdo rje spyan gcig ma/ kha rag khyung btsun/ rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ rdo rje klu mo/rma ri rab 'byams/ rdo rje grags mo/ kong btsun de mo/ rdo rje sman gtsig ma/ sman btsun rdo rje g.ya' mo sel/ rdo rje gas sgron ma/ gangs dkar ti si/ jo mo gangs dkar/ bon ri/ nyang stod hal bo'i gangs/ 'brog la phyi'i gangs/ tsa ri kra/ bsam gtan gang bzang / gnyan chen thang lha/yar lha sham po/ rma chen spom ra1 mdo la ring mo/ ga chen gangs/ padma bkod/ dung ring dkar po/ jo mo nag ri/ jo mo lha ri/ mthon pa bkrisartse/ stseni ri bkra/ spos ri ngad ldan/ bya rgod spus ri/ bya 'u brag btsan/ brag nag btsan rgod/ brag btsan rgyal po/ das rje lhag nyan/ zangasamadog dpal ri/ gzha' brag lha rtse/ gas ri sngon po/ lha ri gyang mtho/ lhari sbomatho/ ma pham g.yumatsho/ skyem mtsho/ gnam mtsho phyug mo/ yar 'brog g.yumatsho/ phag mtsho/ mtsho skya rings/ mtsho sngo rengs/ be ru dug mtsho/ stong ri mtsho nag mtsho khri shor rgyal mo/ mtsho sman ru phyug rgyal mo/gas thang cho longs ma/ rgyal mo mchen lnga/ mthing gi lha mo sogs 'bor chen yod/ da dung gong gi grags pa dang ldan pa'i gnas ri gnas mtsho phud bod kyi ༅ gru che chung tshang mar yang so so'i ༅ gyi zhi bdag skyes lha/ yum sgyu lha/btsan sogs med pa gcig kyang med la 'dir gnas skye bo pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas kyang gzhi bdag dang yul lha sogs ni mthu nus can gyi lhal 'dod — 194 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rade bsnyen zhing bkur ba las de la gnod pa'i bya ba ni til 'bru tsam yang spel nus kyi med/ dper na/ yul lhagazhi bdag gnas pa'i ri dang / nagasatshal/ mtsho klong / rtsa thang sogs nas rtsi shing gcod pa/ sems can srog gcod pa/ sa no rdo slog sogs kyi bya spyod rtsa ba nas spel gyi med/ gang lags she na/ ri dwags ni yul lhagazhi bdag gi sgo phyugs dang / de min rtsi shing dang sa rdo tshang ma ni gzhi bdag la dngang nga'i nor du 'dod kyi yod/ de yang ‘‘yul gru so so'i sa chu nags gsum dang gter kha/ ri dwags sna tshogasakyang yul der gnas par grags pa'i ༅ lhagazhi bdag la dbang bar 'dod cing / de dag slog pa dang gcod pa/ 'don pa/ gsod pa sogs byas na yul lhagazhi bdag mi dgyes par bas yonas 'dzem dogs byed pa yin/mi3①mdor na/ bod mi rigs kyis lha klu gzhi bdag la bsnyen zhing bkur ba'i dmangs srol 'dis bod yongs kyi rang byung khor yug gi bdag skyong thad gal 'gangs che ba'i nus pa chen po thon te da lta gnas ri dang gnas mtsho de dag bod yongs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ༅ kyi mdzes rgyan gtsug gtor ltabur gyur thub pa byung bsam tshad/ de dag gi snyan grags ni bod kyi yul grur lta ci rgyal nang dang rgyal spyi'i yul la'ang yongs su khyab ste gnas mjal dang blta skor du yong mi shin tu mang po yod/ 'di bzhin yul lung so so'i lha klu gzhi bdag la bsnyen zhing bkur ba des kyang yul de ga'i khor yug gi 'byung ba do snyom par phan pa chen po byung yod pa 'i smra medagos pa zhig lags/① 〈grung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉2001lo'i dus deb gsum pa/ lcags dpar deb ngos 140— 195 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bgasum pa/ srogaXchags la dad cing brtseXba'i srolaXlas rang byung rdor yug la bdag skyong gi nus pa thon pa'i skor/bod kyi dmangs srol nang du srog chags la dad gus byed pa'i srolayang mi nyung ba zhig yod1 de yang thog mar sgo lha zhes khyim tshang gi sgo bsrung ba'i spang ma lta bur ngos 'dzin nas phyi sgo'i steng du ri dwags sogs semasacan gyi rwa co btsug gnas de dag khyem za 'di'i gnod pa dang bgegs bar chad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i mgon du bsten gyi yod/ sa cha 'ga' rer sgo lta mnyes par byed chen rgyun du sgo lhag sol ba'i cho ga yang bya srol 'dugade bzhin dgon pa'i nang gi grwa tshang dang / bla brang / sger pa/ 'byor ldan pa sogs kyi sgo'i gyang ldeb dang 1 sgo bkag sogs kyi steng du sog po stag 'khrid ste/ sog po de 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / stag de spyan nas gzigs/lcags thag de phyag na rdo rje'i rnam sprul mtshon chen du bkod de khyimatshang gi gdon bgegs bsrung bar mtshon pa dang / gtsa ra glang 'khrid ste/ gtsa ras nor bu —bkal ba'i glang chen yod de khyem tshang gi rgyu nor longs spyod phun gsum tshogs pa yong re smon par byed pa dang / yang bod kyi khyem chas cha sgam dang dpe sgam sogs kyi steng du mthun pa spun bzhi ste/ glang chen dang /spre'u/ ri bong / bya sreg pa bcas yul 'dir slongs snga rting gis gcig gi steng du gcig khyer ba 'dis khyim tshang 'cham mthun dang / rgan gzhon brtsi — 196 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rabakur yong re smon pa/ tshe ring rnam drug ste/ bgrang bya smin pa'i drang srogagi gam du ngag phebasang nga gnas pa'i ri dwags sha ba dang bya khrung khrung / de'i nye 'gram du ljon shing dang / g.yang gzar can kyi brag ri dang de'i steng nasarbab chu lhung lhung du rgyug pa bkod de khyimatshang gi rgan gzhon tshang ma nad med tshe ring du smon pa/ de bzhin khyim chas kyi steng du/ stag seng khyung 'brug dang / 'brug tshang 'khor/ sed ga khrod sogs kyi khyem tshang la bgegs bar sa thams cad sel bar smon gyi yod/ de ltar dmangs srol de dag gi thog nas bod mi rigs kyis srog chags la thun mong ma yin pa'i dad cing gusalagaces shing brtse ba'i 'du shes bcangs kyi yod pa g.yo por mthong thub/gzhan yang sems can thams cad‘‘mar1mgyur ba gcig kyang med pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi ches gtso bo'i ltab zhig kyang yin1 de'i skor la'aphags pa klu sgrub kyis‘‘ma ye thug mtha' rgya shugs tshog gu tsam/ ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang ka'agyur zhes dang / jo bo rjes‘‘sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe/ pha ma bu pho 'du shes skyes/mi yang dmu dge bsam gtan gyis‘‘spyir dngos po thams cad kyi rdzas rgyun la thog ma med/bye brag gang zag thams cad kyi rdzas rgyun la'ang thog ma med/ gshis rang gi skye ba la'ang thog ma med/ skyes pa la bgrangs kyis mi chod/ mar gyur resakyis bskyangs pa sa med tshur tshe 'di'i mdang sbyar nas/ sgo sna gsanasadrin che lhogs bsam te/ sems can gcig mthong na'ang 'di ma rgan drin can yin snyam du sems/ de nas rigs drug gi ma sems can thams cad nyamathag pa yin tshul kyi dang / de dag gi sdug sna tshogs la 'dang brgyab nas— 197 —

bo kyi srol nga sa nga nga sa kyi zang pa nga bsnying re rje snyam du sgom mi’zhes sems can thams cad rang gi drin can skyes ma lta bur blta dgos pa dang / de dag la byams dang snyeng rje'i sgo nas drin lan 'jal thabs byed pa las dang sems gtum po bdag 'dzin dang ngar 'dzin dbang du shor nas 'tshe ba dang gnod pa ni rtsa ba nas byed mi rung ba'i don bstan yod/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lta ba 'dis bod mi'i bsam spyod la chesamachog tu gyur ba'i bags chags legs po zhig byung nas gtsang po dang mal yonang gi nya dang / srang lam nang gi khye la zas kyi sbyin pa btong ba/ bshasar dang bshan pa'i lag nas ra lug dang nya sogs tshe thar srog blu gtong ba/da dung tha na 'bu srin grog ma tshud pa'i sems can thams cad srog gnas pa gcig pa gcig rkyang yin pa dang / de dag tshang mar 'tsho gnas kyi dbang cha yod pa/ tshe 'dir mi lus dang dud 'gro'i lus/ gshog ldan pyi lus/ 'bu srin kyi lus kyi khyad par yang tshe sngon dge sbyongs tshogs bsags min kho nar rag las par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ de yang ‘‘sangs rgyas dang semasacan kyi khyad par ni/ tshogs bsags pa'i cad du slebs na dus kyi snga phyi tsam ma gtogs sems can thams cad sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba red/ semasacan thams cad sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba'i rgyu ni sems can la dge ba sgrub pa dang rang gi sgrib pa spyong min la thug yod/ des na 'byung 'gyur gyi cha nasabashad na sems can ni sangs rgyas yin la/ 'das pa'i cha nas bshad na — 198 —

bo kyi mangs srol sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i ra/sangs rgyas ni sems can yin no/mi④der brten bod mi chos bshas ra dang bshas pa'i lag nas tshe thar srog blu byas pa'i tshe lug tshe ra/ de bzhin khye sogs rang gi chos grogs su rtsis nas gling bskor dang gnas bskor la 'khrid de dge spyong tshogs bsags kyi las su skul nas 'phral phugs kyi bde ba'i go 'phang thob par sbon pa'i srog yod pa 'di da lta yang nga tsho'i mig lam du 'bor chen thong rgyu yod/ da dung dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i 'gor pha dam pa sangs rgyas bod du thengs gsum pa phebs skabs zhi gcod kyi chos skor dar spel gnang ste gshin po'i phung po rnams dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron lamachod pa'i ྾ du 'bul ba/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron la sbyin pa'i ༅ du gtong ba/ gdon bgegs lan chags kyi mgron la bu lon kyi tshul du gtong ba bcas las dar bar grags pa'i bod mi'i phung po bya gtor gyi dmangs srol 'dis khor yug gi gtsang sbra dang gang byung du rang byung laganod 'tshe mi yong bar sman pa'i nus pa chen po thon yod pa ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/mdor na/ gong gi bod mi'i sa 'og 'bu srin tsha pa'i sems can thams cad phyi sgod kyi gzugs kyi phung po ka'adra ba tsam las nang bcud kyi srog gnas pa gcig mtshungs dang / de dag la'ang rang rang gi 'tsho gnasadabang cha dang thob thang 'dra mnyam yin pa/ srog gcod gong na sdig pa med ces ston ga gcod kyi sdeg pa spong ba/ tshe thar sbog blu byed pa/ srog chagasal① 〈sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad〉lcags dpar deb ngos 15— 1yo —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bdad cing bkur ba sogs byas nas sems can thams cad 'thos phugs kyi bde ba'i go 'phang thob ra du dge spyong gas bsags la 'bad pa/ de bzhin lha klu gzhi bdag la bsnyen zhing bkur nas gang byung du ri klung dang mtsho mtshe'u/ nags྾ sogs la 'tshe ba ma byed pa'i dmangs srol de dag ni bod kye spyi gas dang mang tshogs thun mong gis gsar du skrun pa zhig yin pa dang / spyi gas dang mang gas thun mong la dbang ba'i dmangs srol 'dis kha ba ri pa'i pha tsha bu rgyud la slob gso'i nus pa chen po thon te mi rigasa'adi'i bsam spyod thar bas shes rig ldan pa'i phyogs su bskyod de rang byung khor yug gi bdag skyong thad mig mthong lag 'dzin gyi yo du 'phags pa'i 'bras bu gzengs su thon pa zhig bzhag yod/— 200 —

sa bcad bce drug bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig gis rtsi shing srog chags la bdag skyong gi nus ba thon pa'i kyi skor/bod kyi rtsom rig ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i nang nas dar 'go tshugs pa dang da bar la lo ngo stong lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan yod/ de lta bu'i lo rgyus dus yun ring po'i nang du nga la rlabs cho mes po rnams kyisabarjod bya'i nang don phun sum la sal rjod byed la gru snyan zhing 'jebasapa'i brtsams chos grangs las 'das pa zhig gsar du gtod yod/ de dag ni bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod nang gi gzi 'od rnam par 'phroba'i nor bu zhig yin pas mtsha / 'dzam bu gling gi rtsom rig bang mdzod nang gi nor bu thun mong ma yin pa zhig kyang yin/ de yang gangs ljongasakhaba'i zhing 'dir thog mar g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa dar ba dang / de nasanang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa shugs chen dar stabs/ bod mi rigs kyi sems rgyud la dge ba'i las sgrub cing sdig pa'i rgyu spong ba'i 'du shes kyi kun slong bzang po rdo la ri mo bkod pa ltar 'jags yod/ der brten bod kyi rtsom rig phal yol yang dge las 'jug par stoba'i brjod bya'i snyeng po ni bod kyi rtsom rig gi spyi la khyab pa'i rmang gzhi lta bur gyur yod/ da ni brtsam — 201 —

—bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bachos dang 'brel nas byung zad gleng ngar bya ba la/dang bo/ legs bshad dang bslab bya'i sgor/legs bshad dang bslab bya gleng ba'i skabs gas skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i〈sa skya legs bshad/〉paṇa chen bsod nam grags pas mdzad pa'i〈dge ldan legs bshad/〉gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i〈chu shing bstan bcos/〉'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mchos mdzad pa'i〈rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/〉gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i〈gung thang bslab bya/〉'brong rtse mkhas pa chen pos mdzad par grags pa'i〈kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras brtsi lugs kyi bslab bya dngos grub chu mig〉sogs shin tu mang po yod/ de yang 〈sa skya legs bshad/〉la cha mtshon na/ legs bshad 'dir tshigs bcad sho lo ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu nga bdun tsam yod pa dang /gtso bo'i nang don ni/ngo tsha khrel la mi lta zhing mal dang brnyas pa'i la mi shes/zas dang nor la la sa ldan pa/de 'dra'i gnas su bsdad mi bya/rgyal pos chos bzhin sa bskyangs te/—202—

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho ramin na rgyal po nyams pa'i rtags/nyi mas mun pa mi sel na/de ni gza' yis zin pa'i rtags/rtag tu byams pas skyongs ba yi/rje bos bran g.yog rnyed par sla/pad ma'i mtsho la ngang ba dgam bsdus par yang ngang gis 'du/bya ba 'bad nas kun bsgrubs kyang /'grub pa bsod nam shugs la ragatshong pas rgya mtshor ma rnyed pa'i/nor bu rgyal po'i mdzod na spyod/mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang /gzhan kyi yon tan chung ngu'ang len/de ltar rgyun du spyad pa yis/myur du thams cad mkhyen par 'grodam pa sdig pa chung yang spong /dman rnams chen po'ang de lta min/— 203 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bzho la rdul phran 'byar ba sel/chang la phabs kyang lhag par 'debs/sdug bsngal rgya mtshog snod gyur pa/lus 'di dgra dang 'dra mod kyi/blo dang ldan pas 'khol shes na/'di la bsod nam rten du rung /gnyen bshes kun kyis mtha' bskor te/gcom bskyungs mig rtsa shin tu zhan/gang phyogs 'gro ba'i gtol med pa/de tshe dge ba gzhan rnams phung /legs par brtags nas byed pa la/bya ba nyams pa ga la srid/mig ldan brtags nas 'gro ba na/g.yang sar gom pa 'dor ram ci/ zhes chab srid chosabazhin skyongs ba dang / byams dang snying rje ldan lag dugs rtsub brnag sems dang bral ba/ rten 'brel chos nyid kyi las dang rgyu 'bras la bkur ba/de bzhin khengs skyung gi sgo nas gzhan gyi yon tan chung ngu yang sbyangs dgosalugs dang / bya ba gang zhig sgrub kyang spang blangs kyi rnam dpyod blo dang ldan — 204 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho radagos lugs sogs bstan yod/〈dge ldan legs bshad 〉la cha mtshon na/ legs bshad 'dir tshigs bcad sho lo ka brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa dang / gtso bo'i nang don ni/mkhas pas nor bsags sbyin par gtong /de yis khron chu bzhin du 'phel/'al la mtho zhes khye yis/sangs rgyas mas pa'i bsod nas ltos/blun po nga rgyal che ba'i mthus/dam pa bsten pa'i go skabs med/mkhas rlom zhig gis mkhan slob ni/med par rang rtags blangs zhes grags/mkhas pa gzhan kyis phan btags pa'i/byas pa shes shing drin du gzo/kun tu rgyu yis rgyal po zhigasdig dang bral ba'i byung ba ltos/blun po drin du dgazo bas/phan btags lan du gnod pa byed—205—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga baspre'u sa g.yang las bsgral pa yin/dngan gyi ni spyod lhos ltos/mkhas pa la ni gzhan dag gis/gnod par byas kyang phan pa ste/dge slong lam par bcu gnyis sdes/gnod kyang phan pa'i rnam thar ltos/blun po nyid la gzhan dag gis/phan par byas kyang gnod pa ste/lhas byin la ni ma skyes dgras/bsnyen bkur byas pa'i nyes dmigs ltos/mkhas pa blo gros zab pa'i mthus/gzhan la mi ltos rang gis spyod/mar sbyin byed pa'i rgyal po yis/chos kyi mchod sbyin byas la ltos/ mkhas pa bzang po'i las byed pas/las 'bras bzang po 'a༅ du myong /sing ga la zhes bya ba yis/— 206 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho ra'al du rgyal srid thob la ltos/ blun po ngan pa'i las byed pas/las 'brasang na pa 'al du myong /ma dus rdzobasangs 'khor bcas rnams/me la bsregs pa'i rnam smin ltos/nor bu'i nang gi bsam 'phel bzhin/chos la mkhas pa'i nang nas kyang /mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa ni/bstan pa 'di la rgyan du che/ zhes mkhas pa dang blun po'i tshogs kyi dbye ba dang / mtshan nyid/ la chos sogs rgyas par bshad yod/de bzhin gang zhig gis mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang por yun ring sbyangs pa'i blo gros dang nyams myong sogs la 'brel nas dge zhing bzang po'i las 'ang 'a zhig byas pa na de'i 'bras bu bzang zhing gya noms pa'i bde ba tshe 'di la la du smin thub pa dang / dman zhing gti mug pa'i sdig pa medage ba'i lasangan pa byas na/ de'i 'bras bu ngan pa sdug bsngal mi bzod pa la du yong gi yod lugs sogs byams dang snyeng rje'i dge ba'i mas su pog dgos pa'i legs nyes blangs dor kyi gnad mang po zhig bstan yod/〈chu shing bstan bcos〉la cha mtshon na/ 〈chu shing bstan bcos〉zhes pa ni/ 〈legs par bshad pa chu ye bstan bcos lugs gnyis ya —207—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba'adab brgya ldan 〉zhes tshigs bcad sho lo ka brgya dang lnga bcu nga drug yod pa de dang / 〈legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan 〉zhes tshigs bcad sho lo ka brgya dang sum cu nga dgu yod pa de gnyis kyi bsdus ming yin/ de yang de ye gtso bo'i nang don ni/rigs rgyud zad 'dod bu ngan skye/bsod nas zad 'dod bsam ngan 'char/rang nyid brlag 'dod rig pa rgod/chu mig skam 'dod snyigs ma mang /dam pa'i skye bo nyamathag kyang /chos dang 'gal nga'i las mi byed/char 'dod byi'u skom na yang /sa la babs pa'i chu meḥng /dge spyor brtson par 'dod pa dang /log pa'i 'tsho ba sgrub pa 'gal/tsetog skyes par 'dod pa yis/chu ba blugs na phan gyur ram/chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin/sdig sems mod la 'dor bya zhing /— 208 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho radage ba'i dam bca' rdo ba yi/ri mo bzhin du brtan par bya/bsam pa bzang na 'jig rten gyibya ba kun kyang chos su'agrozo chun la brten 'obs kyi chu/shin tu mtho ba'i ri rtser 'grogatso bo las 'bras dkon mchog la/blo phugs gtad na ci bsam 'grub/lhan rgyal pos yo phab na/lo tog phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/nga rgyal spangs te zhi dul gyis/dam chos snod du rung bar bya/chu bo sgang du tshiganas par/dma' ba'i gshong du 'am bar 'gyur/sgo gsum medage'i spyod ka'adis/phyi ma'i skye ba ngan 'gror nges/ri bo'i zom nas 'bas pa'i chu1— 209 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra pa nga bgayang sa rgyud mar brdab cing 'phyo/dge dang mi dge chung ngu nas/bsags pas shes rgyud gang 'gyur te/char kyi thigs pa bsags pas kyang /mtha' klas chu yod kyil 'khor chags/byang chub sems kyi zin pa'i dgemi zad khyang chen rgyur 'gro ste/dzam bu'i 'bras bu ma dros mtshor/lhang bas gser sbyangs khams su 'gyur/dal 'byor snyeng po ma blangs na/dud 'gro'i rten dang gnyis su med/a ma'i 'bras bu mi spyod na/char ṇa da dang khyad par ci/ zhes 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas ris mi 'dra ba dang / las dbang ka'adra ba/ de bzhin bde sdug sko'adra ba rnams 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi dbang gis phan tshun sdang sems dang 'khon sems che ba/ byams dang snyeng rje'i rgyu dang bral ba sogasa'atsho ba'i khrod kyi skyug bro ba'i gnad mang por bsun 'byen mdzad pa dang /de dag sem ba'i lam gcig bu byang chub sems kyi lam du la ga dgos pa'i — 210 —

bo kye srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho rag dmasang ga bstan yod〈rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos〉la cha mtshon na/ bstan bcosa'adir bag yod rab tu byed pa/ dang dag mkhas pa brtag pa/ spyod thabartag pa/ bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/ bden smra lung bstan pa'i mdo/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag gser 'od dam pa/ brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/ dang dag 'dul ba brtag pa/ kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/snying rje brtag pa/ mi ye bdag po rang gis rang nyid legs par bsrung ba'i tso brtag pa/ ༅ 'khor bde bar srung ba'i ྾ brtag pa/ gros brtag pa/ dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa'i la brtag pa chos kyi rgyal po'i khromasabartag pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i la brtag pa/ chos la sems pa'i la brtag pa bsod nam bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/ lugs la gnas pa dang lugs kyi bstan bcos yon tan bstan pa sogs rang tu byed pa nyer gcig las bsgrubs yod/ de yang ga bo bo'i nang don ni/snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal rigs rnams/'bangs la gzan zas lta bur mthong /sdeg pa dag gi dgu yis/ma nyid zas sumathong nas za/rgyal po rgyal po zhes bya ba/'bangs la brten nas ming du thogs/—21 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bskorang gcig pur gyur pa la/rgyal po zhes ni gzhig 'dogs/rgyal porang nyid khrims ldan pas/'khor ba khrims su byas na mdzes/rang nyid khrims las 'das spyod na/skye dgu'i dbang por ga la 'os/blo khog yangs shing phyi mthar blta/blangs dor la bzhin dpyod la mkhas/rang 'dod chung zhing 'bangs la sems/de 'dra gang yin blon por 'os/bya ba'i cha la rmongs gyur pa/blo dang ldan pa'i gros kyis 'byedachu bo rnyogs mar gyur pa rnams/chu dwangs nor bus྾bar byed/chen po'i sar gnas mi ye bdag po rnams/rang gi 'khor gyi skye bo mtha' dag la/phyogs lhung med ba gcig tsamanyam pa'i yid/—212—

shābo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho ra yangs pa'i sa chen bzhin du bzhag par byed/ 'bangs rnams rang gyi lag mthu yis/bsgrubs pa'i longs spyod rgya chung la/lo re'i bza' btung gos rnams kyang /sems khral med par bdog pa'ang dkon/rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bsrung/'jig rten kun gyi spyi khrims te/rgyu 'bras log par spyod rnams la/sa pa ngan song sdug bsngal yin/skye rgu kun la srog 'phangs pas/rgyal pos srog gcod yongs su spangs/srog gcod tshe thung nad mang byed/de bas rgyal po'i ༅khams su/bya dang ri dwags tshun pha la/'tshe ba ci nus bzlog par bya/ljongs de'i medang dud 'gro rnams/'jigs med srog gi bskyab bya'o/ zhes dbang sgyur sa— 213 —

bo kyi 11la rig sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga bskyongs rgyal po'i blo phugs dogs la mig rgyang thung nga/ bya ba'i cha la rmongasagyur nga/ 'bangs mi ser la gdugs rtsub che ba'i brtul bzhug 'dzin pa sogs tha shal spyod lhos pa na pa la mtshang 'byin mdzad de dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro tshul dang / sbyin pa gtong ba/ bzod pa sgom pa/ chog shes sogs bsten nas 'gro ba kun la byams dang snying rje'i rgyu dang ldan pa/de bzhin rang byung khams kyi srog chags la 'tshe ba spong ba dang gnod pa skobyed pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i gdams pa zab mo bstan yod/〈gung thang bslab bya 〉la cha mtshon na/ gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i 〈mdo sngags kyi gzhung la slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i lam yig〉dang 〈lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya mdor bsdus/〉 〈mdo sngags kun gyi gnad 'dril ba'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/〉 〈bslab bya sems la gzer ba/〉 〈dge spyor la bskul nga'i bslab bya/〉 〈sgrub pa snying por byed tshul gyi bslab bya/〉 〈bslab bya zlog sgom gyi tshul du byas pa skyon yon gsal ba'i me long 〉sogs kyi brtsams chos spyi bsdus la 〈gung thang bslab bya 〉zhes grags/ de yang gtso bo'i nang don ni/las kyis bsdus pa'i pha yul nye du kun/bzhag ste rgyang ring yul du song na yang /rgyus med yul nas don med mdza' bshes sogs/bsdus te rnam g.yeng byed pa spyon pa yin/'ongs don thos bsam las la sgrims shig ang /

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga ba pa tho ranor longs spyod sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/sdig rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyod/gnyen mdza' bshes tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/dus ring bor mi sdod gyes nas 'grogazugs lang tsho ston ka'i me tog 'dra/zhag re re bzhin du rim gyis yal/las skyid sdug 'thag mkhan rkang stabs 'dra/gang dar ba'i tha ma rgud pa yin/gnas 'khor ba 'di ye phun tshogs la/mthar ming lha bya ba gcig kyang med/de soms la dam pa'i lha chos gyis/zhes 'jig rten 'khor ba'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang /gnyen nye bza' dbu phrug skyes 'bras mtshar ba'i lang tsho sogs tshang yomibartan bslu ba'i chos can zhig yin pa dang / de las rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor mi lus rin po che khyad gsod mi yong ched sgo gsum gus pas dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub dgos lugs sogs bstan yod/〈kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras brtsi lugs kyi bslab bya dngosagrub chu mig〉la cha mtshon na/ de la tshig rkang drug brgya lhag tsam yod pa dang /nang don gtso bo ni/rgya gar 'phags pa'i ༅ du 'gro 'dod na/sems pa'i yul na gti mug shul med bzos/— 215 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba'adod chags nag po rgya mtsho'i gting la bskur/chags sdang zhe sdang dmar po'i me la spor/bsam rgyu gcig la bsgom rgyu dran rgyu gcigagacig laganyis kyi 'brelas med zer na/chos la 'gro chas sgrigs shig pha ye bu/'gro gin 'gro gin ltad mo mthong yong ngo /byas ga chos dang btang sa lam la 'grobasam sa thog dang dgos ga lag tu thebs/labs gtam dang dgos ga 'ben la phogade 'dra'i sa ru 'gro 'dod yod zer na/dgos rgyu'i snying po don gyi rdo ga gsum/dang po sems dpa' rtse long bzhin du dngas gcig dgos/gnyis bdams gtsang chu bzhin du gtsang gcig dgos1gsum pa brgya seng ge bzhin du che gcig dgos/de gsum 'dzoms na de ru slebs pa red/chos dang 'jig rten khag khag so so red/sems dang lus po rang rang sod red/sems pa dka' ba spyad nas 'gro 'dod kyang /lus po zhim po bzas nas sdod 'dod che/lus po skyid por sdod pa zhag gsum dang /— 216 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho rasems pa sdug pa phugs nas phugs su sdugasems skyed 'dod na lus kyi dka' ba spyod/lus po bsam na sems pa sdug la spyor/nga la nyan na lus sems dbye ba ra/gser dang ra gan brje mi ston pa red/g.yudang do lo nor na lkugs pa red/'di dang phyi ma'i dpyong da shes na/'jig rten 'khor ba'i mi tshe la 'gro zer/lo gcig lo gnyis medagos brgya ye bar/tha ma sa rdo'i phung po sal thimargyal po gser khri'i steng du bzhugs pa dang /sprang phrug ben la 'og du sdod pa gnyis/mi rtag 'chi ba byung dus 'dra 'dra red/ 'khor ba 'di la rtag pa gcig kyang med/rtag pa med par bden pa rtsal yod/rtag pa brtan pa med pa'i mi tshe 'dil mgo'i g.yod gdugs nyi ma 'dra/byon na ma gtogs bzhugs rgyu yong mdog med/'jig rten 'khor ba'i las la snying po med/—217—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra pa nga ba'akhor ba gtan du sdod pa'i sam red/'grul pa zhag gsum gnas tshang gnas mgron red/so so'i bsam blos sos btang ba dga'/'grul pas 'gro chas sngon nas ma bsgrigs na/gnas tshang rgyab tu khyer nas 'gro rgyu med/gnas mo rogs la khrid rgyu yod mdog med/rang nor rang la bdag dus bsam blo thongs/lde mig mi la shor dus 'gyod pa'i rgyu/pha ma shi ba mang po byung yod 'grophru gu bsdad pa mang po mthong yod 'gro.a ma'i rjes la o lo 'gro mdog med/a ma'i rjes la bu mo 'gro mdog med/so so'i nam dus so sos bskyal nas 'grokhyod rang khyod ra'i bsam blo khyod rang thongs/gcig pur 'gro ba'i lam gyi lam chas 'di/sngon sngon sngon la sprang po'i lag tu sbur/nor gyi rta la 'gro ba'i bang 'gros slobs/phyi ma 'gro ba'i lam la thon chog gyis/nga nga nga rgyal zer ba'i bang rgyal can/gser dngul bzang dang gtam don nga zer zhing /zhim po nga dang 'jam po nga zer gyi— 218 —

bo kyi lha ba sgyu ma 11 sa lha nga lha cha sa ba ba nga sa pa tho zangaganas bzang bskor yang rkang chung na rogs red/ri khrod 'grims kyang rna cog tsha rogs red/rlung la gcus bskor mthong yang stong pa red/rde'u bcud len rang sdug rang gis nyos/bya lugs byed lugs ldan pa'i pha rgan tsho/'dod pa can gyi mi la ngo tsha med/ngo tsha med pa'i mi de dud 'gro'i rgyud/ zhes chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor mi lus rin po che ni shin du rnyed dka' bas dal 'byor mi lus kyi gru la brten nas dge ba'i tshogs bsags dgos pa dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bo chen po sgrol dgos pa/ gal srid shin tu dkon pa'i gru 'di rnyed kyang da dung nyon mongs dug gsum gyi dbang du shor nas gnyid la yur ba na/ nam zhig 'chi bdag glo bur 'ongs skabs 'gyod bzhin du kye hud bdag gi rin chen tshe srog bcoms song sems shing 'gyod par 'gyur nas mya ngan kyi shugs kyis gdong las mchi ma'i 'phreng ba 'dzags bzhin gshin je'i pho nya'i gdong la bltas pa dang changs cig 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su lhung gi yod/ skabs de dus gser khri'i steng du bzhugs pa'i nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyal po dang dbul zhing phongs pa'i ben po'i 'og gi sprang phrug gnyis gnas babs gcig pa gcig rkyang yin la 'bangs blon 'khor dang bza' mi bu phrug dga' nye spun mched sogs kyang grogs su 'khrid rgyu med par thog mji ltar yong ba bzhin du mtha' ma de ltar 'gro dgos lugs sogs bkod nas dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob pa'i — 219 —

'du kyi srid ga 11 ba nga pa ba kyi zad (1 nga zabaring dug gsum nyon mongs kyi sdug bsngal rgyu rnams yongs su dor nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chung kyi las don gnyer dgos pa'i bslab bya bstan yod/mdor na/ gong gi〈sa skya legs bshad〉dang / 〈dge ldan legasabashad/〉 〈chu shing bstan bcos/〉 〈rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/〉 〈gung thang bslab bya/〉 〈kha che pha lu'i 'jig rten las 'bras brtsi lugs kyi bslab byadangos grub chu mig〉sogs de dag gis sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi ches rtsa bar gyur ba'i lta ba'i thog nas nor longs spyod dang / gnyen mdza' bshes/gzugs lang tsho/ las skyid sdug sogs 'khor ba phun sumatshogs pa'i rnam par mngon pa thams cad ni bslu ba'i chos can yin pa dang / rnyed par dka' nga'i dal 'byor gyi rten bzang po 'di thob skabs nges par du dam pa'i lha chos sgrub dgos pa dang / de yang rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi‘‘dal 'byor mi lus thob pa'i shes ldan dag byang chub sems gnyis 'ang da pasasgom pa ni/ dal 'byor rten la snyeng po len pa'i mchog sngon du sems de'i phan yon 'bad pas sgom ④zhes skye bo tshang mar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang ldan dgos la byang chub sems ni bangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon yin pa/ gal srid dal 'byor gyi rten bzang po 'di thong nas da dung dge ba'i las la ma 'bad na rang gis④ 〈byang chub sems spyod la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad rgyal sras 'jug ngogs bzhugs so 〉lcags dpar deb ngos 127— 220 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho rarang bslu bar gyur ba dang / tshe 'dir sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang / phyi mar ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs bar gyur gyi yod/ des na sdig thaspong zhing dge bar 'bad dgos pa dang rang rgyud kyi sdig pa'i 'byung khungasanyon mongs kyi dug rtsa'i sdong po 'di gcod dgos bdang / gal srid de dgaganas pa'i rten med na gzhi nas byams dang snying rje'i rgyu skyes thub kyi yod pa dang / byams dang snyeng rje'i sems skyes na de ni bsod nams kyi mtha' yasapa zhig dang / legs tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung khungs yin pa/ de ltar‘‘rgyal pos srog gcod yongs su spangs/ srog gcod tshe thung nad mang byed/de bas rgyal po'i ༅ khams su/ bya dang ri dwags ma sa la/ 'chi ba ci nus zlog par bya 1zhes dang gi dad 'byor mi lus rten 'di pha ma dag gi khyakhrag gi thigs pa las grub pas khyod kyi lus la bdag 'dzin gces spras ji ltar bya ba bzhin du sems can gzhan la'ang gzhan 'dzin gces spras de ltar byas nas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba sems can thams cad srog gi phung po yod pa'i gnas babs gcig pa yin lugs sogs bkod de gang byung du sems can gzhan la brnyas gtses pa dang srog bcom pa'i gtum spyod la 'jug mi rung ba'i don bstan yod do/

bo kyi sbos ba ma sa nga nga sa byung la ma nga bganyis ba/ zlos gar gyis skor/zlos gar ni sngon byung gtam rgyud dang lo rgyus sogs kyi bcoms bya'i da sna dang lha 'dre sogs mtshon pa'i gzugs su byas te/ brtsams bya'i mi sna so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i skad kyi sgo nas glu len pa dang / bsam pa'i rnam gyur sna tshogs yang nas yang du zlos shing gar ba 'di la zer/ bod kyi zlos gar ni srong btsan sgam po'i sngon dus nas yod par nges zhing / de yang btsan po srong btsan sgam pos ngal bza' dang rgya bza' btsun mor len skabs/ bod rgya blon 'bangs dang bcas pas bsab dang / dga' ston gyi zlos ra rgya chen khrab lugs dang / gzhan yang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas gtsug lag khang legs sgrub byung rjes dang gnas dga' ston nyin mang po byas pa dang / de'i ring bod 'ang ngas rnams kyis glu dang zlosagar la rol lugs sogs la ldan gtsug lag khang dang / pho brang po ta la/de bzhin bsam yas gtsug lag khang sogs kyi gna' bo'i ldeb bris su legasapar bkod yod/ de nas dus dngas bcu bzhi nas bco lnga'i skabs su grub chen thang stong rgyal pos/ bod sa gnas kyi 'grim 'grul mi bde ba'i dka' ngal sel chen/ las mi'i khongs nas shes rig bkra la/ mdzes chos ldan pa'i gzhon nu ma bdun la grub chen nyid kyis rkang lag gi stangs stabs dang bro gar sogs 'khrid ston mdzad de/ bu mo gnyis rngon pa dang / bu mo— 222 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la nga nga sa pa tho rabazhis lha mo/ bu mo gcig gis rol po dkrol ba dang / grub thog nyid kyisarnga brdungs mdzad nas bod kyi zlos gar las tshogs pa ang dang po 'di gsar du gtod par mdzad/ de nas bod kyi zlos gar tshogs pa rim bzhin yar rgyas gong 'phel ji cher song nas/ snga rjes su yar lung bkra shis zhol pa/snye mo bya sgo ba/ thon pa ba/ snang rtse ba/ rin spungs rdzong khongs rgyal mkhar chos rdzong pa/ ngam ring rdzong khongs gzung pa ri bo che/ rnam gling rdzong khongasashang gram bkra shis rtse pa/ lha ba'i skyor mo lung pa/ 'bri gung pa sogs bod kyi sa khul mi 'dra ba khag nas sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i grags can lha mo tshogasapa mi nyung ba zhig kyang gsar du thon/ lha mo tshogs pa de dag gi khrab bya'i gzhung gtso bo ni/ 〈rgyal bu dri med kun ldan/〉 〈snang sa 'od 'bum/〉〈chos rgyal nor bzang /〉 〈gzugs kyi nyi ma/〉 〈don yod don grub/〉〈'gro ba bzang mo/〉 〈padma 'od 'bar〉sogs yin/gong gi brtsams chos mang che ba zhig ni/ dge ba dang sdig pa'i phyogasaganyis 'gal zlar gyur ba'i ngo bo'i thog nas dge ba'i phyogs la sgo gsumakha zhe med par bstod par byed pa dang / sdig pa'i phyogs la the tshoms 'dzem med kyis sun 'byin dang ther 'don byed pa 'ang 'a zhig yin/de yang 〈rgyal bu dri med kun ldan〉lamatshon na/ sngon tsho bhe ta'i grong khyer chen po zhig na rgyal po sa skyong grags pa'i dpal zhes bya ba/ blonapogasum stong drug cu la dbang mdzad pa dang sa ldan gyi btsun yodage ldan bzang mo zhes par sras thugs rgyud shin du bzang ba dri med kun ldan sku 'khrungs shing / rgyal bu dri med kun ldan rim gyis nar son pa na/ yul— 223 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bapadma can gyi rgyal po zla ba bzang po'i sras mo ma snye bzang mo zhes bya ba/gzugs mdzes shing ltan sdug pa/ dad pa che zhing chos la mos pa/ blo rgya che la gtong phod can de nyid rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyi btsun mor bzhes/ de nas rim bzhin sras che ba legs ldan dang / sras chung ba legs dngal/sras mo legs mdzes bcas sku la ngas/rgyal bu dri med kun ldan ni chung ngu'i dus nas ye ge dang rtsis la sogasal rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas shing / dad pa rgya che zhing gtong phod ldan pa zhig yin pas nam zhig na rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyis dbul zhing nyamasathag pa'i 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba labs ma bzhin yab rgyal po las sbyin pa gtong ba'i dbang cha zhus par 'thad par byung bas rgyal bus bang mdzod kyi nor rnams phyogs gcig tu spungs nas dbul por sbyin pa btang /de'i dus sumatha' 'khor bye ma shing drung gi rgyal po shing btsan po zhesang rgyalalog lta can zhig yod pa de log pa'i blor gyur nas bram ze blo gros bya ba zhig dgos 'dod dpung 'joms slong du btang ba dang / rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyis kyang phangs pa med par nor bu dgos 'dod dpung 'joms de bramaze blo gros la sbyin pa gnang / gnas tshu de rgyal po sa skyong grags pas thosal khong khro chen po skyes te rgyal bu dri med kun ldan bdud ri ha shang la la sgyugs byas pa dang / rgyal bus ma dhe bzang ro yum sras rnams phyag phyir la da par zhal gyis bzhes/rgyal budang ma ste bzang po yum sras bcas pa bdud rir gshegasapa'i lam du rgyu nor yongs rdzogs slong mkhan rnams la phangs med du byin par — 224 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga bas pa tho ram zad/ rang gi khog pa'i snying dang dpral ba'i mig gces par 'os pa'i sras lcam gsum yang slong mkhan dag la byin bdang / lha tshangs ldan mnyams sa dkyi ra du ba bzang mo slong pa'ang 'phangs med du tsho/ rdzas bu dri med kun ldan bdud ri ha shang ba'i lo bcu gnyis bzhugs rgyu'i dus ra gtsang ste phyir log phebs skabs sngar gyi bram ze rnams kyis rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyi rnam dkar dge ba'i mdzad zang la ngo mtshar shin du skyes nasalcam sring gsum dang btsun mo ma ste bzang morang 'ang gas phyir tsho byung ba dang / rgyal bu'i spyan gnyis kyang dge ba'i mthus sngar bzhin gas bar gyur ba dang / yul bye ma'i shing drung gi rgyal po log lta can de yang dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing nor budagos 'dod dpung 'joms sogs nor bu thamasacad rang 'jags su phyir tsho zhus/de nas rgyal bu yum sras rnams dang yum du 'byor nas yang yum dang lhan 'dzoms byung ba dang / rgyal bu dri med kun ldan rgyal srid la dbang sbur nas rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs shing mnga' 'bangs thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la bkod pa'i skor bris yod/'jib gzhung 'dir cha mtshon na/ rgyal po dri med kun ldan ni dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo dang / btsun ba bzang yodang / sras legs ldan/ sras legs dpal/ sras mo legs mdzes sogs ni dge ba'i phyogs su yid kyi dang ga ston mkhan dang / de bzhin rgyal po shing khri btsanaponi sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bodang / bram ze blo gros sogs 'khor rnamasani sdig pa'i phyogs su yid bkur bsogs dge sdig gi 'gal zlar gyur ba'i — 225 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bathoganas dge ba'i phyogs kyi da sna gtso bo rgyal bu dri med kun ldan ni kha zhe gnyis med kyis dkon mal gsum brtse gcig dad pa ldan pa/ sgangs bya sgrib gnyis kyi bags cha yodang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing rtogs bya mkhyen gnyis kyi ye shes kyis phyug pa/ ser sna sogs mi mthun phyogs nyamasapa dang bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam par mi rtogs pa/ sems can mgon med la snyeng rje'i sems nye bar bzhag nas gang 'dod rdzogs par byed pa sogs ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan de dag la bsngags par byas pa dang / de bzhin sdeg pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo rgyal po shing khri btsan po de mchog gsum la dad pa med pa/ chos tshu yang dag par mi rtogs par log pa'i lta bar rmongs pa/ sdang sems dang brlang po'i sems kho nas rtag ṭugatum spyod brtul bzhugs 'dzin mkhan zhig tu bkod de dma' 'bebasadang bsun byin byas te skye bo rnams la dkon mchog gsum la rtse gcig dad pa byed dgos pa dang / dge ba'i las la g.yeng med rgyun du 'jug dgos pa/sems rgyud bzang zhing byams dang snying rje'i rgyu sogs ldan na la du 'phagasapa'i bslu med 'bras bu bzang po zhig thob kyi yod lugs sogs bstan yod/〈snang sa 'od 'bum〉la cha mtshon na/ sngon gtsang gi ga rgyal myang stod rgyal rtse'i la ljang phad khud nang pa zhes pa'i khyem tshang phal pa zhig yod pa de la yab la bzang bde chen dang yum myang tsha gal sgron zhes pa gnyisal sras gcig kyang med par yun ring bzhugs shing / na rgas skra dkar du gyur pa'i sku la smad la bu mo khyad du 'phags pa sku 'bras mdzes pa/ thugasargyud dal ba sogs lha'i sras mo dang 'dra ba zhig skyes pa'i mtshan la snang sa—226—

bo kyi srol rtsol ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga la pa tho ra'od 'bum zhes gso / snying rje shes rab brtson 'grus gsum che zhing /sgring pa khengs pa rtog pa gsum chung ba'i snang sa 'od 'bum gyis mdo rgyud kyi dgongs na sogs rtogs par ma zad/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la yang ga dro langs pa'i snga ma/ dgongs mo nyal ba'i rteng ma/ zas kyi g.yos sbyor dang /snam las/ zhing las la la sa par brtson zhing mkhas par gyur bas phyogasade gar khol snyan grags gang sar khyab/ de ltar gnyen slong mkhan mang du byung yang snang gas dam pa'i la gshig byed rgyu'i bsam pa ma gtogs 'jig rten gyi 'dun mar 'gro 'dod gtan nas ma byung /snang sa 'od 'bum dgung lo bco lngar lon pa'i dus su gnas snying gzing drug gi lo dus kyi ltad mo blta bar phebs pa'i tshe/ rgyal rtse ri nang tsho chen du dpon sgra la gyis snang sa mthong nas bu po snang sa de rang gi bu gragasapa bsam grub kyi chung ma byed dgos zhes bye'u khras bzung ba dang / ri bong bya la sa kyis 'a ra ba bzhin btsan gshed kyis gnyen rtags ma dang dar btsugs pas snang la yang yum gnyis kyis kyang rang gi bu yogacig pu 'di ri nang dpon gyi tshang la chung mar ma btang ka med byung / snang sa 'od 'bumarinang dpon za la 'byor nas lo ngo bdun song ba'i ring la/ dpon po yab sras gnyis kyi phyag phyi zhabs tog sgrub la brtson pa/ gus zhen sku bsod che ba/ nang 'khor gyi g.yog pho yodang / mnga' 'bangs mi ser thams cad la nye ring med pa'i byams gzigs skyongs brdar mdzad mkhas pa/ de bzhin ri nang dpon yab sras gnyis kyis kyang gzigs mthong chen po byung ngar brten yod snyid mo phrag dog gi tse rtser bas 'bar nas dpon po sgra chen dang —227—

bo kyi srol 11 sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga bsnabs 'od 'bum dbar la phar dgrug tshur dkrug sna tshogs byas pas snang sa'od 'bum la nyes rdung thengs mang phogs shing / mthar gdug rtsubacan kyi dpon yab sras gnyis kyis nyes rdung sa med byas te snying rlung stod 'chasakyis grongs pa red/ snang ba'i rnam shes srid pa bar dor 'khyam pa'i mjug tu yob glang mgo la sogs las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sbu mdun du yod/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyis snang sa 'od 'bum ni sdig can mayin mkha' 'gro'i sprul ba yin par mkhyen nas 'das log chos mdzad ma zhig byas nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad par skul bas/ snang sa 'od 'bum 'dasalog byung ba dang 'khor bar nges 'byung drag po byung ste bla ma bzang po shākya'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dbang skur/ man ngag sogs lta spyod sgoms gsumala'ang da pa'i dus ri nang dpon yab sras gnyis kyis snang sa 'od 'bum dgon pa skyid po rtser g.ya' lung bya ba na chos rwar bzhugs yod pa thos phral drag po'i brtul bzhug gi 'phrog rtsis byas kyang zam shākya rgyal mtshan dang snang sa'od 'bum kyis rdzu 'phrul grub rtags sna tshogs ston stabs dpon yab srasaganyis kyis brlag mthub par ngo mtshar dad pa skyes nas sngon byas lasala'agyod bshags byas pa dang / mthar snang sa 'od 'bum gyi lung bstan ba ji bzhin dpon sgra chen yab sras gnyis kyang dben pa'i ri khrod 'grim nas dmapa'i lha chos la zhugs pa'i skor bkod yod/gab gzhung 'di la cha mtshon na/ snang sa 'od 'bum ni dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna dang / a ni snyed mo ni sdeg pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo dang /— 228 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga la pa tho rade bzhin ri nang dpon yab sras gnyis ni sdig pa'i phyogs su yi kyi dbagaston mkhan yin bdang / de ltar dge sdig gi 'gal zla'i thoganas dge ba'i phyogs kyi da sna snang sa 'od 'bum ni/ chos sems che ba/ sku 'bras mtshar ba thugs gshis bzang ba/ byams snying rje ldan pa/ shes rab brtson 'grus che ba/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi las la khya du 'phags pa'i mkha' 'gro lta bu'i gzugs su bkod de bstod cing bsngags pa dang / de bzhin sdig pa'i phyogs kyi da sna gtso bo yod snyid po ni 'dod la sa/ zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog gis sems rgyud yongs su brlamasanal mas snying rje'i rgyu dang bral ba/ rgyu 'bras la mi brtsi bar sdig semasabacangs ba dge las su mi 'jug par dge rtsa gcod mkhan gtum mo zhig tu bkod de der 'khang ra dang smad par byas pa dang / dge ba'i lasasul ga skabs bar skabs kyi ngar la dang dka' ngal sogs ji snyed cig byung srid mod/ 'on te mthar sdig pa'i phung pos rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu brlags mi thub pa'i don bstan nas skye bo rnams la/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / nga rgyal gyi dug gsum gsa' dang bral nas sems can phan la sdang sems med par zhi mthun dang byams sems ldan dgos pa'i bslab bya bstan yod/〈chos rgyal nor bzang 〉la cha mtshon na/ sngar rgya gar shar gyi gling phyogs na byang phyogs mnga' ldan pa dang lho phyogs rigs ldan pa zhes rgyal khab gnyis yod pa dang rgyal kha bde gnyis kyi stobs 'byor mnga' thang che chung dang mnga' khongs sa tsha rgya khyon mnga' 'bangs mi ser gyi 'bor —229—

la la la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bgrangs sogs la khyad par gtan nas med mod/ 'on te dus nas zhig nasabyang phyogs mnga' thang ldan pa'i rgyal khab de stongs 'byor mnga' thang rgyasashing / 'khor 'bangs mi ser thams cad bde skyid kyi 'tsho ngar longasasuspyod bzhin yod pa dang / lo phyogs rigs ldan rgyal khab ni rgyal srid dpala'abyor nyams rgud du song nas 'khor 'bangs mi ser thams cad dbulaphongs nyams thag gi gnas su gyar/ mthar rgyal po rang gis kyang thugasakyis ma bzod par byang gi phyogs na la la ba'i mtsho mo dang mtsho der gnasapa'i klu'i rgyal po grogs su 'gugs sems kyi log blo bcangs nas sngags pa zhig mnga' ldan padma bla mal khal mngags nas byang phyogs kyi mnga' thamasacad lo phyogs rigs ldan rgyal khab la yong thabs byed du bcug sngagasa'achang des mtsho la gnod pa byed pa'i skangs/ nya pa speng leb 'dzin gyis gri gug bsnun te sngags pa bsgral bas/ klu'i rgyal pos rngon pa'i drin lan 'jal phyir rngon pa klu la du gdan drangs te mi ye nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya nga phul/ de nas rngon pa drang srong chen po blo gros rab gal gyi sku mdun du sdod skangs/ dri za'i rgyal po'i sras mo yid 'phrog mas gtso byasa'akhor 'bum phrag dang bcas tshangs pa 'du ba'i khrus kyi dzing bu ru sku khrusagal du phebs pa mthong bas/ rngon bas klu la nas nor bu don yod zhags pa khyer 'ongs nas yid 'phrog lha mo bzung / yid 'phrog lha mo rngon pa'i gtan grogs byed par mi 'thad pas drang srong gi dgongs pa ltar yid 'phrog lha mo byang phyogs mnga' ldan rgyal po nor bzang gi btsun mor phul/'on kyang chos rgyal nor bzang gyi sngar gyi btsun mo don grub dpal mos gtsos—230—

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho ranyi stong lnga brgya shin tu medag 'a bar gyur nas chos rgyal nor bzang dang yid 'phrog lha mo gnyis kha bral gtong rgyu'i jusang na bshams la na po nyisastong lnga brgyas lo mcho ha ri nag por mngags te yang rgyal po rmilamadakrug tu bcug pa dang yab rgyal pos mi lam kyi ga smras bzang lugs ji ltar yod lugs skor a mcho la bka' dri zhus pas lo mcho kyis chos rgyalanor bzang byang mi nod btul bar mngags na gzhi nas bar la tshang ma zhi lugs skor rgyal por snyan seng zhus pa ltar chos rgyal nor bzang byang phyogasakhul du mi rgod btul bar brdzangs/ chos rgyal nor bzang byang phyogs sumeergod btul bar bzangs pa'i shul du ams ha ri nag po dang btsun modon grub dpal mos gtsos nyi stong lnga brgyas thabs sna tshogs bkol nas yid 'phrog lha mo gsod par brtsams pas yid 'phrog dri za'i la du 'phur/chos rgyal nor bzang byang nas rang yul du phebs rjes yid 'phrog lha mo dri za'i la du gshegs pa shes pas/ yid 'phrog lha po 'tsho phyir rgyal srid snang med du skyur nas drang srong gi drung nas yid 'phrog lha mos bzhag pa'i rin chen gser gdub khyer zhing / lam dgra ma lus par btul nas dri za'i la du 'byon pa dang / shes rabs blo gros dang / dpa' rtsal thogs med la brten nas yid 'phrog lha porang 'jags byang phyogs mnga' ldan rgyal khab tu bsus/ dbyen spyor dkrug shing byed gte ga mcho ha ri nag po dang btsun mo don grub dang la mos gtsos nyi stong lnga brgyar khrims gcod nan pomadzad/ yab rgyal pos kyang rgyal srid chos rgyal nor bzang la sprad pa dang chos rgyal nor bzang gis rgyal srid chos bzhin skyangs nas rgyal khams thams—23 —

bo kyi srol nga sa nga nga sa kyi ma pa nga bcad bde skyid kyi dpal la rol thub pa'i skor bkod yod/'jib gzhung 'dir cha mtshon na/ chos rgyal nor bzang dang / yid 'phrog lha'i gnyis ni dge ba'i phyogs kyi da sna gtso bo dang / ga mchod ha ri nag po dang btsun mo don grung dpal mo ni sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo dang / de bzhin lo phyogs rigs ldan rgyal po dang / btsun mo nyis stong lnga brgya ni sdig pa'i phyogs su yid smon byed mkhan gyi gzugs su bkod yod/de ltar dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna chos rgyal nor bzang ni/ dkon mchog gsum la rtse gcig gi dad pas bcings pa/ ris med kun la khyab pa'i snying rje'i rgyu dang ldan pa/ zhum pa med pa'i snyeng stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba/brtag bya'i dngos po la dmigs nas de'i ngo bo dang khyad par/ de bzhin de'i mtshan nyid dang blangs dor legs par 'byed pa'i shes rang kyi stobasadang ldan pa/ yid 'phrog lha po ni/ las rgyu 'bras la bkur ba/ rang gshis 'jam pa/ rang bzhin srong ba/ 'jig rten da chos la mkhas pa'i mdzangs ma zhig gi gzugs su bkod de dge ba'i phyogs kyi khyad du 'phagasapa'i pho mo de gnyis la bstod par byas pa dang / gzhan yang sdig pa'i phyogasakyi mi sna gtso bo a mchod ha ri nag po ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi zhabasasusnyegs kyang / sdang sems phung pos lus po yongs sung cings pa/ legasanyes rnam dpyod dang bral ba/ de yang 〈ga che pha lu〉yonang du‘‘nga nga nga rgyal zer ba'i bang rgyal can/ gser dngul bzang dang gtam don nga zer zhing /zhim po nga dang 'jam po nga zer kyi legs po nga dang 'jam po nga zer gyiganas bzang bskor kyang rkang chung na rogs red/ ri khrod 'grim kyang rna — 232 —

bo kyi la la rtsom la sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa la racog tsha rogs red/ rlung lag cus bskor mthong yang stong pa red/ rde'u bcud len rang sdug rang gis nyos’ ①zhes gsungs pa ltar chos gos rnayogasum gyis gzugs kyi phung po yongs su klubs par byas kyang sangs rgyasabastan pa'i rkang 'dren yin pa dang / btsun po don grub dpal mo ni/ dmapa'i chos la dad sems med pa/ las dang rgyu ka'abras bur rtsis bsher mishes pa/ dug gsum 'byung pos 'dren byed yongs su ldong ba/ zog po rdzun rgyal log lta can la skyabs zhu ba sogs kyi sdig pa'i gtum spyod bdag por bkod nas mtshang 'byin drag po mdzad de/ bden lung pa gnyis la phu thag yod/ rdzun khram pa gnyis la phu thag med zer ba'i dpe ltar dge ba dang bden pa'i phyogs kyi mi snar gnas skabs kyi ngal ba la po 'phrad srid kyang mtha' mar bslu ba med pa'i 'bras bu bzang po thobs dang / de bzhin sdig pa'i phyogs kyi skye bo gnas skabs ring ltos dbang gis lam 'gro ji ltar rgyug kyang mjug 4rang nyid 'phongs pa'i sa bon du gyur kyi yod lugs sogasabakod de skye bo la dam pa'i chos la rtse gcig dad pa dgos pa dang / lasadang rgyu 'bras la brtsi zhing bkur nga/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi dug rlangs dang bral dgos pa'i bslab bya bstan yod/ 〈gzugs kyi nyi mar〉cha mtshon na/ sngar rgya gar gyi grong khyer semasakyi blo gros zhes par rgyal po zla ba'i ded dpon dang btsun pol dpal mo lasras che ba zaba'i seng ge dang sras chung ba zla ba'i gzhon nu la ngas/ sras che ① (kha che pha lu 〉lcags dpar deb ngos 8— 233 —

nges spyod drod ga zig ba zang nga ba spyod zad ldan nga bab zla ba'i seng ge nar gson pa dang rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i dbang cha de yang sras de rang la thob/ zaba'i seng ges rigasang na gyi bu mo zhig btsun mor blangs pa'i rjes su yang drang srong sgom chen gyi bu mo mdzes sdug bltabs chog mi shes pa gzugs kyi nyi ma bya ba btsun mor bsus pa dang / rgyal khrims kyang dge bcur brten nas blon 'bangs gong 'og tshang ma yid kyi dang ga rab tu bsten nas dga' bde'i dpal la rol bzhin mchis/ skabs der rigasangan gyi bu mo gan bye bzang mo zhes mig 'phrul dang sgyu ma shes pa/ mthu dang rdzu 'khrul che ba 'di zhe sdang dang phrag dog skyes nas gzugs kyi nyi ma'i srung ba zab mo mu tig phreng ba de g.yo sgyus bslus pa dang / gan bye bzang mos rgyal po 'khor bcas la myos shing rmugs par byed pa'i rdzasang na sum cu rtsa gnyisabatab ste dang po rgyal po'i glang po che rab brtan bsad nas de'i khog stod gzugs kyi nyi ma'i g.yas su bzhag pa dang / de'i khog smad gzugs kyi nyi ma'i g.yon du bzhag nang 'khrol rnams gzugs kyi nyi ma'i sbas mgor spungs/ de'i rjes sras chung ba zla ba'i gzhon nu bsad de sha khrag rnamasagazugs kyi nyi ma'i sbas mgor spungs/ mngon shes shod pa'i smra mkhan no tso yang bsad pas/ rgyal po zla ba'i seng ges gzugs kyi nyi ma gshed ma gsum gyi lag tu sprad nas dur khrod du gsod par btang / 'on te gshed ma gsum gyis gzugs kyi nyi ma gsod par ma phod par rang gar btang / de nasagazugs kyi nyi ma nges med ri khrod 'grim nas rnal 'byor ma zhig tu gyur/mthar rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim pa'i rting ma la slar yang grong khyer semasakyi blo gros phyogs su 'byor ba dang / rgyal sras zla ba'i seng ge yang gzugs kyi — 234 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho ra/nyi ma dang bral ba'i mya ngan kyi khung bur tshud pa'i skabs blo rig gsal nga'i abo na ges rnal 'byor ma 'di gzugs kyi nyi ma yin pa shes nas rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs/ gan bye bzang mo dang rigasang na ma gnyis kyi bya ba ngan pa thams cad mthil brtol/ rgyal po sras bcas rmongs gnyid mas sad de gzugs kyi nyi ma slar yang btsun mor mnga' gal nas dga' bde'i dpal la longs su spyod rgyu byung ba bkod yod/ gzhung 'dir cha mtshon na/gzugs kyi nyi mni dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo dang / rigasang na bu podang gan zla bzang mo gnyis ni sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna'i gzugs su bkod yod/de ltar dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna gzugs kyi nyi mni/ dkon mchog gsum la bslu med skyabs su bcol ba/ kha 'bras yid du 'ongs la semasargyud bzang ba/ thugs rgya yangs la rnam dpyod ldan pa sogs kyi rnam par bkod nas bstod pa byas pa dang / sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna rigasang na bu modang / gan zla bzang mo gnyis ni/ dam nyams log pa'i ltab 'dzin pa/bas mtsha byas tsha sdig pa'i las 'ang 'a zhig g.yodang khram pa gsum don gnyer ba'i gzugs su bkod de sun 'byin dang kha rdung btang nas skye bor dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi snar bsam spyor ngan pa la brten nas thabs shes yod rgus 'tshe ba ji ltar byas kyang gzhig rgyu med la brlag rgyu yang med pa/ de lasaldog sde sdig pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal thub kyi yod pa'i don bstan yod/〈don yod don grub〉la cha mal na/ sngar rgya gar gyi la gru la po zangs gling zhes bya ba na/ chos kyi rgyal po stobs kyi lha zhes pa dang / de'i —235—

la kyi la la la la nga nga sa kyi la la nga babatsun mo kun bzang mar sras rgyal bu don grub sku la ngas/ 'khrungasamathag nas chos la dga' ba zhig yin/ rgyal bu don grub dgung lo lnga lon pa'i tshe yum kun bzang ma de bsnyung gzhi drag po phog nas mi ring bar grongs/der rgyal pos 'bangs phal pa'i bu mo padma can zhes pa zhig khab tu bzhes pa der yang sras shig 'khrungs pa'i mtshan la don yod ces gso lo/ srasadon yod ni btsas mthag nas yum gyi nu zho bzhes pa tsam ma gtogs pha ma gnyis la blo'i gtod par a jo rgyal bu don grung dang mnyam du nyin mtshan khor yug kun du ga bral med du bzhugs kyi yod/ blon 'bangs 'khor thams cad kyis rgyal bu don grub ni chos sems dkar ba/ byams dang snying rje che ba/ shes rab blo dang ldan pa sogs gang ci'i thad nas bltas kyang rgyal po las 'os pa med ces nam rgyun du gleng mol byed kyi yod/ gtam de dag btsun mo padma can gyi rna bar thos nas/ rgyal bu don grub 'di med pa'i thabs shig bya dgos snyam nas kho mos rang la nad gzhi drag po phog pa'i la bstan te/ rgyal po'i sku tshe dbang thang nyams par byed cing / rang gi srog la gnod pa skyel mkhan byed gte rgyal bu don grub de nyid yin zer nyes med nyes 'gel byas mthar/ rgyal bu don grub mtha' 'khob mi med lha 'dre'i la ko sha bya ba'i gnas su gas/ rgyal bu don grub ni yab rgyal po'i bka' bzhin sa rong rtsub pa'i ko sha la du rgyang 'bud 'gro rgyu'i gra sgrig gnang skabs rgyal bu don yod kyis gcen po don grub dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu'i utshugs mtha' skyel gnang stabs gzung po don yod mnyam du mi khrid ka med byung / mi med lung stong gi bye thang brgyud de ko sha la du phebs pa'i lam—236—

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho rabar du tsha grang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal dpag med kyis mnar nas mthar gcung po don yod sku gshegs pa dang / gcen po don grub kyis gzung po don yod kyi sku phung 'di tsan dan gyi bsil grib 'og g.yas sgom legs par bcos nas bzhag ste mya ngan gyis gzir te smre ngag 'don bzhin ko sha'i yul du phebs pa dang / zhag bdun song ba na lha'i dbang po rgya byin gyis drang srong zhig tu sprul nas rgyal bu don yod la shi gsos kyi sman thur ma gang blugasapas sngar bzhin dran pa rnyed thub pa byung / rgyal bu don grub ri khrod cig la byon pas bla ma legs pa'i blo gros dang mjal/ der gong gi rgyu mtshan rnamasazhib cing zabar zhus pas bom yab sras gnyis gzung po don yod kyi sbu phung 'tshogadu phebs/ 'on kyang der ni shing tog gi shun pa dang rtswa'i mal gdan tsam ma gtogs gzung po'i rus pa tsam yang ma rnyed/ dus nas zhig na yulader rgyal khab cig yod pa la char chu dus sum babs pa dang / mend phyugs nad rgyun mi༅ pa byung bas de la mo lung gsung rtags zhus pa ltar byis pa lo brgyad 'brug lob zhig klu'i rgyal por mchod na gzhi nas bkra shisalo legs phun gas byung bar gsungs/ de nas bdud blon ji shus rgyal bu don grub ni 'brug lob yin pa shes te rgyal po'i pho brang du 'khrid pa dang /rgyal bus kyang 'gro don gyi rṣa du rgya mtsho ru 'dzem med mchongs stabs klu'i rgyal po yang rgyal bu don grub kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo mtshar mdzad spyod la rjes su yid rang zhing rgyal bu phyir mngags pa dang / phyis su yang klu lams ngos medagos bzhal gyis bzhe bzhes/ de nas bzung rgyal khang der lo legs rtag tu byung zhing 'bangs rnams phyug po byung bdang / nad rim gyi — 237 —
