'du ku da ba zad ba la nga ba kyi zad pa'i nga zabadri ma dang bral nas tshe ring bde thang byung stabs rgyal bu don grub de nyid la de ka'i rgyal por bskos pa dang lhagacig 'od ldan ma 'di rgyal po'i btsun mor bzhes/ de nas lo gnyis song tsam na/ rgyal po don grung 'khor dang bcas pa sngar ga byung po grongs pa'i sa 'dir phebs pa dang gcen gcung gnyis kyang ngo mjal byung bas spro ba dpag med du 'phel/ mthar rgyal po gcen gcung gnyis kyis rang la pha ma dran nas 'khor dang bcas pa zangayogleng rgyal khab tu phebs pa dang / gcung po don yod kyang rgyal po'i gser khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas bzung sku mchen gnyis kyis rang so so'i rgyal srid chos bzhin skyangs nas gong 'og tshang ma dga' bde'i dpal la longs su spyod rgyu byung ba'i skor bkod yod/gzhung 'dir cha mtshon na/ rgyal bu don grung dang rgyal bu don yod ni dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo dang / btsun mo padma can ni sdig pa'i phyogasakyi mi sna ga bo bo'i gzugs su bkod yod/ de ltar dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna rgyal bu don yod dang don grub gnyis ni/ chos la dad cing rgyu 'bras brtsi nga/blo gros ldan la dpa' ngar che ba/ la rgya zab la dka' sdug mnyam myong thub pa sogs kyi rnam par bkod de 'dam skyes padma ji bzhin 'dam la skyes kyang rdzab kyi dri mas ma sbags pa'i phul byung gi mdzad bzang la yid rang mngon par bstod pa dang / de bzhin sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna btsun mo padma can ni/sems rgyud brlangs shing bya spyod gtum pa/ khongs rgya chung la sdang sems che ba/ dge bar yid smugs sdig par dga' ba sogs kyi skor bkod nas skyon — 238 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho ra/btsugs tsha thag chod byas te skye bor‘‘sdeg pa'i grogs po bsten gyur na/sdong bo srin gyis zos pa ltar/ legs tshogs 'grib cing nyes pa 'phel/skyon kun rtsa ba grogs po yin ①zhes pa ltar sdeg pa'i phyogs kyi skye bor grogasasung sten na de ni rang nyid phungs pa'i sa bon 'ba' zhig dang / dge ba'i phyogs kyi skye bor grogs sung sten na de yang bde ba'i 'bras bu bzang po smin thub pa'i don bstan yod/〈'gro ba bzang mo〉zhes pa'i gzhung 'dir cha mtshon na/ sngar ༅ maṇḍal sgang zhes bya ba'i yul zhig na rgyal po 'i la dbang po zhes bya ba zhig yod/dus nam zhig gi tshe yul maṇḍal sgang gi rgyal po 'i la dbang pos blon 'bangasa'akhor bcas rang rang so so'i go mtshon me mda' dang mda' gzhu sogs dang /khyi mo khrid de ri bo'i steng du khye ra byed par 'gro dgos pa'i 'bod skul gnang /ri steng du khye ra byas te de'i nyin kha sha sum cu song dun tsam brgyab pa dang /nyi ma nub nas sa rub mtshams su glo bur du khye mo lcags khra babs shes de nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin yang nas gar song med par gyur/ blon 'bangs rnamasakyi ji ltar btsal 'tshol byas kyang mi rnyed pa dang / sang nyin nam langs pa'i tshe rgyal po'i bka' ltar blon po tri na 'dzin khyi mo'i rkang rjes 'tshol du 'gro ba'i skabs/ shar phyogs kyi nags tshal stug po zhig gi khrod na khang chung 'ig yod pa mthong nas rgyal por snyan gseng zhus pa dang / rgyal po blon 'bangasa'akhor dang bcas pa khang khyim de'i sgo drung du slebs/ khang khyim nang du mi④ (bslab bya gces bsdus〉lcags dpar deb ngos 203— 239 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga ba/phal pa'i bu mo dang mi 'dra ba/ bltas na skyes 'bras mtshar ba/ nyan na gsung skad snyan pa/ bsnams na dri zhim 'thul ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis yid dbang rab tu 'gug pa'i 'gro ba bzang mo yod pa gzigs te/ bram ze rgan rgon gnyis la bu mo 'di bdag gi btsun mor bsub yin zhes brjod nasargyal blon 'khor 'bangs dpon g.yog rnams rang la du log gode nas rgyal pos 'gro ba bzang mo pho brang du gdan drangs pa dang dga' ston rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo rgyas par la / lo shas song rjes khong gnyis la sras mo lhagacig kun tu bzang mo la ngas pa dang / yang lo gsum song rjes sras lha sras rgyal bu kun tu legs pa 'khrungs/ rgyal blon mnga' 'bangs thams cad dga' bde'i dpal la rol ba'i dus na/ sngon rgyal po 'i la dbang po'i btsun mo ha cang shin du yid phibade bar gyur nas 'gro babazang mor gnod cing 'tsho bar byas pas 'gro ba bzang mo bar snang mthongasasu 'phur ba dang / yab rgyal po 'i la dbang por spyo chu drangs te btson du bcug lcam sring gnyis po thengs mang dkrongs rtsis byas te/ shan pa dang /nya pa/ gdol pa bcas la sbog bcoms dgos pa'i bka' btang yang de dag gis gsod par mi nus par tshe thar du btang / de rjes lha sras rgyal bu kun tu legs pas yu padma can gyi rgyal po mdzad pa dang / gcen molhagacig kun bzang dang mnyam 'dzoms kyang byung / gnas tshu de dag ha cang bdud mos go thos byung nas dmag 'bumatsho gcig yod de a padma can la gal bshams/ der lha sras rgyal pos dngag gi gdong len byas te —240—

bo kyi srom rtsom la sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho raha cang bdud ka'akhor bcas pa rtsa med du btang ba dang / yab rgyal po mun pa'i brtson las bston te pho brang du gdan drangs/ de sngon sgyu srog skyobasadrin can shan pa rgan gzhon dang / nya pa rgan gzhon sogs la bya dga' gya noms par gnang te la padma can gyi blon po dang nang blon la bka' bkod gnang / de nas yab sras gnyis kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs pasargyal blon 'khor 'bangs thams cad dga' bde'i dpal la rol rgyu byung ba'i skor bkod yod/lha mo'i gzhung 'dir cha mtshon na/ 'gro ba bzang yodang lha srasagacen gcung gnyis ni dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna dang / ha cang btsun mo ni sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna'i gzugs su bkod nas dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna 'gro ba bzang yodang lha sras gcen gcung gnyis ni byang chub sems dpa'i stobs mnga' la/ rgyu 'bras la mig ltar gces pa/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa/ spangs blangs rnam dpyod ldan pa/ de bzhin bden pa'i phyogs kyi rgyab langs shan pa rgan gzhon dang / nya pa rgan gzhon gnyis ni gshis rgyud rang bzhin srong ba/ byams dang snyeng rje'i rgyu ldan la/ dge sdig go shes thub pa sogs dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi snar bstod cing bsngags par byas pa dang /gzhan yang sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna ha cang bdud mo ni sems rgyud tsub cing gtum pa/ khengs dang dregs pa ldan pa/ bskams chag sgyu bsred pasabacings ba/ gzhan loganod sems 'ang 'a zhig la 'jug pa'i skyug bro la zhe log pa'i bdud mo gzugs su bkod de zur za dang skyon brjod nan po mdzad de skye bor/ ha cang g.yo sgyu che drags na/ tha mar rang nyid brlags— 241 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bapa byed zer ba ltar 'dod la sa/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog bcas mi dge ba'i sdig pa'i 'byung rtsa dug lnga 'di med par ma bzos na/mtha' ma rang nyid brlags pa'i rgyu 'ang 'a zhig yin pa'i don bstan yod/〈padma 'od 'bar〉la cha mtshon na/ sngon rgya gar gyi la na kha mu ṇi zhes pa'i pho brang na/ rgyal po log pa can mal sbyin dang / blon po rkang mgyogs bang chen tshong dpon nor bu bzang po sogs yod/ pha tshong dpon nor bu bzang po ni shes rab can zhig yin pas stod zog yod pa smad du bskyal/ smad zog yod pa stod du bskyal/ lho tshong yod pa byang du bskyal/byang tshong yod pa lho ru bskyal/ rgyal po'i bang mdzod stong pa nor gyis bkang /nyin gcig mu stegs rgyal po de log pa'i blo snar gyur te/ rgyal po'i bsam pa la blon po 'di med pa zhig ma bzos na rang gi gong du shor ba 'dug snyamasanas tshong dpon nor bzang med pa bzo rgyu'i bsam ngan bcangs/ de nasanor bzang rgya mal gling du nor bu len par 'gro dgos zhes btsan shed kyisabazangs pa dang rang la du phyir ldog pa'i skabs dang bral bar gyur/ de nas tshong dpon nor bzang gi sras padma 'od 'bar de yang lnga lam du skyelartsis byas/ padma 'od 'bar rgya mal gleng du nor bu len par phebs khar yum gyis lha sras bram zes padma 'od 'bar la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i ga dmasang ga gnang / padma 'od 'bar gyis tshong phrug lnga brgya khrid nas nor bu len par phebs te rgya mal dkyil du 'byor skabs sngar bzhin klu rnams khros te gru rdzings slog par yong skabs padma 'od 'bar gyis mkha' 'gro'i ga dmasang ga 'don pa gnang bar brten gnod 'tshe skyel mi thub par nor bu gser gyi sga—242—

bo kyi srol rtsom la sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho rang mchong gi rnga yab blangs nas rang la la phyir phebs/ mthar rgyalapothabs zad de shan pa'i lag tu sprad nas shar ri'i rtse mor rtsems byas pa dang / de'i spur thal rnams phyogs bzhin gtor nas rlung la bskur no/der mkha' 'gro'i nus mthu las padma 'od 'bar mngal skyes min par rdzus te me tog padma'i ze'u 'bru'i dkyil nas sngar las gzi mdangs rgyas pa zhig 'khrungs/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma lnga pos rgyal po log pa'i mal sbyin dang rkang mgyogs bang chen gyis gtsos bdud blon rnams gser gyi glanga'i nang bzhag nas nam mkha'i mthongs su khrid de lho nub srin po'i la gyi mkha' thog tu slebs skabs rgyal po dang bdud blon thams cad srin po'i la du bskyur nal na po rnams kyi zas su btang / ༅ de'i mnga' 'bangs mi ser dang blon po'i gas rnams slobar bas 'phel nas/ padma 'od 'bar shar ri'i rtse nas gdan drangs te gser khrir mnga' gal ba dang / padma 'od 'bar gyis kyang rgyal srid legs par bskyangs nas stobs 'byor phun sumatsho salablon 'bangs thams cad bde ba'i gnas su 'khod par byas pa'i skor bstan yod/la ba gzhung 'dir cha mtshon na/ sras padma 'od 'bar dang pha tshong dpon nor bu bzang po gnyis ni dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna dang rgyalapomal sbyin dang blon po rkang mgyogs bang chen gnyis ni sdig pa'i phyogs kyi skosna'i gzugs su bkod de dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna sras padma 'od 'bar dang /pha nor bu bzang po gnyis ni dkon mal gsum la rtse gcig dad pa dang /byang chub sems pa'i gzhan phan sems kyis phyug pa las la brtson zhing —243—

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bdapa' ngar che ba/ spyan rgyang ring la shes rab dang ldan pa sogs bsngagasapa'i la du bkod pa dang / de bzhin sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna rgyal po mal sbyin dang blon po rkang mgyogs bang chen gnyis ni las dang rgyu ye 'bras bur mi brtsi ba/ log lta 'dzin la log lam du spyod pa/ phrag dog che la khog rgya chung ba sogs kyi gzugs su bkod de dma' 'bebs drag po mdzad nas skye bor sems pa bzang na yodang lam yang bzang / sems pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ngan zhes pa ltar 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras la bslu ba med pa dang /semasang na gzhan la 'chang na rnam smin so sor 'khor ba'i rgyu mtshan kyi thog nas dam pa'i lha chos la blo kha phyogs nas dge ba'i las su 'bad dgos pa'i don bstan yod/mdor na/ gong gi〈rgyal bu dri med kun ldan/〉〈snang sa 'od 'bum/〉〈chos rgyal nor bzang /〉〈gzugs kyi nyi ma/〉〈don yod don grub/〉〈'gro ba bzang mo/〉〈padma ma'od 'bar 〉sogs bod kyi lha mo'i la ba gzhung 'di dag la/ 'don dang / gzhung / bkra shis bcas go rim gsum gyi khrab ston sgrig gzhi'i thog nas khrab gzhung nang gi gzugs bkod mi sna'i mdzesashing sgeg pa'i nyams/ brjid cing dpa' ba'i nyams/ yid du mi 'ong zhing da sdug pa'i nyams/ thamatsha zhing rgod bro ba'i nyams dbang btsan zhing drag shul gyi nyams/ mthong bdang thos pa tsam gyis dngangs shing 'jigasapa'i nyams/ sdug bsngal gyis nyamathag cing snying rje ba'i nyams 'dod pa la brngams shing la sa pa'i nyams/ dul zhing 'jam la zhi ba'i nyams sogs—244—

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho rartser son gyi sgyu rtsal rnam pa'i thog nas gzigs mong tsho 'dren byed bdud rtsir bshams stobs yid kyi dbang po cig car nyid du 'as thub nus pa dang ldan yod/a par bod kyi lta mo'i gzhung 'dir rolas ram 'degs nyung ba dang / gar stegs dang rgyab ljongs kyi cha rkyen kyi dgos pa de tsam med pa/dkar cha dang ldan na sa cha dang dus tshod gang yang rung ba zhig la pob ston byed thub pa'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i ngo mtshar yo chos du mas bcings yod stabs/ ga rjes gas gnas mi 'dra ba khag nas dang rang gis sgrig sagasabyas pa'i yar lung bkris zhol pa/ snye mo bya sgo ba/ thon pa ba/ snang rtse ba/rig spungs rgyal mkhar ba/ ngam ring gcung pa ba/ rnam gling shangs 'gramapa/ lhasa'i skyor mo lung pa/ 'bri gung pa sogs lha po tshogs pa mi nyung bzhig byung ste bod kyi lha mo'i sgyu rtsal 'di sngar las lhag pa'i gong 'phelas pozhig byung yod/la pogs pa de dag gis lo re'i lha yo zho ston gyi skabs su nor bugleng gar bskyod de khrab ston gzigs 'bul byed kyi yod pa dang / de min rang rang gi 'du logs ra dang / 'ong bskor/ de bzhin dus ga gtan 'khel med par thengs yang 'khrab ston byed kyi yod stabs/ bod khulaladar khyab rṣa po byung nas bod kyi mtho rim shes ldan mi drag lta ci/ tha na dmangs khrod kyi yig 'bru pho gcig kyang mi shes pa'i mang gas rnams kyisakyang brtsams chos kyi brjod bya'i nang don ngas thog nas bshad thub kyi yod/rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni spyi gas kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig yin po— 245 —

la kyi la ba nga sa nga nga sa kyi ma ma nga bdang / des klog pa po'i yid kyi phung por bzang ngan dge sdeg gi bag chagasasub thabs bral ba zhig 'jog thub kyi yod/ dper na/ bod mi'i khrod du dre med kun ldan zhes 'bod pa'i skabs su/ rgyal bu 'di ni byams snying rje'i bdag po dang / gtong phod stongs dang ldan pa/ rang gi rgyu nor longs spyod lta ci/ tha na rang gi bza' mi bu phrug kyang sbyin par gtong phod pa'i zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa sogs kyi bdag po zhig yin pa dang / de bzhin snang sa 'od 'bum dang / chos rgyal nor bzang / gzugs kyi nyi ma/ don yod don grub/'gro ba bzang mo/ padma 'od 'bar sogs ni/ dam pa'i chos la rtse gcig dad pa dang ldan pa/ log par lta ba'i log lam ngan pa spengs ba/ yang dag pa'i lta nga lam bzang la yang dag gnas pa/ 'khor ba dug gi rgya mtshor bsun zhing dbugs 'byin pa/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med par rang 'bras mig ltar gces pa/ ngan song gnas las mchongs te bde ba'i rjes su stegasamakhan yin pa sogs yid kyi me long nang du rdo la ri mo bkod pa ltar gsal lham mer 'char thub kyi yod la/ brtsams bya'i nang gi dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna'i dge ba la 'jug pa'i 'phrin las rnams rgyun du 'tsho ba'i nang gi cad 'dzin dmig dpe lta bu dang / de bzhin sdeg pa'i phyogs kyi tha shal gtum spyod ngan pa rnams dor bya'i gzhi ru 'dzin nas‘‘rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems las byung / byang chub sems kyang snying rje'i rgyu las byung / de phyir snyeng rje'i ngang tshal rab tu ldan par bya mi zhes pa ltar gong gi 'a ba gzhung nang gi dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna ji bzhin byams dang snying rje'i rnam dkar — 246 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho ralas su zhugs na/ 'a༅ phugs bde skyid kyi 'bras bu thob pa dang / de las ldog ste zas gos bsdod gsum kho na'i ra du gang byung du sems canagazhan gyi srog 'phrog pa'i gtum spyod la zhugs na/ sdug bsngal gyi 'brasabusmin rgyu 'ba' zhig yin pa'i rgyu 'bras bslu med kyi chos la sngar las lhag pa'i dad pa ba po byung nas/ gal srid sems can gzhan la phan pa'i lasasuzhugs na bde ba'i 'bras bu thob pa dang / de las ldog te sems can la 'tshe ba'am srog gcod pa'i las su zhugs na/ de yang sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu smin rgyu nyag cig yin par yid ches brtan po skyes nas/ gang byung du srog chags la gnod pa mi skyel bar dmigs gsal gyi nus pa chen po thon yod/gsum pa/ rnam thar0gyi0skor/bod kyi rtsom rig khrod du rnam thar gyi brtsams chos ni shin du mang po yod/ ches snga shos kyi rnamathar ni btsan po'i dus kyi rgyal blon grags can tsho mdzad 'phrin bkod pa'i rnam thar thung ngu mang po yod pa dang / de nasabatsan po'i rgyal rabs thor zhig tu song nas bod khams྾ bur thor skabs/sa gnas so so'i dbang sgyur mtho rim mi drag gis skabs de'i spyi gas kyi dpal 'byor dang / chab srid/ rig gnas bcas kyi 'phel rgyas kyi gomastabs dang bstun nas/ rang gi grub mtha'i stobs dang snyan grags khyab spelayong ra dang skye bu dam pa'i mdzad 'jin la bsngags par byed pa'i rṣa du grub mtha' so so'i ma rdzas kyi dang dge bshes kyi mdzad 'phrin bkod pa'i rnayo— 247 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la ma nga bathar brtsams chos kyi mtho rlabs zhig 'phyur yod/ de yang grags pa dang ldan pa'i rnam thar brtsams chos ni 〈mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/〉〈bu ston gyi rnam thar/〉〈sa paṇa gyi rnamathar/〉〈mar pa'i rnamathar/〉〈nas cing pa'i rnam thar/〉〈je'i rnam thar chen mo/〉〈thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar/〉〈'brug pa kun legs kyi rnamathar〉sogs stong lhag tsam yod par grags/ rnam thar ni skyes chen dam pa'i sku tshe hril po'i sbu gsung thugs 'phrin las yon tan lngar bstod par byed pa dang / de dag gis ji ltar byas nasang la ba dang du blangasate dam pa'i chos la 'jug la dang / ji ltar byas te sdig pa'i bstan dgrar bsun 'byin bya lugs skor bkod pa sha stag yin/ dper na/ 〈mi larasapa'i rnam thar〉la cha mtshon na/ rje btsun mi la'i khyem ni thog mar 'byor pa dang ldan pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang rje btsun mil dgung long dun laslebs skabs yab sku gshegs/ yab tshe las 'das khar/ rje btsun mil mabugasum dang khyim tshang gi rgyu nor rnams gas g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dang /yod khyung tsha dpal 'gran la bcol nas/ rje btsun mil khyims pher skabasargyu nor pha gzhis khong la bdag sprod byed dgos pa'i zhal ches bzhag 'on te drin lan log par mjal la rgyu 'bras rtsis med du gtong mkhan a khu dang gni gnyis kyis khong ma smad gsum ga'i rgyu nor thams cad ham 'phrog byusapas ma cad ‘‘dbyar zhing las byed dus lo khu'i g.yog dgun bal las byed dus lo ne'i g.yog lto khyi'i ltos las bong las/ gos hrul phrag thag cad pa la dres ma'i ske rag bcings pa pyon nas/ las dal med byed dgos byung — 248 —

bo kyi srol rtsom la sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga la pa tho rabs yan lag rnams ser kar song / lto gosang na pa'i stobs kyis khamadog skya la sha rid pa/ skya dang po gser gal ral ba nyis long la/ phyis skyaboseng seng shig sro'i ral ba nyis long byung bas/ mthong bdang thos pa'i misems chung kun mchi ma 'tshor ba dang / a khu dang yod la lkog lab dir re ba byung rung 'dzem med byas mi④de ltar a khu dang a ni gnyis kyis gnar gcod la med byas stabs/ mil ma bu gsum gyis snying nad bcangs te dgra sha len pa'i 'dun pa drag po bcangs mod/ gas dang a rte gnyis la bu tsha brgyud mang stabs btul ma thub/ de nas yum myang tsha dkar rgyan 'u thug ste rje btsun mil la skyor po grong gi bom gnyag pa g.yung ston khro rgyal dang /gtsang nong gi bla ma gnubs pa gnyis kyi drung du mthu slob par mngags/mthu rtags legs par thon skabs/ a khu'i bu'i bag ston gyi nyin 'khong yosmad gsum la shin tu sdang ba'i dgrangs so lnga mthu'i nus pa la brten nasakhang bsdigs btang / yang yum gyi 'dun pa ltar ser ba phab nas grong gi lotog ma lus pa yongs su bcoms ste 'khon lan snyeng nad brtsad pa zhig blangs/de ltar rje btsun mi las mthu btang ka'akhon lan slog thub pa zhig byung yang thugs 'gyod rṣa po skyes nas/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i za du ma rjes su rong ston lha dga' dang / lho brag bla ma mar pa sogs kyi zhabs la gtugasabadang / sgrub par dka' ba'i mkhar las rnams grub bdang / bzod par dka' ba'i nyams sad rnams theg par byas mthar bo ma'i dbang dang ① (mi la ras pa'i rnam thar 〉lhags dpar deb ngos 17— 249 —

bo kyi sngon ga ma sa nga nga sa kyi zang gra nga bgadams pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par thob/ de nas bla ma'i bka' ltar nges med ri khrod 'grim nas sgrub pa snying por zhugs ga pa dang / dka' spyad dang du blangs te mchog gi dngos grub thob/ slob bu yang bgrang las 'dasapa zhig byung nas bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa rgya chen khyab spel mdzad mkhan bstan pa'i bdag po chen po zhig tu gyur ba'i skor bkod yod/rnam thar 'dir cha mtshon na/ rje btsun mi bar sa pa ni dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo zhig yin pa dang / a khu dang a ni/ de bzhin ba ri lo tsā ba dang dge bshes rtsag phu ba sogs ni sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi snar bkod/dge ba'i phyogs kyi mi sna gtso bo rje btsun mil das pa ni/ nyon mong dug lnga'i g.ya' dang bral ba/ dka' spyad brtson 'grus dang du len pa/ mkhyen nus brtse gsum gyi dpal mnga' la/ lta spyod sgom gsum gyis thugs phyug pa'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag la bkod de bsngags brjod byas yod/ gzhan yang sdig pa'i phyogs kyi mi sna a khu dang / e zhe/ de bzhin ba ri lo tsā ba dang / dge bshes rtsag phu ba sogs ni/ sdig pa'i grogs su bsnyen pa/las 'bras chu la bskyur mkhan/ kheng dregs skam chags ldan pa/ gzhan la gnod sems che ba sogs kyi gzugs su bkod de bsun 'byin dang dma' 'bebs byas yod/ lhag par rnamathar 'di'i nang gi khye ra ras pa dang mjal ba'i skor zhes pa'i nang du‘‘sprin dang na bun 'thibs pa las dus rgyun chad med par kha char 'bab pa/ g.yas ri brag mtho la gzar ba log can gzan rnamasang ra skad sgrog cing bya rgyal rgod po lding ba/ g.yon ri sprang ri snum la 'jam pa la/ ri dwags sha ba dang / dgo ba/ gna' ba rnams rang — 250 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba ngas sa pa tho rabazhin gyis bag phebs te rtse zhing 'jo ba/ mdun na nags tshal bzang pometog sna tshogs bkra ba'i nang na/ spradang spre'u rnams yang rtsal sbyong ba/ rma bya dang 'jol rol sogs te mdzes pa'i bya sna tshogs gsung snyan mi rtsa'i lenacing sgra sgrog la 'dab gshog gi gar stabs bsgyur ba/ sgrub phug gi mdudanamar gas chu gangs chu rdza chu rnams dus rgyun sa med par lhung lhang snyan pa'i sgra sgrog cing 'bab pa ①zhes pa'i nyams dga' ba'i dben gzhig tu sgoms sgrub nyams len la bzhugs skabs/ khye ra bzhig gis sha ba rmug chung gcig ded de rngon la 'jug rtsis bya skabs mi la nas pas6‘'gro ba mi ye lusal srin lo gdong / mi lus srin gdong skola'i glu la nyon/ mi lus rin chen dkon gsungs te/ khyod 'dra mthong na dkon rgyu med/ srin po'i gzugs kyi sdig pa can/ ngan song sdug bsngal khyad bsad nas/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa sgrub lags kyang / sdig pas 'dod pa ka'agrub ste/ nang zhen pa log na dngos grub 'thob/ phyi snang ba btul gyi mi thul kyis/ khyod rang sems 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ khyod sha ba bsad pas mi 'grangs te/ nang dug lnga bsad na ci bsam grub1 phyi dgra bo btul yang je mang 'gro nang rang brgyud btul na dgra bo med/ mi tshe sdig lam skyel bar/ dam pa'i lhachos byas na legs ①zhes dang de bzhin‘‘g.ya' ri dang gangs ri rdza ri gsum/ 'di gsum skola'i sgrung gnas yin/ sgrub gnas de gsum gyis④ (rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉lcags dpar deb ngos 430① (rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉lhags dpar deb ngos 434— 251 —

ngo kyi da ba zil ba nga nga ba kyi zang pa nga nga yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog sha ba dgo ba gna' ba gsum/ 'di gsumarshala'i sgo phyugs yin/ phyugs de gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog g.yedang 'phar ba spyang ki gsum/ 'di gsuma'i la'i sgo khyi yin/ sgo khyi de gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog bya 'jol mo gong mo rgod po gsum/de gsum grola'i khyim bya yin/ khyem bya de gsum kyis yong na ras pa'i phyi lashog nyi mas ba skar ma gsum/ 'di gsum mi la'i spyan gzigs yin/spyan gzigs 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog lha dang 'dre dang drang srong gsum/ 'di gsum skola'i khyim mtshes yin/ khyim mtshes 'di gsum gyis yong na mas pa'i phyi la shog spradang pa'i mi dred gsum/ 'di gsum mi la'i rtse grogs yin/ rtse grogs 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog bde dang gal dang mi rtogs gsum/ 'di gsum mi la'i skyo grogs yin/ skyo grogs 'di gsum gyis yong na nas pa'i phyi la shog ka dang rug pa thul ba gsum/ 'di gsum skola'i kha zas yin/ zas 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog g.ya' chu gangs chu rdza chu gsum/ 'di gsum mi la'i btung chu yin/ btung chu 'di gsum gyis yong na mas pa'i phyi la shog rtsa dang rlung dang thig legasum/ 'di gsum mi la'i pyon rgyu yin/gos 'di gsum gyis yong na das pa'i phyi la shog ①ces gsung pa na rngon pa 'di grol nas pa'i lta spyod sgom gsum la dad pa shin tu skyes te sha ba dang khyi mo mda' gzhu dgo slog zhags pa sogs phul ba dang / slad du mi dge ba'i ④ 〈rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉lcags dpar deb dngos 437— 252 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro chas la ba nga sa pa tho rasrog gcod bya ba spangs nas dge spyong las su 'jug pa'i skor bkod yod/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos kyi rtsa ba ni snying rje yin pa dang de ni rang gi dmigs yu du gyur pa'i gang zag la dmigs nas sdug bal lasabaskyabs par 'dod pa'i rnam par ka'atshe ba'i sems byung zhig yin pa dang /rnam par ka'atshe ba ni sems can dang gzhan thams cad bde bar gnas pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig kyang yin de yang 〈la du brjod pa'i tshoms〉kyi nang duthams cad la yang srog ni sdug thams cad la bas 'jigs ba na/rang gi nyams la dpag gyis te/ brdeg par mi bya gsad mi bya zhes pa ltar srog gi phung po yod pa'i sems can ci 'dra zhig yin rung / rang gi srog lamig ces pa dang / mi phangs pa gcig kyang med/ ci bzhin rang gi srog laji ltar gces pa bzhin du sems can gzhan gyi srog la'ang de ltar gcesa'adzin bya thub na/ rang gzhan gnyis kar phan pa yod pa'i don bstan yod/de ltar bod kyi rnamathar ni brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rnam pa de labarten nas mthong thos kyi gdul bya rnams thar nga dang / thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur pa zhig yin pas/ de'i nang grung mtha' khag gi bla maskyes chen dam pa la mkhyen nus brtse gsum dang / 'al rtsod rtsom gsum/de bzhin lta spyod sgom gsum gyi mdzad 'jin la bsngags brjod byas te/ skye bor dal 'byor mi lus kyi rten 'di shin tu rnyed dka' ba zhig yin pa dang /rin chen da lus kyi skal bzang go skabs 'di thob skabs nges par dam pa'i chos la blo gtad de sdig gtum gyi las thams spangs dgos pa/ de yang —253—

bo kyi 11la zin sa nga nga sa kyi zad sdig nga ba〈spyod 'jug〉las‘‘'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / 'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ de kun rang bde 'dod las byung mi zhes pa ltar/ tha na 'bu srin las pa'i sems can thams cad srog gnas pa 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / de dag la'ang rang rang 'tsho gnas byed pa'i dbang cha yod pas snying rje chen po dang brtse ba chen posabu bzhin skyangs te rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'phral phugs bde ba'i don du 'bad dgos༅ ga4 bar bstan yod/mdor na/ bod kyi rtsom rig bslab bya dang legs bshad/ de bzhin zlos gar rnamathar bcoms sgrub de dag ni bod khul yongs su dar khyab chen po yod pa dang / tha na yig 'bru tshig gcig kyang mi shes pa'i mang tshogs kyisakyang de dag skor ngag thog nas shod thub kyi yod/ lhag par brtsams chos de dag gi gtso bo'i brjod bya'i snying po ni‘‘sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du dar ba nas/ bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang khyad par bod kyi rtsom rig gi brjod bya gtso bo ni byams dang snying rjes drangs pa'i sems can gyi srog migacod pa sogasadage ba bcu'i las lam ltar dge ba sgrub pa dang sdig pa spong ba gnyis brjod bya'i snying po'i nang gi snying por bzung nas sems can thams cad la bde ba sgrub pa dang sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa ston pa'i brtsam chos dus rabs rim par mang du byung mi①zhes dang / yang ‘‘bod kyi gna' sgrung khrod du yin na'ang 'dra/ bod kyi gna' ra bas rnamathar rtsom rig khrod yin yang 'dra ste/① 〈sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad〉lcags dpar deb ngos 213— 254 —

bo kyi srol rtsom ri sa rtsi nga sro cha sa la ba nga sa pa tho raspyi tshogs steng gi dge ba'i stobs shugs la snying thag pa nas bstod bsngagasabyed pa dang / sdig pa'i stobs shugs la snyeng rje med par bsun 'byen dang jer 'don byed pa de ni thams cad yongs khyab tu snang ba'i brjod bya'i snyeng po zhig red ①ces 'khod yod/ rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig yin zhing / de ye nus pa ni klog pa por gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas dge ba'i lam la 'jug rgyur bag chags gting zab zhig 'jog rgyu 'di yin/ de ltar bod kyi brtsams chos de dag gis kyang rgya che'i klog pa por/dkon mchog gsum brtse gcig skyabs su phyin nas/ zhe sdang / nga rgyal/phrag dog 'dod chags/ gti mug gi 'byung rtsa bdag 'dzin dang rang 'dzin gyi ltab ngan bzangs dgos pa/ yang dag brdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasani byang chub sems las byung ba dang / byang chub sems ni snyeng rje rṣa po lasabyung ba/ snying rje chen po ni sems can kun la khyab pa'i brtse sems chen po ste/sems can thams cad la 'tshe ba spangs zhing sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang 'bral bar 'dod pa'i byang chub sems mchog rin po che skyes dgos lugasasogs bstan nas bod mi kun gyi bsam spyod lor bas gong 'phel du gtang thog gang byung du sems can gzhan la gnod 'tshe mi bya bar sman pa'i nus pa chen po thon yod ces kho bos lnga pho ches brjod nus/④ (bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig las mtshon pa'i sdig spong dge sgrub kyi bsam blo la cung zad dpyad pa 〉lcags dpar deb ngos 58— 255 —

sa bcad bcu bdun/ bod mi kyi snga rabs khrims srolabaca' yig gis rang byung khor yugam la la bdag nga nus ba thon pa'i skor/bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba nas zung bod kyi lo rgyus dang /rig gnas/ khrims srol/ bsam spyod goms gshis/ sgyu rtsal sogs gang gi thad la'ang 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod/ bod kyi snga rabs khrims srol bca' yig gis rang byung khor yug gi bdag skyong thad nus pa shugs chen thon par cha mtshon na/ thog mar btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus su khrimasasrol khod so drug gtan la phabs pa dang / de nas bod la bur thor rjesaphag gru'i dus khor yug srung skyobs che du shing la snyegs nags gso byed dgos pa'i khrims srol gtan la phab pa/ de nas chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags dang gtsang pa sde srid/ dga' ldan pho brang gi dus su khrimasayig zhal lce bcu drug dang khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum bcas kyi nang du mi'ajigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa yong la ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i khrims srolasogs gtan la 'bebs gnang mdzad yod/— 256 —

bo kyi snga rabs mal srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i dang po/ btsan po'i kyi dus kyis bca' khrims skor/spur rgyal gyi dus skabs gas ba'i ljongs 'dir dbang sgyur ba'i btsan po mang du byung ba'i nang nas ches phul du byung ba'i rṣa srid mkhasacan dang / dam gdon mkhas can/ khrims lugs mkhas can/ phyi 'brelamakhas can ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po de nyid lag ga chos rgyal srobabatsan sgam pos dgung lo bcu gsumathog srid dbang bzhes mthag blonapo'aga' zhig gis yab gnam ri srong btsan dug gis bkrongs shing 'bangasagyen log tshab chen byung nas yang gnam ri srong btsan gyis btsugs pa'i rgyalasrid kyi rmang gzhi bzang po de thor la nye ba'i dus sumachis rung / shes rigaldan la/ blo stobs che ba'i mi rje 'dis dang thog rab nyid badzra nye ba'i blon po khag dang mna' 'brel btsugs nas yang la dug gtong la dgyi blonapo rnams tshar bcad cing de dag gi ga rje dbang thang yongs rdzogs med thabazos thog de g.yang kyis srid skyangs ba'i ring yar la dang skyid la la la sogs pa'i rgyal phran dang rus rgyud tsho pa khag dang lhan du gna' skyeladayobaca'i thog nas mnga' zhabs sa bsdus te gcig gyur byas yod rung / donadu sa gnas so sor kha'athor dbang sgyur gyi ngo bo rang sor gnas pa la brtenanas pham nyes byung ba'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyis gcig gyur ma byung ba'i rgyalaphran dang rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig dang ngan 'brel byas te slar yang btsanapo'i srid dbang thor zhig tsugatong rgyu'i nyen kha'i rang bzhin gnas yod thamakhyen nas/ rgyal phran khag dang / rus rgyud tsho pa/ rgyal blon bcas kyi — 257 —

nge bye srogs zig ba nga pa ba kyi zag ldan nga zababadag dbang je chung du btang ba dang dbang sgyur snying pa'i stobs shugs med pa bzos thog myang dbas mnon bcas kyi gtso bo byas pa'i dbang sgyur gsar pa'i stongs shugs la brten bdang / de'i gnas babs rje mthor btang nas rus rgyud tsho pa'i sger btsan dbang sgyur stobs shugs rtsa brlag tu btang ba der 'bangs mi ser gyi rgyab spyor mtha' gcig tu thob cing / mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran rnams kyang rim bzhin dbang 'og du bsdus te phyi nang lhing 'jags su gyur pa dang / bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos tshang ba'i spur rgyal dusaskabs kyi rgyal rabs gsar pa zhig rtsom 'go mdzad/de nas chos rgyal de nyid kyis rgyal sa ltas ra spos nas pho brang po ta la dang / jo khang / ra mo che/ de bzhin mtha' gdul yang gdul gyi gtsug lag khang sogs gsar du skrun pa dang / bod yig gsar du gtod pa/ rgya dkar nag dang ga che bal po sogs kyi paṇḍita dang lotsā ba 'ga' zhig gdan drangs nas nang bstan dang / sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gsong rig pa/skar rtsis sogs bstan bcos mang po bod yig tu bsgyur/ de nas chos rgyalade nyid kyis gsar du btsugs pa'i srid dngang sra brtan dang / mnga' khongs bde 'jags su 'khod chen chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don bcas kyi khrims srol cung cha tshang zhing go rim ldan pa zhig gtan 'bebasamadzad yod cing / skabs der thog mar gtan 'bebs mdzad pa'i khrimasasrol spyi'i ming la khod sum bcu so drug zer/ de'ang bka' ye khrims yig chen po drug bka' gros chen po drug yig tshang drug bka' ye phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug bcas yin/ bka' ye khrims yig — 258 —

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra ya la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rachen po drug ni/ dang po/ khri rtse bum bzher kyi khrims/ gnyis pa/ 'bum gser thog sha ba can gyi khrims/ gsum pa/ rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims/ bzhi pa/ mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims lnga pa/ dbang la bcad kyi khrims/ drug pa/ khab sonang pa'i khrims bcas yin/ dang po/khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims ni dmag don dang srid 'dzin zung 'brel gyi layolugs dang / sgrig gzhi/ dpon rigs khag gi go gnas bcas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khrims dang / gnyis pa/ gser thog sha ba can kyi khrimasani zhing 'brog sa gnas khag gi tshong las gong 'phel dang / der stangs bde yong la bre srang zho cha sogs 'jal gshor 'digs gsum gyi la gzhi gcig gyur byed pa/ gsum pa/ rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims ni byed dgosapa gsum dang / byed mi chog pa gsum/ bstod bsngags byed dgos pa gsum/ dma' 'bebs byed dgos pa gsum/ gnar gcod byed mi rung ba gsum bcas rgyal khrims bco lnga/ lha chos dge ba bcu dang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug bcas dang / bzhi pa/ mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims ni/phyogs gcig bden pa yod la phyogs gcig bden pa med pa'i gyod gzhi thag gcod byed la gyi khrims/ lnga pa dbang chen bcad kyi khrims ni pyod lophyogs gnyis kar nyes pa yod mnyam yin kyang rim gras mi 'dra bar gzhigasanas thag gcod bya la gyi khrims/ drug pa khang gsonang pa'i khrims ni phyogs nyis kar nyes pa che chung dang yod med 'dra ba'i nyes can la khrimasagacod byed la bcas yinade dag gi khrod nas rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims zhes pa 'dir —259—

nge kyi da ba zil sa nga nga sa ku zang pa nga ba/cha mtshon na/ rgyal khrims bco lnga dang 1 khrims chen bdun/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug bcas bsdoms pas khrims phran so brgyad bsdus yod pa dang /de yang rgyal khrims bco lnga ni1 mi mdzad pa gsum/ bstod pa gsum/dmad pa gsum/ mnar ba gsum bcas dang khrims chen bdun ni sangayorgyas chos lugs kyi lha chos dge ba'i nang nas srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa/ log par g.yem pa/ rdzun du smra ba/ chang la rol ba/ gyen log byed pa/ bang so 'bru ba/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug ni dkon mchog la gus par byed pa/ chos dang ye ge slob spyong byed pa/ rigs mtho ba dang /rang las rgan pa'i skol zhe yodang gus bkur zhu ba/ rang gi grogs po la phyi thag ring po byed ba/ la dang khyim mchos la phan 'dogs gang thub byed pa/bsams dang bya spyod drang bzhag byed pa/ lorangs spyod bzang dang ldan pa'i mil mig dpe ltab/ zas dang rgyu nor la chog shes dgos pa/ drin can gyi skol drin lan 'jal dgos pa/ bre srang la g.yo sgyu med pa/ spyi laphan sems che zhing phrag dog med pa/ ngag 'jam po'i sgo nas skad cha bshad pa/ bzod sgom che zhing blo khog yangs pa dgos pa/ bud med kyi kha la minyan pa bcas yin/khrims srol de ni btsan po rgyal blon rnams kyis skabs de'i spyi tshogasakyi dngos yod gnas tshul che za sna tshogs la rtogs dpyod zhib mo mdzad de sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dge ba bcu dang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug sogasagazhi ru bzhag te legs pa'am dge ba'i phyogs mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs dgosapa dang nyes pa'am sdig pa'i phyogs bkag 'gog ji ltar bya lugs kyi snyigs— 260 —

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rador bcud len gyi khrims lugs shig lags/ khrims srol 'di gtan laphabs pa nas bzung bod mi'i 'du shes dang spyod pa sogs gang phyir 'gyur ldog chen po byung nas gang byung du sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed bar phan pa'i nus pa chen po thon yod/ de yang ‘‘sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po de nyid kyis bod 'bangs bde la 'god pa'i phyir/ chos dge ba bcu la brten pa'i khrims bca' ba/ 'dod yon lnga spos ba/ phan rtsa du skyes bskur ba/mnga' 'og gi 'bangs rnams la dam pa'i chos la bsgo ba la ① de bzhin ‘6bod kyi rgyal khrims su'ang / byams snying rje gzhi rtsa byed pa'i‘6dge ba bcu'i khrims mi dang ‘6da chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi srol gtan la pab ste chos srid gnyis ka bskyangs shing / de nas bzung ‘‘dge ba bcu dang ‘‘mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug mi mi bod kyi rgyal khrims su gtan la pab khyad par dge ba bcu'i dang po srog migacod pa yin zhing bod du chos phyogs nas bshad mdagos shing srid phyogs nas kyang srog migacod pa rgyal khrims kyi dang po'am rtsa bar 'jog pa ni bod ma gtogs 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab gzhan dag la med do/ ④ gzhan yang ‘‘bod du chos srid gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i khrims su gtan 'bebs mdzad pa nas bod mi'i bsam spyod thad de las 'dang mi rung ba'i lcags ri lta bu btsugs pa red/ yang na bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi rgyalakhrims kyi rtsa ba'am gzhi ma ni srog migacod pa sogs dge ba bcu zhes pa'o/ mi④① (bod kyi snga rabs khrims srol yig cha bdams bsgrigs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 56① (sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad bya ba bzhugs so〉lcags dpar deb ngos 211④ (sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad bya ba bzhugs so〉lcags dpar deb ngos 212— 261 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bde bzhin gong gi sa bcad nang du drangs zin pa bzhin btsan po srong btsan sgal 'i ring la de ltar 'di phyi kun tu phan pa yi/ bzang po'i btsan khrims nya' zhing dam par bsdams/ ri dwags rnams ni rgyal po'i dkor nor mdzad/ ra lug be'u la sogs rang gtong yin/ ①zhes ri dwags srog chags rnams ni rgyal khabs kyi nor khongs su btang nas gang byung du de dag la gnod 'tshe byas mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs kyang mdzad par grags/gnyis pa/ phag gru'i dus kyi kyi bca' yig skor/ rab byung drug pa'i sa glang (spyi lo 1349)nas bzung phag gru byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod spyi ye chos srid la dbang gi ga lo bsgyur sgo btsugs/phag gru byang chub rgyal mtshan ni 'bri gung dpon rin skyabs dang lcam khra smon 'bum spyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung lnga pa'i chu stag (spyi lo 1302)lor sku bltams/ dgung lo bdun la tshes bzhi rnying ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs te byang chung rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gal /dgung lo dgu la son skabs mkhan la dar ba dang / slob dpon pu hreng pa'i drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas sa skya bdag chen bzang po dpal gyi zhabs phyir bzhugs/ rab byung lnga pa'i lcags bya(spyi lo 1321)ste sku nyid dgung lo nyi shur son pa'i dus gas skya'i ti ka kun dga' blo gros kyis① (chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcag dpar deb ngos 94—262—

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i raphag gru'i khri dpon du bskos shing / yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma shud rnyi pha la dbyi tsung ke han gyis dam kha stag mgo mnor bu gsum pa dang ta'i gi tu'i go gnas sprad/ ring por ma lon par g.ya' bzang pas khamachu bslangs te g.ya' bzang pa dang dmag thengs kha shas byas kyang thog mar pham/ de nasa'abri gung pa dang g.yang bzang pa/ tshal pa bcas lkog tu kha mthun nasagaya' phag gnyis kyi khamachu sa skya'i dpon chen gyi mdun du gtugs bsher khya skabs slar yang gi tu pham/ 'on kyang gi tus khri dpon gyi go gnas dang thayog rtsis ma sprad pa'i dbang gis dpon chen rgyal ba bzang pos dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag yar lung du drangs nas rjes su gi tu bar chingasa'agrig 'dum byed rgyur ga g.yar te gi tu 'dzin bzung thog brtson 'jug dang /srog la thug pa'i nyes brdungs zangs gshas btang yang khri dpon gyi go gnasadang thamag rtsis ma sprad par re zhig btson 'jug byas/ rjes gas skya'i dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po dang dpon chen dbang brtson bar 'gal ba cher song zhing sa skya'i gdung rgyud ngo ma mang che ba dpon chen dbang brtson kyi phyogs su langs te dpon chen dbang brtson la yon rgyal rangs kyi gong masadapon chen gyi 'ja' sa byung bar brten/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang posagitu btson khang nas shor nga'i khul byas te glod dkrol btang / de rjes dpon chen dbang brtson dang sa skya'i ti ka kun dga' rgyal mtshan sku mched gnyisakyis dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po lha rtse rdzong du brtson 'jug byas thog khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag yar lung du drangs nas yun ring dmag 'thab byas— 263 —

bo kyi srol zig sa nga nga sa kyi ra sa nga bkyang glag ma rnyed par da tur rgyal ga thob ste rab byung drug pa'i sa glang (spyi lo 1349)lor bod sa gnas yongs la dbang sgyur byas/ de rjes dmag chen khrid de sa skya'i mtha' bskor ba dang sbrags/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po brtson khang nas bton zhing dmag 'khrugs slong ba'i byed gte rnams la khrims gcod byas te sa skya'i srid dbang yongs rdzogs rtsis blangs nas phag mo gru bas bod yongs la dbang sgyur byed pa'i 'go tshugs so/de nas rab byung drug pa'i me sprel (spyi lo 1357)lor lcags rtse gri gu rdzong dang / 'ol kha stag rtse rdzong / gong dkar rdzong / sne'u rdzong bcasabartsigs shing / de'i phyi lor gzhis ka brag dkar rdzong brtsigs/ gzhan yang gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i rdzong dang / rin spungs rdzong / pa snam lhan grub rtse sogs rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs nas rdzong so sor rdzong dpon bsko bzhag dang / gsar du btsugs pa'i srid dbang sra brtan dang mnga' 'bangs bde ba'i lam du dkri byed dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce/ sne mo lasa'adzin gyi zhal lce/ zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi zhal lce/ bzung bkyigs khrimasara'i zhal lce/ nag can khrag cor kyi zhal lce/ dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhalalce/ rdzas khrag gi zhal lce/ spyon ham mna' dag gi zhal lce/ brkusapa 'jal gyi zhal lce/ nye 'brel 'bral bzloms kyi zhal lce/ byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce/ nas phar tshur gyi zhal lce ste gas 'brug sgrog pa'i zhal lce bco lnga dang bka' yig yid bzhin nor bu'i bang mdzod sogs gtan la phab yod/ khyad par bka' yig yid bzhin nor bu'i bang mdzod ces bya ba'i nang du‘‘rang — 264 —

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i ra/re'i sa cha dbang rigs thams cad du/ skye shing lcang ma skye nges 'bum phrag gnyis re/ lo re bzhin dam bca' byas nas 'a gas dgos shing / lcang khrims pa bskos nas rtsis len pa dang / zhun thar byed dgos 'di'i yon tan/ sde lha khang gsob/ lha sde mi sde'i khang pa zhig ral la song ba gsong/gru shan gsong sogs mi byed pa'i thabs med pas/ ka'adzad pa'i gter/gas nas/ byang chub kyi sems skyed la/ skye shing la snyegs pa'i do dam byed dgos/ yul dang lung pa thams cad skye shing ngan du song 'dug pas/bsnyal ma byed pa rnams kyang / nam zla'i dus dang bstun nas/ shing la rtsa 'gog ma byed/ zor ba dang lag cha non pos mtshams su bcad la/ bcad pa'i shul der/ shing skye ba'i thabs byed dgos/ zhes bod mis deng skabasabag med du shing gcod la zhugs te nags tsha loganod 'tshe chen po byung ba dang / bod kyi la lung thams cad skye shing nyung bas lung pa thams cad sngo ljang snumathing gi bcud dang bral stabs bod kyi sa cha thams cad las ltar nges par skye shing lcang ma 'bum phrag gnyis btsugs dgos pa dang / de dag la la las mi sna lcang khrims pa bsko bzhag gis rtsis len rtsis sprod zhib par byal slad kyi do dmal shugs ston rgyab rgyu/ shing gcod byed skabs kyang shing gi rtsa ba bkog mi chog par/ zor ba dang sta re sogs mtshon cha no por bsten nas yid zabang nga bcad de bcad shul der yang shing sdong mi skam pa'i thabs te 'jim pa sogs byug dgos pa/ lhag par bca' khrims de'i nang dulha sde mi sde'i khang pa zhig ral la song ba gsob dang / gru shan gsob sogs mi byed pa'i thabs med pas/ skomadzad pa'i gter skye shing —265—

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bal gas pa'i do dam byed dgos zhes bod mis shing la gsan gsagasobyed ba ni nan mi mdzad pa'i gter ste skye shing gi bskyar gsos nus pa la brten nas lugs mthun gyi sgo nas rang byung nus khungs bod spyod byed lugs sogasagal por bstan yod/gsum pa/ ri rgya klung rgya bsdams ba'i bca' khrims kyi skor/ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i bca' khrims ni mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs kyi sbyin pa gtong ra du skabs de'i srid gzhung gis par spyang dang bye ba phud/de bzhin skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog la sa che gci la yang gnod 'tshe michog pa'i bca' khrims la zer/ de yang srid 'dzin srid gzhung gis ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i bca' khrims de ni lo rgyus kyi khrims srol yig la dpyad gzhi byas na/ thog mar tā si tu chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi skye bo byings rnams kyi spyod la blang dor gyi rim pa zhes pa'i bka' shog nang du rgyun ldan gyi ri rgya klung rgya dam pa/ zla ba byung ngo cog dus bzang gsumadang / hor zla dang po dang / gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ brgyad pa rnams kyi tshesagacig nas bco lnga'i bar sangs rgyas kyi dus chen yin pas srog gcod spongs/thab khar sha gsar ma 'grim/ 'brog pa rnams kyis kyang tshes grangs 'di'i bar dmar khe lam 'gro khyi ra ba rnams kyis/ klung gi ri dwags ma dron/—266—

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rarngon pa ba rnams kyis srog ma gal ④ces bdag med sems can nyen khalas skyobs cing rang gnas su bde bar 'khod pa'i rṣa du ma re'i dus bzang gsum ste tshes brgyad/ tshes bco lnga/ gnam gang dang / de bas bo zadang po/ bod zagasum pa/ bod zla bzhi pa/ bod zabargyad brnams kyi tshel cig nas tshes bco lnga'i bar du 'brog pa rnams kyis dmar khol mi'agro ba dang / khye ra ba rnams kyis kyang gang byung du sems can loganod 'tshe byas mi cho pa'i ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i srol dar ba dang / de nas gtsang pa sde srid bstan skyongs dang nga po'i dus su gtan la phabs pa'i khrims yig zhal lce bcu drug nang dun na mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pas sems can bdag med sha rus pags pa'i phyir srog gis nyen pa rnams skyobs pa dang bde bar 'dug pa'i phyir cho 'phrul dus chen nas zla ba bcu'i bar ri rgya klung rgya bsdoms pa①zhes cho la bzla nga ste bod zla dang ponas bod zla bcu pa bar du gang byung du sems can la gnod 'tshe byas mi cho pa'i bca' khrims gtan la babs pa/ gzhan yang dga' ldan pho brang gis srid dbang bzung rjesasngar ltar ka'ajigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa gtong ba'i ri rgya klung rgya bsdomasapa'i srol 'di mnyams gong 'phel ngang brgyud 'dzin mdzad yod/de ltar tā la'i jam sku 'phreng lnga pa'i dus su gtan la phabs pa'i khrims yig zhal rtse bcu gsum nang dun na mi 'jigs bskyabs kyi sbyin pas① rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi rnam thar 〉 lcags dpar deb ngos 262① bod kyi snga rabs khrims srol yig cha bdams bsgrigs〉lhags dpar deb ngos80—267—

la kyi la ba nga sa nga nga sa mi ma ma nga bsems can bdag med spyang ki ma gtogs ri dwags nya sram rnams so sor rang gi gnas su bde bar 'tshos chog pa'i ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa gnang /mi’④de rjes dga' ldan pho brang srid gzhung gis mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa'i srol 'dir sngar las lhag pa'i mthong chen dang mthus rgya tshang du btang ste bca' khrims nang du 'khod pa'i ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i nang don rnams kun gyisamathong la du gyur ba'i rtsa tshig gi ngo bo'i thog nas lo ltar rdzong gzhis khag la bka' rgya bsdams pa'i srol zhig mchis shing de la ri klung rtsa tshig zhes dmangasagatso bcos bsgyur ma byas bar du mngon rgyu yod/don dbang sku zhabs bsod nams stongs rgyal lags kyis ngo sprod gnang bar gzhigs na/ bka' shag gong 'og gnyis kyis lo re'i bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i gong nas ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i rtsa tshig dang rgyab sgon thams can mnyam du rdzong gzhis khag la bzangs tshar ba byed kyi yod/ de yang ri klung rtsa tshig la cha mtshon na‘‘ bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi sa char 'khod pa'i ser skya mchog dman bar par bcas pa mtha' dag la bzlo ba/'jig rten gyi khams su phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi rtsa rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyag cig yin cing / bstan pa de yang tshal bzhin 'dzin pa chos byed dge 'dun la rag las na/ gdan sa chen po gsum gyis gtsosaris med dge 'dun gyi sde rnams gcig du thugs mthun pa'i sgo nas chos byed kyi rtsa ba 'dul khrims la gnas shing / thos bsam sgom gsum bshad sgrub ① 〈bod kyi snga rabs khrims srol yig cha bdams bsgrigs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 156— 268 —

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba sa pa tho pa'i ra'achad nyan gyis dus 'dang ba zhig nges par dgos gnas las ma las mi do dam bskul lcag rtsa 'dzin gang che dgos rgyu yin cing / rgyun gtan gnyan yod cho 'phrul mar pa'i dus ston hor zla dang po nas bzung bdun pa'i gnam gang bar phar spyang dang / byi ba phud/ de byings bya ri dwags/nya sram/ sgo nga / gcan gzan sogs mdor na bdag tsam bzung ba'i srog chags skam gsher du gnas pa che mthams cad la ri rgya klung rgya bsdamasa'akhos bgyis par drag gzhan sus kyang gnod 'gal du 'gro rigs bgyisamichog pa spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi rtsa tshig rim song de ltar yang / rdzong gzhis ste mob rnams nas don grub phyogs gtso 'don las mjun mnon do dam ji bzhin med pas lhod yang dang / 'go dmangs byings nas kyang spang blangs tshugs gnas yod kyi med chos bcas/ da sgos ngos ring du 'tsho zhing /bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs ched srog chags che mtshang ma'i srog la skad gcig kyang 'tsher ba med pas dam bsgrags bkod 'doms tsha nan dgos rgyu dang / gangs ljongs bde thabs lugs gnyis kyi lar rgya'i legasatshogs yar ldan 'byung ched rje gong ma rim byon dang / srid skyongs na rim bcas blangs dor gnad kyi rtsa tshig rim par stsal ba ma zad/ lo ltar ri klung rtsa tshig sgrigs chug tu 'gro mus kyang / dngan bde skyid kyi gshed ma 'ga' zhig nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang zung du 'brel ba'i dga' ldan pho brang pa'i lugs gnyis bka' khrims dang / chab 'bangs mtha' dbus kyi bde thabs ral bor du gtong ba sogs spyi khyab rtsa tshig dang 'gal ba'i tshulamin log spyod ji snyed cig yod 'dug pa/ da phyin drag gzhan su thad nas de — 269 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga b.rigs bgyis pa srid na 'di nas nyang gnon rtogs zhing dang 'brel bas go thos sam/ sa gnas sne sdod do bdag nasazhu 'bod byung ba sogs 'phrala'al rtsad dpyod thog nas 'gal ba po'i steng rtsa ra rgyangs 'bud dang / sarigs rgyu dngos gzhung len sogs skabs sbyar kyi nyes pa yan song med pa gtong nges bcas de rtsis dang gces theg pa 'khur len dgos rgyu dang / rtsa tshig 'di bzhin 'byor 'phral mnga' khul tshang mar don gnad re re bzhin go don 'phrod nges sgrogs sbyangs dang 'brel bas 'dor len 'dzol med byed rgyu'i gan 'doms thog 'di bya gnas tshu kyang 'al bsring dgos rgyur/ de don khyod gong 'khod tshang mas blangs dor 'dzol med la bzhin spyod pa bgyis/ zhes go bar bya ba'i dge stod 'brel gyi brda mas rna ba bzang po zhesal lcags mo yos lo'i rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes6 dge bar rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhan med pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris ①zhes par spyang dang byi ba phud de byings bya ri dwags/ nya sram/ sgo nga / gcan gzan sogs bdag du med pa'i srog la sa skam gsher du gnas pa che mthams cad la skad gcig tsam yang 'tshe ba gtan nas med pa bya rgyu dang / gal srid khrims 'gal de rigs byung tshe ‘'gal ba po'i steng rtsa ra rgyangs 'bud dang /sa rigs rgyu dngos gzhung len sogs skabs sbyar gyi nyes pa yan song med pa gtong nges bcas zhes khrims 'gal mi sna drag gzhan ci 'dra yin yang khrims gcod tsha dri nan po dang rgyangs 'phud gtong rgyu/ de bzhin sa rigs① ljongs yig tshags las khungs nas mkho 'don gnang /— 270 —

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rargyu dngos thams cad gzhung du bzhes pa sogs kyi gtan 'bebs na na pomadzad yod/ gzhan yang bgrod mi nyung ba'i lung khug tu 'ba'i thosami'atshor ba'i snang tshur mi thon phyir rdzong gzhis tshang mas nan tan gyi sgo nasamajug sgon chad lhag med par btang gi yod/ de yang rgyal rtse rdzong gis rgyang ru khul la bzangs ba'i mjug sgon la cha mtshon na/ ‘‘tho don/ ngos ring 'tsho dang / skye 'gro sdig 'bras kyi du ཿkhas nyamasang ba rnams bde skyid smin grol gyi lam du dkri slad skam gsher du gnas pa'i srog chags rnams la mi'ajig srog gi skyabs sbyin bgyis te lo ltar ri klung rtsa tshig mthu po che gtong mus ma zad/ sngon du nya 'dzin pa dang / ngang pa sogs 'dangs chags kyi sgo nga 'don len mi chog pa'i skor bkod rgya 'thus na na song ba bzhin blangasador 'dzol med byed pa gzhir bcas kyang / rgyang ru khul de lung khug tu song gshis mi go mi thos snyam pa'i rang bshed can gyi mi ngan 'ga' zhig nas nya sram/ ri dwags sogs skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags la 'tsher ba ci che med pa'i nges pa ka'adug pas re re bzhin ther 'don kyi nyes pa gcod dgos yang / sngon byas 'gyod sems kyi slad nas rang gces spang blangasabyed rgyu yod na snyams da lam ring 'then cing / phyin chad loganas so so'i 'go byed gtso rgan rnams nas dam pos dam bcings kyi de rigs gleng tsam med pa dgos rgyu dang / ci sto ri klung rtsa tshig gis mtshon bkod don ga phyir rtsi med byed mi'i rigs shar na byed gte rdzong khrims khungs su rtsis sprod thog rtsa 'dzin mig lar phan pa gcod ba las/ ngos 'dzin bag yangs su bzhag rigs shar tshe do bdag smos ci khyod rang yul gyi gtso rgan 'go byed dang /— 271 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga brdzong sdod bcas la'ang nyes pa phyis 'doms gcod dgos byung na mi legasapas/ tshang mas bod ljongs spyi'i bde thabs gal cher bsam gzhigs kyi spang blangs 'dzol med thog rgyal rtse rdzong sdod rim 'byor nas mjug gnon rgyab gnyer kyang lhod yangs ma song ba dgos rgyud/ de rtsis yid 'doms gyis/shing glang zla tshes la bris/ de ltar ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa'i rtsa la 'di bod kyi la gru yongs kyi skye bo pho mo rgan dar gzhon gsumatshang ma'i rna ba'i dbang pos thos thub la yid kyi dbang por yang rdo la ri mo bkod pa ltar byung nasabag med du sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed par gsos kyi bdud rtsi lta bur thub pa byung yod/bzhig pa/ dgon pa'i bca' yig gi skor/dgon pa'i bca' yig ni ston pa shākya thub bas gtan 'bebs mdzad pa'i dge la dang dge slong gi sdoms khrims gzhir bzung nas dus skabasasosodang / sa gnas khag gi dmigs gas gnas tshu dang bstun te bzosapa'i dgon pa'i chos khrims zhig la grags/ bod kyi dgon pa khag gi bca' yig nang du'ang gang byung du sems can gyi srog gcod pa/ dgos med kyisas brko rdo slog dang skye shing la gnod ba byed pa/ dwangs gtsang chu mo sbags par byed pa/ rngon rgyag byed pa/ de bzhin gang byung kha lud rna lud dang gad rnyigs dbyugs pa sogs tshu min bya ba dgag par byed pa'i chos khrimasamang po zhig gtan 'bebs gnang yod/ dper na〈rgyal rtse dgon kyi bslab —272—

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i rabya mdor bsdus pa'i khrims su bca' ba〉zhes pa'i nang du‘‘chos sde'i shar kyi rin chen sgang gi chu rgyud dang brag nag po lho'i brag 'og dbyen zlum mchod rten dang / la btsas/ nub kyi btsad skor ma ṇi sgang / byang gi brag skya la kharnams kyi khongs su/ ri dwags rngon pa dang / tshong pa sogs kyis dud 'gro'i srog bcad pa sogs byung na/ mang ja 'bul ba dang bcas pa'i chad pa 'gel/ gong gi sa khongs su sha'i phyir dud 'gro bsad pa'am/ tshong pa'i sna rten byas pa byung na/ dkar mo zho gsum re'i chad pa 'gel/ gzhan yang mnga' zhabs kyi ri rgya klung rgya rgyun du bsrung rgyu/ pho mo'i nya rgya/ chu mig shelamago'i nya srung / dkar ma'i nya rags mig sdom/ mtsho mo bris thung nya ragasagasob/ de thad du dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur nya kha bslu ba/ gzhan yang mnga' zhabs kyi ri rgya'i bca' tshig rang rang na yod pa rnams 'phral du dam zhing / phugs su rgyun sring ba'i do dam so rtogs dgon pa so so'i bla yode bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams dang / gtso cher chos sde nas dpon slob rnams kyis mdzad ①ces dang / 〈smin grol gling gi bca' yig〉nang du ‘‘gling gi phyi rol du yang dgos med kyis sa brko/ rdo slog skye shing gcod rgyu/chu rags dang skyed tshal sogs la gnod pa byas pa byung na steng gos bshu ba dang / mar rtse phyag sogs nongs pa che chung la dpag pa'i dran 'dzin btang snyoms sum lus pa byed 3④ces dang / 〈'bri gung byang chub gling gi bca' ① (rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi rnam thar〉lhags dpar deb ngos 198④ (bod kyi snga rabs khrims srol yig cha bdams bsgrigs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 393— 273 —

nge kyi sbom ba sa nga nga sa kyi zang pa nga bayig〉nang du dgon gyi nye 'dangs kyi shing che mthams cad gcod breg byed pa/ ri klung gi srog chags che chung gang yang gsod 'jug pa de ltar spang bya ldog pa'i rim pa rnams las byung zad re 'gal yang / chos khrims pa gnyis nas btang snyoms sum bzhag par 'os mtshams kyi bkod 'domasabyed dgos/ ④zhes dang / yang 〈gong ra nges gsang rdo rje gling gi bca' yig〉nang du gling gi lam srang dang chu mgo sogs su bshang gci ka'ador/'du khang gi rtseg pa ka ba sogs la mchil snangs mi 'dor ①zhes dang / de bzhin〈li thang byams chen phyogs thams cad rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi bca' khrims〉nang du rgyang grags gcig tshun gyi ri klung gsems can rngon pa bsrungs te ka'ajigs pa'i sbyin pa ltar ①zhes gang byung du srog migacod pa/ dgos med du sa brko rdo slog mi byed pa/ skyed tshal la gnod 'tshe meebatong ba/ bshang rdzi dang rna lud gsad gang byung du dbyugs mi chog pa/chu mgo sbags ba'i ga tsun btang ba/ rngon rgyag la rngon 'gog bya dgos pa sogs kyi gtan 'bebs mang po mdzad yod/logazhi bca' yig de dag dgon sde khag gi 'dul khrims la gzhigasate gtan 'bebs byas pa zhig lags kyang rgya che' dad ldan mang tshogs ni ① (bod kyi snga rabs khrims srol yig cha bdams bsgrigs〉lcags dpar deb ngos 403① (spyi bye brag legs nyes 'byed pa'i bca' yig lam yig sko 'ja' sogs bkod pa khrims gnyis gser shing phun tshogs 'dod 'jo〉lcags dpar deng ngos 111① (spyi bye brag legs nyes 'byed pa'i bca' yig lam yig sko 'ja' sogs bkod pa khrims gnyis gser shing phun tshogs 'dod 'jo〉lcags dpar deb ngos 143— 274 —

bo kyi snga rabs mas srol bca' yi sa rang nga ra yu la ba nga sa pa tho pa'i ra/sangs rgyas kyi sde dang / chos kyi sde/ dge 'dun kyi sde ste mchog gsum kyi sde la rtse gcig skyabs cing gsol ba dang / mchog gsum gyi sde'i mdzad 'phrin ni rang gi bsam spyod spang blangs kyi tshad 'dzin nam mig dpe kon ra 'dzin kyi yod stabs dgon pa'i bca' khrims de dag kyang mang tshogs kyis ma skularang bzhin ngang du mchog tu bkur ba'i sa bon lta bur gyur te bod mi'i bsam spyod thad sngar las lhag pa'i lhad med dwangs gtsang du gyur rgyur phan pa chen po byung yod/ de yang rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyis‘‘thun mongasa'adul ba'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i kun spyod rnams byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung bas kyang gnang nga'i skabs ma gtogs bsrung dgos la gzhan yodad pa bskyed pa khyem pa'i sems dpas kyang bsrung dgos pas/ kha 'dru ba'i so shing dang mchil yodag dor ba ni sal sogs pas dgab par bya zhing /bshang gci dang snangs la sogs pa thun mong du longs spyod pa'i chu dang thang la dor ba lha la sogs pas smad par 'gyur bas dor mi bya'o/mi ④ gzhan yang ‘‘bod kyi dgon pa che khag gi bca' yig nang du/ phyi rol yul du dgos med kyis sa brko rdo slog dang / skye shing gcod pa dang rku ba/ chu rags bshig pa dang / skyed tshal brlag pa sogs khor yug loganod pa byas pa byung na/gnod pa de 'dra byed mkhan gyi steng gos bshu bdang / mar rtse phyag sogasanongs pa che chung la dpag pa'i dran 'dzin btang snyoms sum lus pa byed pa'i srol rgya chen po dar ba las khyim pa rnams la'ang khor yug brko slog mee④ (spyod 'jug rtsa 'grel〉lhags dpar deb ngos213— 275 —

la la la ba la sa nga nga sa la la sa nga ba/byed pa'i bzang shugs thebs pas/ bod kyi pho brang dang / dgon pa/ khyem pa'i khang pa sogs kyi nye 'dab kyi rtsi shing che mthams cad gcod bregasameebyed pa dang / ri klung gi srog chag sgyu ma che chung gang yang gsod da rung ba'i bsam spyod rgya che bar chags so/1mi①mdor na/ bod kyi btsan po'i dus nas bzung dus skabs mi 'dra ba'i srid 'dzin srid gzhung gis skabs so so'i gnasang bas dang bstun pa'i rang byung khor yug gi bdag skyong thad nus pa chen po thon pa'i rmad du byung ba'i phul byung bca' khrims mang po gtan la 'bebs yod/ de ltar rang re'i mes pos srid 'dzin khrims lugs kyi gnya' shing btsan por brten nasarang byung khor yug gi bdag skyong thad sems nus yod rgu bton pa 'di ni rigs gzhan la cung mthong bar dka' ba'i mdzad 'phrin rlabs po che 'ba' zhig yin pas phyis rabs skye bo la ngos nas bshad na spobs pa skyes dgosapa zhig yin la dus mtshungs slob spyong bya dgos pa'i mig dpe bzang po 'ba' zhig kyang yin/—① (sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi spyi don gsar dpyad〉lcags dpar deb ngos 221— 276 —

sa bcad bcoXbargyad/ rang byung khoraXyug dang 'brel ba'i srol rgyun brtsam bya'i skor/gangs ri ra bas 'khor mo yongs su bskor ba'i khyad 'phags kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir mi lo stong phrag du ma'i lo rgyus ldan yod la gzi byin rnamapar 'phro ba'i rig gnas bang mdzod nang sgra dang bzo/ tshad yodang nang rig pa/ gsob rig pa dang snyan ngag mngon brjod dang sdeb spyor/ zlosagar dang dkar rtsis sogs sngon byon mes po'i shes rab kyi rtsal bzang po lasa'akhrungs ba'i zla med nor bus khengs yod/ de bzhin las la brtson zhing blogros rgyas pa'i rgya che'i bod skomang tshogs kyis kyang snyan zhing 'jigs la go don zab pa'i dmangs khrod rig gnas dmangs gzhas/ dmangs sgrung /gtam dpe sogs kyang ha cang phun sum tshogs po gsar gtod byas yod/lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig brtsam bya'i nang du rang byung khor yug dang 'brel ba'i brjod bya'i nang don gyi 'bor tshad ni shin tu mang po yod/ de yang bod kyi rtsom rig nang du 'khod pa'i rtsi shing sbog chags kyi brtsam bya'i skor gleng skabs/ thog mar rtsom pa po'i rang rtogs kyi rtsom sgrung skor dang / de nas— 277 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la srang bdamangs sgrub / dmangs gzhab/ gtam dpe/ zhar byung du bod kyi tha snyad mngon brjod sogs kyi skor gleng ba la/dngas po/ rtsom pa po'i rab rtogs kyi rtsam sgrung skor/bod kha ba'i ljongs kyi rig gnas sa gzhi gshin por yang mi rigasagazhan dang 'dra ngar srog chags dang rtsi shing la sbyar ba'i rtsam sgrung mang dag cig myu gu rgyas te 'bras bu yongs su smin thub pa byung yod/ dper na/rdzogs chen dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa'i 〈gtam pad ma'i la gyi zlos gar 〉dang / rdo ring bka' blon bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i 〈bya la gtam rgyud 〉dang / zhabs 'bring pa blobazang la khrims kyis mdzad pa'i〈rdza tshig gtam rgyud 〉de bzhin〈g.yag lug ra phag gi gtam rgyud 〉dang / 〈bsam yas bya de dkar po 〉gzhan yang deng skabs rtsom pa po rnam grol gyis mdzad pa'i〈char shul kyi nagasal 〉dang / dpal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i〈tsetog rdzum rwa'i nang gi klan ka 〉o rgyan rdor rjes mdzad pa'i〈phrag dog can gyi co ka 〉mgon po dngosagrub kyis mdzad pa'i〈spo bo blo khrul dang / khyi/ zhim bu bcas kyi gtamargyud 〉sogs mang dag zhig yod/ de dag gi khrod nas gna' rtsom〈bya sprelagatam rgyud 〉'di nyid skar tshogs mang po'i khrod du 'od mdangs rab tu 'tsher ba'i nyi za lta bu zhig yin stabs/ stod mnga' ri skor gsum dang /bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug bcas bod kyi la gru —278—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rakun la grags pa'i ba dan shin tu g.yo ba'i khyad 'phags rtser son gyi rab rtogs brtsam bya 'ba' zhig lags/ rtsom 'di ni bcad lhug spel ma'i rnam pa'i thog nas gleng ba zhig yin pa dang / brjod bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs la rjod byed skad cha bab chags pa/ brda dag rnying pa'i mdud pasamabacings bar go sgal tshig spyor ha cang bde stabs klog ba po'i yid kyi dngang por bag chags zab la 'dzin bde ba'i khyad chos shig kyang ldan yod/ de yang 〈bya sprel gtam rgyud〉kyi rjod khya'i nang don dang rjod byed tshig gi snyan 'jeb skor ngo sprod rags tsam zhusan/ sngon yum bkris mdzes dga'i yul gyi ri bo kun bzang zhes rtsa ba nags 'dangs dang / sked pa spang ri1 rtse mogangs kyis brgyan pa zhig yod/ ri de'i rtse mor seng ge dkar shi/ sgang ri la lha bya gong mos gtsos bya rigs sna tshogs dang / rtsa ba la stag gzig dom dred la sogs pa'i gcan gzan sna tshogs kyis dngas yod/ nags tshal de'i khul zhig na spre'u sprin gyi sgra can sogs spre'u mang dag cig gnas yod/spre'u de dag nam zhig tsam na gnas bdag gir du bzung ba'i tshur gyis gnas/de nas spre'u khag nas spang ri la phyin nas ye tog dang ser sha speng rgyan sogasaci dgar longs su spyod bzhin mchis/ de nas bya byi'u rnams spre'u yis rang gi sa khongs su btsan 'dzul byas par ma dga' bar rang gi sa khongs bdag skyongs ched du btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed pa'i las ka'i sgo btsugs pa dang /bya rnams gros byas nas lha bya gong sgomang gas te spre'u rnams la 'di ltar smrasaso‘‘kye kye/ grogs po spre'u rnams la zer rgyur/ ri kun bzang zer bde'i rtse mo seng ges bdag tu bzung / sked pa bya yis bdag tu bzung / rtsa ba — 279 —

la kyi la 'a la sa nga nga sa mi la la nga bgacan gzan gyis bdag du bzung ba de ltar la/ khyed rnams nged 'dab chags kyis bdag tu bzung ba'i spang ri la don med 'khyams nyul du 'ongasanas/ rtsa ba tsetog 'bras bu sogs la snang med du longs spyod byed pa de ltar dngos pas/ da phyin cad bag yangs kyi tshu po rdo du yongs nas bza' btung la bdag gir du bed spyod byed par mi rigs so/mi ①zhes smras pas spre'u rnamasamidaga' ba'i gad mo bgad pa dang / de nas spre'u tshogs kyi spre'u gtso bo des de ltar smras so‘‘kye kye/ lha bya gong mo snyan gson cig ri ye rgyal po kun bzang 'di/ rtsa ba dbang chen gser la thug sked pa yan la sa steng sbebs/ de spyi mthun las kyis grub pa la/ sger gyis bdag po sprod don med/ rtse laseng ge gnas na yang / rang bzhin las kyis gnas pa las/ seng ges rin gyi nyos pa min/ sked par bya tshogs gnas na yang / rang bzhin las kyi gnas pa dang / gcig 'dus gnyis 'dus tshogs pa las/ sus kyang khyod la phul ba min/ rtsa bar gcan gzan gnas na yang / las kyis skye ba blangs pa las/ gser dang dngul gyis bsgrubs ba min/ nged spre'u gnasa'adir skyes pa yang / tshe sngon las kyis 'phangs pa las/ sus kyang bos nasayong ba min/ des na ri 'di'i rtsa rtse dang / skyes shing nags tsho 'bras bu dang / rtsi thog rtse tog la sogs pa/ rang cag thun mong dbang ba la/ sger gyis dgag bya byed don med/ spyi nor sger gyis bsrungs pa de/ khamachu rtsod pa'i snga ltas yin/ spyi zhing sger gyis btab pa de/ 'thab mo'i sgo ka'abyed ① (bya spel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos2— 280 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rapa yin/ spyi zas sger gyis za ba de/ ltogs 'gong snying la zhugs pa yin/khyod smra ba ma mang gdogs sdod/ don de tsho sems la mnga' mdzod la/khong 'dab chags yongs la lan de skyol ①zhes smras par de la lha bya gong mosakyang lan 'di ltar smras so‘6khyed spre'u gtso bo tshur la nyon/ khyod phyogasagacig mthong ste gnyis ma mthong / don gyi rtse mo shes kyang mthil ma rtogs/ha ma go ril ril 'di/ don nyag la bkag na rang la 'khor/ ri spyi mthun las kyis grub mod kyang / gnas so sor bdag po sprad pa de/ khyod khra chung mig gis ma mthong ngam/ thos chung rna bsam go 'am/ yul 'dzam bu gling 'dir dpe mtshon na/ spyi mthun las kyis grub na yang / rgya gar rgya nag hor dang bod/ li dang ba la yum pa sogs pa/ rang rang dbang re so sor yod/ rgya gar chos kyi rgyal pos bzung / rgya nag tsi na rgyal pos bzung /hor sog jing gir rgyal pos bzung / li yul yam bu rgyal pos bzung / de tsho khyod kyis ma shes sam/ rang rang las kyis bkod pa zhes/ khyod kyisaṣanabs ba de/ shin nyung de na te dkar nag gi las kyi ri mom bris pa'i/rgyu med 'bras bu 'byung mi srid/ las kyi ri mom brkos na/ rang dang gzhan gyi dbye ba byung / nga la brten nasang ye 'dzin/ de la brten nasa'akhor ba 'dir/ thog med dus nas 'khor no zhes/ ston pa sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'das/ gsungs pa sngon khyod ma shes sam/ shes na rang cag sems can la/ bdag ka'adzin pa yod bsan/ bdag gir 'dzin pa'ang ① (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos3— 281 —

la kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bshugs la byung / khyod bdag gir 'dzin pa spong 'dod na/ rang semasabadag med gtan la phob/ gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba la/ ham pa thob shag byed mi nyan/ rang rang dbang ba'i sa cha la/ rang nor rang gis bdag po sprod/ de ltar byas na 'thab rtsod med/ gyod dang kha mchu bu lon med/de e bden dang de na khyod rang soms ①zhes smras par spre'u gtso bo des de la skabs thog gi lan ji ltar rgyab dgos pa'i spongs pa dang bral te rang gnasas log phyin pa dang / de nas spre'u'i dpon 'bangs rnams tshogs nas dang po'i kha mchu 'byung rkyen dang 1 de nas lha bya gong mos gtam ji ltar lang ྾ sogs zhing par shod skabs spre'u'i tshogs kyi lang 'tsho dar la babs pa rnamasakyis‘‘pho re re la lus po re re yod/ lus po re la lus rtsal re re yod/ kho'adab la sa lcags las bzos pa min/ nged spre'u mar las bzos pa min ④zhes 'dab la sa rnams dang 'khrugs 'dzing bya dgos pa'i ltab bstan pa dang / yang spre'u'i tshogs kyi nyams myong phyug pa rnams kyis‘3bden rdzun brtag dpyad ma byas na/ pho gsar ngar de khye ngar yin/ rdo dbyug pa gnyis kyi spyan 'dren yin/ rgyab mdun la mig kyang ma bltas pa'i/ pho gsar gyi mchong de g.yang la lhang / mgo dang rkang lag gi chag sgo yin/ chu chen gyi zheng la ma bltas pa'i/ pho gsar gyi rkyal de spyo rkyal yin/ 'chi 'dod kyi snga ltas ston pa yin/ de bas sprel rgan nga yod la nyon/ las bya ba ④ (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lhags dpar deb ngos 4 ① (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 7— 282 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rabazang ngan gang la yang / don drang por bcad na mdzangs pa yin/ rang 'dod dang ham pa g.yo sgyu gsum/ 'phral lam du 'gro yang phugs mi brtan1lha dkon mchog gsum po dbyings nas khrel/ las rgyu 'bras 'phrang la de skothar/ tshe 'di la sus kyang cha 'jog med/ tshe phyi ma dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong / pho thabs rdugs kyis las kyi don mi mthong / rgyu de bsams drang por los la spyod/ pho nga yis bsam gno btang ba na/ dus da lan pyod kyi gzhi rtsa de/ dgra tshur gol ma red phar rgol red/ kho 'dab chags bya yesacha la/ nged spre'u sa lha lung la 'dre lag brkyangs/ de ma byed zer ba los de bden/ bden bzhin rdzun rgyab ham pa byas/ pyod med par pyod gzhi 'di gyur na/ rtse chung chung gis ri bo rtsel bsregs/ chu chung ༅ gis lung pa chu yis khengs ①zhes 'dab chags kyi sa char btsan 'dzul bya medagos pa'i ltab bstan/ de nas spre'u rnams gros du ma byas mthar sprel rgan rnams kyisabashad pa yang phibade na ba min 'dug pyod dang khamachu med na los dga'/'on te lan gcig lan gnyis rang la bden kha'i byin na'ang dngos 'brel ngo yang tsha zhes gsang phyin pa'i spre'u rnams slar yang lha bya gong mo'i 'gram du phyin nas‘‘kye kye/ grogs po lha bya gong mo tshur gson dang / gsang rang re phar tshur gtam gleng ba'i/ don de rnams༅'i tshogs la smras/ khong rgan gzhon mtha' dag tshogs nas kyang / gros zengs gcig ma yin gnyis gsum byas/ gros zhing cing brtag par byas pa'i tshe/ pho re re'i gnas gtam re ④ 〈bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 9— 283 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babatang / mo re re'i kha nas gru re blangs/ de tham cad lab pas ga nas zin/don rdog rtsa gcig tu bsgril ba la/ khong spre'u tshogs kyis 'di ltar gleng /ri mthon po ri bo kun bzang 'di/ sngon srid pa chags pa'i ri ma gtogs/dus deng sang glo bur byung ba min/ seng ge dang ri dwags 'dab chagasasogs/ pha a ma'i yang mes dus skyes nas/ ri 'di la las kyis 'khor ba las/ dus deng sang gzhan nas 'ongs pa min/ sngon bskal pa'i thog ma chags pa nas/ dus kha sang de ring phan chod la/ khyod 'dab chags rang re ri dwags rnams/ rtsa mnyam za chu mo mnyam 'thung la/ phar rtsod tshur rtsod gang yang med/ de e yin ma yin khong tshor dris/ dus da lo'i dus kyi nyi ma la/ khyod bya rnams rna ba rnying pa la/ gtam gsar pa zer ba ji lta thos/nged spre'u sdod pa'i nags la yang / khyod bya tshogs yong dang yong bzhin yod/shing 'bras za dang za bzhin yod/ tshur za dang phar za 'dra 'dra yin/ susasul sdug yus byed rgyu med/ da yang tig gtam gyi rdog kha la/ snga sad la gnas pa bzhin/ byas na gyod dang khamachu med/ sngar med gsar srol byed zer na/ de lugs zhabs phyi zhus pas chog mtho la tshad na mtho la tshad/'dom la 'jal na 'dom la 'jal/ 'di 'dra'i lan zhig skyol shog zer/de nyan na rna ba'i bu ram red/ ma nyan tshig ga dkrug shing red/ ④cesabashad par lha bya gong mos kyang lan 'di ltar 'debs so/‘6spre'u gros nyan 'ongs pa tshos/ gtam smras nged kyi sems la 'chang / gtam de la gtam① (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lhags dpar deb ngos 12— 284 —

rang nga ra nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ralan 'jal shes kyang / nged bya tshogs stong khrag mang po yod/ nga gcig gisagatam lan 'jal mi rigs/ pho rabs gcig gi blo rtse las/ pho 'bring gsum gyi gros bzang dga'/ zer ba gna' bo'i gtam dpe yod/ nged 'dab chags bya rgyalas byug yin/ ri rabs mthon po'i rtse na bzhugs/ de la zhus thub ma song yang / thang dkar rgod pom na chad nas/ mdang skyesabyi'u yan chad kyi1 bya che chung tshang ma gros la bsdus/ gtam mgo mthosamed par bshad/ gros 'go shes rab can kyis brtsams/ gros thag bsod nams can gyis bcad/ nged 'dang chags gnas pa'i sa cha la/ rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad yod/ de tham cad gros la 'tshogs pa la/ zhag gcig dang gnyis la 'dus sa med/ khyod spre'u mang yang sbar mo gang / gros byasapa'i blo rtse nga yis shes/ da zla ba gcig gnyis sgug sdod kyis/ nged bya tshogs gros thag chod mtshams la/ khong smra mkhan rte tso 'bod la gtong / de bar du khyod tsho log la rgyug sprel rgan shing rtser zug yong ngo / sprel phrug g.yang la lhung yong ngo / sprel mgo lhag pas 'khyer yong ngo / sprel mjug dbyug gus 'bud yong ngo / sprel zasarba ba la ril yong ngo / sprel skyag ṣalashor yong ngo / don de tsho'i rigs la ca ga gyis ④zhes lan btab/ de ltar 'dab gas tshogs dang spre'u'i gas gnyis phan tshun rtsod gzhi drag po thengs mang byas kyang gdal nang gi rtsed la dang lab lab smra mchu gzan pa'i dpe ltar don gyi snying po gang yang ma byung / de dang de ye mtshams su spre'u'i ④ (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos13— 285 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bakhrod na sprel gzhon don grub zer nga blo rig gal ba zhig yod pa 'dis de ltar smras son na kyi kye/ sprel rgan blo bzang gis gtsos mdzad pa'i/ spre'u rgan gzhon bar gsum thams cad gson/ nga sprel gzhon don grung zer ba de/pho lo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis yin/ pho rgan gras la ma slebs te/ blo grosazamo phal cher shes/ steng ma lhan spyod 'gros shes/ mgo nag min bya spyod shes/ dud 'gro phyugs kyi skyid sdug shes/ de shes tsha lag du len le min/dran tshad kha nas 'don le min/ 'gag la thug dus ma la ba na/ blo grosakhog pa'i nang du rgas/ shing bzang lpags pa'i nang du rul/ dgos dus mi phan don med red/ da nga yis gros gtam kha shas zhu/ de o red ma red dgongs pas cho / bya la gnyis kyi gyod gzhi 'di/ rtsa ba che cher 'dra zer te/ bltas na rtsa ba chung chung red/ rgya che chung 'di 'dra byed mi byed/ da ltaso so'i lag ka'adug kho 'dab la sa gnam la 'phur na yang / 'bab dus sa gzhi'i steng du 'bab/ sdod sa ri dang nags las med/ gnam la 'phur rtsal yod na yang / sal babs dus lus kyi rtsal/ yod med kun gyis shes gas red/ pho rgod zhan la dgos zer na/ sku pyong bya la ma byung na/ spre'u la de tsam yong don med/ don yin lugs bshad na de 'dra red/ de yin kyang pyod dang 'thab mo de/ med na phan tshun gnyis ka bde'adum na phan tshun gnyis ka dga'/ dga' ba'i dga' lugs shod zer na/phan tshun mthun zhib byung zer na/ 'gro ba bde la sdod pa bde nyal na skyid la zas na zhim/ des na 'dum na 'dum pa legs/ 'dum pa'i skad cha gtong lugs de/ rang res zer lugs med 'dug kyang / ri la 'khor ba'i —286—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rari dwags dang / gcan gzan sder chags sna tshogs kun/ ri dwags khongasatshogatogs pa na/ ri dwags gzhan gyis la ba gyur na/ mdzes kyang mdzesala'adra yang chags/ lab na ka'agrig yong don med/ ①ces zer bas 'di 'khod kyi spre'u tshang ma'i yid la shin tu babs po byung / de nas spre'u rnamasakyis ri dwags sha ba/ dgo ba/ gna' ba/ ri bong sogs gcan gzan 'phar spyang stag gzig sogs la bya sprel dbar gyi 'gyod gzhi'i byung rkyen dang /da tsho gnas tshugasogs zhing par bshad pa dang dus mchos blo ldan ri bong la 'dang chags dang spre'u'i dbar 'dus sgrig rgyu'i re bzhu skabasang gcig po phyin na ri dwags kyi khongs su gtogs pas bya rnams yid ches dka' ba dang /ga la lha kyid nga dang mnyam du khyim bya de pho 'di slebs byung na nga gnyis kyis khyed tsho'i dbar la 'grig thabs byas chog ces mkhas blangs/ de nas ri bong bloldan dang khyem bya de po gnyis bya tshogs kyi khrod du phyin nas 'di ltar smrasaso‘‘kye kye/ rgod dang go bo bya glag sogs/ bya chen rnams kyis dbus su zhugs/bya 'bring rnams kyis gzhung nas 'brang / bya phran rnams kyis mtha' nasabaskor/ bya gral sgor mong 'dra'i dbus/ nged de pho ri bong blo ldan zhes/nyam chung sa 'og 'bu 'dra bas/ gtam dang bshad bshad zhu rgyu 'di/dma' sa nas mtho bcos byas 'dra bas/ babs mtshungs po rang ni mee'adug kyang / sems dkar po gangs ri mthon po 'dra/ lus dkar po dar dkar zho 'thung 'dra/ gtam dkar po 'o gzho chags 'dra/ dkar po rnam ① (byu sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 34— 287 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bgasum 'dzoms pa yin/ gtam pi wang snyan po'i rang sgra 'di/ khyed rnamasakyi snyan la gson cing dgongs/ bya sprel sa/nyis kyi pyod gzhi 'di/ da phyin chad 'grig thabs tshul la gnas/ dgongs pa en tsam ma bzhes na/'grig pa'i 'jog po ma mchis pas/ da nged gnyis zhus pa'i tshig la gson/ri 'di la gnas pa'i spre'u rnams/ sdod yon gsal gnas na yang / bza' rgyu speng ri'i log nas za/ spang rir bza' sa med zer na/ spre'u rnamasastotshe phyi le med/ de yang spang ri'i logs 'di nas/ rtswa dang rtsi tog 'brasasnatshogs/ thams cad spre'u yis spyad gyur na/ 'dab chags thugs nad ga nas theg don de la rtsod pa chung ra du/ spangs ri'i gas sum cha gcigaspre'u la gsol ras gnang rogs mdzod/ de las bgos ba'i spang ri la/spre'u tshos za rgyug spyod gsum po/ mi byed skad cha nga tsho bshad/ don de khyed rnams gsan gyur na/ spre'u sa mi nyan byed dogs med/ de 'dra dgongayopa'i dkyil la zhugs/ thag chod lan zhig gnang rogs mdzod ga④cesabashad par bya ye tshogs rnams mi dga' bar gyur ba dang / de la pho nog nag chung gis lan 'di ltar smras so/ ‘‘kye kye/ blo ldan rnam gnyis tshur la gson/rnam gnyis thugs sems gangs ri 'dra/ 'dra bsam tshad dngos rang red/thugs sems la lhad skyon med na yang / gsung de la mi 'dra hrung zhig 'dugade yod pa'i yod lugs shod zer na/ 'di na bya tshogs yod pa de/ semasayod kun gyis shes gas red/ de yin na bya gas cha las/ sum cha gcig ④ (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 42— 288 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i raspre'u la sprod zer ba'i1 gtam 'di 'dra gsung ba ci 'dra red/ bden yod bya yis cha de/ bden med spre'u la sprod zer ba/ gal te bya yesaphyed de/ khong spre'ur nyo tshong byed zer na/ rin la ji 'dra sprod rgyu red/skyin bag 'dra sprod rgyu red/ de lan gas por gsung rogs mdzod/ ’①ces zer bar khyem bya de phos‘‘ da gson dang zhu rgyu 'di 'dra yod/ 'dab chags bya yos cha nas/ spre'u la sprod dgos zer ba de/ bya lasdug pyong gtong rtsis min/ 'grig chags kyi gtam 'go 'dzugs lo yin/de la rin skyin dgos zer na/ skyin tshab sprod dgos los kyang bden/ skyin tshab ji 'dra yod zer na/ spre'u rnams gnas pa'i nags chos du/ 'dab chags che chung sna tshogs kyi/ bya tshang grangs kyis mi langs pa/ sngar yang yod la da yang 'byung / de spre'u'i sa cha e yin lags/ yin na de la rin dang spyin/ sngar phan ji 'dra sprad le yin/ da phyin sprod rgyu yod dam med/ med na nags nas 'dang chags rnams/ sdod sa sgo thabs ci mi yong / spo thabasalar nas mi 'dug na/ sngar rgyun mi sdod ka med yin/ don 'di'i rigs kyi bya ba la/ rang sar phibazhag bsam blo thongs/ skos ra rang bzhag bsamablothongs1 btang na bden rdzun shes nas yong / phyogs gcig mthong stoganyis ma mthong / g.yag zhar bsad za ma yin no/ tshig de tshor brtag dpyad mdzad shes na1 drang mi drang gi gnas lugs shes pa'o ①zhes bshad ④ (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 43① (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 44— 289 —

la la la la la sa nga nga sa la la la nga bapar bya rgyal rgod po de yang yid rangs nas tha la kyi la 'di ltar smras so/kho re 'dab chags bya tshogs nyon/ da res bya spre'u gling gzhi 'dir/ ri bong de pho gnyis po yis/ 'grig chags btang ba'i tshig de la/ ma drang bsam pa lar nas med/ gtam der brtag dpyad byas pa na/ drang po tshangs pa'i thig shing red/ las de las drang zhing tshad pa zhig lha tshang pa 'ongs kyang bya rgyu med/ don de la phan tshun gnas zer na/ bkris dang lugs legs gnyis ka yong / nga mthon po brag rtser bsdad na yang / mig rgyang gis ri klung thams cad mthong / sgang ri dang nags ri'i gnas tshu shes/ 'dab chags dang spre'u'i skyid sdug shes/ don de la spre'u sa nyan shag red/ de nyan na rang re 'dab chags la/ pyong dang gun zhig ye nas med/bya che chung kun la phan nges red/ de bya la sa rnams kyi sems la zhog thag gtsang mde la la par mdzod ④ces bshad/ de nas spre'u'i tshogs kyis ri bong blo ldan dang khyim bya de phor pyod 'dum 'grig gnang bar thugs rje che zhus pa dang / dus de nas bzung bya sprel tham cad gong gi gan rgya 'di lasami 'gal bar/ phan tshun thams cad shin tu 'cham mthun ldan la/ bde skyid bkris ldan par 'gyur to/de yang 〈khya la gtam rgyud〉nang du rtsom pa pos gson nyams ldan la yid kyi dngang po cig car nyid du 'gug par nus pa'i rjod byed tshig gi spyor ba la brten nas sprel rgan blo bzang dang spre'u gzhon yon ma/ de bzhin smra ① bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lhags dpar deb ngos 45—290—
