rang nga ra yu nga 'bril ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ramakhas ni tso dang lha bya gong mo sogs kyi gzugs brnyan dang rang gshes klog pa po'i 'dren byed lam du glog brnyan bstan pa ltar ji mji bzhin mngon par byas yod/ dper na spre'u'i rigs kyi rang gshis gi skabs su rtsomathapos‘‘kho spre'u zer ba'i byed mang de/ ri dwags dkyil nas drags min/ pho rgod ma yin tha ma yin1 byed rgyu gla ba'i spu las mang / sdod tshugs nyin mo'i skar las nyung / kun la ga dgra sna dgra bsags/ bzhag na ma slebs dgu la slebs/ ded na shing gi rtse la bros/ gdang lag pa rkang pa gsum/ sdod pa'i gnas skabs khol med/ bya mang byur gyi sna 'dren yin/ khamang dgra bo'i g.yab shing yin/mi①zhes spre'u rigs sdod tshugs med la bya byed mang ba/gzhan la kha dgra bsags rgyur dga' la dpa' blo khog de tsam med pa'i spre'u'i rang gshis gsal por ston yod/ de nas spre'u'i tshogs kyis bya gas khongasas btsan 'dzul bya skabs bya rnams mi dga' bar gyur nas‘‘nga tsho'i sa char spre'u sa la lung la 'dre lag brkyangs/ da dung mda' brgyab pas mi chog gzhu chog ngoms/ mdung brgyab pas mi chog bdan ngoms/ rdo btang bsaskochog lag ngar bsgrengs/ mig bltas pas mi chog mig log bgrad’mi④cesaspre'u'i tshogs kyis 'dab chags rigs la brnyas bcos rkang brkyangs lag brkyangs byed lugs rnams rjod byed tshig gi spyor ba nyung yang don gyi mdog kha ma gyur ba'i sgo nas gsal por bstan thub pa byung yod/ gzhan yang sprel ④ (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 17④ (bya sprel gtam rgyud〉lcags dpar deb ngos 14

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga bas kyi ra la nga brgan blo bzang gleng nga'i skabs su blo sgam zhing mig rgyang ring ba/ skad cha bshad skabs thog mar khal byil byil lan gsum byas pa/ lag pa g.yasarked par 'degs pa dang / g.yon pa pus mo'i steng du 'jog pa/ spre'u gzhon ga li ma gleng ba'i skabs su lag ngar bsgrengs pa dang mjug ma g.yug g.yug byed pa/ de bzhin smra mkhas ni tso ni smra mkhas shing ngag 'jam pa/skad bya'i nang don phun sum la sal tshig gi spyor ba snyan zhing 'jeb pa lhabya gong mo gleng ba'i skabs su/ sngon la gshog pa rdeb rdeb lan gsum byas pa dang / de nas gzhi nas skad cha shod pa sogs ri skyes srog chags de dag gi rang gshis dang gzugs brnyan zhib par bkod yod/mdor na/ bod kyi rtsom pa po'i brtsam bya rang rtog gi rtsam sgrung 〈bya sprel gtam rgyud 〉tsam du ma la da dung 〈gtam pad ma'i la gyi zlos garagyi〈rdza tsig gi gtam rgyud/〉〈g.yag lug ra phag gi gtam rgyud/〉〈bsam yasabya de dkar po/〉 〈char shul gyi nags tsha /〉 〈me tog ldum rwa'i nang gi klan ka 〉sogs de dag la'ang gong smos kyi klog pa po'i yid dbang cig car nyid du 'phrog thub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos de dag gis yongasasubacings yod/gnyis pa/ srog chags dang 'brel ba'i dmangs sgrung skor/dmangs sgrub ni bod kyi rtsom rig khrod du bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod la/ de ni bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal bang mdzod nang du rang 'od shin tu — 292 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam tha'i ra'abar ba'i nor bu zhig kyang yin/ lhag par srog chags dang mi shing la sbyar ba'i dmangs sgrung ni sems ldan sems med kyi gzugs su bkod pa dang /sems med sems ldan gyi gzugs su bkod pa/ yang mi dud 'gro'i gzugasas bkod pa dang / dud 'gro mi'i gzugs su bkod nas bod mi rigs kyi snyeng stongs dang blo gros/ blangs bya dang dor bya/ dge ba dang sdig pa/las dang rgyu 'bras sogs gsal por mtshon thub pa'i brtsam bya 'ba' zhig lags/ de yang srog chags dang rtsi shing la sbyar ba'i dmangs sgrub rnamasalas bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mngon thung pa'i phul byung brtsam bya re gnyis ri mo'i lam du drangs pa la/gcig ri bong dang sprung kiganang lnga mo rdo mang po spungs yod pa'i chu 'gram zhig du ri bong gisabud shing skam po bkog nas dang tang ste stobazo grab byed skabs khos mgo bo bkyags nas phyogs bzhir bltas pa na/ chu'i stod rgyud nas spyang ki thalamadog shugs zad cing brla bar du rnga ma 'khums nas tshur yong ba mthong /spyang rgan 'di ni nyin 'ga'i sngon du ri bong dkar po chung zung za mkhan de yin pa ngo shes nas rig pa bsgrims nas thabs shes btsal/ spyang ki rang gi 'khris sum slobs gong ri bong gis rang gi rkub sha rtsel yud tsam bsros rjesaphar rgyugs phyin nas 'khyags pa'i sgang du tsog bur thengs kha shas bsdad pa red/ spyang ki thag nye sar yong rjes ri bong gi byed stangs de mthong bas kho pa thamatshan par gyur nas ri bong la/ kwa ye ri bong chung chung / khyod rang der — 293 —

la kyi la 'a la sa nga nga sa ma nga la nga bag re byed kyi yod dam zhes dris pas/ ri bo gisang 'dir 'chi med lhayeman ngag sbyang gi yod ces zer/ spyang kis gtam de thos rjes gnas skabasari bong bza' ba'i bsam pa dor nas/ nga la yang spyong thabs slob nogasazer/ ri bong gis de mur khas blangs nas spyang kir zer don/ bdag gi man ngag ni rkub sha me la bsros rjes 'khyags pa'i steng tsog bur sdod rgyu de yin/ de ltar thengs kha shas sbyang na grub 'bras bzang po thob nges yin/yin na'i cad kyis yid 'jog byed dgos pa ni/ rkub ni me la tsha thag cad bsros te 'khyags pa'i thog dus yun ring tsam sdod rgyu de yin zhes brjod/de nas ri bong de las bral nas ri sked phyogs su bskyod1 spyang kis ri bong gis bshad pa ltar rkub sha me la bsros rjes zha gas pa'i steng tsog pur bsdad bas 'khyags pa bzhu nas rkub ngos tshang mchus rlon par gyur/ de nas yud tsam song rjes slar yang 'khyags pa chags nas spyang ki'i rkub 'khyags par dam por 'byar bas yar langs bsam rung rkub la gas pas ga la gtong /khos shugs ji yod brgyab ste yar langasapasarkub kyi lpags pa cha shas 'khyagasapa'i steng du 'byar te lus/ skabs der ri bong gis ri sked nas spyang ki'i bzo lta skyug bro po der bltas nas dga' sgo tsha med byung zhing gad mo chen po shor/ spyang ki ni na zug chen po gtang rkyen khong khro bzod ma thub par ri bo btsal nas gsod rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam nas phyog bzhir rgyang lta byed skabs/ ro bong ni ri sked na bsdad de rang gi gdong dang mig la dngos po zhig byug bzhin yod pa mthong ste/ spyang kis na zug bzod bsran gyis ri bong gi gam du phyin nas/ ri bong ltasang na khyod ni da dung spobs pa che mdog — 294 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol btsam bya'i ral/ ngas da ltas nges par gsod rgyu yin zhesang ro sgrog ri bong gisalo da dung rdzig nyams che mdog de ni lo rang ngang thung 'tshang 'a byas pa'i skyon red/ yo kyis rkub ngosakyi sha de mer tsha thags ma sros par dar 'khyad gas thog bsdad na los sbyar zhes brjod/ spyang ki'i sems la ri bong gis bshad pa de dngos 'brel bden pa red snyams nas/ gcung po ri bong lags yo bden1 da resangs nor ba red ces bshad nasang ga 'jam po'i sgo nas yang skyar khyod kyis gdong la ga re byug gi yod dam zhesadris par/ ri bong gis do nan po'i ngang spyin chu bskus na o kyis ltos dang /ri mgo pha gi na ri bong mang po yod pa mthong gi ka'adug gas zer/ spyang kis ri bong gis bstan phyogs la bltas kyang rgyang ring na sprug bas g.yog pa'i ri mgo kha shas las gzhan gang yang ma mthong tsang ga na 'dug gam/ ga na 'dug ngas ni mthong gi ka'adug zer bar/ ri bong gis khyod kyi migalaspyin chu bskus med pas ga lamathong thub ces bshad/ des na spyang kir hamasems skyes te sems nang ngas kyang mig la spyin chu bskus nas rgyang ring mthong ba zhig byung na/ phyin sa ri bong gang du bros kyang mthong gi red snyamasabadang 'breld lta kho'i yonas spyin chu skud thabs bslabs/ mig je gas po du song rjes da gzod kho bzas na phyis mi drags bas yonas/ gcung po ri bong lags/ lo kyisang la spyin chu skud thabs slob rogs zer bar/ ri bong gis mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas shing / de mi yong / de mi yong / ngas da nasakhyod la ci yang slob mi nyan/ ngas khyod lamachog gyur yon tan bslabs kyang gang byas kyang nga za bar srid ces lab/ spyang kyisangs khyod gsod na ga la— 295 —

bo kyi srol la sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga basbod/ nga la mchog gyur yon tan bslabs na ngas khyod la drin lan 'jal nges yin zhes zhu ba yang yang phul bas mthar ri bong gis khas blangs te/spyin chu sbud thabs ha cang las mi po red/ khyod kyi mig btsums rjes de'i khar spyin chu gar po gang mang bskus na de bas yag bskus tshar rjes phyi nyin nam ma langs bar btsum dgos pa las mig phran tsham yang gdangs mi nyan/nam langs rjes mig gdangs na thag ring gang sar ha cang gal po mthong thub ces bshad pas/ spyang kis dga' spro'i ngang ri bong la thugs rje che yang yang zhus/ ri bong gis da 'grig song snyams ste spyang ki pha ri'i spang steng la khrid thog spyang ki'i mig gnyis por spyin chu gar la mang ba zhig bskus nasaspyang kir mig gdangs mi nyan pa'i kha ta bskyar du byas rjes mgyogs myur ri rtser bros phyin/ phyi nyin zhogs pa nyi ma ma shar tsam la spyang kis bya bye'u rnamasakyis skad sgrog pa thos nas da gzod gzhi nas nam gal ba shes pas semasanang brjod las 'das pa'i spro ba dang rngam sems rab tu skyes te mig gnyisa'abyed par brtsams pa na/ mig gnyis kyi yas lhags mas lhags la 'byar/mas lhags yas lhags la 'byar stabs gang byas kyang 'byed ma thub pas 'gro thabs bral/ dngangs skrag dang 'gyod pa drag pos mig gis ma mthong na shi rgyu sgug pa rang yin snyam zhing / da ni shi dang gson gang yong bsams nasamig la sder mos shugs kyis zad bas gdong pa yongs khrag ral 'dzar rer gyur rjes mig phye thub tsam byung / gang sar bltas pas ri bong ni gtsang steng gi 'gag 'gram zhig tu bya ba byed kyi yod pa mthong / de ma thag ri bong gi sar rgyug phyin nas/ khrag dmar thon bzhin pa'i mig gnyis bsgrad de/ kho— 296 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rare ri bong chung chung / yang o kyisang lamago skor btang byung / ltasang na khyod kyis da dung nga lamago skor ga re gtong rtsis yod dam/ de res thar par gtong thag ra yin zhes skad cor brgyab/ ri bong ka'atshang 'a skragasnang spu tsam yang med par rang gi rkang bal rko rlon zhig ra sa byed kyi tsho pa mthong ngas/ spyang ki de bas thamatshan skyes te mig gnyis ce rer bltasanas bsdad par/ ri bong gis spyang kir ngas da bar o lagang thub ci thub kyis yon tan bzang po bslabs yod1 'on kyang bsam med khyod kyis go rang gis ma ra yus mi la shod zer lo dpe ltar/ yo kyis byang ༅ po yobyung bar nga ka' khang ra byed kyi 'dug da yin na gang yang slob kyi min zer/spyang kis lam seng gtsi rang de 'dra'i sems jig dog pal/ ngas khyod kyi bslab khya byang chub po ma byung ba shes pas lo la medag med/ da phyin ngasapho kyis bslabs pa'i yon tan la byang ༅ po sbyang rgyu yin zhes brjod pa dang sbrags/ da thengs lo gang las kyi yod ces dris/ ri bong gisang rkang pa la tshad de lhag bzo gi yod zed/ spyang kyis de bzos nas phan pa ci yod ces dris/ ri bong gis glen pas ci shes/ rkang lham da phan pa shin du che ba khyod kyis ma mthong ngam/ phan pa med na mgo nag mis ga la pyon/ rkang lha mgyon dal ma 'jam rtsub gang la bskyod kyang bde lamagyogs pa/ rkang par na zug migatong ba ma zad/ lhag par 'khyags steng dang brag ldebalaskyod dus ha cang mgyogs pas khyod kyis bltas na phan thogs gang 'dra chen po ka'adug gam zer ba na/ spyang ki'i bsam par rkang lham 'di 'dra zhig nga la yang cha gcig byung na ci ma rung / 'on kyang kho pas khas blangs ye yong snyams— 297 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bte/ kha'atsher 'tsher dang gus gus zhum zhum gyis gzung po ri bong o kyisarkang lham bzo thabs de nga la bslabs na da chog gas zer bar/ ri bong gisalos chog lo kyis byang chub po ma byung tshe nga la 'khang ra ma byed ang zer/spyang kis da 'grig song snyams te khong tsam bzhin so lo don du yon tan spyong bar slob mkhan la 'khang ra ga la byed/ de 'dra dpe mi srid/ khyod kyisang la yid ches byed rogs zer/ ri bong gis de ltar yin na yag po 'dug ngas khyod la bslabs chog yag po nyon a/ de las po po red/ yid 'jog byed dgos pa ni/ dang po ko ba ga mkhregs chur yag po sbang rgyu dang /gnyis pa ngas khyod la rogs byas nas rkang lag bzhir g.yog te 'tshem bu rgyag rgyu/ gsum pa 'tshem bu rgyab rjes nyi khug dro por bsdad de rkang lhaganyi mar skam thag chod ba byed dgos/ de nas bod spyod dgos pa ste/ thog mar 'khrugs steng la rgyugs dgos pa dang / de rjes brag la rgyug dgos/ de ltar gyis dang gzhi nas khyod kyi re smon 'grub thub bo/ 'on kyang de ltar khyod kyisabyed thub bas zhes lab pas/ de ltar bya rgyu las skabs snang dag med do zhesabashad pas/ de 'phral ri bong gis snga sa nas gra sgrig byas te sbas nas bzhag pa'i ko ba blangs thog spyang ki'i rkang lag bzhi po dam thag ra btumasanas 'tshem bu rgyag skabs/ spyang kis ri bong gi gdong par lta bzhin/gcung po ri bong / da res khyod kyisang la ku re ma byed ang / nga la chags sgo byung na dpe bsags kyi red zer/ ri bong gisangs khyod la de 'dra byed ga la phod/ de bas lo blo bde'i ngang nasangs bslabs pa ltar yon tan rnamasabyang chub pa spyongs/ nga ni da lta ri rtser slel po lhas te de'i nang yol thog — 298 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i raphar dbrel tshur da ji la byed rgyu'i yon tan sbyang dgos pas sdod khoms med zer te ri rtser 'dzegs song ngo / spyang ki ni ri bong gi rjes su mig hu rer ltazhing sems nang da thengs yang ri bong gis yon tan khyad par can zhig slobargyu yin pa 'dra/ ngas kyang 'di byang chub pa byas thog ri bong gi yonas slongapo dbril ba'i yon tan de yang sbyang dgos zhing rkang lhag ma skam bar du nyi mar bsros/ skamathag chod rjes yar langs te ngas yon tan 'di byang chub song snyams nas mgyogs por gtsang 'gram la rgyugs te 'khyags steng lashugs kyis rgyugs pa na rkang pa spo long 'di long med par 'khyags 'dred shor nas rgyang thag ring porang med pa'i sar slebs pas spyang ki'i sems la yogazhi ko lha mgyon na mgyogs la goms pa spo mi dgos par slebs kyi 'duga'adi 'dra rtag par byung na rkang lag brdab chag mi yong ba'i nges pa ka'adugade las brag ldeb thog bskyod de tshod lta zhig bya'o snyams shing / 'khyags steng nas 'gyel ma langs kyis thon te brag ldebs su 'byor ma thag gzab nan chen pos brag la 'gro 'go bcoms te gom pa 'ga' spos mtshams tha hrag ces pa'i sgra dang chabs cig rkang 'dred shor te thog tshad gcig lhag tsam gyi g.yang sar lhang bas re zhig dran pa 'thor/ gang tsam du dran pa gsos rjes na zug bzod bsran kyis yar langs pa dang 'breld gzod yang ri bong gis mgo skor btang ba gzhi nas tshor te khong khro'i me rtser ba tu 'bar bzhin mche nga gtsigs nas po lhag zer tshal sbar tshal bzos te ri bong 'gro ba'i phyogasasumig sdigs nas phyin pas ri bong ni ri mgo na spel lhas zin te nyi mar lho zhing skyid po'i ngang bsdad yod/ spyang kis zhe sdang drag pos dag dngas mig — 299 —

bo kyi srol zad sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga babasgrad kyis ri bong chung chung / ltasang na khyod kyis yang bskyar nga lamago skor btang byung / da res nges par du lo za'o zhesang ra skad sgrogs/ ri bong ni 'tshab 'tshung med par kar po'i nang yol nas par dbril ba dbril byed kyin du ngas dang thog nas khyod kyis sbyangs 'bras byang chub po ma byung na sdug myong rgyu red bsams mod/ 'on kyang khyod kyis lnga tshugs chen pos slob tu bcug pas so sos byang ma chub par nga la 'khang ra bya rgyu min zer yang da thengs 'di ltar lab dgos don med/ nga za 'dod na zo zhig zer bas/spyang ki'i bsam par ri bong 'jigs snang med par da dung skel po'i nang phar dbrel tshul dbril gyi rtsed mo skyed mdog kha po rtsed par mtshar snang skyes bzhin 'di 'dra byas pa phan pa ci yod ces dris/ de ltar byas na lus bde zhing na tsha med par gyur nas lus bzang stongs cher 'gro thub/ stag dang seng ger yang 'dzing thub la sha lpags mkhregs por gyur nas me mdas kyang 'begasameethub zer bzhin re zhig dbrel mtshams bzhag ste/ dpa' nyams che mdog gisangs 'di ltar sbyangs pas stobs shugs 'gran zla med par gyur/ mdang dgongs nga bstag gcig 'phrad byung / ngas kho'i gnag sems shes te lamaseng kho'i rkang pa nas bzung te rngon pa zhig yod pa'i mdun la 'phangs pasarngon bas stag kho lnga lam du btang song zer bzhin spel ponas thon te spyang ki'i 'khris su gom pa do gsum spos te da shog dang / drin lan log 'jal byed mkhan glen lkugs khyod bangs mthu rtsal ga tshod bslabs kyang ma shes par da dung ngas lan zer/ khyod la mthu rtsal nga ltar byung na nga bza' rgyu yin pa de shes kyi yod/ ngas kyang khyod bsgugs te rngon pa yod sar 'phen rgyu'i gra — 300 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol btsam bya'i rasgrig byas yod zer/ spyang kyis ri bong bskrag snang ye nas med ba sakho skrag ste gos pa kha shas phyir snur byas nasang ga 'jam pos/ spunas bzang po lags1 bdag gi gong du bshad pa rnams sko yan kyi skad cha tsam yin pasathugs 'dzin ma gnang dang zhes ri bong gzur mig lta bzhin khyod kyi thabasashes 'di ha cang yag po 'dug da resangs sems thag bcad de sbyang rgyu yin pas khyod kyisang la dngos su bslab na 'grig gas zer/ ri bong gisagang yang ma lab par khros pa'i tshur kyis bsdad/ yang spyang kis nu bo ri bong lags/ khyod khro ma langs par nga la slobs dang / phyin chad ngas khyod kyi dge phrug bzang po zhig bya'o zer/ ri bong gis nan po'i sgo nas ngo ma slob 'dod ba yin nam byang ༅ byung rjesang za 'dod pa ma yin nas zer bar/da thengasang rang byang chung po byung na khyod la bka' drin gsol rgyu yin bsad slobs dang zer bas1 ri bong gis mgo 'jog 'jog ngang 'o na nga ga chesasong bas yo yud tsam sgugs shig ngas yo kyi gzugs por ran pa'i spel po zhig lhas chog zer/ spyang ki dga' ston rog du bsdad/ khres po slasazin mtshams spyang ki slob po'i nang bcug ste kha dam por bsdams/ ri mgo bde sa zhig tu dbrel dbril byed du cug dbrel log thengs bcu grangasa'aga' shas rgyab rjesang la gas cung zad rgyob zer ba dang / da lo thang bde sar da brel dbri la thengs soganyis spyob/ de nas yud tsamang la gsos te g.yang gzar du dbrel dbril byed du rgyugs/ de ltar byas na nus stobasachen por gyur thub/ yin na'i yid gzab ma byas par g.yang gzar la lhang na slar dbril dbril thengs sum brgya byed dgos/ gzhan yang lus stobs— 301 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bachen por gyur na nga'i drin lan ma brjed pa byed dgos zer/ spyang kis ri bong gis bslabs pa ltar byas/ de nas g.yang gzar dbrel dbril byed skabs ri bong gis spyang kir de ltar byas na ga dus shes thub bam/ da thabasami 'dug ngas phyo la rogs byed zer te shed kyis 'bud rgyag btang ngasamathar spyang ki la po dang chabs cig g.yang gzar mthon po nas 'ang ba rdo ltar ril bas sha thor rus thor du gyur toshaṃganyis/ gtam 'dod can gyi se mo gog gogasngon la ljongs mdzes la ltan sdug pa'i nags gseng cig na rtsemogog gog dang bying chen thu lo gnyis yas mas byas te gnas chags nas bsdad yod/ nyin zhig khong gnyis skad cha med par mnyam 'dzoms byung nas phyi logs su stong tsho bar 'gro ba'i lam du phan tshun skad cha shod res mang po byas pa dang / zas zhim pa phar ster la ster byas pa dang grogs mo yang bsgrigs/ 'on kyang don du medagog gog ni gtam 'dod ha cang che bas kho gnyis phyi la du mkhas mkhas snyan snyan shod res byed rung / don du phan tshun zhe sdang dang phrag dog chen po byed kyi yod/ kho gnyis lam du phan tshun skad cha shod res byed skabs gnyis kas gtam 'dod kyis rang gis rang la'u dbastod byas te/ zadagog gog gis bshad par/ rogs rol gsang 'jig rten 'di'i thog skyes snga shos shig yin pas 'jig rten srid pa la sa④ gtsang khul gyi dmangs sgrung legs btus 〉 lcags dpar deb ngos 4—302—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'iral rnamasang las rgyus mnga' che ba med ces 'ud shob bshad bying la thu lus kyang 'ud shob kyis dogs rol gas/ nga skye dus ri'i mgo 'bur tsamalas byas mi 'dug ces brjod/ der zadagog gog kyis byas na pa'i buyo'abring ba dang rogs mon mnyam red ces shod bzhin de snyan khong gnyisasoso'i khrim du log phyi nyin yang khoganyis khamakhas 'dra la sa kyis mnyam du ka'atsho bar phyin pa red/ yud tsam song rjes bying chen thu lus/ rogasamolags/ nga la 'bu srin yongs kyis bstod bsngags gtong ba dang nga rang nas bltas kyang de rang red bsam gyi 'dug gangs lags zer na/ nga khasbub bslogs dka karang byon dang / nga g.yar bslangs na gser sku rang byon yin zhes bshad pas/ skad cha des medagog gog lang rgyal chen po bslangs te kho mong ni kha yar bslangs na gos che ljang nag dang / khamar spub na gos chen ljang khu 'dra/ da dung khog nang nas rgyun du spos dkar gyi dri bzang la lo ba'i yon tan ldan yod ces rang gis rang la 'ud bstod byas de nas kho gnyis gtsang 'gram zhig nyung lags brgyab ste skad char mgo g.yengs pas medagog gog rkang 'dred shor nas drag du rgyug pa'i gtsang la nang lhang shing la g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i 'bu srin rnams kyisamochus da ra ba mthong ste chu khar lta dub rgyag par yong skabs po bo tsha ga skyengasabazod thabs bral ba byung yang kha nas gtam 'dod kyis 'a ra rang khyer shoga'adi ltar khyer dag tsang bkra shis lhan po yang mjal ba 'dug ces skrag kyang mi skrag khul gyis bshad/ de nas mo mtsho 'khor zhig tu khyer nas skor ba 'khor bsdad pas sems su dngangs skrag la po skyes rung / gnas 'khor —303 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga b.rang 'khor zhig skor ba 'bum phrag gcig 'khor na tshe 'di'i sdig sgrib thamasacad dag pa yong ba 'dug ces bshad/ gang mtshams su skor ba 'khor shugs che ru song nas srog nyen la po thug pas/ nus shugs yod la kyisarkyal brgyab nas 'gro ba dang la rba rlabs kyi shugs kyis kho mo gtsang 'grayogyi dzogaseng tu phud pas mos rang gis shugs brgyab khul gyis kha nas/ shab ze de 'dra'i yang sha dod pa la zer nas rang la'o bstod byas/ log 'gro ba'i lam du rta'i rngig pa'i 'og tu mo'i gzugs po'i zur gcig za nas shi grabasabyas/ yin na'i lam gyi g.yas g.yon du 'bu srin mang po yar 'gro mar 'gro byed kyi yod stabs po gtam 'dod che bsan zug ma btang khul gyis/ rta ro 'dis pa'i gos chen la sems pa shor nas phran bu dbral song ba dang / nga'i khog nang gi spos dkar gyi dri bzang phyir la la bsal khrims phran bu shor song zhes bshad rjes khya re khyo re'i ngang nang du log pa dang / sems su de ring rang nyid chus⑩ra ba'i dngangs skrag dang rta yis 'dzis pa'i na zug gis da ni gson thangs gral song snyams nas nyal sdod pa'i skabs der bying chen thu g.yong ste/ rogs mo lags/ la rang ga par phebs pa yin/bar lam mjal yas ma byung zhes bshad pas/ rtse mo gog gog ni gtama'adod dang zhe sdang che zhing rgyun gtan nas rdzun gtam shod rgyu lang shor ba yin pas/ mos rogs mo lags/ nga snam bu'i chag bcag par phyin pa yin/deng sang gnam gshis drod che bas phyi gos phud nas grib bal zhig btang nas bsdad yod cesa'ud shob bshad/ 'on kyang mos rang nyid chus ga ra skabs bying chen thu lus dngos sumathong ba de gting brjed du song ba red/—304—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rasang shogs der bying chen thu lus/ rogs po tshe skyid lag ga khyod rang 'tshol rdo mkhan zhig 'dug ces lan sprad pas/ mos gtam 'dod chen posang 'tshol mkhan shin tu mang bas yang su yin nas zhes shod bzhin sgo thonadasa'agro dus/ byeng chen thu lus dbu la snag sprug gzer ba/ na bza'agos chenaljang zang zhes pa'i bya dpon zhig 'dug zer/ medagog gog gis phal cher nga'i gzhang lags yin gyi red ces shod bzhin song bas de mthag tu pu shud kyis no la ring ba'i mchu tos ma chu 'thog brgyab nas rang sa de rang du bzasapa red/ de nas bzung bying chen thu lu la zhe sdang byed mkhan med pasablobade'i ngang 'tsho ba bskyal ba redashagasum/ mthun pa spun bzhi/de yang sngon 'das ba dus na yul ka shi zhes bya ba'i nags tshogayostug la shin tu nyams dga' ba'i gnas shig na srog chags gong ma sreg dang /ri bong / spre'u/ glang chen bcas gnas yod pa de rnams phan tshun yid bcugs shing bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la longs su spyod pa'i skabs der srog chagasabazhi pos rang cag bde zhing skyid pa 'di'i thog nga tshos rgan rabs la bkur ba dang 1 gcig phan gcig grogs/ 'jig rten gyi mig dper 'os pa zhig yong thub pa la 'bad rgyu'i bzang po'i gros la zhugs te mthar su rgan pa dang 1tshogazhon pa'i gnas tshul brtag dpyad byed rgyur mos mthun/ thog mar bya ④ (gtsang khul gyi dmangs sgrung legs btus〉lcags dpar deb ngos 153— 305 —

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga bgong ma sreg gis na gro rda'i shing stong zhig bstan par/ glang la gyis bdag dang po lam 'di brgyud nas 'gro skabs shing 'di bdag gi lus tsha dang mnyam pa zhig mthong byung zhes bshad/ de nas spre'u sa/ bdag gnasa'adir slebs skabs kyang shing 'di'i ring la bdag gi lus dang mnyam pa 'dug ces bshad/ de nas ri bong gis/ bdag 'dir slebs skabs shing 'di skyes nas lo ma gnyis tsam yod pa'i steng gi zil pa bldags pa yin zhesasmras/ mthar bya gong ma sreg gis/ bdag gis 'di'i sa bon bzas nasastug pa btang ba las shing 'di skyes pa red ces srog chags bzhi pos rang rang gnas der thog mar slebs skabs kyi gnas tshu srong por smras pas de rnams kyi rgan gzhon go rim byung ba des sngar bas phan tshun mdza' gzugasadang zhe sar bcas pa'i rgan gshon bkur ste tha na phar tshur 'gro skabs kyang glang po che la spre'u dang / de la ri bong / ri bong la gong ma sreg bzhon nasa'agro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la gnas pa sogs dngos 'brel 'jig rten gyi mig dper 'os pa byung ba de'i mthu las yu der la chu dus phebs/lo phyugs rtag legs sogs bkra shis dge mtshan gyis khyab pa zhig byung /skabs der la de'i rgyal po dang / blon po 'bangs bcas pas 'di lta bu'i bde skyid rang rang so so'i bsod nams kyi mthu las byung ngo zhes smras pa lasakha ma mthun bas drang srong mngon shes can zhig yod pa der su'i mthu la brten nas 'di lta bu byung ba 'dri rgyur kha 'chams/ drang srong des 'di ni rgyal po'i mthu yang ma lags/ blon po'i mthu yang ma lags/ 'bangs kyi mthu yang ma lags te 'di ni la 'di'i nags khrod stug por gnas pa'i srog —306—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rags 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba bzhi'i mthu la brten nas byung ba'i rgyu masagang yin gsal por smras pa la kun yid ches te yul de'i mi rnams kyis kyang srog chags bzhi po de rang gi mig dper 'dzin pa de la lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang yid rab tu 'phrog ste/ gus bcas zhe sar bcas pa dang / dka' thub tshal na gnas pa yi1 gong mdzag gi tshang spyod dag 'jig rten so sor rab tu bstanashabazhi/ spobs pa mtho ba'i ri bong chung chung /gna' snga mo spang gshongs shig yod pa der srog chags che chung 'dra min sna tshogs ma 'dus mnyam 'dzoms kyis 'tsho ba bskyal bsdad yod/ srog chags de dag gi nang nas spobs pa ha cang che ba'i ri bong chung chung zhig yod pa des rang gi gzhang bong bu ngoms nas srog chags gzhan la mthong chung dang brnyas bcos byas nas su la'ang brtsi gi med pas spang gshongs de'i thog gi srog chags tshang ma ri bong la zhen pa log nas kho par kha ta bslab bya byed mkhan gcig kyang med/ 'on kyang gzugs stobs che la shed shugs bzang ba'i a pho g.yag gis sems kyis ma bzod par ri bong long ga 'jam posa'adi ltar smras so/ tshur la nyon dang ri bong blo dang ldan pa khyod/ ma g.yeng rna ba a pho'i kha la nyon/ gshong 'dir gnas pa'i srog chags tshang ma ni/ma 'dus mnyam 'dzoms las kyis bskos pa yin/ rang rang gang 'dod tswa① (gtsang khul gyi dmangs sgrung legs btus〉lcags dpar deb ngos591— 307 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga deng sa kyi ra yu nga bachur rol ba na zhe 'khon phrag dog rtsal 'ang yong rkyen med/ 'on kyang la ni zhe sdang nga rgyal grolas tsha/ rang ngoms dang che byed pa ga re nga / de 'dra byed pa 'os sum mchis pas/ de las rang skyon dor nas dmangs dang mthun pa gyis/ zhes brjod pas/ ri bong gi rna bar 'gro rgyu lta ci/ de lasalhog ste khrel bgad dang sa mchongs gnam mtshongs thengs gsum byas nas/rna cog ring po krong nger brkyangs/ khra chung mig gnyis 'bur tshugs su sdang nas smras pa/ kho re nyon cig la med rkang 'khyam khyod/ nag po kha leng sdug lcog nga la nyon/ nyin mo sgron me spar ba ga re mtshan/ sangs rgyas ka kha slob pa dgod re bro/ ri bong zhes bya'i blo ldan shes rab nga / rtsa ba spang gshong 'di yong dag po yin/ mes po'i dus nas gang 'dod lha chur rolarang ngos byed pa nga ra'i 'khor gzhi red/ sdig can nag po kha leb la kyisani/ nga yos za chu la nga byas pa'i khar/ speng gshongs steng la nag po'i brun kyis rgyangs/ da dung nga la rtsod gzhi'i kha mchu la gas/ de la rang ham sems gang 'dra mche 'am/ zhes smras pas/ a pho g.yag ni mgo bo dkrugs dkrugs dang mjug ma g.yug g.yug gis thag ring sar song ste ri bong dang kha rtsod ma byas pas/ ri bong ni sngar las spongs pa ches che song nas kho gzugs stongs che la rwa rtse no na'ang nga blo ldan gyi gtam la gtam lan 'jal ma phod par 'gro dgos pa ni ha cang nyams dma' po zhig red snyamasanas de bas dngas dregs chen pos srog chags gzhan dag lamathong chung dang brnyas bcos khrel med byed rkyang byas/ dus ni 'gro mgyogs pas mdzes sdug ltan sdug pa'i dbyar gyi dus bzang de 'ja' ltar la nas/ snyeng rje bral —308—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i raba'i dgun kyi grang ngar de spyang ki ltar ma྾sa te 'ongs/ nyin zhig nayomakhar sprin nag gis 'khrigs shing / logazhi yongs rdzogs kha ba'i gosadakar pyom/ pa'i dus der/ sug thung ams ri bong gis mas g.yan gi mdun du phar ma྾gas mchongs dang bcas 'di skad smrag gang lo 'ang b.rang 'bang shog nyin zhag bsdoms pa'i dgu 'bab shog dgu gnyis log pa'i bco brgyad 'bang shog nga tsho'i gzhang lags kyi zhabasalalcag kyi rkang rtsa gyon yod/ a pho nga rang la cha mtshon na spen ma'i sog gur la'ajag ma'i ka ba yod pas ga tshod bab kyang sems khral med/ da sngo shor na nag po kha leng kho shor 'gro/ ngas ltad mo lta'o zer nas ri bong tshang du 'dzulasong / khab ni 'bab tshad ches cher phyin nas gangs kyi bab rim mthug pochags dus ri bong gi tshang de gnon shugs mi 'khyog par dib par 'gro bsari bong khong skad shor nas/ 'o tsi la1 dra ma gnon yong gi 'dug ces chig lang rgyag pa'i ngang kho pa gangs kyis mnan nas phyi ma'i lam du bskyal loshilnga sgam po khra skyid/gnang lnga mo sgam po khra skyid zer ba'i byi'u'i lus la byi ba'i mgo can spyod pa shin du ming po zhig yod/ khos byi'u rnams dang 'phrad dus so bstan nas byi'u khral las g.yor thabs dang / byi ba rnams dang 'phrad dus gshogapa bstan nas byi ba'i khral nas g.yol thabs byas nas las la mi brtson zhing /① (gtsang khul gyi dmangs sgrung legs btus)lcags dpar deb ngos 158— 309 —

nge kyi srog ma sa nga nga sa kyi ma grang nga bsgyid lugs che bas nyin ltar gsang spyod nang 'tshal te/ migatsang bsha stag bzas nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod1nyin gcig kho pa lho chas 'tshol du 'gro ba'i lam bar du 'bras busaphyug pa'i ljon shing lo 'dab sngo lngang lhab lhab g.yob zhig gi steng na byi'u ting ting sgrol ma zhes pa mgul kyi spu pad rag ltar dmar zhing / gshog sgro g.yultar sngo ba/ spu mdog 'ja' tshon ltar rnam par bkra ba zhig gis‘‘ting ting zhes yid dbang 'phrog pa'i snyan gyur gyi sgra dbyangs sgrog bzhin yod pa de ltos mthong ma thag yid kyi dbang po rang dbang med par 'phrog nasakhatshums tshums dang mig hrig hrig gis bltas te/ spu mdog bkra zhing gsung snyan ldan pa lags/ dal med lusang la las pa ma brtson par/ zad gosa'adzoms shing dpa' stobs ldan pa/ nga'i 'dun thab mdzad na ci dgar nolabs chog ces smras par ting ting sgrol mas/ byi'u'i lus la byi ba'i mgo brnyan can/ sgam po khra skyid zer ba nyon cig kye/ khyed kyi bzhugs gnas za thung gnas bab sogs/ ma gsang srong por smros dang nga yis brtag cesasmras/ khra skyid kyis de'i lan du/ bdag ni bya dang byi'u'i khrod du 'gro ba'i dus/ lha bya gong po phud pa'i gras 'gor sdod mkhan dang / rdza ra bye ba'i khrod du 'gro ba'i dus 'di na/ 'khor yongs tshang ma'i gral 'go gus pasa'adzin/ kha zas sman 'bras dri zhig ro bcud lhag du ldan/ btung ba chu mig gtsang mar byas nas 'tsho ba skyel/ steng gi gzhal yas khang dang 'gran pa'i pho brang yod/ thar ba spyod gtsang brtul zhugs ldan pa'i gzhon nu yin/— 310 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i razhes smras par ting ting sgro mas/ de 'dra dngos gnas yin min rjes su lta'o/zhes smras nas ting ting zhes snyan pa'i skad dang bcas 'phur song bar khra skyid kyis ting ting sgoma'i rjes bsnyegs kyang gshog rtsal med stabs sa la lhung ste/re zhig dbugs stem ste ma du ci bya gtol med kyi ngang du lus so/de nas nyin zhig bya dang byi'u rnams tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs pa'i skabs ting ting sgro mtshogs 'du der zhugs nas lha bya gong mo'i g.yas g.yon gyi gral star rim par bltas kyang sgam po khra skyid mthong rgyu med pas ci yin snyams nas de gar bsdad pa red/ gang 'tshams song nas sgam po khra skyid slebs te bya byi'u kun gyi gral mthar zhum zhum byas nas bsdad pa mthong ban ting ting sgoms kho pa'i sar phyin nas/ khyed ni lha bya gong mo'i blon po ste/thob thang gdan thob ka'ajog ci ye phyir/ gral mthar zhugazhum bzhugasapa'i gnas lugs ci/ srong por spros dang sgam po khra skyid lags/ zhes smrasapar/ kho ni lam seng lan shod rgyu ma dran par phran tsam lus/ de nas khosating ting mkhyed kyis pa'i gdong la bltas bsdad pa yin tsang 1 nga ngo tsha nasagral mgor 'gro ma nus zhes rdzun bshad pas/ ting ting sgrol ma yid chesapar gyur/ de nas kho pa gnyis phan tshun mdza' zhing brtse bas mnyam du rtsed 'jor rol nas dus yun gang tsam song ban/ ting ting sgrol ma'i grogasamobye'u chung chos kho mos sgam po khra skyid dang 'brel ba byas pa'i gnas tshug shesanas bsam pa bzang pos/ las kyis 'brel ba'i grogs mo ting ting ma/khyed kyi bza' zla sgam po khra skyid 'di1 sgyid lug che zhing migatsang kho nas 'tsho/de dang 'grogs na shin tu mi 'os so/ zhes smras par ting ting sgrol ma'i — 311 —

bo kyi srol na ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babasam par grogs mo chosang la phrag dog byas nas de ltar bshad pa red/khong spyid lug che zhing mi gtsang zas te 'tsho ba skyel mkhan marangs can zhig yin na nga dang 'grig dogs med bsams nas khong la sems dkar gyi bslab byar mnyan par sgam po dang sngar ltar mdza' zhing brtse bar byas nasabasdad/ yang grogs mo chos sems kyis ma bzod par kho mo'i sar phyin nasang tsho grogs po tsho sems dkar gyi bslang bya rna ba'i rgyab kyi lhags par brtsis kyang rang ni tshe sngon las kyisang tsho dang 'brel ba'i grogs mo yin tsang khyed la las nyes byung ba de nga tsho grogs mor byung ba ltar brtsis nas yang bskyar zhu rgyur/ grogs mo khye ni sman 'bras dang sman chu bzhes nas 'tshar longs byung ba zhig red/ sgam po zer ba bya byi'u gang la'ang ma the bar dmar hreng nag btsog mdog nyes pa de ni dus rtag tu las la mi brtson par gsang spyod kho nar la la nas mi gtsang ba zhe gcig longs spyod byas nas 'tsho nga bskyal te 'tshar longs byung ba'i khya ngan tha shal zhig red/ la thugs yid ma ches na nyin gcig kho pa dang mnyam du rtsed la mas mdzad skabs kho'i rkang par skud pa zhig btags nas de'i shul du phebs dang / nga tshos zhus pa'i skad cha de bden pa yin min gal yong / zhes smras pas ting ting sgrol masade ltar byed rgyur khas blangs/ de nas nyin shas song mal 'khong gnyisartsed la mas su 'gro dus shig la ting ting sgrol mas grogs po tshos bslabs pa ltar sgam po'i rkang par skud pa ring po zhig mngon chung gis btags nas snang med rtsed 'khyams byed pa'i skabs sgam po grod pa lhogs nas glo bur du 'phur song ba na ting ting sgrol mas kyang sbud pa'i sne bzung nas rjes 'ded byayo—32—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rapas sgam po kho grong pa zhig gi gseng tu 'phur song ba bzhin rjes 'ded byasabs kho ni ha cang dri ngar ba'i gsang spyod zhig gi sgo rtsar babs nas par tshur phyogs kun tu blta zhing byas mthar bya byi'u mthong rgyu med stabs mgyogs por gsang spyod nang 'dzul nas skyag 'bus yongs su khengs pa'i migatsang brdog gcig la mchus phur phur byas nas zos pa de ting ting sgrol mas mthong ba na ting ting sgrol ma'i sems la 'di dngos gnas yin nam/ yang na nged kyi mig 'phrul ba yin nam snyams nas gshog pa sig sig dang / mig bgrad bgrad byas nas bltas kyang de ga rang mthong skabs rang nyid sgam po'i mgo skor 'og tshud pa'i 'gyod bdang khong khro bzod mi thub pa byung ba'i thog grogs mo tsho'i bslab byar mnyan par ngo gnong ste dbugs ltem lte yongang nasamig mchi mas dngas bzhin du rang gi tshang yod sa der 'phur song ngo / ting ting sgro ma 'phur phyin nas lam bar du gleng ga zhig yod sar slebs pasakhomos/ tshur la gson dang gling chung gru bzhi lags/ tshe sngon las kyis gusamolus 'dir bskos/ sodakar 'dzum ston g.yo rgan byi'u ngan khos1 nga rang bslus pas dus 'dir mtshang ma 'phya/ gling chung khyod kyis de snga'i ngo lagazigs/ sgam po khra skyid kho pa yong nga na/ nga ye sdod gnas khol ma gsungs lags/ zhes skyo glu zhig blangs nas 'phur song / de nas yang 'phur 'gro dus tshal zhing zhig yod par slobs pas kho mos/ tshur la gson dang dmar chen la phug lags1 nga la grogs dang grogs mo mang na yang /tshang ma'i sems bzang zhe sdang gtam la brtsis/ sems dkar bslab byar mnyan rdzab du lhung 1 de ring 'apyod ba byas kyang phyis song lags/ khyed nas— 313 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babu mo'i sdug la dgongs pa bzhes/ sgam po khra spyid kho pa yong ba na/ nga yesdod gnas kho lam gsungs lags/ zhes skyo glu zhig blangs nas sems sdug ba po byed bzhin 'phur nas tshang yod lo khang pa der slebs mthag khomos/ tshur log son dang khang brtsegs bkod ldan can/ gus po sgong shub phud nas da bar du/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid khyed dang mnyam du gnas/tsha tsha grang grang lo zla du ma'i nang / bya byi'u khri stong khyed kyi grogs lo gyur/ de ring gus mo byas nyes byung song bas/ o nas nyam chung bdag bsdug dogs mdzod/ sgam po khra skyid kho pa yong bsan/ nga ye sdod gnas kho la mgasungs lags/ zhes yang ngu bzhin skyo glu zhig blangs nas tshang du log song bas tshunas tshur de khyem mchos tsho dang grogs mo tshos thos rjes tshang mas kho mo'i sar yong nas sems gsodang bslab bya byas so/ de nyin sgam po khra skyid kyis ting ting sgrol ma nyin gang sgug bsdad kyang kho mo log rgyu med pas kho'i bsam par de ring ting ting sgrol ma mi yong ba ci yin nam/ nga'i gsang ba khomos shes pa min nam/ yang na phru gu sems gnag de chos pa'i tshe zad de'i sgro bzang mthong nas 'thug mda' brgyab nas bsad pa min nam snyam pa'i bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang nas bsdod pa'i gnas las bral te/ting ting sgrol ma 'tshol du song / kho pa ting ting sgrol ma 'tshol ba'i lam bar du gling ga zhig yod sar slebs nas khos tshur la nyon dang mgo zing sdong rgan tsho/ nga ye snying grogs ting ting sgrol ma de/ gang du 'phur ba khyod e mthong ngam/ gang du sdod min khyod tshogs shes sam/ drang gtam yod na snga tsam bshad na legs/ sta re 'phyar dus 'gyod pa phyis drags yong 1 zhes smras— 314 —

rang nga ra nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rapar/ sdong po tshos rang la dma' 'bebs gtong zhing 'ud sho bakhengs dregasache ba'i byi'u nag btsog de ye skad cha rnams thos mthag khong khro tshad med kyisagazhig gis kyang kham grags par mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas te kho pa lcang sprug gis brdung nas phud/ sgam po khra skyid kyis rang nyid la lcang sprug phog pa dang lan rgyag mkhan med pa mthong nas khong khro dang bcas 'phur song ngo de nas yud tsam song rjes tshal zhing zhig yod sar slebs pas khos/ tshur lanyon dang la phug che chung tsho/ nga ye mdzes ma ting ting sgrol ma de/ gang du 'phur ba khyod tshogs mthong ngam/ gang du sdod min khyod chos ye shes sam/drang gtam yod na snga tsam bshad na legs/ rtsa ba bkog dus 'gyod pa phyisadrags yong zhes smras par la phug tshos rang nus rang gis mi rtogs pa'i byi'u nag btsog de'i 'chal gtam de thos nas khong khro chen pos tshang mas mgrin gcig tu khyod kyi kha'adir bltas na dbyug rdung lan brgyar byas kyang chogatha'adug yo 'di lta bu'i 'jon thang yod na nges tshor 'dri dgos don ci/khyod sdug mig zha ra min na 'tshol bar song / zhes gshe gshe dang ga rdung btang bas kho bci bya gtol med ngang 'phur song / de nas gang mtshamasazhig song dus khang pa zhig gi thog byi'u mang po zhig phar lding tshur lding byed bzhin yod pa de khos mthong bas ting ting sgrol ma yang byi'u de tsho'i khrod du med dam bsams nas de phyogs su 'phur phyin te/ byi'u rnams la tshur lanyon dang / lcags sgrog lan dgu brgyab pa'i byi'u than tsho/ nga ye tshe grogasating ting sgrol mde/ khyod tsho mnyam du yod pa ma yin nam/ gang du 'phur min khyod chos ye mthong ngam/ sdod gnas gang du yin min gshes sam/— 315 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bzhes smras pas bye'u tshos kho pa ni dus rgyun du migatsang bar longs spyod pa dang /kho rang tsho'i grogs mo ting ting sgrol mar mgo skor gtong mkhan byi'u ma rabasacan de yin pa shes nas de bas khong khro chen pos/ migatsang spyad nas 'tsho nga'i byi'u btsog khyod/ las la g.yol zhing sgyid lugs kho na byed/ yul khams gang du song yang dri ngan khyab/ khyed bgrogs sgrig byed mkhan glen pa red1 yid 'ongs mdzes ma ting ting sgrol ma de/ lo na zabs g.yo rdzun 'og tu tshud/ khyod kyis kho mo re ba'i bsam pa de/ nyin mo'i rmi lam yin pa shod ci dgos/ de las ldog ste yul du phyi log bgyis/ rdzun spangs spyod gtsang zhig tu 'gyur bar gyis/ las la brtson pa'i pho gzhon ang dang bgyis/ dus der nga chos khyod la bden pa shod/ ces kho par dma' 'bebs dang bslab bya btang bas sgam po khra skyid ngo tsha ba dang / sems sdug gi ngang gtsi/ bden bden rgyu 'bras ston pa'i rje bla ma/ mkhyen mkhyen ma rabs bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ tso min g.yo rdzun sngar nas spyad pa'i 'bras/ sa phyogs gang du song yang 'phya ba'i rgyu/ grogs tsho'i drang gnasathog dang 'dra ba'i gtam/ thad kar bshad pas rang gi mtshang la phog da cha me long nang du bltas pa'i tshe/ tha shal 'di lta'i tshul la lhang ba snang /zhes gong la'i khar bsdad nas bu bshad byed bzhin pa de/ ting ting sgrol mas thos rjes sems kyis ma bzod par tshang nas phyir 'phur yong ste kho par tshe sngon las kyis bkod pa'i khra skyid nyon/ de snga khyod kyisang la mgo skor btang / gus mo grogs dang ka'adris nyams re dma'/ ngo tsha yid skyosaganya' yang 'degs par dka'/ da lta de snga'i ngo la bltas nas ni/ khyed la — 316 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'bril ba'i srol brtsam bya'i raskad cha 'ga' zhig shod rgyu yod/ grogs mo ro ldan gsung gi bdud rtsi 'di/mi nyams blo ye rdo la gal por bskos/ ma rabs spangs nas dad brtson gru gzings 'di/ rba rlabs bshags te thog med yong bar bgyis/ lo lo sgyid lugs tha shal spyod ngan rnams/ thams cad ma lus rab 'bar rtse lcesabasregs/ sems chung spyi mthun yin lugs tshu ldan bgyis/ ngal rtsola'abras bus 'tsho ba'i byi'u gcig bgyis/ de yel 'ong dus na slebs pa'i tshe/ bdag gis khyed dang tshe grogs byed la go zhes smras par/ sgam po khra skyid bsam yu las 'das pa'i gtam de thos ma thag dga' skyo gnyis ldan gyis mig mchi mas dngas bzhin par rjes su spyod ngan spangs nas tshu dang mthun pa'i byi'u zhig bya rgyu'i khas len dam bca' bzhag nas rang la du 'phur song ngo shade ltar gong du dper brjod tsam du drangs ba'i dmangs sgrub 〈ri bong dang spyang ki〉zhes pa der cha mtshon na/ gzugs dang yan lag shin tu stobs chung yang shes rab kyi blo gros mchog tu mnga' ba'i ri bong gis rtag tu srog chags nyams chung kho nar brnyas bcos la dga' ba'i spyang rgan thal mdog can der rang gi thabs dang blo gros la brten nas dang po spyang ki za rngam can de'i rkub la shegs pa grang la steng du sbyar rtsa bcug pa dang /gnyis pa spyang ki za rngam can gyi mig gnyis la spyin byugs nas rang gdong rang gis rdzas su bcug pa/ gsum pa spyang ki za rngam can der ko rlon gyi rkang ① spang rgyan me tog 99lo'i dus deb bzhi pa/lcags dpar deb ngos 44—37—

bo kyi la la la sa nga nga sa kyi la la nga balham bzos te brag las lhungs su bcug pa/ bzhi pa ri bong blo ldan gyis spyang kir gnar gcod tsha grang sna la sa btang rjes mtha' ma la po'i nang du blugs nas g.yang gzar thon po nas mar dbyugs te 'chi pa'i lam du btang ba dang / rang dang 'dra ba'i nyams chu srog la sal gnod 'tshe gtong mkhan za rngam can gyi spyang ki 'di brlags par byas yod/ de yang dmangasasgrung 'disang tsho klog pa por srog la sa yin rung shes rang kyi blo gros dang ldan pa zhig yin na khengs dregasang rgyal can gyi stobs ldan dgra bo yang brtul thub pa bstan yod/de nas dmangs sgrung 〈gtam 'dod can gyi zadagog gog〉la cha mtshon na/ 'bu srin rtse mo gog gog dang bying chen thu lu gnyis ni phyi la laphan tshun rogs mo yin mdog byas kyang zhe gting nas phan tshun nga rgyal phrag dog ldan pa zhig yin/ lhag par zadagog gog ni rgyun du gtam 'dod kyi skad cha kho na shod rgyur dga' ba las snying dang snying bcug pa'i skad cha bshad rgyur dga' po rtsa ba nas med/ der brten nyin gcig rang nyid gzab gzab ma byas rkyen chu nang du lhung nas shi grangs byas kyang rdzun gtam bshad rgyur lang la shor ba'i ge mo gog gog gis rang nyid snam bu'i la bcag par phyin pa yin zhes bshad skabs dngas dregs can gyi bying chen thu lus dbu la snag sprug gzer ba/ na za gos chen ljang khra pyon pa'i bya pu shud gdan drangasanas gtam 'dod can gyi rtse po gog gog 'di skye lam du btang / sgrung 'disaklog pa por 'bu srin srog la sa yin yang grogs po phan tshun snyeng gtam shod pa las gtam 'dod kyi rdzun gtam bshad rgyu med pa bstan yod/—318—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rade nas dmangs sgrung 〈mthun pa spun bzhi〉la cha mtshon na/ srogachags bya sreg pa dang / ri bong / spre'u/ glang chen bcas yul ka shi zhes bya ba'i nags gas stug la shin nyunyams dag 'a ba'i nang phan sa mdza' shesache la yid gzugs nas dga' zhing skyid pa'i 'tsho bar yongs su spyod bzhin yod pa dang / khong chos rgan rabs la brtsi bkur dang 1 gcig phan gcig rogs sogs byas nas mgo nag min mig dpe lta bur mngon pa byas yod/sgrung 'dis klog pa por 'dang chags yin na'ang 'dra yang na ri dwags yin na'ang 'dra phan tshun gcig gis gcig la brtsi bkur dang phan tshun gcig gis gcig la dogs ram byas na char chu dus sung bas pa dang / rtag tu bde skyed kyi 'tsho bar longs su spyordo da rgyu yong bags por bstan yod/de nas dmangs sgrung 〈spobs pa mtho ba'i ri bong yo ༅ 〉la cha mtshon na/ srog chags che chung khag ka'adra ba rnams yid du 'ongs ba'i spang ljongs bde mo'i steng du 'tsho bzhin yod pa dang / srog chags de dag gi khrod du ri bong chung ༅ gcig yod zhing khol gzhang bong bu gcig yod stabasaspobs sems kyis dngas bzhin srog chags gzhan lamathong chung dang brnyasabacos khon byed kyi yod/ tshul 'di byams sems can gyi ga pho g.yag gisamathong rjes kho la sha tsha dang ldan pa'i bslang bya byas kyang kho pas g.yag gi bslab byar nyan rgyu lta ci/ de bas g.yag la gang na tshig ngan gyi dma' 'bebs mang po byas/ de nas nyin zhig nam mkhar sprin nag gis 'khrigasashing / sa gzhi yongs rdzogs kha ba'i gos dkar gyon pa'i dgus gyi dus kha ba drag po babs nas spobs bcan gyi ri bong 'di 'chi khar thug kyang da dung — 319 —

bo kyi srol 11 sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga bsrog chags gzhan la dma' 'bebs byas pa dang / mthar ri bong spongs pa can 'di'i tshang gangs dib shor nas kho pa yang skye lam du shor/ sgrung 'disaklog pa por srog chags yin yang rang la nye ba'i spun mchen dang grogasapostobs dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig yod srid kyang de dag ngoms nas gzhan gyi srog chags la dma' 'bebs dang brnyas bcos byed mi rung ba dang / gzhan yang srog chags gzhan gyi sha tsho'i snying gtam rna nga'i rgyab tu skyur na de yang rang nyid phungs ba'i rgyu 'ba' zhig yin pa bstan yod/de nas dmangs sgrub 〈sgam po khra skyid 〉la cha mtshon na/ srog chagasasgam po khra skyed zer ba bye'u'i lus la byi ba'i mgo dang ldan pa/ khos byi'u rnams dang 'phrad dus so bstan nas byi'u'i tshogs kyi khral las g.yol thangasabyed pa dang / yang byi ba'i tshogs rnams 'phrad dus gshog pa bstan nas bye ba'i khral rnams g.yol thangs bya mkhan las la mi brtson zhing / sgyid lugasadang ldan pa/ nyin ltar gsang spyod nang du 'dzul nas migatsang nga kho nar spyod mkhan zhig yod/ nyin zhig kho pa lho 'tshog bar 'gro skabs mgul kyi spu pad rag ltar dmar zhing gshog pa gas ltar sngo ba/ spu mdog 'ja' tshon ltar rnam par bkra la yid du 'ong ba'i byi'u ting ting sgrol ma dang ngo shes byung /sgam po khra skyid kyis bdag ni bya dang byi'u'i khrod du bya gral gyi thog mar bsdod pa dang rdza ra byi ba'i khrod du'ang gral mgor bsdad cing srog chags tshang masang la gud gud zhum zhum bya ye yod lugs sogs gtam 'dod can gyi dzun gtam mang po zhig bshad stabs byi'u ting ting sgrol ma yid dbang rab tu 'phrog nas khodang mdza' bcug gi 'brel ba btsugs/ gnas tshul de dag — 320 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rabyi'u ting ting sgrol ma'i grogs mo rnams kyis shes nas mol gta bslab bya mang po byas nas sgam po khra skyid kyis mgo skor btang tshur sogs zhingaṭubashad/ de nas byi'u ting ting sgrol mas rtag dpyad ga bzang byas po brgyud sgam po khra skyid kyis dang la mgo bskor btang ba shes tshor byung stod ma po khra skyid dang 'brel thag bcad/ sgrung 'dis klog pa por bya byi'u 'dab chagasayin yang dus nam yang las la brtson zhing sgyid lugs dang bral ba/ gtam 'dod rdzun gtam mi bshad par drang po'i las su 'jug pa/ gal srid gtam 'dod kyi rdzun gtam 'di re zhig lam du song yang mtha' ma shog thumanang du me sbas mi thub pa'i dpe ltar tshang brdol rgyu yin pa sogs zhing par bstan yod/mdor na/ bod kyi srog chags dang 'brel ba'i dmangs sgrung de dag rnams ni brjod bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs la legs nyes blangs dor kyi bslab bya'i rgyu dang ldan pa/ rjod byed tshig gi spyor ba ni shin dug son nyamasaldan la gzhan gyis go sga ba'i khyad chos kyis yongs su bcings yod/ de yang gong gi srog chags dang 'brel ba'i dmangs sgrung de dag phud da dub〈bya po'i dpa' skad) 〈ri dwags rgyal po dang ri bong shes rab can/〉 〈rta glen bdang ri bong blo ldan/〉 〈stag mig zan/〉 〈pho rog gis g.yud mar ster/〉〈'ug pa dang srin bya gnyis kyi gleng gtam/〉 〈za rngam che ba'i byi'u gsum/〉〈lug gu nag po/〉 〈ri bong gis drin lan 'jal ba1〉 〈spyang bshad/〉〈khyams sems can gyi bas ru/〉 〈spyang drung ldan pa'i byi'u mchil ma/〉 〈bya ye rgyal po 'dems pa〉sogs brjod ༅ nang don phun sum gas pa'i — 321 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bdamangs sgrub ha cang mang po zhig yod/gsum pa/ srog chags dang 'brel ba'i dmangs gzhas skor/dmangs gzhas ni kha ba'i ljongs kyi bod mi rigs khrod du dar khyab shin tu che ba'i rig gnas shig yin/ de yang lo rgyus kyi bgrang bya'i 'phrang lam ring po'i spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur gyi go rim nang du/ las la brtson zhing blorig bkra ba/ byams sems che la drang sems ldan pa'i bod mi chos rang nyid 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i spyi tshogs khor yug dang rang byung khams kyi snang tshul sna tshogs la ngos 'dzin dang 'brel gsar gtod byas pa zhig yin bas brjod bya de dag gsal zhing go sgal/ rjod byed tshig legs shing zor yang ba'i khyad chos kyis bcings yod/ dmangs gzhas spyi de la yang bye brag tu nang gsesakhag ka'adra ba bshas yod pa ste/ mdza' gzhas dang / tshig rgyag smon tshigango mtshar/ smre ngag kyi gzhag sogs yod/ de ltar bod kyi dmangs gzhas kyi bsgrub bya phal che ba zhig ni dpe ri skyes srog chags dang 'dab chags mi shing sogs la spyar nas brjod bya'i dpe can gyi nang don babs chags la gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas ston thub pa'i khyad chos dang ldan yod/ dper na/thag ring gi mgron po bas ba'i skabs su/‘‘shar gser zhu can sgyu ri bo nas/bya rgyal khyung chen 'phur nas 'ongs/bya khyung chen thag ring mgron po red/— 322 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rathag ring gi mgron por sbu mgyogs zhu/dgung sngon chu shes pho brang nas/gas 'brug sngon dgrags nas 'ongs/lhogs 'brug thag ring mgron po red/thag ring gi mgron por sku mgyogs zhu/nub phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams nas/pha ma mchos kyi khri khar phebs/pha zam thag ring mgron po red/thag ring gi mgron por sku mgyogs zhu/ ① zhes dpe can nub phyogs dag pa'i zhing phyogs nas phebs pa'i dbu 'phangs mtho nga'i skyesachen bla mdam pa de nyid dpe thag ring shar kyi gser zhu ri bo nas phebs pa'i bya rgyal khyung chen dang dgung sngon chu shel pho brang nas phebs pa'i gas 'brug sngon mo ji bzhin mthong dkon lag lhags che ba'i khyad chos dang ldan pa bstan pa'o/skyid pa'i 'du tshogs gleng ba'i skabs su/‘‘sha 'dus dgo 'dus spang la 'dus/sbang rtse tog yag na skyid 'dus red/① (dmangs gru snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lhags dpar deb ngos 3

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra ya nga bstag 'dus gzig 'dus na gsal 'dus/nags shing tog yag rten skyid 'dus red/che 'dus༅ 'dus༅la 'dus/khyimaja chab 'joms na skyed 'dus red mi④ ces dpe can khyem tshang nang gi rgan dar gzhon gsum 'dzoms pa'i skabs su gal srid ja chang no bcud dang ldan bzhig yod na/ de yang bde skyid nang gi bde skyed yin pa 'di dpe ri skyes sha bdang dgo ba mnyam du 'dzoms skabs yangasashing rgya che ba'i sgang ljongs steng du yid dbang shin tu 'phrog pa'i rtse tog dang /yang ri skyes stag dang gzig gnyis mnya mas 'dzoms skabs snag cing snum pa'i nags྾gyi khrod du phun sum gas pa'i shing tog gis bcings na de yang bde skyid nang gi bde skyid yin bltar mgo nag mi yin na'ang 'dra/ roskyes kyi srog ༅sa yin na'ang gang ltar de dgal 'tsho ba phun sumatshogasapar longs su spyod rgyu byung na de yang bde skyid nang gi bde skyid yin pa'i don bstan pa'o/mgron por bang dud rtsi ba྾mas bsab byed pa'i skabs su/‘‘dgung sngon tshang gi ston zo yin/'bru྾ chung 'dra ba'i mgron ྾/④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lcags dpar ba ngos 14— 324 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i ba tshom tsho rayo྾ma 'dra bas bsab byed/rdza khra yag za gi ston mo yin/'brong rtsa dmar 'dra lo yon polngaspeng tsetog 'dra bas bsab byed1pha gas rtse gi ston mo yin/gling ge gsar 'dra ba'i mgron pol/rṣa bdud rtsi ba྾mas bsab byed mi① zhes dpe can ags gi ston lo skabs su gling rje ge sar rgyal po lta bu'i mgron po pho gsar stag shar gzhon brnams bcoms bdud rtsi rṣa gis bsab byed pa 'di dpe dgung sngon dbyings kyi gas 'bug sngon po las ba zil mas bsababyed pa dang / ma ses da kyi stobs ldan 'brong ba la spang ljongs steng gi metog sna 'dzoms du ྾bsab byed pa ltar gcigs ga mgron po dag lazhabs zhu spus gas kyi bsab zhus yo don bstan pa'o1lon mnyam pa'i 'dris grogs po rnams mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i dus/‘‘dgung sngon po༅'grigs 'gro red/༅'grigs dkyil nas gas bzhugs ① (dmangs sku snyan dbang bdud ji〉bas shar de 〈 yo— 325 —

bo kyi srol 11 sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bayang 'grig pa'i mtha' na 'khrug chung 'khor/khyod 'brug chen sems kyi bde skyid red/rdza khra yag gral 'grig yang 'grig red/gral 'grig pa'i dkyil na seng chen bzhugs/yang 'grig pa'i mtha' na seng phrug 'khor/khyod seng chen sems kyi bde skyid red1 mgo khang ba gral 'grig yang 'grig red/gral 'grig pa'i gong na mgron po bzhugs/yang 'grig pa'i zhol na na za'akhor/o mgron po'i sems kyi bde sgyid red’① ces dpe can lo na mnyam pa'i chung 'dris grogs po rnams phan tshun mnyam 'dzoms byung nas grogs po phan tshun sba gsang med par snying dang snying gtugs pa'i skad cha dang rtsed 'jor rol ba 'di dpe dgung sngon dbyings kyi 'brug rṣa yon khrod du 'brug chung 'brug phrug 'khor ba dang / gangs rdza ri'i khrod kyi seng chen maye gam du gces phrug seng phrug rtsed 'jor rol ba ji bzhin sems nang gi bde skyed long spyod 'ba' zhig yin pa'i don bstan pa'o/byams sems can kyi dpon la 'bangs mi ser 'khor ba'i dus/① 〈dmangs klu snyan dbang bdud tsi〉lcags dpar deb ngos 28— 326 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol btsam lha'i ra‘‘stod kan na ri chen sprug po can1ri sprug pa can la ri dwags 'khor/'di ri dwags 'khor na gzhi bdag dag ga'/bar kan na mtsho po rlangs pa can/mtsho rlang pa can la nya sras 'khor/'di nya sram 'khor na klu rgyal dga'/smad 'di na dpon po byams sems can/dpon byams sems can la 'bangs mi 'khor/'di 'bangs mi 'khor na dpon po dga' ① zhes dpe can drang sems ldan lagayo sgyu med pa/ bya mas sems ldan long nga rgyud ring ba'i dpon ris bzang po'i gam du 'bangs mi ser 'khor na mnyes tshor chen po byung ba dag dpe ri chen sprug pa can gyi khrod du ri skyes srog chags 'khor na gnas 'di'i yul lhagazhi bdag mnyes po yod pa dang / yang yangs shing rgya che ba'i mtsho po blangs pa can gyi nang du srog chags nya dang sras gyi tshogasa'akhor na de yang klu dbang rgyal po mnyes po yong rgyu yin pa'i bzhin dpon byams sems can kyis 'bangs mi ser lamago bton gtso skyongs gnang ba'i don bstan pa'o/④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi7gas dpar deb ngos1⑪

bo kyi srol ri bas nga nga sa (1 ra yu nga bde yang dag chen bzang po de dag ni tsho 'di ga'i rgyan yin zhesapa'i skabs su/‘‘stod kyi sha bo du dar can/mgo ru dar 'dzoms nas bsdad dang na/srib kyi lung ba'i rgyan zhig red/smad kyi ma bya sgo gur cakalus sgro gur 'dzoms nas bsdad dang na/chu mchu lo ma'i rgyan zhig red/tsho drug ldan dpon po tsho/sde mgo ba༅yonas bsdad dang na/sku rgyal bod kyi rgyan zhig red ①ces dpe can byamasasems che la drang sems ldan pa'i dpon byas pa can ni yum gru'i mdzes rgyan bzang po yin bdag dpe ri skyes sha ba ru dang ldan pa 'di spangs ljongs yulagyi mdzes rgyan dang / ma bya sgo gur mdzes ma 'di rma chu yul kyi mdzes rgyan ltabur bkod nas mkhas zangs ldan la blo rig bkra ba'i dpon bzang risamed kun skyongs thub pa 'di yul gru yongs kyi spongs pa yin pa'i don bstan pa'o/④ (dmangs sku snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lcags dpar deb ngos 105— 328 —

rang nga yu nga 'brel ba'i srol bsams ra—a khu 'brog pas rang gi phyugs bdakar nag norabur brtsi ba'i skabasaspa‘‘dgung ga sngon o dkar gur khang na/'brug yo༅ g.yang yor bu red/ bkra shis pa'i g.yo dar por ba྾/mtsho sngon po chu shel gur khang na/nya gser mig༅nga gi nor bu red/bas shis pa'i g.yang dar ya ra la bstod1sab྾ ldan shel dkar gur khang na/phyugs nor ba g.yang gi nor bus/bkra shi ba'i bas dar yo la bstod 3④ ces dpe can ba྾zhing rtsa ka'adzoms pa'i ga kyi steng du zog dkar nag sha gshed rgyasab 'di gsa'ang pa'i g.yo gi nor bu yin ba 'di dpe dar la babs pa'i g.yuḥgayob ni yangs shing rgya che ba'i dang sngon dbyings gyi nor budang / mdzes po ཿga pa'i gas mig nya ༅ gas nos ba mtha' bral ba'i mtsho sngon shka g.yo gnor bu lta yongs nas zog dkar nagartag du skyes 'phel byung bshags rgyas pa' di byung thang gas 'brog pa'i ① (dmangs klu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉 lhas dpar ba ngos133— 329 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba—nor bu'i nang gi nor bu yin pa'i don bstan pa'o/byas pa can gyi pha mas rang phrug gas skyongs gnang bar lusang ga yid gsum gyi sgo nas dad pa'i bka' drin mapho ma du/‘‘spang gser bo'i khug gi sha bo skyid/rwa bcu lag rgyas pa spang gi drin/badzra tog med na ji ltar skyid/mtsho sngon po'i nang gi nya mo skyed/lus gshog drug rgyas pa mtsho mo'i drin/chu gtsang mo med na ji ltar skyid/༅ pha ma'i rtsib kyi bu phrug skyid/chung ga snyam lag rgyas pa pha ma'i drin/yul pha ma med na ji ltar skyid mi① ces dpe can lang 'tsho dar la babs pa'i dgu tshos da ltarang la ldan pa'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho nga dang dzragros kyi shes bya/ 'od stong ldan pa'i mdun lam sogs yod tshad kyi yod tshad tshang ma ni bdag skyes pha ma gnyis kyi sku drin yin bdag da bsha pho sha gshed rgyas pa speng gi drin dang nya mo lus stobs rgyas pa mtsho ye drin lta bur bkod nas dmed pa'i pha ma'i bka' drin ni dus nam yang 'jal thabs dka' ④ (dmangs sku snyan dbang bdud mi)lcags dpar deb ngos 137— 330 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i raba'i don bstan pa'o1 bod da rigs kyi rang gshis bzang po ri mo'i lam du bkod thal/‘‘rta 'do ba'i rgyud 'di rkyang gi rgyud/'di rkyang gi rgyud la rgas rgyu med/de rgas rung gos pa 'chos rgyu med/mdzo khyung dkar rgyud 'di 'brong gi rgyud/'di 'brong gi rgyud la rgas rgyu med/de rgas rung 'brong rwa lhung rgyu med/bod gdong dmar rgyud 'di dpa' bo'i rgyud/'di dpa' bo'i rgyud la rgas rgyu med/de rgas rung dpa' stobs nyams rgyu med ④ ces dpe can bod mi rigs kyi snying rje ldan la dpa' stobs che ba/ ngang rgyud ring la g.yo sgyu med pa/ blo rig bkra la brtson grus che ba'i rang bzhin bzang po de dag dpe ri skyes srog chags lnga dkar rkyang ji ltar rgas kyang gos bgrod ka' chos ba dang / stobs ldan 'brong ji ltar rgas kyang 'brong rwa lhung srol med pa lta bu'o zhes kha ba'i ljongs kyi bod mi'i rang gshis bang po rnams dus nam yang 'gyur dka' ba'i don bstan pa'o1① (dmangs klu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lcags dpar deb ngos1yo

bo kyi srol zig sa nga nga sa ra ༄ nga bapha ma gnyis kyis rang gis lha gur 'dzin pa'i lhad med brtse dung skabs su/ ‘‘rkyang ga dkar gser gyi gdog can/dgung nyi zla gnyis kyi chibs pa red/stod sha bo gser gyi rin thang can/rdza mthon po gnyis kyi sgo zog red/ma bu dung gi so sgo can/yul pha ma gnyis kyi sems ltos red ① ces dpe can lang 'tsho rgas pa'i pha ma rnams kyis dang gi lang tsho bgrang bya'i rkun pos bcomasaskabs chung nas gsos pa'i rang gi phru gur re ba bcol ba'i 'du shes 'di dpe ri dwags srog ༅sa kha dkar rkyang 'di dgung gi nyi zla'i chibs rta yin ༅nga / sha bo khra ril 'di brjid ༅sa rdza ri mthon po'i sgo phyugs lta bu yin zhes pha ma rgan rgon lon rgad skabs 'ang 'tsho dar la babs pa'i gzhon skyes lha gu rnams kyis blta skyongs dang dogs ram byed dgos pa'i don bstan pa'o/stag shar gzhon pa skyes pa pho'i ngabs bstan pa'i skabs su/‘‘lhogs na grong sgo mi nyul ga④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud dzi)lcags dpar deb ngos220— 332 —

rang nga ra ༄ nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam byu'i rabre ser 'brong gi ngang tso yin/sgom na 'dam chu mi yong ba/ga dkar rkyang gong nga g.yin/sdug na mig chu migatong ba/skyes pa pho yongang tshi yin ① zhes dpe can yan lag gi dbang por ba sa rgyas la snying stobs kyi spobs pas yongs su phyug pa'i pho gsar stag shar gzhon po tsho 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal dang / las ka'i gnon shugs/ brtse dung las da ser sogs dka' ngal ji lta bu zhig 'phrad kyang nyams dmas pa'i mig chu rtsa ba nas migatong ba'i ngang ka'adi dpe stobasaldan bre ser 'brong po ji ltar ltogs kyang tsho grong khu du za yo'྾du mi yong ba dang / spongs bcan gyi ga dkar rkyang ga pho skom yang 'dam chu skosang ba lta bur bkod de skyes pa phor dka' ngal gas 'phrad kyang dka' ngal la mgo mi sgur ba'i don bstan pa'o/pha ma'i lang 'tsho bgrang byu rkun po bcoms nas rang skya 'phel ba'i 'tshob༅thabs༅skabs dka' bdu mas gas byas nas yo nasagasola'i dgu yis4 ma rgan rgod gnyis pos dang dogs ramabyed rgyu dzing tsho bod tsho mes yi dus nas bas yo rang gshis yo ① dmangs sku snyan dbang bdud mi〉bas dpar de jo༅41— 333 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babazang 'ba' zhig yin/ 'on te las 'bras mi brtsi ba1 sdig pa'i grogs kho nar brten mkhan dgu 'ga' zhig gis bod mi'i rang gshis bzang po 'di rna ba'i rgyab kyi rlung bur bskur nas rang nyid rang 'go thon skabs pha ma'i bka' drin gting brjed du btang nas pha mar mthong chung dang mthar bcugs pa'i tha shal spyod tshul 'ba' zhig byed kyi yod/ de yang pha sems bu dang bu semasardo zhes pa'i nang du/‘‘'brong bre ser yid sems rdza lagatad/rdza khrel med ri mgo gabs bzung /'brong bre ser 'khor ba'i kho thag ra/bya ngang pa'i yid sems mtsho la gtad/chu khrel med mtsho la 'gram dar chags/bya ngang ba 'khor ba'i kho thag sa/a pha ma'i blo sems byu ga gtad/bu khrel med yid sems rdo ba chags/yul pha mags ba'i kho thag ra ’① ces dpe can byas pa can gyi pha ma gnyis lang 'a tsho yol nas rgad pa'i tshe rang gi tshe mjug re lhosaphrugur bcol yang khrel med dgus rang la bkur bste mi byed ba'i tshul de dag ④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lcags dpar deb ngos 268— 334 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i radape 'brong bre ser gyi re ba rdza ri mthon por bcol yang rdza ri mthon po gangasakyis klubs nas 'brong pre ser 'tsho ba'i gnas dang bral ba dang / gser bya ngang pa'i blo gtad yangs ba'i mtsho mor bcol yang khrel med gtum mas ra la gas nas gser bya ngang pa'i blo gtad bcom yums blta bur bkod de tha shal spyod ྾ 'ang 'a zhig gis bcings pa'i khrel med dgu'i mas bru bar byas pa'o/gzhan yang dmangs gzhas 'di'i rigs kyi sgrub bya gzhan zhig ni dpe dang dpe can gyi go rim mi sgrigs par rjod byed sa 'bru tshang ma dpe ri skyesasrog chags dang / 'dab sas1 rtsi shing sogs la bkod de brjod bya'i dpe can gyi nang don shugs kyis go bar nus pa'i dmangs gzhas kyang mi nyung ba zhig yod/ dper na/‘‘khyung chen mkha' la lding 'dra'i klu zhig len/gshog rtsal dgung nas ngoms pa'i glu zhig len/seng chen gangs la 'gying 'dra'i glu zhig len1gsar la dbu na shoms pa'i glu zhig len/rgya stag nags la mchongs 'dra'i glu zhig len/dpa' rtsal lus la 'dzoms pa'i gru zhig len ① zhes khyung ④ 〈dmangs klu snyan dbang bdud rtsi)lcags dpar deb ngos 57— 335 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bachen dgung sngon dbyings su lding nas gshog rtsal ngoms pa dang / seng chen gangs ri'i rtsel 'gying nas g.yur la ngoms pa/ stag mo nags྾ stum bzad du dpa' rtsal ma lus ngoms pa sogs brjod de don du glu gzhasagatong ༅lo mngon par rtser son gyi glu yo du 'phags pa zhig 'bul ba'i don bstan pa'o/pha yodang / bza' zla/ spun mar/ grogs po/ khyim mtshesasogs bstod pa 'bul ba'i skabs su/‘‘rdza khra yag dkyil kyi 'brong mo skyed/ba mi tog med na ci ltar skyid/sa rtsi tog pha ma'i kha ma red/rtsa rgya mas gting gi nya mo skyed/chu dngas po med na ci ltar skyid1chu dngas mo pha ma'i kham re da/na bde mo stong gi rkyang phrug skyed/tso ljang bu med na ci ltar skyid/she bus yo gas red ④ ces 'brong mo g.yum rdza ri'i steng du bde zhing rma ba 'di lha rtsi tog yod pa'i bka' drin dang /④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lhags dpar deb ngos117— 3yo —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol bcom lha'i ra gser mig nya mo mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i nang du bde zhing skyid pa 'di mtsho modangs shing gtsang ba'i bka' drin/ kha dkar rkyang phrug na gar bde zhing skyid pa 'di ba ljang bu yod pa'i bka' drin yin zhes brjod bya'i don du da ltabade zhing skyid pa'i 'tsho bar longs su spyod rgyu byung ba 'di/ pha yo ༅'a drin nam/ bza' zla'i bka' drin/ spun mched kyi bka' drin/ grogasapo'i bka' drin/ khyem mchos kyi bka' drin sogs yin ba bstan pa'o/de bzhin dung ri spang ri gas ri gsum zhes pa'i nang du/‘‘shar phyogs dung ri dkar bo red/'dab lag dung gi mchod rten red/rtsi bcud dung gi me tog red/gnag mo nor gyi pha sa red/zho 'o ma gnyis kyi gzhi ma red/lho phyogs g.yu ri sngon po red/'dang la ga ga kun maṇḍal red/rtsi bcud g.yunas tog red/kha dkar rkyang gi pha sa red/rta rgod loganyis kyi gzhi ma red/nub phyogs sbang ri ser bo red/'dang la ga gser gyi bums red/

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga brtsi bcud gser gyi ye tog red/g.yang dkar lug gi pha sa red/gos phrug gnyis kyi gzhi ma red ① ces don du ba chu dusasung bas pa/ rtag du lo legs bzang ba1 rgyun du phyugs sha shed rgyas pa'i pha yul 'di dung gi mar rten dang / gas yem༅/ gser gi bum pa ltar sus kyang 'gran zla bral ba zhig yin pa bstan pa'o/'brong ru dmar rwa rtse no po red ces pa'i nang du/‘‘dgung a sngon bang rim rgod pos bzung /rgod thang dkar gshog sne dkar ni red/rdza khra yag lung ba 'brong gis bzung /'brong ru dmar rwa rtse no ni red/ stod sgang dkar lung nga rkyang gis bzung /rkyang kha dkar gom lag bde ni redami1④ ces blo rig bkra la las la brtson pa/ brtse sems ldan long nga rgyud ring ba/ drang sems ldan la g.yos med pa'i kha ba'i ljongs kyi mi dmangs kyis rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i blo gros dang shes rig la brten nas pa yums gas skrun dang bdag ① (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lcagasadapar deb ngos 143④ (dmangs klu snyan dbang bdud mi〉lhags dpar deb ngos165— 338 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ra skyongs gang legs byas pa bstan pa'o/gzhan yang / yags cha 'grig ces pa'i dmangs gzhas nang du/‘‘rta ra ra'i rogs pa rkyang rkyang red/rgyug mgyogs dal med na yag re ltogabya ma bya'i dogs brgya bya red/sgo yag btsog med na yag re ltos1bya khu byug rogs pa ne tso red/skad yag btsog med na yag re ltos1④ zhes don du gang zhig gser gyi ri laganas bcol na/ de ye 'dab chags thams cad gser du gyur/ gang zhig bdud kyi ri laganas bcol na/ de ye 'dab chagasathams cad bdud du gyur zer ba'i gtam ji bzhin grogs po mnyam sgrig byed skangs/ phan tshun gnyis ka'i rang gshis dang spyod lam mthun po dang babasachags dgos lugs sogs bstan pa'o/tswal bstod pa zhes pa'i dmangs gzhas nang du/‘‘snyamago ga dkar rkyang gis bzos/rkyang rnam rig rgod pa de ye drin/① (dmangs sku snyan dbang bdud mi〉lhags dpar deb ngos210

bo kyi srol zig sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga badzod da g.yang mo lug gis zos/lug ngal rdzong mthug pa de ye drin/dag ting bre ser 'brong gis zos/ 'brong sha kha mthug pa de ye drin1 ① zhes don du dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che dang / chung sbar mo gang nas gso skyongs gnang mkhan ni drin chen pha ma gnyis po dang / de nas mig rum gyi mun pa sel nas shesabya'i sgron me lag tu gnang mkhan ni drin chen bshes gnyen dam pa yin zhesabaka' drin can kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams la bstod pa'i don bstan pa'o/de bzhin/‘‘mtho nam mkha'i bya lam gong ma nas/dar ser po yug gcig rlung gis bskyod/dar ser po ma red thang dkar red/ser lam med bus gtsang stod la phur/mtho nam mkha'i bya lam bar yonas/dar ljang g.yug gcig rlung gis bskyod/dar ljang khu ma red ma bya red/ljang ldem me rgya gar yul la phur/④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lcags dpar deb ngos 227— 340 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ramatho nam mkha'i bya lam zhol yonas/dar sngon po yug gcig rlung gis bskyod/dar sngon po ma red ga byug red/sngo ldem rtse lho rong mon la 'phur3① zhes pa dang yang /‘‘brag rtse rdza rtse gangs rtse gsum/ri de gsum rtse mos sngon gnas/dgung nyi ma g.yas skor kyi lo li/dgung zla ba g.yon skor kyi da li/dgung ga sngon bstan ba ji dar red/brag sked rdza sked gangs skyed gsum /ri de gsum skyed brdo rje bragargod thang dkar g.yas skor kyi da li/rgod thang sprug g.yon skor kyi lo li/brag rdo rje bstan pa ji dar red/brag rtsa rdza rtsa gangs rtsa gsum1ri de gsum rtsa bag྾ mo chu/① (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud mi〉lhags dpar dis ngo༅yo — mo1 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bsram nag po g.yas skor kyi li li/nya gser mig g.yon skor kyi li li /chu gtsang bo'i bstan ba ji dar red 1④ gzhan yang /‘‘dgung sngon po'i dkyil la glu zhig len/dgung nyi zla yid bzhin nor bu red/'brug pho chung nor bu'i rgyan cha red/char ba྾mnor bu'i dngos grub red/rdza khra yag dkyil la glu zhig len/rdza khra yag yid bzhin nor bu red/'brong bre ser nor bu'i rgyan cha red/nang rdza chu nor bu'i dngos grub red/nags rgya rdzob dkyil lo gru zhig len/nags tsan da na yid bzhin nor bu red/bya khu byug nor bu'i rgyan cha red/mgo ྾ tog nor bu'i dngos grub red mi① ces sogasabarjod bya phun sumatshogs la rjod byed tshig snyan zhing 'jigs pa'i dmangs④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi〉lcags dpar deb ngos 239④ (dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi)lcags dpar deb ngos 244— 342 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ragazhas 'bor chen zhig bod kyi yul grur khyab nas bsdad yod/mdor na1 bod kyi dmangs gzhas nang gi ri skyes srog chags dang /'dab chags/ rtsi shing sogs la sbyar ba'i brtsams bya de dag gi thog nasagangs ri'i sa mtho'i thog gi bod mi chos rang byung khor yug la bcangs ba'i bsam pa'i 'du shes dang / ri skyes srog chags la bcangs ba'i lhad med brtse sems sogs gsal por mtshon thub kyi yod/bzhi pa/ srog chags dang 'brel ba'i gtam dbe'i skor/gtam dpe ni gangs ljongs yul gru kun gyi mang tshogs kyis dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i nang du bed spyod shin tu che ba'i ngag thog gi dmangs khrod rtsom rig cig yin/ rtsom rig de la tshig bsdus shing spyod bde ba/ don gsal zhing go sgab/ bshad na smra lce bde ba/ nyan na rna bar snyan pa/ dpe mtshon gson nyams ldan brjod byed nyams gyur ldan bsogs kyi ngo mtshar khyad chos du mas bcings yod/ de yang bod mi'i gtam dpe'i bang mdzod nang du'ang rang byung khams dang / srog chags dang rtsi shing sogs la sbyar ba'i gtayodape yang mi nyung ba zhig yod/dper na 'phya smod dang zur za byed pa'i skabs su/rnga mong ske ti ring rung / gnam kyi skar ma'i lon/ri bong sug ti thung dub1—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kye ra yu nga ba'aba' 'bur lam la mi thogastag mchongs sar wa mo mchongs na/wa lo ma'i ske gas 'phud srid/bya khā tas gnas 'phang kar/ mi ngan pas rang mgo mi thub/'bu nag bas bor rwa co skyes/bre ser 'brong las g.yug byas/'bu nag rwa co can la 'brong me zer/sbrang nag thig lo can la stag mi zer/khye dgu gnyis kyis nye ngo shes/bya ri dwags gnyis kyis dgra ngo shes/khyis phar zug med par/gla phos sa zugakhrung khrung spu rig dkar na'ang /— 3yo —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ra mjug gu'i rtse mo nag po red/gangs dkar seng ge'i g.yur la la/khyi nag dom bu'i rnga mas 'gran/spyang mo khog gnong med na ri zur 'grimadon med/sha pho tsher snang med na rdza rtse 'grimadon med/wa mo sdar mas gangs steng seng ger 'gran/nas gzan bye'u sa nas 'phang rgod por 'gran/'phrug thang nas thang la zag rgyu med/rgod phrug g.yang nas zags snying ro rje/ba ge'i g.yur la la/ba'i lag rtsed/yo ba ma byas dug zas/rma bya'i mgo la sgo gdugs skyes/ ka'aju bzhi mig snum bsagazhi mi'i mgo lar lab༅sa/

bo kyi srol ri la nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bgazig tshang sgo rtsar/gla ba'i 'phag 'asarnga mong ske ring yang /la phar rgyab dag mi stob/bya chen mang po tshogs dus/pu shud mjug sgro skam song /wa las g.yo sgyu che ba med/wa mas 'ang ba rgyug che ba med/ ces za mong ji ltar gyi gzugs mtho yang dgung gi nyi zla skar gsum 'dzin par mi nus pa dang /grong pa'i sgo khye nag po ji ltar gtum zhing drags kyang gangs bsdod seng ge'i g.yur la la do zla bral nga/ 'bu nag bas bor rnor ngar can gyi rwa co ldan rung stobs ldan 'brong gi zla bor ka'adzin pa/ rkang drug sbrang nag la thig le'i kha mdog gis spras kyang nags kyi rgyal po gcan zan stag dang khyad ḍa— da chen po yod lugs sogs bkod de nyam ༅ skye bor rtag rtsamathong chung dang brnyas bcos khona'i brtul bzhugs 'dzin mkhan nga mkhasang 'jon gyi skye bo tha shal de dag lagason nyams ldan la brnag thog rtsa 'khel gyi 'phya smod dang zur za mapho par byas yod/— 346 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rasbang blang bslab bya ston pa'i skabs su/'gro wa rolas mkhas/sdod ri bong las bogagangs dkar po seng ge'i gdan sal1'brug pho chung yin yang gzur na dga'/bya pho rog nag rung mas bdakar/nga'i ba rtsub rung bsams dkar/khrung khrung dkar pol/mjug rtse nag po ma song ba/glang chen gyi khal be'ur bkal ba/ngang pa mtsho la 'gro bar zab ltas phyi bltas/stag lamachongs za bco brgyad yod na/walas la khung bcu dgu yod/stag mchongs sar ra mchongs na/

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba ra yem jing gas log yong /dred mong gis 'phyi ba 'dzin pa'i las ma byed/spre'u gsab pa las/seng ges 'gyings pa dga'/dgos kyis brgyan/bya sgo yis brgyan/rma bya dang phe ta mnyam du 'grogs mi srid/glang chen dang ba glang mnyam du sdeb mi srid/tsi tsho ram pa za bar za lugs dang /ab ra thang la rgyug par rgyug lugs/ra lug brdung kha brgyab na/mgo khrags mos bldags yong /sa'i ri mo thang la yod/stag gi ri mo phyi la yod/— 348 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i ga brtsam bya'i rami'i ri yonang la yod/sha 'drog rkyang 'drog dgo ba 'droga'adrog rgyu mi rnyed ri bong 'drogasha pho la sgang 'gro ba la/phyi bltas la na gsum lta dgos/sngon la skyes pa rna cogamajug du skyes pa rwa co/rna cog sngon la skyes kyang /skyes rtsal ra co bzang ba/spre'ur mjug ma yod ba sprugs na shes/༅la yan lag yod med btsir na shes/mgo rwa co bsnams 'brong min/da yo tsog tsog tsho sa zam min/pho rog rgas kyang skad ba ci sdzawīr pho rgas lha pas/— 349 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga brgan pas gang byed gzhon pas byed/gla ba'i dgus brag la 'dzegs/'brong bre ser khas 'khyer yong lo min/stag dmar g.yag sgo khye yong le min/ zhes skye bo ka'adra zhig yin yang rnams kun 'tsho ba'i nang du dgazhan la gang byung gis 'phya sbod dang brnyas bcos sogs༅ min gyi bya ba la ka'ajug par‘‘'gro wa molasamakhas pa dang 1 sdod ri bong las lhag pa bzhig byung na/ phan tshun gnod sems dang bral nas 'cham mthun ngang 'tsho gnas thub pa zhig yong gi yod/der brten bya ba gang zhig gi dbu 'dzugs skabs‘‘sha pho la sgang du 'gro ba la/phyi bltas la na gsum lta dgos zhes pa ltar phyis byung gi 'bras bu bzang ngan gang thon thad sngon nas bsam blo drug gsum bco brgyad btang na/ bya ba gang gi thad la'ang ka'am pa zhig yong thub1 'on te gong gi bslab bya de dag ra du ma bzung bar ‘‘stag la mchongs chen bco brgyad yod na/ wa la tshul khung bcu dgu yod1ces dang ‘‘spre'u mjug ma yod med sprugs na shes/sprul la yan lag yod med btsir na shes’ ces phan tshun nga rgyal dang zhe sdang /phrag dog gti mug 'dod bas sogs kyi rtse lce drag po rnam dpyod shesarang sbrang char gyis snubs mi thub tshe ‘‘rgan bas gang byed gzhon pas byed/gla ba'i phru gus brag la 'dzegs ces pa ltar phyis byung gzhon skyes kyi phrug gu rnams la'ang bag chag sa shin tu ngan pa zhig yong gi yod pa sogs 'gro 'dug — 350 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i raspyod gsum gyi bslab cha mang dag cig gsal bar bstan yod/bstod pa dang yid smon gyi ngang lhos bstan pa'i skabs su/drug pa'i sha bo'i rwa/ bco lnga'i gla ba'i rtsi/bcu ba'i wa mo'i gra dbyar gyi rma bya'i sgro/stag dar mas stag phrug khrid khrid/'brong bre 'us 'brong phrug gsogaso/'ug pas mun pa rub na 'dod/bya phos nam mkha' lang ka'adod/kha ba nyin tshan bco brgyad babs kyang /byi'u co ka khra mo'i skad la 'gyur ba med/kha dkar rkyang la kha lo med/bre ser 'brong la sna lo med/rgod thang dkar brag rtser bsdad na'ang /mig rgyang gis ri klung kun lo mthob1— 351 —

bo kyi rten ri sa nga nga sa ra yu nga ba stag mo sha gnas sa kyang /rang sha rang gis mi za/stag shi yang sder mi skam/wa shi yang gra da nyam ga bya kha ta pho rog skyung ka gsum/lus nag kyang sems pa dung las dkar/bya ngang pa byang la 'gro le red/mtsho me long tsam la gtad pa red/rtsa bzang la ri dwags dang /chu bzang la khrung khrung /sha lo shed dang /dgo pho'i bang /e chu mdo sgang gi mi lus las/lung pa sa chu 'dzoms pa'i ri dwags skyid/— 352 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsa ma bya'i nas mkha'i bya la rogs dgogs 'og 'bu la grogs dgog dbyi dkar po'i rgyu mdang /shel dkar po'i mar rten/ zhes stag shar gzhon pa'i yan lag gi cha yongs su rdzogs par gyur nas dpa' dang blo gros rtsal sogasagang gi thad la'ang mngon par maryā tu gyur ba'am/ dman shar bu lo lang pho tshe tog rab tu smin nas mdzangs ma'i yon tan ma lus yongasasurdzogs skabs‘‘drug pa'i sha bo'i rwa/ bco lnga'i ga ba'i rtsi/ bcu ba'i wa lo gra dbyar gyi ma bya'i sgro zhes pa dang / byams sems can gyi pha mas sha lasabacad pa'i dgur lhad med kyi brtse sems dang / zol med kyi gas skyongasaganang ba'i skabs su‘‘stag dar mas mi gu khrid khrid/ 'brong bro lus 'brong phrug gsogaso/mimi yang rang gi pha ma spun mar dang dga' nye brtse grogasasogs phyi rol gyi khor a cha rkyen tsi 'dra zhig la 'gyur ldog ci tsam zhig byung yang 'gyur med brtse sems rdo la ri mobs bltar brtan por gnas pa'i dus‘‘khab nyin sa bco brgyad babs kyang / byi'u co ka khra lo skad la'agyur ba med ces dang 1 de bzhin sbas blangs kyi bya ba'i yo rmongs pa'i dri mas ma sbags pa'i rnam dpyod mas po da྾ por‘‘rgod thang dkar brag rtser bsdad na'ang / mig rgyang gis ri klung kun lamathong /3zhes dang /gzhan yang ‘‘e chu mdo sgang gi da lus las/ lung bas chu 'dzoms pa'i ri — 353 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bdwags skyid ces 'gro ba da yod la 'byor lus rten thob kyang lus semasagadung gi mnar ba'i skye bo las/ ri lung lha chu 'dzoms pa'i ri dwags snang ba skyid ba gru zor yang la nyam gyur ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gi yid smon bya tsho dang / bstod bsngags bya ༅rnams ga྾ por mngon par byas yod/gzhan yang dpa' snying stobs kyi brjod bya ston pa'i skabs su/pho bya rgyal khyung gi rwa nag yin na/nga zhe sdang sprul gyi lce nag nag yin/khyod sha rwa rwa lag mang na/nga dgo rwa thems pa los yod/khra khra 'ug pa'i sgo 'dra 'dra/brtag sog le'i kha 'dra 'dra/rgya stag dmar pon gas nasang ra na1seng ge dkar mo gangs nas los 'gying /ngang phrug la rkyal rtsal rdzogs/rgod phrug lagashog rtsal rgyas/bya rgod po zhig la ci za /— 354 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rabyi'u zhar ma zhig la'ang de tshal1za spyad stag gi g.yod na/'ju spyad go bo'i pho bdagos/—ngang pa mtsho ka' phur dus/nya mo skrag dgos med/wa shi yang gra mnyam pa/pha med kyang gnya' mi chaga'aphyi ba sug lag thung yang / speng lhagazhan la mi sprod/wa mo 'dzum gson ngom pa las/rtag shi rnga mngoms pa dga'/gangs sdod seng ge'i g.yur la ngoms la/sa 'og 'bu srin ༅ pa'i rgyu mas med/ ces skye bo ka'adra zhig yin rung gdog bsdad na khamachu med/ mgo rus du bcug na lhags pa med zer ba ltar phan tsa sdang sems dang khengs dregs kyi semasang na yo— 355 —

bo kyi srol zig sa nga nga sa kyi ra ldan nga ba'achang na rang skyid la gzhan skyid pa'ang yong gi yod/ 'on te dug gsumagyis bcings ba'i skye bo tha shal 'ga' zhig gis brdungs par brdungs la na maslog na/ rdung mkhan mang du mang du 'gro zhes pa ltar rtag tu nyam chung skye bor brnyas bcos kho na'i brtul zhugs la 'jug gi yod/ der brten ga bya rgyal khyung gi rwa nag yin na/ nga zhe sdang jig gyi lce nag nag yin/ khyod sha rwa rwa lag mang na/ nga dgo rwa theg pa los yod1 khra khra 'ug pa'i sgro 'dra 'dra1mi rtag sog le'i kha 'dra 'dra/ 'phyi ba sug lag thung yang / speng lhagazhan la mi sprod zhes pa ltar bden pa'i chen du tha shal skye bo de dag gi tha shal spyod tshul dang 'thab rtsod byed rgyu 'di dpa' dang blo gros gnyis kyis phyug pa yin pa dang / de yang ngan pa tshar bcad na/ bzang po sgob 'phel ba bzhin spyi tshogs dang khor yug kun la phan pa yod pa'i don mang po bstan yod/mdor na/ gong gi dpe mtshon tsam du drangs pa'i srog ༅yodang sbyar ba'i gtam dpe de dag ni nga tsho'i sngon byon mes pos 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang du srog chags kyi rang gshis dang 'tsho ba'i goms gshis sogs la gzhigs nas skrun pa zhig yin stabs/ de dag brjod byed tshig bru thung yang brjod bya'i nang don gsal bar ston thub pa/ dpe don dbar la 'brel ba babs chagasalarjod byed gson nyams ldan pa/ nyan pa tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog thub la blo ye yul du 'jags bde ba'i khyad chos sogs du mas bcings yod/
