rang nga ra nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ralnga pa/ skyes dngos srog chags dang 'brel ba'i mngon brjodaXskor/bod kyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi ga rgyal mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'di logazhi rtsom rig gi khongs su gtogs kyi med mod/ 'on kyang bod kyi rtsom rig rjod byed pho gi tha snyad nang du med du mi rung ba'i grub cha 'ba' zhig lags pas da thengs kho bos kyang bod kyi rtsom rig nang du rgyun du bed spyod mang ba'i rtsi shing dang srog ༅sa/ de bzhin khor yug gas kyi ming gi rnam grangs mngon brjod skor lamado tsam zhig gleng na/gcig skyes dngos kyi mngon brjod skor/nags྾ gyi ming la/ ྾/ za ྾ / nags klung / stug po'i nags/ nags 'thib po1 shing ldan nags/ skyed mos tshal gyi ming la/khyim gyi ྾/ bcos pa'i nags/ skyed mos྾/ nye ba'i ྾/ ljon shing lha mar/ tso ba'i sa/ khyim kyi kun dga' ra ba/ 'bras shing ra ba'i ming la/ bza' shing ra ba/ 'bras ldan nags/ mchog gi ྾/ ngalagaso'i 'dun sa/ skyo sangs gnas/ dpal gyi kun dga' ra ba/ ljon shing gi ming la/ ljon pa'i shing / yal ga༅/ 'dang ldan/ rkang pong /rkang pas yong / rlan las skyes/ yo gis/ rtse mo can/ mgo lding — 357 —

bo la la la la sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bcan/ 'gro 'gog 'gro med/ steng skye ba/ 'dab ma yangs ldan/ la ga bres/ sdong po rnam rgyas/ la 'dang can/ sa skyes/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gi ming la/ pe tog 'bras ldan/ nags mcho mo gsham min/'bras bu 'dzin/ 'bru ldan/ 'bras ldan/ shing thog can/ snye ma can/bza' shing sdon dkar po'i ming la/ dri zhim dkar po/ dri zhi btags/ba lang mgo ha ri sdon/ me'i srung shing / tsamachog sdon dmar po'i ming la/ til dmar can/ 'dab ma'i lus/ chos byed/ snun ldan/sa'i sdon/ spos dkar gyi ming la sa la'i ljon pa/ sa la'i shing / rna ba can/ la sa shing thog med/ lo thog mchog med lhag ma/ ag ru'i ming po/ ag ru/ mdzes sbyin byed/ dri zhig ljon pa/ phibadag dga'/thal ba'i rnying po/ 'dab zung can/ phreng ba'i dri/ bkris can/ shug pa'i ming la/ de ba dwa ru/ lhan shing / brgya sbyin rkang la nga / yongasabazang can/ thang shing / mda' 'dzin/ shing ser/ bdug spos/ lomra'i shing gi ming la/ sbrang mi'i pho nya/ dpyid kyi shing / ma gnad/ rkang drug tshes/ no ldan mi phyed/ phyag rgya ldan/ bud med dga'/ ge sar 'thab/ 'dzag byed/ mngon 'dod/ bslang ba'i shing / bcud bzang /tsam pa ka'i ming la/ bsod nams bsungs/ mchog thob/ gser gyi metog can/ me tog rgyal/ sbrang shing gi ming la/ legs pa'i shing / sbrang gnas can/ 'od zer mdangs can/ sbrang tsho tog bu ram rtse togamangar ba 'dzin/ shing ring / bur shing gi ming la/ mdzod byed/ bcud 'dzin/ 'o ma 'dzin/ ro mngar/ ral gri'i lom can/ mngar ba'i rtsa/—358—

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ratsetog 'tsho/ shing skyer pa'i ming la/ khu bser po/ gta dru/ dus skyesashing ser/ lhag ma'i ming la/ srin can sbubs ldan/ gling bu shing / sabon gyis 'chi/ rlung 'bud can/ rlung gis sgra sgrog ka'abru'i shing gi ming la/ so po'i tsetog mchin nad dgra mdzod ldan rked ma/ spre'u'i shing /shing stag pa'i ming la/ gro ga gdugs khebs/ pags pa can/ dge'i gzhi can/ re kha'i 'dab/ shun pa 'jam/ chad pa'i shing / pags pa gnyen/gur gum gyi ming la/ tshim byed dmar/ rtsa ba brgya pa/ rdzing drung skyes/ me tog dog can/ kun nas 'khums/ rtse tog nyi ma/ tsam can/ dri zhimalus dmar1 me'i rtse mo/ bde byed 'thung byed/ dpa' ba brtan pa/ slotres kyi ming la/ zaba'i lhag ma/ sbrang rtsi'i 'dab/ zaba'i mgul can/rgas med 'tsho byed/ yangs bcan/ spang spos kyi ming la/ speng spos spu can/ dka' thub can/ 'byung po'i ral pa/ dri'i sras po/ spyang rgyan gyi ming la/ ri bo rna rgyan/ kun tsugs/ khyab 'jug gzhon pa/ gzhan lasargyas/ gzhan gyis mi thub/ ba lang zas/ ston gyi rtse tog sgog pa'i ming /kun dong / ro ldan/ snye'u sga'u/ lha min khrag po klo'i spog la phug gi ming la/ nyi las tsi ka/ 'dang gsum/ legs 'dab/ ngang pa'i rkang /gtun shing / gzer ma ra mgo 'i ming la/ chu med skyeg reg bya ngan/reg pa dka'/ du byed ma/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' can/ mtha' rted dka'/gas/ bku sha'i ming la/ ngas sem/ loganas/ bdud 'dul gdan/dag byed/ mchod sbyin rgyan/ khrus kyi rtswa/ snyamachog snyad bang / gtsang byed sogs skyes dngos dang 'brel ba'i tha gta cang phun sumatshogs po yod/— 359 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bganyis/ srog chags sug bzhi can gyi mngon brjod skor/stag gi ming la/ dri nom/ nags kyi shā na/ 'tsho byed/ brtul phod/dom gyi ming la/ gcan gzan gtum/ rakṣa lu bha/ dred mong gi ming la/smrig da ha/ ta ra khru/ ri dwags za/ ri phag gi ming la/ sa slog sa'ajoms/ mang du skye/ nags kyi nyi ra/ ngur smrig can/ mchu ring / spu rengs/ 'khor lo'i gdong / sna can/ 'phar ba'i ming la/ ri dwagasagasod/ mtshang/ dpa' bse/ ko ba/ be ka/ wa mo'i ming la/ ri dwagasakhram pa/ ba lang 'tshe/ sa myos/ slu byed/ mtshan mo'i ri dwags/ ngan g.yom/ bcu ru'i ming la/ sgo ba'i tshegs/ gcig pur gnas/ rwa gcig pa/ ma ho'i ming la/ 'jigs pa bcu pa/ rdul ldan mig chur 'dres/ sa nyal/ rta yodagra gshin rje'i gzhon pa1 ral pa can/ khyu mchog mig dmar/ spre'u'i ming la/ yal ga'i ri dwags/ gnyer ma'i gdong / phar 'gro rgyug mchongs/ sa'i mjug ma/ rlung gi bu brgyud/ skodang 'dra/ sras gyi ming la/ nya 'dzin/ ma spre'u/ 'ug pas mas byed/glang po che'i ming la/ lag ldan/ gnyis 'thung / myos num can/ so ldan/nyi bu/ soganyis pa/ dbyugs bsna can/ rnga bong la/ mchu 'phyangs/rlung dga'/ mdzo ye ming la/ grus ma/ 'bab byed/ glang gi ming la/lkog shal/ nog can/ bzang po khyu mchog lug gi ming la/ lto 'phyangs/g.yang mo/ rta ye ming la/ mgyogs 'gro rgyab 'dzin/ rtag du za/ rnga yang mjug ma can/ rlung skyes/ bang ldan/ cang shes/ legs 'gro— 360 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ra rlung gshog can/ gyi ling / bong bu'i ming la/ mgrin bzang / rna chen/shugs 'gro/ bzod pa'i ka khyud/ khyi ye ming la/ grong gi gcan zan/seng ge'i rigs/ nor srung / rdo rje'i mjug ma/ zhum bu'i ming ga grobagi spre'u/ lus bskum/ khrus mkhan/ bshang bsred/ rnam grol mib/'bar kha'i mig byi ba'i ming la/ rkun po/ 'jigs byed/ rko byed/bug pa byed/ ri gnas ma/ dri ma can sogs yod/gsum/ 'dab chags kyi mngon brjod skor/bya spyi'i ming la/ sgong skyes/ gnyis skyes/ tshangs skyes/ mkha' 'gromakha' spyod/ mkha' la rgyu/ 'dab ldan/ 'dang ma'i shing rta can/ yan lag drug pa/ nas mkha'i rta/ mkhar nyal/ sgro ldan/ rtse ye mgrin/'phur 'gro mkha' bgrod/ lus mgyogs/ 'dab skyob/ 'dab chags/ga byug gi ming la/ dpyid kyi pho nya/ nags na dga'/ 'dab ma'i zeg pa/na tshod gnas/ mig mdzes/ 'dod pa'i tā la/ gzhan gyis gsos/gzhan kyis rgyas/ ngag snyan/ dbyangs snyan/ gzhan la sems/ 'dod pa'i pho nya/ bya rogs gsos/ lnga pa'i dbyangs/ sbrang rtsi'i sgra/ ma bya'i ming la/ sgeg ldan1 mgrin sngon1 gtsug phud can/ mjug sgo can/legs bris/ rab g.yo/ gar mkhan/ 'brug sgra'i gar/ rna rgyan can/shing la rtse/ brtan pa dregs/ sar 'gro bkra ba'i 'og pag can/ mdong ldan/ 'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg mdong mtha' can/ sen mo'i gar/gtsug ldan/ sprin la dga'/ 'brug sgra'i mngal 'dzin/ lag 'gro za/— 361 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga 〉 kyi ra yu nga basprin gyi sgeg mgrin pa sngon/ 'dab brgya pa/ rte bo'i ming la 'thor byed/ yid gzhung / kunas 'gro rtseganyis/ 'khyog po'i mchu can/tshig 'jam/ 'jam ljang 'dang ldan/ bya rgod kyi ming la/ rlung spyod/mkha' la 'khor1 ring 'phur/ nam 'phang gcod byed/ khrung khrung gi ming la/ mgrin pa rang ring / gru lha/ mig sman/ ngang pa'i ming la/ dra ba'i rkang ldan/ ma dros gnas/ 'khor lo'i yan lag tsa kram ga grong 'joms/ mkha' lding dkar po/ mtsho byu/ ngur pa'i ming la/ shing rta'i lus/ 'khor lo can/ gnyis gnyis spyod/ mtshan mo bral/ 'dod pa ldan/ko kaḥ 'dab chags gser ldan/ phug ron gyi ming la/ skad gcig 'dod ldan/ co co sgrog rdo ye zas can/ ko po ta1 rgya phebs gnasa' yon / / dig snyan/ 'khrul ba'i mig can1 khug rta'i ming la/ char bsdod/chu nyung / kard1 tsa ta ka/ sprin la slong / sprin 'digs bzang mo/ thub pa'i bu/ sgra sgrog char dga'/ chu khya'i ming la/ chur sgrogs/ chur 'jugam 'dab shas/ khyim bya'i ming la/ zangs kyi gtsug phud/ mya ngan med/zung gi sgra sgrog mtshan mo skad/ bde legs can/ yongs zlum migadaga' byed/ gas byed/ 'phen byed/ nor bu'i mgrin can/ 'od kyi sde/snga bar sgra sgrog zags ze can/ pags pa'i gtsug phud/ mtshan mo rigarkang pa'i mtshon/ sreg pa'i ming la/ ki rte ri/ gshog bkra ba/ bya khra'i ming la/ 'dang chags za/ ri bong za/ bya khra g.yob1 'ug pa'i ming la/bya nog dgra nyin mo 'jigs/ sna ring / sna 'khyog 'phrog byed migako shi ka/ mtshan mo spyod/ bya nog 'jigs byed/ srin bya'i ming la1— 362 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ra'agal 'du'i rdzun can/ 'byung po'i bya/ nyin mor dga' bral/ nyin mo yib/ ser skya'i blta byed/ mig ser can/ gad mo'i dbyangs ldan/ bya rog gi ming la/ bden pa'i ngag bdag nyid sgrog 'chi med gter za/gtor mas rgyas dga' bas rgyu/ 'khrig pa sbed/ rdo rje'i mchu can/mdog gcig pa/ lan cig skye/ brgya byin skyes/ gzhan gsor ba dga'/grong khyer spyod/ khā ta thos sgrog pha wang gi ming la/ pags pa'i 'dab can/pags byi'u/ khyem du 'gro/ dza ru ni bya nog dgra bo/ mtshan dus rgyu/ co ka'i ming la/ brda ka/ phye leb cha ga pa/ byu gag gi ming la/ sa gnasasmal ka kri mi ku ku sgrog gzhon nu mgrin ldan/ mgrin dkar po/ sprin gyi bya mar sdong can/ bya dkar/ zaba'i gtsug phud sogs yod/bzhe/ chu srin rigs kyi mngon brjod skor/chu srin la la ming la/ rgya mtsho kham zas/ can na kra/ chu ye srin po/ ral gri'i so can/ nya mid che/ kun 'joms/ nya ye ming la/ sgong skyes/ myu ka/ mig ka' ma/ 'gro ldan/ rnam 'phyo/ snal sa rgyu/gser gyi mig can/ chus mi 'a ba/ la nyal/ gyab ring / rus sbal gyi ming la/ yan lag lnga pa/ dam du 'dzin/ bul 'gro yan lag lnga sbas pa/glas 'a nga / 'gram rkyong / khog pa can ngan pa'i shub ldan/ sbal pa'i ming la 'phar 'gro char mas skyes/ lce med/ bshang sbas/ sdig srin gyi ming la/ 'phrog byed mig rkang mang po sbal chen dung gi ming la/sham ka/ chu srin gshed/ rgyal po gsab/ bkris dung / skye ba lngapa—363—

bo kyi da ba zil sa nga nga sa kyi ra sa nga banya phyis kyi ming la/ mu tig 'byung gnas/ mu tig ma/ nya skyogs/ grol ba can/ mu tig skye gnas/ nya lcebs/ yon la pa tra/ dug gis mi brdzi/chu gter las byung / mgron bu'i ming la/ cho lo'i sa bon sogs yod/lnga/ 'bus srin rigs kyi mngon brjod skor/sbrang ma'i ming la/ rkang drug bung nga/ bhra ma ra1 ra yig gnyis pa/me tog 'thung / sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs/ ge sar spyod/ 'khor 'grobacud 'dzin/ sbrang rtsi myang / sbrang rtsi skyongs/ sbrang rtsi 'dod/ sbrang rtsi'i dri myang / rdul nyal/ me tog 'thu ba1 me tog zas can/ me tog 'juganyam chung dbang po/ gsum sgra/ bcud sbyin/ bcud brtul zhugs/ rdul 'chang / dri skyes/ sposang da ldan/ no myang / me tog myang / me tog la rtse/mchog rtsa dga'/ sbrang rtsi spyod byed/ sbrang rtsi 'dod/ sbrang rtsi'i zas can/sbrang rtsi skyes/ sbrang bu/ sbrang ma/ sdom gyi ming la/ thags mkhan/ dra ba can/ lteb bal can/ spre'u 'dra/ sdig pa rwa can gyi ming la/ dur bsa'achi/ mar gyis nyams byed/ lus mi stug grog ma'i ming la/ srin phran ma/ rgyu rgyu ra/ gshin rje'i bu/ dar gyi srin bu'i ming la/ dar gyi srin bu/sbud pa'i bu/ srin bu me 'khyer gyi ming la/ mkha' snang / dkar 'od/nam mkha'i 'od/ nam mkha'i mu khyud/ nyin mi gsal/ 'od can/ 'od kyi sa bon/ lam 'od/ shing gi srin bu'i ming la/ rtsa 'bu/ shing zan/ yege pa/ 'bu rkang brgya lag brgya'i ming la/ rkang brgya/ yan lag brgya pa/de bzhin 'bu za mo'i rigs kyi ming la/ gdung can/ skye ba ba'i sogs— 364 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ramang du yod/drug lho 'gro'i rigs kyi mngon brjod skor/sprul gyi ming la/ mig gis thos/ gzar bu mgo nyal byed/gnyid skos da/ rkang sbas/ 'khril ba/ logs rings/ yol 'phyo/gdengs can/ lho 'phye/ lag 'gro lto 'gro gya gyur 'gro brang 'gro'akhyog 'gro kun 'gro ba lang sna/ thig le'i sna/ 'khor lo can/ rlung zas can/ 'phel ka can/ lce gnyis pa/ ngan pa'i zas can/ khung du nyal/ dug 'dzin/ dug gi mtshon cha can/ tshangs pa'i ming la rtsa yed byid/ sog lo can/ ral gri can/ mdung can/ khyim ldan/ mig sman rtsa/nyin sob/ tsa ṭa gi bshol ldan/ bkra ba/ rgyal ba thu bo sogs mang poyod/bdun/ khor yug dang 'brel ba'i mngon brjodaXskor/da spyi'i ming la/ 'bar byed/ be shwa na ra'i bu/ chu ye miganagartse mo can/ 'khyog 'bar/ shing 'phel/ lus ma bsrung / sbyin bsregasalag pa/ nor las rgyas/ 'od kyi shing rta/ du ba'i tog rlung gi grogs po/lam nag zhugs/ gtsang byed/ dag byed/ gtsug phud can/ 'bar ba'i lce ldan/ rlung spyi'i ming la/ nam mkha'i srog nam mkha'i dbugs/ mamos 'phel/ nam mkha'i stobs/ g.yo byed/ rdul gyi gas pa/ 'gro ba'i ngang tshul/ 'gro ba'i srog dri bgod/ dri lan/ dri'i shing rta/ gnas— 365 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bamed/ rtag 'gro/ kun 'dul rnga/ bsil byed/ reg ldan/ nam mkha'i ming la/ kun gsal/ lha rtse rol pa'i gnas/ mtha' med/ mi g.yo/ mi 'da'/ lhal ma/ sprin lam/ rgyu skar lam/ lus med/ go 'byed/ me zhal lam/ lhan rdzing ring / khyab 'jug gnas/ chu sgrogs/ chu mthongs/bar med mkha'/ mi 'gyur bar snang / kun 'gro mtha' bral/ kun khyab/sprin gyi ming la/ du ba'i skye gnas/ nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan/ chu ye bzhon pa/ tsha zer 'jom/ ka dam pa can/ nam mkha'i gling / rlung gi shing rta/mkha' gos can/ sgra ldan/ sprin gyi bza ṇi/ nam mkha'i glang po/ mkha' la rgyu/ chu 'dzin/ nas mkha'i ta yol/ glog ldan/ chu khur/ glog gi ming la/ 'jug pa brgya pa/ gzhi sngon skyes/ sprin kyi lcug ma/ gser 'od can/lus zang de 'thung / skad cig 'od/ skad cig gsal ba/ rdo rje'i sgra/gnam lcags sgra/ thog dang lhan cig 'brug sgra'i ming la/ sprin gyi sgra/dbyar skyes rnga/ sgra brgya pa/ thog gi ming la/ rdo rje'i char pa/ chu 'dzin skyes/ rtse char 'phro 'jom/ lce 'bab pa/ lce snyeng med/ chad nyams/sprin gyi rtse bo che/ rdo rje'i zegs ma/ chus mi nyams/ gnam lcags/ sprin gyi zer 'phrob/ ri 'joms/ 'jigs byed/ ser ba'i ming la/ sprin gyi rus pa/ sprin gyi rdo/ chu mkhregs/ sprin gyi gong bu/ sprin gyi ka ba/ rdo yeb/ lo thog gshed/ char pa'i ming la/ sprin bcud/ sbrang char/ ba sa bon/ sprin gyi me tog mkha' las bab/ rlung gi 'bras bu/ rgyun bab zhod/ gung char/ gru char/ char rdul/ chu ye zegs ma/ rgyun gyi myu guchu ye zer/ chu rdul/ 'ja' tshon gyi ming la/ dbang po'i mtshon/ brgya — 366 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i rabyin gzhu/ ro hi ha1 rlung gi rgyal mtshan/ rlung gi bal/ rlung gi 'bras bu1'od lnga pa/ gzha' tshon/ 'ja' ris/ rgan po'i thig lha rgyal mas cha/sos ka bzhad/ drang 'khyog lhan tshon ris/ dbang po'i shing bal/ nyi ma'i ming la/ nyin lo 'dren pa/ 'od stong ldan/ 'gro ba'i sgron me/'jig rten mig bcu gnyis bdag po/ snang ba'i mdzod/ dus kyi byed po/dus las rgyal/ nam mkha'i nor bu/ nam mkha'i tog chu ye tshom rkun/padma'i gnyen/ tshang pa'i rta/ mkha' lam pa/ dbyig gi khu ba/ tsha zer can/ nyin lo 'byung gnas/ snang ba'i bdag bla med 'od 'byin/mun pa'i dgra 'od kyi nor can/ gza'i bdag po/ pad ma'i rtsa lagapadma'i grogs/ 'od byed/ snang byed/ nyin mor byed/ rta bdun pa/ rta ljang can/ sna tshogs/ shing rta/ sna tshogs 'od/ nam mkha'i thig le/srid pa'i mig phyogs kyi ka'akhyud/ stong 'thob/ 'od kyi skya can/ namamakha'i mig nyin mo'i dbang phyug lo'i shing rta/ gas yon ba'i nor bu/ zla ba'i ming la/ rgya mtsho skyes/ chu las skyes/ bde 'byung / gtsug rgyan/ ri bong 'dzin/ tshes bdag bsil byed/ mtshan mor phyed/ ku mud gnyen/pad ma'i dgra mtshan mo'i bdag po/ rgyu skar gtso/ gnyis skyes rgyal po/bsil sbyin mkhan/ nam mkha'i rna ba/ thos ldan dbang / steng 'phur/chags skyed/ rgya mtsho dga'/ ri dwags mtshan ma/ bcu drug cha/ bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas/ bdud rtsi'i 'od/ shar gyi theg le/ rtse'i dbang phyuga'od dkar can/ bdus zer can/ maka tsho nor bu/ ga bar dbang /rgya mtsho'i mar gsar/ bdud mi spro/ cha gter mun 'jom/ ri bong can/— 367 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga brgyu skar bdag po/ rgya mtsho'i ming la/ chu gter/ chu bdag ba phung po/rin chen 'byung gnas/ dbang chen mtshan/ zla bas 'phel/ zaba'i grogs/ pha rol skomangon/ brgal ba dka'/ chu srin 'byung gnas/ chu srin bdag chu ye srin bu'i grong khyer che/ ri ye thod can/ no ldan ma/ samachod ma/ dug can gnas/ nyal 'gro'i gter/ dal 'ang ba mdzod/ chu srel/ chu srin rgyal mtshan can/ zla ba'i yom/ chu spyi ye ming la/ btung bya/btung byed/ sgo kun 'gro/ sprin gyi rtse tog sprin gyi bcud/ dag byed/ngan sel/ 'bru phan/ sprin gyi myu gu 'thur bgrod/ 'bab chu'i ming la/chu klung / gzhol 'gro gya gyu 'gros/ mtshor 'bab/ dal 'bab/bags kyis gzhol/ 'khyog 'gro chu rgyun/ 'bab ldan/ nyal 'gro lhung lhung sgra sbyin pa/ zla ba'i lag bcud 'dzin ma/ gling ldan/ 'jig rten shing rta ma/ dngal rlabs can/ sa gzhi'i ming la/ nor 'dzin/ skogayob/ brtan pa/ skrun byed/ 'od srung byin/ 'dzin ma/ zhag ldan/ ri'i phur bu/ mtha' yas/ yangs ldan/ gser ldan ma/ rgya mtsho'i gos can/sna tshogs 'dzin/ kun bzod/ ri ye rna ba can/ nor ldan/ nor gyi dzragros ma1 chu gter ska rags can/ chu skyob/ dbyig gi blo gros ma/ dbyig 'dzin/ bcud ldan/ gling 'dzin/ gser gyi snying / 'byung po 'dzin byed/rten byed/ ri spyi ye ming la/ migayo1 sa 'dzin/ sa gzhi 'chang / 'gro med/ byen 'phyur/ sbomatho la/ sa skyong/ chu skyong/ sa'i phur bu/ sprin gyi so can/ gangs ri'i ming la/ kha ba'i lhan po/ gangs ri'i dbang /dka' bzlog g.yod na'i bdag ke la sha/ ri'i rgyal po/ bsil ri/— 368 —

rang nga ra yu nga 'brel ba'i srol brtsam bya'i ragangs ldan/ gangs can/ kha ba'i rdul brtsegs/ ga ba'i ri/ sa 'dzinadakar po sogs yod/de ltar gong du drangs pa'i skyes dngos srog chags dang 'brel ba'i mngon brjod de dag gi nang du skyes dngos srogs gas dang de bzhin khor yug sogs kyi yo chos dang nus pa/ phan tshun gcig lagacig brten pa'am 'gal zlar gyur ba/ skye ba'i gnas sam 'byung ba'i khungs sogs kyi rang bzhin khyad chos rnams gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas klog pa po'i 'dren byed bdud rtsir bshams yod/dper na ljon shing la/ ྾ ga can/ 'dang ldan/ rkang khung /steng skyes/ mgo lding can/ ka byug la/ nags dga'/ gzhan gyis gsos/khye la/ seng ge'i rigs/ grong gi gcan gzan glang po che la/ soganyisapa 'khor lo'i rkang / dbyug pa'i sna can/ rgya mtsho la/ dal 'ang ba mdzod/ chu srin gnas/ rin chen 'byung gnas ces rtsi shing srogs chagasadang khor yug gi thun mong ma yin pa'i yo chos dang / mtshon rtags/gzugs kyi rnam pa/ de bzhin phan nus sogs gas bar bstan yod/ de bzhe 'do brte mdze bteban du 'ug pa la bya gas dgra mas 'a / zags/ ma la/ pad ma'i gnyen/ rgya mtsho las ba'i grogs zla bas 'phel/ zaba'i yom/sdig pa rwa can la/ mar gyis nyams byed/ du bas 'chi/ rtsel/ rlung gi grogs po/ shing 'phel zhes mi shing srog chags dang khor yug gi khyad chosaphan tshun gcig la gcig brten pa'am 'gal ba'i cha nas bstan yod/ yang gur gum la kha cher skyes/ rdzing drung skyes/ pad yol/ chu skyes/ 'dayo—369—

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra la nga bskyes/ mtsho skyes/ thog la/ chu 'dzin skyes/ phug non la rgya phebs gnasa'al / bya spyi la sgong skyes ces mi shing srog chags dang khor yug gi skye ba'i gnas sam 'byung ba'i khungs gas bar bstan yod/mdor na/ kha ba ri pa'i sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyis bsreg bcad brdar gsum mdzad pa'i shul bzhag nor bu mngon brjod 'di ni gangs ljongs rig gnas bang mdzod nang du gzi 'od lhag par 'phro ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nor bu zhig lags/ de yis bod kyi rig gnas dang sgosasurtsom rig bya bzhag gong 'phel dang tha snyad phun sumatshogs pa sogs yong rgyur sman pa'i nus pa chen po thon yod/

zhar byung dang bo/ rgyalaXspyi'i tshogs pa khag nas rang ljongs kyiXs khul khag tu mnyam 'brel gyi las don spel ba'i skor/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lor bas brgyad cu nas bzung rgyal spyi'i srid gzhung min pa'i rtsa 'dzugs dang / phyogs gnyis kyi srid gzhung rtsa 'dzugs/de bzhin mnyam 'brel rgyal gas kyi rtsa tshogs bcas nas bod du yodanguladang lag rtsal gtso bor byas pa'i las don dang las grwa mi nyung ba zhig spelayod la/ las grwa de dag gi rgyab skyor byed yul gtso bo ni 'phrod bsten dang /slob gso1 dbul skyor/ lag rtsal sbyong brdar/ khor yug srung skyob bcasayin/tshogs pa 'ga' shas kyis bod du gtan sdod las byed ba mngagasanas las don rgyun ring spel ba dang yang gshas kyis las yi re zung grub rjesaphyir then byed ba yang yod/ 'dir nga chos rang byung khor yug gi las don dang 'brel ba yod pa'i tshogs pa khag gcig ngo sprod zhu rgyu yin/

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba/dang po/ rang byung khor kyi yug thebs rtsa tshogs ba/la b.rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa tshogs pa ni 'dzam gling thog stobasashugs dang gzhi rgya che shos kyi khor yug thebs rtsa zhig yin/ spyi lo 1961lor thog mar btsugs pa nas da bar lo ngo bzhi bcu lhag tsam gyi ring 'dzam gling gleng chen drug dang rgyal khab 153nang khor yug srung skyob kyi mas don dang lasagrwa khri gcig lhag tsam legs sgrub byung yod/ rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa tshogs pas rgyal khab 48nang yan lag thebs rtsa dang su'i sil na du spyi khyab pu'u btsugs yod/ tshogs pa'i las don gyi dmigs yu gtso bo ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs dang rang byung khams gnyis dang ra mthun sbyor legs pos 'tsho gnas yong rgyur legs skyes 'bul rgyu de red/rang byung khor yug tshogs pas lor bas80tsam nas rang rgyal du mnyam 'brel gyi las grwa la ba dang / 1996lor dpe cing du krung go'i yan lag don gcod khang btsugs pa/ 1998lo nas bzung rang ljongs su rgyab skyor gyi las grwa la 'go brtsams yod/ de nas rim bzhin lhas ra don gcod khang gsar du btsugs nas sa khul las byed bas rang ljongs kyi zhib phra'i las don khag la do dam byed kyi yod/ rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa tshogs pas srid gzhung gi 'brel yod tshan pa khag dang lhag par du ljongs—372—

rgyal 'i tsho sa pa sa rang ljongs kyi sa la ma ma 'brel las spel ba'i ranags las cus dang mnyam 'brel thog bod kyi byang thang rang byung srung skyobakhul gtso bor byas pa'i rang byung khor a dang ri skyes srog ༅sa kyi srung skyob thad las don dang las grwa sna tshogs spel yod/'dir nga tshos las don gtso bo khag gcig ngo sprod zhu rgyur/gcig spungaXskyob lteXganas gnyer kyi 'dzugs/byang thang rang byung srung skyob khul kyi srung skyob dang do dam nus par shugs snon dang srung skyob ma lag ཿsa sgo tshang du gtong ra/ rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa gas pas spyi lo 1999nas bzung byang thang gi gas du srung skyob 'bab tshugs kyi khang pa rgyab pa dang / spyi lo2002lor byang thang shang khag lnga dang rdzong gcig tu rlangs 'khor sogs kyi yo byad sprad nas shang dang stong rim pa'i srung skyob ltoganas gas ra du btsugs yod/ lte gnas de dag gis srung skyob kyi zhor la ri skyes srog ༅sa kyi gnas༅ dang grangasa'abor sogs la rtog zhib byed kyi yod/gnyas/ sgrong brdar 'dzin grwa mi dang zhib 'jug tshogs 'du/bod kyi rang byung khor yug srung skyob las don gyi gnas 'bang dang rjes sor 'phel rgyas kyi ga phyogs gas po yong go spyi lo1998lor rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa tshogs pa dang rang ljongs kyi 'a༅ yod ka tshan khag gcig mnyam 'brel thog bod kyi skyes dngos sna gas zhes pa'i rgyal spyi'i tshogs 'du bskong tshogs byas pa red/ gas po'i thog rgyal spyi dang rgyal nang gi — 373 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu zang bamakhas pa dang 'brel yod 'gan khur ba bcas kyis rjes sor bod kyi rang byung khor yug srung skyob kyi las don la bsam 'char bton pa dang / thebs rtsa tshogs pa'i las don mang po zhig bsam 'char de dag rmang gzhir byas nasarjes yod/spyi lo 1999lor rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa tshogs pas zi ling du tshogs pa'i‘6khor yug srung skyob dang gtsod lpags nyo tshong la bkag 'gog ces par rgyal spyi'i tshogs 'dur rgyab skyor byas yod/spyi lo 2000lor snga rjes su nag chu dang / sger rtse/ nying khri bcasasukhor yug srung skyob kyi shes bya dang / ri skyes srog chags zhing bsher/ srung skyob khul gyi do dam/ de bzhin mnyam myong spel res bcas kyi spyong brdar 'dzin grwa chen du gnyer nas bod kyi khor yug srung skyob pa dang / do dam lasabyed pa'i ra las shes bya gong mthor btang yod/spyi lo2003lor nag ba shar ngos rdzong khag bzhi dang lhasa'i rdzong khag lnga'i nags las do dam par ri skyes srog chags srung skyob dang srung skyob khul gyi do dam sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa gnyer ba red/gsum/ khor yug sprung skyob kyi dril bsgrags/thebs rtsa tshogs pas ljongs na gas las ces la yodangul gyi rgyang skyor byas te bod kyi rang byung srung skyob gsar 'gyur (pho lta)zhes pa gsar du ston pa dang khor yug dang ri skyes srog chags kyi srung skyob la skul ded gtong chen dril bsgrags par ris sna tshogs bston yod/— 374 —

rgyal 'i tsho sa pa sa rang ljongs kyi sa la ma ma 'brel las spel ba'i ra/bzhi/ byang thang rang byung spung skyob khul gyi shings byang /ljongs nags las ces dang thebs rtsa tshogs pa mnyam 'brel thog byang thang srung skyob khul gyi tsamatshams khag tu shing byang btsugs pa dang shing byang thog dril bsgrags dang gas bshad ye ge yang bkod yod/ shing byang de dag byang thang gi sa gnas gtso bo khag dang lam chen gyi g.yas g.yon de bzhin khyang thang gi dbus ga bcas su btsugs yod/lnga/ ma dngul gyiXrgyab skyor/thebs rtsa tshogs pas ma dngul gyi rgyab skyor byas nas ljongs nagasalas cus su rang byung srung skyob khul gyi rgyu cha dang gzhi grangs kyi nyar tshagasadang dbye zhib byed pa'i las grwa zhig gnyer bzhin pa yin/mdor na thebs rtsa tshogs pas bod dang lhag par du byang thang rang byung srung skyob khul du rgya bskyor gyi las don shugs ba spos yod bdang da dung mu mthud ljongs nags las cus sogs 'brel tsho sa bdang lhan du bod kyi rang byung khor yug gi srung skyob la legs skyes 'bul rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod/

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bganyis ba/ mnyam 'brelas rgyal tshogs 'phel rgyas 'char kyi gzhi pu'u/la 2na nyam 'brel rgyal tshogs 'phel rgyas 'char gzhi pu'u dang rang ljongasakyi 'brel yod las khungs dang mnyam 'brel byas nas jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul gyi tshogs skrun 'char gzhi dang ༅ skor zhabs zhu'i 'char gzhi bzos pa dang / de rjes jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul du lag shes bzo las la rgyab skyor gyi las grwa spel yod/gsum pa/ sa mtho'i zhing 'jug khang /bal 0la ba༅mas ba1kabazathebs rtsa 'di ni thog mar spyi lo 1971lor btsugs pa dang / da lta.ari'i rgyalas po shing ston zhes par gnas yod pa dang de'i rgyab skyor gyi lasadon gtso bo ni ri rgyud a lung khag gi srol rgyun rig gnas dang / rang byung khor yug la srung skyob byed rgyu de red/ ri bo thebs rtsa snga rjes su jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyong khul dang / lhas/ gzhi rtse sogs sa gnas khag tu khor yug srung skyong dang 'brel ba yod pa'i las grwa btsugs pa dang / lhag par du jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul du mi sna gas skyong dang / ri dwags kyi gnod 'tshe/ nags྾ do dam sogs kyi khor yug srung skyob kyi —376—

rgyal 'i tsho sa pa sa rang ljongs kyi sa la ma ma 'brel las rje ba'i ralas don rnams sa khul kyi mang tshogs dang srid gzhung gi 'brel yod tshanabadang mnyam du grub yod/bzhi pa/ mi rabs gsar pa/(patsho bsabs ba6zasabayol10sa④)skor bas gsar pa zhes pa'i thebs rtsa de ni ga ri'i was ci ne gnub mar gnas yod la1 spyi lo 1992nas zung bod kyi jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul du slob gsodang / 'phrod bsten/ rang byung khor yug sogasakyi las grwa khag gcig la rgyab skyor byas yod/ de'i nang nas phan bde pa zhesapa'i las grwa de gtso bo yin/ thebs sa des jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul gyi grong tsho mang por phan bde pa zhes pa'i mi sna gas skyong byas yod/ phan bde pa de dag la gtso bo sman dang grong mi sgrig tshogs byas nas thun mong gi khya nga sgrub rgyu'i lag rtsal dang shes bya'i spyong brdar byas yod/ gzhan yang rang byung srung skyob khul gyi las byed bdang 'go khrid la srung skyob do dam kyi spyong brdar go skabs bskrun yod/lnga pa/ kun phan thebs rtsa tshogs pa/(bsabs ba0ba ༅la10sa) kun phan thebs rtsa gas ba'i lo ri'i grong khyer ni'u yog bluganasacing nye ba'i lo shas ring bod dang / mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ kan su'u sogs— 377 —

bo kyi srol ri la nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babod rigs sa khul du rgyab skyor gyi las grwa rgya che tsam bskrun yod/ rang ljongasagyi jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul gyi gting skyes rdzong dang lhas/nag chu khul la slob gsodang 'phrod bsten/ lag rtsal spyong brdar/ dbul skyor/ 'thung chu/ rang byung khor yug zhing las sogs la ma dngul dang lag rtsal gyi rgyab skyor byas yod/drug ba/ 'dzam gling gong 'phel do khur tshogs ba/yo①zakyab①༅kyi2atshogs pa 'di'i las don gtso bo ni jo mo glang ma'i rang byung srung skyob khul gyi rdzong khag bzhi'i grong tsho dang shang khag la yong ༅ chu ka la dang /slob khang la snyegs bskrun/ de bzhin lag rtsal spyong brdar dang sa khul re gnyis su glog khang chung chung yang bskrun yod/bdun ba/ zams pas dge rtsa/bas2༅la gsab zas pa dge mas nye dus ljongs nags las ces dang rang byung khor yug thebs rtsa dang mnyam 'brel thog byang thang rang byung srung skyob khul du khor yug snang skyob kyi dril bsgrags dang slob gso'i thad rgyab skyor byas pa ma zad snyamathu da khor yug srung skyob thad las grwa gsar du tshogs rgyu'i 'kho gzhi bzos yod/ gzhan yang deb 'di'i par bskrun thad zam pa dge rtsas rgyab—378—

rgyal 'i tsho sa pa lorang ljongs kyi sa la ma ma 'brel las rje ba'i raskyor gyi ma dngul gnang yod/ brgyad pa/ rgyal spyi'i ri khul zhib 'jug lte gnas/(101 0ba)lte gnas 'dis bod kyi ri khul dang byang thang du rang byung khor yug gi zhib khug las don dang shes bya khyabs gtong za spyong brdar 'dzin grwa btsugs pa dang / spyi lo2002lor lhas ra rtsa thang dang khor yug gtso bor byas pa'i rgyal spyi'i zhib 'jug gas 'du bskong gas byas pa der nogasaram chen po byas yod/dguXpa/ noraXweXrgyalaXkhab kyi rgyab skyor/(sa0jags6mas①bsabs ba)nor we srid gzhung gis bod ljongs slob grwa chen modang / ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang sogs las khungs dang sde tshan rgyud nas rang ljongs kyi shes yon can mi nyung ba zhig nor we du khrid nas ra las 'dra min gyi spyong brdar byas yod/ spyi lo1998nas bzung las grwa de'i rnam grangs gcigs mngags kyis byang thang du ri skyes srog ༅sa kyi zhings ga las don thog bzhugs yod la rnam grangs de snyamathu da rgya bskyed gtong rgyu'i 'kho gzhi bzos tshar ba yin/— 379 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga la kyi ra yu nga babace pa/ srog chags spung skyong tshogs pa/(yo1zabaza1zaza①sa④za༅༅༅11①sa sa 1za1ra)gas pa 'dis byang thang dang bod kyi shar rgyud du ri skyes srog chagasal zhib pog thengs mang byas yod/ lhag par du mkhas pa 'byor rje sha lasabyang thang gas du lo mang zhib yog dang rtogs zhing byas pa'i grub 'brasasumatsho bod sa mtho'i ri skyes srog ༅sa zhes pa'i deb skad grags chen po de bris gnang ba yin/bzu gcig rgyal spyi'i khrung khrungaXthebs rtsa/(1mas bas༅110༅khu6masazab①ba ༅la10༅)thebs rtsa 'dis nye ba'i lo bcu'i nang bod kyi khrung khrung dkar po'i 'tsho sdod sa gnas dang / grangs 'bor/ srung skyob kyi dka' ngal bcasalartogs zhing byas bdang / 2003lo'i lo mjug karang byung khor yug thebasartsa dang mnyam du lhan grub rdzong du khrung khrung srung skyob skor gyi spyong brdar 'dzin grwa bsgong tshogs byas pa red/bcu gnyis/ rgyal spyi'i spung skyob tshogs pa/(①sa④2ja༅༅la10༅ 1༅la2a༅110mas)spyi lo1987lor gsar du btsugs pa'i rgyal spyi srung skyob gas pas da — 380 —

la 'i tsho sa pa sa rang ljongs kyi sa la ma ma 'brel las rje ba'i rabar 'dzam gling gi sa khul mang por khor yug srung skyob kyi las don spel yod pa dang / rang rgyal sa pa'i rgyal khab gsum bcu'i nang don gcod khang btsugs da/ tshogs pa 'dis nye ba'i lo shas ring rang rgyal gyi lho nub sakhul du mi sna sbyong brdar dang rang byung srung skyob khul gyi do dam/ de bzhin bod kyi gnas ri dang gnas mtshor srung skyob byed rgyu'i las don ྾bzhin yod/ gzhan yang dpe deb 'di'i dpe bskrun thad ma dngul gyi rgyas skyor gnang yod/ gzhan yang 'dir ma lod pa'i thebs rtsa bshas kyis rang byung khor yug gi las don spel yod rung de dag gi las don rgyun thung ba 'amayang na gzhi rgya chung ba bcas kyis 'dir bkod med/

gyi ma'i gshebasdus 'a hūṃ gtsas chus sa cha byed khro bhe /

bo kyi rtsa che'i ri sa sro cha sa kyi ming tho/༵/ / / // // — 395 —
bo kyi rtsa che'i ri sa sro cha sa kyi ming tho — spu rgyas dang 'dam gzhu sogs byeX/ ༷lha// |ge — 397 —

zhar byung gsum pa/ rang byung thon khungs do dam gyi 'brel yod bca' khrims dngas srol yig khagadang bo/ rgyal gab kyi 'brel yod rtsa khrims/krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khang khor yug srung skyong kyi bca' khrims/(1989)krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab rgya mal khor yug srung skyob kyi bca' khrims/(1982)krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi gzhing do dam bca' khrims/(1986la bzos 1998la bzo bcos byas/)krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi nags tsha bca' khrims/(1984labazos/ 1998la bzo bcos byas/)krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi sa thang bca' khrims/(1985)krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi nya las bca' khrims/(1986)grung hwa med mangs mthun rgyal khab kyi la bca' khrims/(1988)krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi sa chu srung 'dzin gyi bca' khrims/— 400 —

rang nga tho ngas ma 'brel yo bca' mas ngams yi 1991krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi gter rdzas thon khungs kyi bca' khrims/1986krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ri skyes srog chags srung skyob kyi bca' khrims/1988krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi zhing las bca' khrims/1993gnyis ba/ rgyal thrad spyod khyab khang gis 'brelas yod srid 'dzin khrims srol/gong gal bca' khrims kyi lag bstar srol zhib khag dang /krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab thon khungs khral 'jal gyi gnas skabasasrol yig1993gter rdzas thon khungs kyi gags ba bsdu len gyi do dam gtan 'beb/1994grung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rang byung srung skyong khul gyi srol yig1994krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ri skyes rtsi shing srung skyob kyi bca' khrims/1996ri skyes sman rdzas thon khungs do dam gyi la yig 987grags can mdzes ljongs do dam kyi gnas skabs srol yig 1985—401 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga bgasum pa/ tshanas pa khag gi thrad 'jin sgrig srolagatso bod khag gcigarang byung srung skyob khul gyi sa zhing do dam byed thabs(rgyal khab sazhing do dam hrus dang rgyal khab khor yug srung skyob cus nas995)rgya mtsho rang byung srung skyob khul kyi do dam bya thabs(rgyal khab mtsho don cusanas 1995sa gshis rdzas shul gyi do dam gtan 'beb/(rgyal khab sa gshis dang gter rdzas pu'u nas994)logs bskrun las grwa'i khor yug srung skyob byed rgyu'i do dmathabs shesargyal khab khor yug srung skyob ces sogs nas986)nags tsha spyi gling gyi do dam thabs shes(nags las pu'u 993)grong khyer spyan gzigs gling kha'i do dam gyi gnas skabs srol yig(la gsabaskrun pu'u nas1994)phyir gtong nang 'dren zhing las skyes dngos sa bon gyi gnas skabs lag bstar thabs shes(zhing las pu'u 997)

rang nga tho ngas ma 'brel yo bca' mas nga srol yi bzhi pa/ rangaXrgyalaXzhugs zinaXpa'i 'brel yod rgyal spyi'i spyi chings khagaskyes dngos 'dra min rnam grangs kyi rgyal spyi'i spyi ྾sa/(1993lor zhugs/)chu skyes srog gas 'tsho gnas kyi gal tsho rgyal spyi'i brlan sa'i spyi chings/(1992lor zhugs/)stong la nye ba'i ri skyes srog chags dang skyes dngos kyi rgyal spyi'i nyo tshong gi spyi chings/(1981lor zhugs/)mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi bye thang 'gog bcos kyi spyi byungs/(1996lor zhugs/)'dzam gling rig gnas dang rang byung gna' shul srung skyong kyi spyi chings/(1985lor zhugs/)rgyal spyi'i chu srin 'dzin gsod kyi spyi ྾sa/(1980lor zhugs/)— 403 —

zhar byung bzhi pa/ khor yug srungs skyob kyi dril bsgrags dang dran gso'i nyin mo khagadang bo/ rgyal spyi'i brlan sa'i nyin mo/dus tsho / zla ba 2pa'i tshes2nyin/gal bshad/ spyi lo 1971lo'i zla ba 2pa'i tshes2nyin dbyi rang gi ram gsar zhes pa'i grong khyer du brlan sa'i spyi chings la rgyal khab khag nas lag len gyi ming rtags bkod pa dang / de nas spyi lo 1996lo'i zla nga bcu par rgyal spyi'i brlan sa spyi chings rgyun las u yon nas zla ba 2pa'i tshes2de 'dzam gling brlan sa'i nyi mar gtan 'khel byas pa yin/ nyin der rgyal khab kyi tshan pa khag dang rgyal spyi'i rtsa la snyegs de bzhin mang tshogs bcas nas rnam pa 'dra min gyi byed sgo la nas brlan sa'i rin thang dang phan nus la dril bsgrags byed pa ma zad brlan sar srung skyob byed dgos kyi slob gsogatong ba'i srol zhig chags yod/gnyis pa/ 'dzam gling chu'i nyanas mo/dus tsho / zla ba 3pa'i tshes22nyin/— 404 —

ra yu nga ba kyi dril ba sa nga dra so'i mo gsal bshad/ spyi lo1993lo'i zla ba 1tshes18nyin mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogasakyi skabs47pa'i tshogs 'du'i gros ra las gong gas nyin de 'dzam gling ba nyin lagatan 'khel byas pa red/skabs de'i gas 'du'i thog bskyar du dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros don kyi sa bcad bco brgyad par gros bsdur dang zhi bas ga byas yod/sa bcad de'i gtso don ni thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i nang tshwa med kyi chu ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin la mi 'bor dang da྾ 'byor rim bzhin 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i spyi tshogs 'dir tshwa med ba dgos pa nyin re bzhin che ru 'gro gi yod/'dzam gling gi rgyal khab dang sa cha mang por ༅ thon khungs nyams rgyud du song bas dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang mi'i bde thang gi 'tsho bar dka' ngalarṣa po yod par brten sa khul dang rgyal khab/ rgyal spyi'i sa gzhung dbar bcas kyis mu mthud chu la srung skyob dang ba thon khungs lugs mthun bed spyod byed rgyur slob gsodang dril bsgrags byed rgyu o/skabs de'i gas 'du'i gtso don khag gsham ga྾/gcig dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros don gyi sa bcad bco brgyad pa'i bsams gzhir bzung nas lo re'i zab 3 pa'i tshes22de 'dzam gling tsho nyin mor gtan 'khol byas pa dang /gnyis/ rgyal khab khag gi rang rang gi gnas tshul la gzhigs nas nyin der byed sgo 'dra min sbom du nas spyod mangs kyi go rtogs gong mthor gtong rgyu/gsum/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi drung yig nas nyin der rgyal khang khag la rgyab skyor gyis byed sgo khag spel / thubs byed rgyu1— 405 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babazhi/ rgyun sring 'phel rgyas u yon lhan khang nas las don dang char gzhi gang rung la gtan 'khel dang lag bstar byed skabs dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gros don gyi sa bcad bco rgyad pa de gtso bor 'jog dgos pa'i bsam char bton yod/ gzhan yang 1988lor krung hwa med mangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi chu khrims bzos pa dang / chu bed pu'u nas lo re'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes1nas7bar krung go'i ba gza' khor du gtan 'khol byas/ de nas1994lor de'i dus po de zla ba 3pa'i tshes22nas28bar la bsgyur pa red/gsumaXpa/ 'dzam gling sa dkyilaXnyin mo/dus chos/ zla nga 4pa'i tshes22nyin/gas bshad/ spyi lo1970lo'i zla ba 4pa'i tshes22nyin/a ri'i ha 'ur slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma tan nye san ha da zhes pas grosa'ago bton nas khor yug srung skyob kyi byed sgo sgrig tshogs byas pa der rgyal yongs kyi slob ma dang mang tshogs mang po zhugs pa de ni yod kyil nyin mo'i thog mde red/ spyi lo 1990lo nas bzung rang rgyal du'ang byed sgo de spela'ago brtsams pa red/bzhi pa/ 'dzam glingaXthang nod 'gog bcos nyin mo/dus po/ zla ba 6pa'i tshes17nyin/— 406 —

ra yu nga ba kyi la ba sa nga thos yogs shad/ spyi lo1994lo'i zab 6tshes17nyin rang rgyalas pa'i rgyalakhab brgya lhag tsam gyis〈than pa dang thang rgod 'gog bcos kyi spyo྾sa〉thog ming rtags bkod pa dang / spyi lo1994lo'i zab 12pa'i tshes19nyinamanyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi skabs49pa'i tshogs 'dus zab6pa'i ྾17nyin de 'dzam gling thang rgod 'gog bcos nyin mor gtan 'ab byas pa red/lnga pa/ 'dzam gling mi 'bor nyin mo/dus ga/ zla ba 7pa'i tshes11nyin/g.yo bshad/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis1988lo nas bzung lo re'i zang 7pa'i tshes11nyin de 'dzam gling ka' bor nyin mor gtan 'khel byas te 'dzam gling rgyal khang khag dang mang gas za mas mi 'bor gyi gnad don lado snang yong ra yin/ rang rgyal gyi ka' bor nyin gsab 6pa'i tshes11yin/drug pa/ 'dzam gling srog chags nyan mo/dus po/ zab10pa'i tshes4nyin/lo brgya lhag tsam gyi sngon las ta li'i chos spel mkhan pho ran kun zhes pasazang 10pa'i tshes4nyid srog ༅sa la dga' skyong byed dgos skor gyi byed sgo ྾ba dang / de rjes mi rnams kyis khong gi bya spyod la dran gsodang mi'i rigs— 407 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra nga bkyi srog chags la gces skyong byed pa'i srol bzang rgyun 'khyongs yong rṣa lore'i zla nga 10pa'i tshes4srog gas nyin la gtan 'khel byas pa red/bdun pa/ rgyal spyi'i skyes dngos nyin mo/dus ga/ zla ba 12pa'i tshes29nyin/gsal bshad/ 1993lo'i zla ba 12pa'i tshes29nyin nas bzung / skyesadangos ste mang gi spyi chings dngos su nus pa thon pa dang / mnyam 'brel rgyalatshogs kyis nyin der dran gso yong ra spyi lo 1995lo nas bzung lo ltar gyi nyin de rgyal spyi'i skyes dngos nyin mor gtan 'khel byas pa red/brgyad pa/ 'dzam gling gnam gshis nyin mo/dus ra/ zla ba 3pa'i tshes23nyin/1950lo'i zla ba 3pa'i tshes23nyin 'dzam gleng gnam gshis rtsa tshogs de btsugs pa dang / gnam gshis spyi chings yang lo de nas nus pa thon 'go tshugs/ nyin der dran gas yong rṣa 'dzam gling gnam gshis rtsa yogasakyes1960lo nas gong gsal nyin de 'dzam gling gnam gshis nyin mor gtan 'khel byas/ — 408 —

ra yu nga ba kyi la ba sa nga so'i nyi mo dgu pa/ 'dzam gling du med nyan mo/dus ra/ zla ba 5 pa'i tshes31nyin/gas bshad/ 'dzam gling 'phrod bsten rtsa tshogs kyis198lor zab5pa'i tshes31nyin de 'dzam gling du med nyin logatan 'a྾byas pa de du bas(tha mag)mi'i bde thang la gnod 'tshe yod par dran skul byed za yin/bcu pa/ 'dzam gling rdor yug nyin mo/dus po/ zla ba 6pa'i tshes5nyin/spyi lo 1972lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes5nas16bar mnyam 'brel rgyal gas kyisasithon khor po grong khyer du khor yug gas 'du skong tshogs byas par rgyal khab113nas srid gzhung dang 'brel yod sku tshab phebs yod/ gas 'du'i thog 'dzam gling khor yug gnad don dang rjes sor khor yug bsrung skyob byed rgyu'i thabs jus sogs la zhib khug byas pa dang / gas 'du'i thog mnyayo'abrel rgyal tshogs kyis mi'i rigs kyi khor yug gas 'du'i bsgrags gtayozhes pa gtan la phab pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling khor yug bsrung skyob byed rgyu'i bya spyod kyi 'kho gzhi bzos pa red/ donas1972lo'i zab 10pa'i nang mnyam 'brel rgyal gas kyi skabs27pa'i gas 'du'i thog lo re'i zla ba6pa'i tshes5de khor yug nyin mor gtan 'jigs pa red/— 409 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga babace gcig pa/ kung go'i saXzhing nyinaXmo/dus po/ zla ba 6pa'i tshes25nyin/1991lo'i zla ba 5pa'i tshes24nyin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang skabs 83pa'i rgyun las tshogs 'dus lo re'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes25de klung go'i sa zhing nyin mor gtan 'khel byas te spyi dmangs tshang mas sa zhing la gces skyong byed rgyur skul 'ded gtong rgyu yin pa red/ bce gnyisaXpa/ dku dbyang rim par spung skyob byed pa'i nyin mo/dus po/ zla ba 9pa'i tshes16nyin/gsal bshad/ spyi lo 1987lo'i zla ba9pa'i ches16nyin khan ṭar rgyal khang 46gis dku dbyang rim pa'i dngos rdzas zad gron skor gyi ra yig thog ming rtags bkod de rim bzhin dku dbyang rim par srung skyob byed pa'i zhib phra'i las ka 'go brtsams pa dang mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis nyin de 'dzam gling dku dbyang rim pa srung skyob byed pa'i nyin mor gtan 'khel byas/bcu gsum pa/ 'dzamaXgling zas kyiXnyin mo/dus po/ zla ba 10pa'i tshes16nyin/— 410 —

ra yu nga ba kyi la ba sa nga so'i nyi mo gas bshad/ mnyam 'brel rgyal gas kyis lo re'i zab10pa'i ྾16de 'dzam gling zas kyi nyin mor gtan 'khel byas te mi rnams kyis zas rigasalagron chung byed rgyur skul ded byed rgyu red/bcu bzhi pa/ 'dzam gling gtsang ma bzo ba'iXbyed sgo'i nyin mo/dus po/ lo re'i zab 9pa'i gza' 'khor gsum pa'i gza' pa sangs nas nyi ma bar/gsal bshad/ byed sgo de thog mar yod khru lo ya'i gta'i ni gtsang ma bzo rgyu zhes pa'i byed sgo las byung nga zhig red/ da ta'i ni gtsang ma bzo rgyu zhesapa'i byed sgo de 1989lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes8nyin ba bded/ de nas1993lonas bzung mnyam 'brel rgyal gas kyis byed sgo de 'dzam glingagatsang ma bzo rgyu'i byed sgor ming sgyur ba dang 'dzam gling rgyal khang mang posalo ltar byed sgo de rang rang gi rgyal khab du spel ba'i srol gas yod pa bcasaso/— 411 —
zhar byung lnga pa/ bod kyi da yod rang byung spung skyob khul/
rte ༄ —'ing ba —— 'a ko za'
bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra nga ba — 414 —
zhar byung drug pa/ bod du snga rjes su btsugs sgong pa'i rang byung spung skyob khul/— 415 —
ga / /
jo snga rjes ba sa rtsong pa'i rang nga za — 417 —
bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga ba— 418 —

zhar byung bdun pa/ mche'u gnyis dmigs bsal chus kyi ri skyes srog chags la srung skyongs (sgrob )dang /do dam la shugs sgon/ dril bsgrags slob gso don 'khyol byed rgyu'i skor gyi spyi lo 2003lo'i 'gan 'khri'i yi ge dang bo/ ri skyes srog chagasaXl srung sgrobs (skyob )byed rgyu'i don snying skor/gcig ri skyes srog chags la srung skyobs(skyob )byed rgyu ni gcig nas rgyal khab kyi don chen yin pa dang gnyis nas rang rgyal krung hwa midamangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mtshan snyan la thugs pa'i don chen zhig kyang red/ lhag par du bod kyi rtsod (gtsod )dang rkyang / 'brong bcas gsum ni (la )rgya che'i (mang tshogs kyis)do 'khur chen po byed gyi (kyi )yod pa red/gnyis/ ri skyes srog chags la srung skyobs(skyob )byed rgyu ni rang rgyal gyi mkhor ('khor )yug mdzes ljongs la phan thog yod pa'i bya spyod zhig — 420 —

ma la mis bsal la ri sa sro chas la nga bal sa rared/ sa thog gi srog gas dang rtsi shing skyes ( skye dngos bcas ni mkhor 'khor yug mdzes ljongs kyi yid du 'ongs lo rgyan cha zhig red lamirabs rjes mi'i ma'i bde skyid skrunas zhig kyang red/gsum/ ri skyes srog gsal srung skyobs ( skyong te byed rgyu ni rgyalakhang kyi rgyu nor red b.rang rgyal spyi 'bangs yongs kyi mthun mongs ( thun mong kyi lha nor yang red byas tsang de mi sger rang nyid gyi kyi dpala'abyor kholas la zhig gzhigs te nas gang byung du nas tsho rgyas pa dang rkusagasod sogs byas tshe rgyal khab dang mthun mongs ( thun mong gis rdo gi rgyu nor la rkus gzod byas parang red/der brten srid gzhung rim pa khag dang mi 'bangs yongs kyi ri skyesasrog ༅sa la srung skyobs ( skyob byed rgyu de 'gas 'khri red la 'os 'gan yang yin/gnyis ba/ ri skyes srog chags kyi la srung skyongs byed mi rgyu'i bya thabs dang lag len bstar thabs skor/gcig ri skyes srog chags la srung skyob yag po yongs rdo yong la shang dang tshun rang nyid kyi spyi 'bangs khrod ri skyes srog ༅sa mngon rngon rgyag byed rgyu la bkag 'gog byed dgos bas zad phyi mis ri skyes srog la salamangon rngon rgyag byed rgyu la bkag 'gog dang blta skul nan po byed dgos dang 'gan la 'i nang don dmangs yongs la dril sgrag yag po byas—42 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra yu nga banas phyi mis ri skyes srog chags la par len bdang blta skor byed pa sogasayongs(yong )tshe 'brel yod gong rim kyi lag mkhyer (khyer )med tshe gang byung gi (gis)par len pa dang blta skor sogs byed mi chog bkag 'gog byas kyang mnyan pa byung tshe dus thog du 'brel yod bde (sde )tshan la yar zhu byed dgos/gnyis/ ri skyes srog chags kyis mthon (thon )rdzas nyo tshong byed mkhan la srid gzhung rim pa dang spyi 'bangs yongs kyi (kyis)bkag 'gog nan po byed dgos/ khrim (khrims)'gal kyis sgo nas nag tshong byas tshe dusathog du thag gcod byed dgos la 'brel yod sde tshan la snyan zhu byed dgos/ri skyes srog chags kyis mthon (thon )rdzas nyo tshong byed mi chog zer (ces)ri skyes srog chags la srung skyob byed rgyu'i skor gyi rtsa khrims nang gas po po mkhod (khod )yod/gsum/ ri skyes srog chags kyi bsdod gnas dang khung po la bstor (gtor)skyon btang mi chog de snga shang kha shas dang grong tsho kha shas nang la ri skyes srog chags kyi bsdod (sdod )gnas la bstor (gtor )skyon btang nasarta ba dang 'phrul chas sogs bod spyad nas ri skyes srog ༅sa kyi bsdod (sdod )gnas la bstor (gtor )skyon gtong gyi yod pa red/ de ni dag (bdag )yod srog chags dang dag (bdag )med srog chags gang zhig yin rung sa cha de la gnas pa'i srog ༅sa yin pa de la dbang cha che chung med pa tshang ma rgyal khab dang spyi 'bangs gis(kyi )rgyu nor yin pa de la snang che chung med pa'i srid gzhung rim pa khag gi dril sgrag byed dgos la/ spyi 'bangs— 422 —

mtshe'u nyis mi sa bsal la ri sa sro cha sa la nga ba bya bas / rayongs kyis ngos 'dzin yang byed dgos/ de'i thad shang kha shad (shas)dang tshun kha shad (shas)srol dmangs khrim (khroms )dang tshun srol dmangs khrim (khrims)nang bcug yod de la shang tshang mas smig ga(mig dpe ) bltadagos/gsum pa/ bya dgag dang chad spyodaX(gcod )byed rgyu'i skor/gcig ri skyes srog chags la srung skyobs(skyob )byed pa'i nang grub 'bras dngos gsal yod mkhan la bya dga' sprod rgyu/④ri skyes srog ༅sal srung skyobs(skyob )byed rgyu'i rtsa khrims rim pa khag re re bzhin spyi 'ang ngas yongs la dril bsgrags byas yod pa/ ④ gdon mtshungs pa'i spyi 'bangs yongs kyi rtsa khrim (khrims)nang bsal(g.yo )tshang ma shes thub pa/④ kha don mtshungs pa'i srid gzhung rim pa brtar (ltar )gis(gyis)do dam byas nas spyi 'bangs khrod la ri skyes srog chagasamangon (rngon )rgyag byed pa yod tshe dus thog du gnas tshul shod pa/ ① ri skyes srog gas kyi mthon (thon )rdzas nyo tshong byed bdang bsdod (sdod )gnas la bstor (gtor )skyon btong (gtong )mkhan la dus thog tu thag gcod dus pa'i dngul de shang tshun rim pa sus lag bstar byas yod na de rang gi dag (bdag )rgyu/ ④ rtsod (gtsod )yod khris(khrid )yodang ngar rtsod (gtsod )'khrid sal da yod mo ṭa bkod sgrig byas pa'i shang gsum rgyun ring bskor (skong )skyod 'gro rgyu'i 'gan yo yod ba phud de min shang rnams— — 423 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga nga sa kyi ra ya nga b.rang rang gi sa khongs la yod pa'i ri dwags la blta zhing dang bskor skyod byed pa bcas la bya dga' yod/gnyis/ shang tshun gang yin rung khamakhas po (tshig)snyan bshad de bya spyod ngo ma mi ༅ mkhan la bya dga' med pa ma zad gnas྾ che tsam yod na 'gan 'khri rtsad gcod byed rgyu/ ④mngon (rngon )rgyag byed mkhan shesakyang yar zhu med pa do dam med pa/ ④ri skyes srog chags kyis mthon (thon )rdzas nyo tshong byed mkhan la do dam thag gcod med pa dang yar zhu med pa/ ④ri skyes srog chags kyi bsdod (sdod )gnas bstor (gtor )bshig gtong mkhan la do dmathag gcod med bdang yar zhu med pa/ ④phyi misari skyes srog chags la gang byung par rgyag pa dang blta skor byed pa la do dam thag gcod med pa dang yar zhu med pa bcas kyi gnas྾ la bya dga' med pa ma zad gnad don che rigs la 'gan 'khri rtsad gcod byed rgyu yin/bzhi pa/ chus nas shang grong bar dang shangs grong brdal nasagrong tsho bar/ grong tsho nas khyem tshang re re bar 'gan 'khri mings brtags (rtags)'god rgyu/dmigs bas༅nags las tshan pa'i 'gan 'khurd shang med mangs srid gzhung gi 'gan 'khurd grong tsho u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'khur ming rtags bkod pa'i dus ra 2༷02lo'i zla bal tshes—nyin/—424—

dpe skrun gsal bshad/〈bod kyi la rgyun rig gnas dang deng dus kyi khor yug srung spyob〉ces pa'i deb 'di ni rtsom ba pos yun ring gi khor yug srung skyob kyi las don gnang ba dang / deng dus kyi go la hril po'i khor yug gi gnad don de dza drag gi rang bzhin du gnas bzhin yod pa sogs la dmigs nas rtsom sgrig gnang ba zhig red/deb 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos dang thog bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnasadang la goms gshis lugs kyis dngos shugs rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas khor yug srung skyob kyi las don la nus pa chen po thon yod pa'i bden dpang khungs 'dren gnang yod pa dang chabs gcig de thad kyi brtsam bya dang shod rgyun sogs mang po zhig drangs nas bod mi rigs kyi mes po chos lo rgyus kyi dus yun ring po'i nang khor yug srung skyob kyi las don thad 'jog gnang mdzad pa'i byas rjes rnams rim par bkod yod/gzhan yang khor yug gi gnad don de 'dzam gleng thog dza drag rang bzhin gyi gnas bab cig tu slebs yod pa des mis gtsos pa'i 'gro ba'i 'tsho sdod kyi gnas bab la 'jigs nyen bzo bzhin yod pa'i skor dang / khor yug srung skyob kyi las don de 'dzam gling thog tul mus yin pa'i skor — 1 —

bo kyi srol ri sa nga ngeng sa kyi ra yu zang babakod yod pa ma zad/ 'brel yod bod kyi khor yug gnad don dang khor yug srung skyong kyi las don skor/ de bzhin bod ljongs sa mtho'i ri skyes srog chags kyi rigs dang / grangs 'bor/ gnas yul/ 'tsho sdod gnas bab/rgyal khab kyi srung skyob rim pa gang yin pa sogs kyi skor zhib par gzhung drangs khungs skyel gyi sgo nas 'god gnang mdzad 'dugamador na deb 'di rtsom sgrig dang dpe skrun zhu thung pa 'dis bod kyi deng dus kyi brtsam bya'i nang nas khor yug srung skyong kyi skor gsal bar bton pa'i gleng brjod kyi stong cha kha bskong byed thub pa ma zad/ bod kyi khor yug dang ri skyes srog chags kyi gnas bab ha cang thabs sdug yin pa dang / der srung skyob byed rgyu'i las don de mi tshang ma'i 'dor med 'os 'gan zhig yin pa de shes rtogs thub pa zhig yong rgyur phan thogs yong rgyu yin pa ma zad de 'brel kyi zhib 'jug dang las don gnang mi tshor dpyad gzhi nus pa chen po thon rgyu yin pa bcas/mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas/
